jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.excerpt: Viget is an independent digital agency that has been designing and building digital products and platforms since 1999.
jobs.description:
Viget is an independent digital agency that has been designing and building digital products and platforms since 1999. Our culture is ideal for lifelong learners seeking a variety of meaningful work, supportive collaboration with positive teammates, and a healthy work/life balance. We work from four offices (hybrid) and remote locations throughout the U.S., and enjoy a proven cadence of virtual and in-person meetings and retreats to build camaraderie and stay connected. We work with tech companies (like Robinhood and SpectrumAi), non-profits (like World Wildlife Fund and NPF), and consumer brands (like Stern Pinball and ESPN).
As a Product Manager at Viget, you’ll work on a variety of projects, including complex content and ecommerce sites, but most importantly custom software products. You’ll facilitate product design sprints, define and prioritize requirements, collaborate with our brilliant designers and developers to design and build products, lead quality assurance, and celebrate launches.
At Viget, Product Managers are experts in building digital products. They work collaboratively with clients (often startups) to understand organization goals, define solutions, answer hard questions, and ensure the overall quality of a product. They facilitate product planning and discovery, lead requirements gathering and feature definition, oversee technical delivery (working closely with our engineers), and conduct QA. They have a technical acumen and effectively collaborate with both internal teams and clients on technical matters.

Here are a few examples of the kind of work you’d lead:

  • Bringing a Series B-funded clean energy startup’s established web-based product to native mobile with a team of product designers and React Native developers;
  • Taking a founder’s idea for Optify from concept to prototype to a well-defined product equipped with a name and brand strategy;
  • Partnering with SpectrumAi to design and build Twyll, a modern clinical session-management tool that enables ABA therapists to capture real-time data, and streamline documentation.

Here's what we are looking for:

  • You have worked in a fast-paced software development environment before, either at an agency or product company, though agency experience is preferred.
  • You know how the web works and how a web app works, which means you’re aware of technical constraints when talking to clients. You don’t hesitate to ask a lot of questions in order to define the functionality of what we’re building.
  • You can break down a set of wireframes into actionable tasks for back-end and front-end developers. You’re passionate about finding innovative, efficient, and effective ways to document those tasks.
  • You can shepherd often-vague client requests and ideas through the definition process. You know when to rely on a product designer, but you’re comfortable thinking through logic and creating useful documentation of that logic.
  • You’re able to describe workflows and tasks purely from an end user’s perspective, helping developers make informed implementation decisions.
  • You’ve performed QA. You can distinguish a bug from a functional update from a new feature request. You don’t write merely good bug reports. You write better bug reports – or, at least, that’s your goal each and every time.
  • You have 2 to 10 years of professional experience in a product management role, ideally within an agency.

Project Management at Viget:

  • The project management team at Viget includes two roles:
  • Project Managers own planning, management, and delivery of a variety of project types, including marketing sites, content sites, e-commerce sites, and custom software efforts.
  • Product Managers specialize in the discovery, technical planning, management, and delivery of digital products and custom software.

Everyone at Viget:

  • Embodies our core values of integrity, work ethic, collaboration, creativity, and lifelong learning.
  • Values mentorship, learning, and sharing knowledge.
  • Writes and speaks clearly and effectively when collaborating with teammates and clients.
  • Believes in and supports our commitment to building a diverse and inclusive company.

Compensation and Benefits:

  • Annual base salary of $75,000 - $105,000 (mid level) or $95,000 to $125,000 (senior) per year depending on skills and experience
  • Additional comp available via spot performance bonuses, sales referrals, and new hire referrals
  • 401(k) retirement plan matching up to 4%
  • 100% company-paid health and dental coverage for you and your family
  • Stipends for wellness (apps, gyms, etc.) and connectivity (mobile phone or home internet)
  • 15 days PTO (20 after 2 years), 9 paid holidays, and 2 community service days per year
  • Up to $2,000/year in conference and training (professional development) budget

How to Apply:

Apply by completing the application form. We expect you may use AI for research, prep, and proofreading during the job application process. We use AI daily and believe that building AI skills is essential, but at this stage we need to get to know you. To that end, unless directed otherwise, we expect you will not submit AI-generated answers or assignments (writing, coding, designing) nor use AI for real-time help during interviews. Using AI tools to misrepresent your knowledge, ability, or experience is unethical. It’s also impractical and short-sighted since once you’re in the role you’ll often need to think and communicate in real-time without AI help. As a small team with high standards for quality and, above all, integrity, we ask that you write your own application answers, submit work that reflects the real you, and share openly how you used AI in the application process if at all.
We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications and are actively seeking people from underrepresented groups to join our team.
Before you apply, learn more about us on LinkedIn, Instagram, Flickr, X, Vimeo, and by exploring .
Viget maintains a drug-free workplace. We are unable to offer work visa sponsorship at this time.
Viget is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where all of us feel valued and heard. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ancestry, socioeconomic status, religion, mental or physical disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. jobs.title: Cybersecurity Engineer
jobs.excerpt: About XTELXTEL is a leader in advanced, AI-driven solutions for consumer goods companies, combining cutting- edge technology, industry expertise, and data management to accelerate profitable revenue growth and value realization.
jobs.description:
About XTEL

XTEL is a leader in advanced, AI-driven solutions for consumer goods companies, combining cutting- edge technology, industry expertise, and data management to accelerate profitable revenue growth and value realization.

Position Overview

XTEL is hiring a Cybersecurity Engineer to strengthen XTEL’s security posture across our platform, applications, and Microsoft environment. You’ll join a growing Security & Compliance team that already maintains a mature compliance foundation (ISO 27001:2022, SOC 2 Type 2, SOC 1 Type 2, ISAE 3402) and an established GRC function, alongside a managed SOC, an IT team, and a Cloud Operations team.

This is a very hands-on role where you’ll lead vulnerability management, work with Engineering and Product to embed security into the SDLC, partner with IT & Cloud Operations to continuously harden our Microsoft environments, and drive triage and remediation of issues surfaced by our SOC. Because you’ll work alongside existing IT, Cloud Operations, and GRC capabilities, success depends on collaboration and influence as much as technical depth.

The ideal candidate must be proactive and self-directed: actively seeking out opportunities to improve security across the organization and able to operate effectively with limited guidance and oversight.

Key Responsibilities

  • Vulnerability management. Own intake, triage, risk-based prioritization, remediation tracking, validation, SLAs, and reporting across our Azure environments (dev, test, prod, and customer-facing) and the development pipeline.

  • Secure SDLC & CI/CD. Partner with Engineering, Product, and QA to continually improve secure development practices:

  1. Pipeline security and security gates in CI/CD.

  2. SAST, DAST, IAST, dependency/software composition (SCA), and code scanning.

  3. Secure code review practices, threat modeling, and security requirements in design.

  • Microsoft environment hardening. Work continuously with IT to further secure infrastructure - identity and access management, endpoint protections, M365 controls, and configuration/hardening baselines.

  • SOC-driven remediation. Coordinate and drive triage and remediation for alerts, incidents, and vulnerabilities reported by XTEL’s SOC, including root cause follow up.

  • Penetration testing. Coordinate external penetration tests (scope, execution support, findings management, retesting and closure), and conduct internal testing.

  • Patch management. Support patch management processes and verification in partnership with IT and Cloud Operations.

  • Cloud security partnership. Partner with Cloud Operations on Azure security architecture, secure-by-design patterns, CSPM, secrets management, and network security.

  • Compliance & audit support. Support security audits and continuous compliance (ISO 27001, SOC 1, SOC 2 Type 2, ISAE 3402), including evidence collection and control improvement.

  • Cross-functional enablement. Translate security findings into clear, actionable guidance for engineers and into evidence and inputs for the GRC function.

  • Continuous improvement. Proactively identify and act on opportunities to raise the security bar across the organization.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 3+ years in cybersecurity engineering, security operations, DevSecOps, or security-focused IT (cloud-native SaaS experience strongly preferred, ideally on Azure).

  • Vulnerability management: Proven track record running vulnerability management beyond scanning - prioritizing and driving remediation to closure across teams.

  • Application & SDLC security: Working knowledge of AppSec and SDLC controls (CI/CD security, SAST/DAST/IAST/SCA, secure code review) and the ability to embed security without slowing delivery.

  • Microsoft environment: Hands-on experience securing Microsoft environments (Entra ID, Intune, Conditional Access, endpoint protections, M365 controls).

  • Cloud security: Working knowledge of Azure security services and cloud security posture management.

  • Self-direction: Ability to work independently, set priorities, and build or mature programs in a lean environment with limited guidance.

  • Communication & ownership: Strong communicator who can drive work and build trust across Engineering, Product, Cloud Operations, IT, and Compliance.

  • English: English proficiency

Nice to have:

  • Familiarity operating within an ISO 27001 / SOC 2 environment and supporting audits.

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code and securing CI/CD at scale.

  • Hands-on penetration testing or offensive security experience (e.g., OSCP).

  • Experience with compliance automation tooling (e.g., Drata).

  • Relevant certifications (e.g., GIAC, CISSP, AZ-500, SC-200, SC-300).

Who You Are:

  • Proactive and self-starting - you find work that needs doing and do it without waiting to be told.

  • Pragmatic and risk-based - you focus effort where it reduces the most risk and balance security with delivery.

  • Collaborative - you achieve outcomes through influence across teams you don’t manage.

Geographical Location:

  • Belgium, Leuven.

  • Europe Remote

What We Offer

  • Remote or Hybrid working set-up 🏡

  • Flexible working hours;⌚

  • Competitive Salary Package and Bonus scheme;💸

  • A challenging role in a fast-growing AI-driven company; 🪄

  • A diverse and international team with strong ownership and a can-do mentality.🌏

  • Opportunities to contribute meaningfully to the organization’s growth and development.🚀

Equal Opportunities Statement

If you have strengths to share, we’d love to hear from you. We value diverse backgrounds and experiences, so don’t hesitate to apply even if you don’t meet all criteria.

XTEL is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

jobs.excerpt: Treat PeteDME’s MSK Integrated Care patients from home.
jobs.description:
Treat PeteDME’s MSK Integrated Care patients from home. Our program pairs knee and lumbar bracing with physical therapy and remote therapeutic monitoring, delivered through a network of in-home therapists. Remote visits and monitoring are paid per visit and per call.

How you join
Every therapist on the remote caseload starts with six in-person brace fittings on patients from your own current caseload, so you know the devices you will be coaching patients on. Each fitting is a paid clinical visit — intake, fitting, and follow-up — at a flat fee agreed in writing before your first patient. We give you a one-page screening tool to identify candidates among the patients you already see, and we handle the prescription, benefit verification, and the paperwork.

This is not a sales role. We do not ask you to refer; you treat patients you already see.

After six fittings
Teletherapy patient referrals from PeteDME begin: our patients, work from home, on your schedule, paid per visit and per call.

What you get
• Free specialized training and certification in orthopedic bracing.
• AI-generated SOAP notes — no new EMR to learn.
• Keep your current job. This is additional, independent-contractor work alongside it.
• Flat fees fixed in advance; no part of your pay depends on volume or on referrals.

Requirements

    • Active physical therapist or physical therapist assistant license in the state where you practice.
    • Currently working in home health or another in-home setting.
    • You evaluate and provide treatment.

How to apply

    Complete the short questionnaire. It asks about your license, your setting, and your caseload, and it asks you to acknowledge that teletherapy referrals begin after six fittings. A clinical onboarding specialist will reach out within one business day.

Requirements

Strategics Analytics Manager (Marketing Measurement Partner)

Job Details

Role: Strategic Analytics Manager (Marketing Measurement Partner)
Department: Data & Measurement
Job Location: Remote (Canada)
Role Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Hours: Monday - Friday 9AM-5PM (in your timezone, flexible hours)
Compensation: $109,000 - $147,000 CAD + Profit Sharing (after 1 year of employment) + Benefits
Role Availability: This posting is for an existing vacancy at Thrive Digital

As a company that values inclusion and diversity, Thrive seeks individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply!

About Thrive

Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar.

Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon.

Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of - together.

The Role

Joining Thrive’s Data & Measurement department as Strategic Analytics Manager, you’ll own Strategic Analytics / Marketing Measurement workflows that drive growth across our clients marketing programs. You’ll partner with internal media teams and client marketing teams by providing measurement consultation and delivering technical insights that inform business decisions. You’ll be a core part of our lift experimentation program, leading client lift tests from design through execution to final presentation. You’ll also support clients and media teams with broader data and measurement capabilities, including measurement reporting, customer or event-level analysis, or media mix modelling, and help shape the evolution of Thrive’s strategic marketing measurement service.

Your focus will of responsibilities will be:

  • Domain: Own marketing measurement outcomes through strategic and technical lenses, from scoping client objectives, to executing analysis and presenting insights. This will involve designing and executing geo lift tests, building analyses and insights reporting, and consulting client and internal teams on the right measurement approaches.
  • Client: Be the measurement lead across client partnerships, working with paid media teams to turn data into insights and decisions that clients can act on.
  • People: Serve as a strategic translator between data and marketing teams, supporting product feedback loops, identifying gaps, and driving integrated project success. Contribute to Thrive’s knowledge across marketing measurement and strategic analytics by educating non-technical stakeholders.
  • Company: Build Thrive's capacity to lead marketing measurement strategy by refining playbooks, sharing knowledge, and strengthening cross-department roadmaps and systems. Support our Data & Measurement department’s broader service and product evolution to drive stronger marketing analytics insights, tools and strategy across our client roster.

We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role:

  • In your first 30 days you’ll focus on learning Thrive’s systems, building relationships with your team, and understanding our current operating model. You’ll immerse yourself in existing or onboarding client workflows and begin to get acquainted with our in-house measurement solutions across lift experimentation and media mix modelling.
  • In your first 60 days you’ll begin to support Strategic Analytics / Measurement client workflows across geo lift experimentation, custom reporting and analysis, and measurement consultation.
  • In your first 90 days you’ll begin to own Strategic Analytics / Measurement client workflows to advance insights and measurement outcomes. You’ll collaborate with the Data & Measurement team on priority initiatives across measurement service evolution and incoming client partnerships.

Qualifications

  • Marketing Measurement Expertise: You have deep experience with marketing measurement tools, advertising privacy, lift experimentation, attribution, and/or media mix modelling. You understand which data and signals matter most for marketing investment decisions.
  • Growth Marketing Acumen: You're fluent in marketing metrics and unit economics across ecommerce and/or B2B demand generation (e.g., ROAS, CPA, CPM, CAC, LTV, ROI, brand lift, MQL/SQL) and apply them in your analysis and consulting.
  • Technical Data Rigour: You use data to uncover root causes and challenge assumptions, leveraging SQL, Python, and LLMs to troubleshoot discrepancies and build custom analyses and reporting.
  • Consultative Influence: You have a proven track record of influencing marketing executives, gaining buy-in on complex measurement approaches, and translating data into actionable business decisions.
  • Curiosity & Adaptability: You thrive in fast-moving environments, embrace evolving methods and services, and see change as an opportunity to grow.

---

Equal Opportunity Employer

Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued.

This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process.

Competitive Total Compensation Package

At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more!

The Use of Artificial Intelligence

Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent.

Hiring Eligibility by Location

While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship.

Beware of Hiring Scams

Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

Thrive is a remote-first company with team members working across multiple regions. We recognize and respect the Indigenous histories of the lands where our team lives and works.

About Business Financial Group

Business Financial Group (BFG) provides accounting, tax, payroll, and financial advisory services to U.S. businesses. We are seeking an experienced Fractional CFO to support a client engagement delivered through a partner advisory firm.

Role overview

The Fractional CFO will strengthen the client’s weekly cash flow visibility, improve forecasting reliability, and provide clear financial analysis for management decisions. This hands-on advisory role requires close coordination with the partner firm, BFG’s Fractional Controller, and the client’s accounting team. The professional will progressively assume leadership of recurring cash flow meetings under the partner firm’s oversight.

Key responsibilities

Cash flow and liquidity oversight

  • Review bank balances, expected customer collections, vendor payments, debt obligations, and other near-term cash commitments; identify liquidity risks and decisions requiring management attention.

  • Prepare a concise, one-page weekly cash flow summary before the scheduled Monday review meeting, with practical recommendations and follow-up actions.

  • Participate in weekly cash flow reviews and progressively lead the discussions in line with the agreed transition plan.

Forecasting and financial data reliability

  • Review and maintain financial projections in Clockwork, perform weekly forecast-to-bank tie-outs, and investigate material differences between projected and actual cash balances.

  • Review recurring obligations, assumptions, and forecast mappings; coordinate corrections with the Fractional Controller and monitor reconciliation against agreed variance tolerances.

  • Monitor the timeliness and completeness of customer invoices and vendor bills in QuickBooks Online (QBO). Escalate material delays affecting forecasts to the partner firm on the same business day.

Financial analysis and financing support

  • Support the Fractional Controller with analytical reviews of loan balances, advances, repayments, accrued interest, and inventory balances; identify discrepancies and their reporting implications.

  • Coordinate a financing support package comprising trailing twelve-month profit and loss, current balance sheet, year-to-date financial statements, debt schedule, accounts receivable aging, and a 13-week cash flow projection.

  • Review the package for apparent inconsistencies and submit it to the partner firm for review and authorization before external distribution.

Action tracking and collaboration

  • Maintain the 90-day financial action tracker before each weekly meeting, documenting progress, overdue actions, dependencies, and decisions needed.

  • Coordinate financial findings and executive communications with the partner firm; work effectively within its branding and client communication arrangements.

  • Maintain confidentiality, document work and recommendations, track time against the agreed allocation, and promptly flag additional capacity needs.

Required qualifications and experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or a related discipline.

  • Substantial progressive finance experience, including responsibility as a CFO, Fractional CFO, Finance Director, or equivalent senior financial advisor serving U.S. businesses.

  • Demonstrated hands-on expertise in cash flow management, short-term liquidity planning, financial forecasting, and explaining forecast variances.

  • Strong working knowledge of QBO, financial statements, U.S. accounting practices, debt schedules, and accounts receivable and payable analysis.

  • Experience with Clockwork or comparable forecasting software, with the ability to work independently in Clockwork following onboarding; strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.

  • Clear professional English, confidence leading management discussions, sound judgment, and the ability to turn financial findings into practical recommendations.

  • Ability to deliver reliably within a limited monthly allocation, attend recurring meetings, and respond promptly during agreed communication windows.

Preferred qualifications

  • CPA, CMA, CA, MBA in Finance, or a comparable professional qualification.

  • Experience preparing lender reporting packages, supporting financing applications, and advising businesses with liquidity constraints.

  • Experience with inventory-based businesses, manufacturing, beverage production, or spirits; familiarity with Proof 8 is an advantage.

  • Prior fractional advisory or outsourced finance experience and collaboration through Slack and shared Google Drive workspaces.

Working relationships and scope

The role focuses on cash flow advisory, forecasting oversight, and financial analysis. The Fractional Controller retains ownership of month-end close, accounting reconciliations, and adjustments. The partner firm retains the client relationship, overall financial strategy, financing negotiations, long-term planning, and exit advisory. Additional responsibilities require an agreed scope change.

CAMH is the lead for the coordination and administration of 9-8-8, the new national three-digit number for suicide prevention in Canada, that launched on November 30, 2023. 9-8-8 is Canada’s official three-digit national helpline for suicide prevention and emotional distress. This ground-breaking service is available 24/7/365 and accessible to everyone from coast to coast to coast.

The 9-8-8 National Hub plays a pivotal role in providing front-line service for the 9-8-8 Suicide Crisis Helpline. The 9-8-8 National Hub provides 24/7 service via phone and text modalities.

We are currently seeking a full-time, permanent 9-8-8 Hub Training Coordinator to join the National Hub training team. This role involves training new responders, implementing quality assurance measures, conducting performance assessments, offering real-time coaching, and fostering a positive and inclusive work environment. The training coordinator will collaborate with the supervision team and hub leadership to enhance service delivery and professional development opportunities for responders and supervisors.

This role has significant relationships and responsibilities outside the Agile team, including working with other Product Owners, Product Managers or Operational Leaders, HGB Associates, Business Owners, and other stakeholders. This role serves as the integral connector between business or operational functions and technology.

Job Description:

The Senior Product Owner is responsible for having a deep understanding of how and which technology platforms and tools are used by HGB associates in the respective operational area they support. This understanding serves as the foundation for improving technology that increases the value of products and services indirectly and/or directly to HGB customers. This understanding occurs through either being a user of this technology or learning through other users. Critical thinking, problem solving, and keen listening skills are required for this role



Once this understanding is achieved, the Senior Product Owner is responsible for engaging with the Product Manager or Operational Leader to learn priorities and pressing needs of the operational team. The Senior Product Owner is then positioned to serve as a representative of the operational team to define and prioritize requirements, initiatives, and/or user stories with the Agile Team. This will require work assignments that are moderately complex to complex where the analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors.

As part of the prioritization process, the Senior Product Owner is responsible for preparing and participating in for Program Increments. This includes briefing the Product Manager and/or Operational Leader and other Clinical Operations Leaders on the recommended program vision, roadmap, and content presentations.

Once the Program Increment is complete, the Product Owner is responsible for iteration and program execution which includes, but is not limited to maintaining team backlog; iteration planning; accepting user stories; assisting with decision making related to sequencing of work; ensuring and facilitating adequate user testing prior to push to production; and coordinating with other Product Owners as needed. Included in this phase is supporting and/or producing the system demonstration of the fulfillment of the user stories for various stakeholders.

While performing in this role, the Senior Product Owner must possess excellent communication skills with all stakeholders to ensure the right product is being built, in the right order, within budget and by the deadline. The Senior Product Owner monitors progress throughout the feature life-cycle, working closely with the operational team to resolve questions and challenges, reduce risk to contract standards and minimize delays. The Senior Product Owner will serve as the Agile team's primary contact for information, work prioritization, and decision-making while also reporting back to the Product Manager and/or Operational Leader to report progress and to ensure alignment.

1. Works with business teams, scrum master, product managers, Clinical Operations leaders and other HGB teams on understanding and communicating the business needs and priorities. This effort will also include document demands in ServiceNow or designated system. 20%

3. Participates in the daily, weekly, and monthly scrum team activities by articulating IT needs and requirements, writing features and stories, works prioritizations, obtains product manager alignment on features, stories, and prioritization, makes critical decisions, and builds the backlog for their product. 60%

  • Problem solver who can find viable solutions that meets business needs, absent from all ideal tools and resources.

  • Must be passionate about contributing to an organization focused on continuously improving consumer experiences


Use your skills to make an impact

  • Communicate product progress, decisions, tradeoffs, and results clearly to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Understand how campaign, audience, media, placement, spend, pacing, performance, and measurement data flows across systems and informs product decisions.

  • 6+ years of experience in technical product management, product management, technology consulting, software development, data, analytics, or a related field.

At Commerce, our mission is to empower businesses to innovate, grow, and thrive with our open, AI-driven commerce ecosystem. As the parent company of BigCommerce, Feedonomics, and Makeswift, we connect the tools and systems that power growth, enabling businesses to unlock the full potential of their data, deliver seamless and personalized experiences across every channel, and adapt swiftly to an ever-changing market. We believe in harnessing AI responsibly to unlock new possibilities, and we’re looking for individuals who use it intentionally to solve problems, accelerate outcomes, and expand what’s possible in their role. If you want to be part of a team of bold builders, sharp thinkers, and technical trailblazers who shape the future of commerce, this is the place for you.

We are seeking a commercially minded, proactive Customer Success Manager (CSM) to own and grow a portfolio of named customer relationships with direct accountability to Net Revenue Retention (NRR) as the primary performance metric and core OKR.


This role is responsible for driving customer outcomes across the full customer lifecycle — from onboarding and adoption through retention, renewal, expansion, and advocacy. Customer Retention & Revenue Growth

jobs.excerpt: Overview Fleet Data Centers designs, builds and operates mega-scale data center campuses.
jobs.description:
Overview
Fleet Data Centers designs, builds and operates mega-scale data center campuses. Fleet provides its customers flexibility and predictability to meet their upside demand forecasts, addressing a key need in the market as traditional leased models are struggling to keep pace with the demand for new Cloud and AI infrastructure. Fleet is led by a team of industry veterans that have already made a lasting imprint on the evolution of global digital infrastructure and are committed and uniquely capable of upleveling data center development scale and operations in the face of rising demand. Fleet is well positioned to bring in-house design, engineering and operational capabilities to collaborate with customers on tailored solutions for campuses of 500MW+. This unique model enables Fleet to provide the world’s largest and most sophisticated customers a seamless extension of their own data center fleets with constant access to design innovation.

Position Overview

The Director of Land Development supports the pre-development phase of Fleet’s data center projects and carries those projects forward through the balance of their lifecycle. The Director of Land Development leads site diligence, campus master planning, entitlements, and permitting, from initial site control or joint venture through stabilization, then stays with the project through lease, vertical construction, stabilization, and the ultimate disposition of the asset. The Director of Land Development works closely alongside senior members of the organization, and represents Fleet before the jurisdictions, agencies, utilities, and communities that decide whether a campus gets built.

Job Responsibilities

In addition to other duties assigned, the Director of Land Development will hold the following primary responsibilities:

  • Lead site inquiry and evaluation of prospective sites in assigned markets, identifying the risks and opportunities that determine whether a site advances to site control or joint venture formation, and carrying multiple projects across diverse jurisdictions at once
  • Own the pre-development workstream plan for assigned projects: define the diligence scope at site control or joint venture formation, sequence the studies that gate a development decision, and hold the schedule that carries a site from control to vertical construction
  • Run land and site diligence, including title and survey, geotechnical, environmental, wetlands, cultural resources, traffic, and water and wastewater, and convert the findings into buildable area, phasing, and cost consequences that leadership can act on
  • Lead entitlements and permitting across local, state, and federal jurisdictions: map the approval path for each site, prepare applications alongside counsel and consultants, and carry hearings through to recorded approvals and issued permits
  • Direct masterplanning with internal and external stakeholders so each campus plan reconciles critical load, building form factor, substation and switchyard siting, water strategy, and site constraints, and revise that plan as customer requirements, power availability, and investment strategy move
  • Support the internal power teams on the entitlements, permits, and land use matters that power infrastructure requires, including substation and switchyard siting approvals, transmission and distribution easements and rights-of-way, conditional use approvals for generation and battery energy storage, and the property rights needed to bring interconnection and behind-the-meter solutions onto the site
  • Support the creation and management of a bottom-up pre-development budget, tracking commitments and spend against it and helping forecast the capital draw by phase so leadership can plan funding
  • Assemble and manage the consultant bench: write scopes of work, support solicitations, bid-leveling, recommend awards to management, negotiate agreements with internal legal, and hold each firm to its deliverable dates
  • Interrogate engineering and consultant deliverables before they circulate, testing them against the approval path, the site constraints, and the development schedule, and returning work that does not hold up
  • Represent Fleet before local government, including planning and zoning commissions and public works staff, and attend city council and county commission meetings as required
  • Work the rest of the local apparatus that moves an approval, including assessors, clerks, utilities, and state and local economic development offices, and build the relationships that drive approvals
  • Support leasing and capital markets on assigned sites, translating site and schedule reality into delivery dates and costs that can be committed to customers, lenders, and investment partners
  • Advance the horizontal development features that makes a campus buildable, including securing water, wastewater, fiber, and road infrastructure and coordinating earthworks packages specific to data center campus use
  • Represent Fleet in the community, building and maintaining relationships with adjacent landowners and community groups, and reflecting the company's approach to land stewardship and local economic benefit in every public interaction
  • Uphold company Environment, Health & Safety standards across consultant and contractor activity on assigned sites
  • Hand projects to construction without losing the record, transferring permit conditions, commitments made to jurisdictions and utilities, and design assumptions, then stay with assigned projects through vertical construction, stabilization, and disposition
  • Contribute to scalable tools and processes that improve project delivery and communication, from schedule and budget standards to trackers and reporting templates, so each new site starts from the last one's lessons

Education & Experience

  • Education/Accreditations: Bachelor's degree in engineering, real estate development, architecture, planning, or an equivalent discipline. Current or past Professional Engineer licensure greatly preferred.

    Experience: Minimum of five years' experience in large-scale land development, civil engineering, site planning, construction, or data center and energy development, including direct ownership of at least one entitlement path from application through approval. Civil engineering experience greatly preferred. Candidates who have taken a greenfield site through to a construction start will stand out.

    Travel: 50%. This position requires regular travel to project sites, jurisdictional hearings, utility and consultant meetings, and Fleet offices, with meaningful time in the field during active entitlement periods.

Core Skills & Competencies

  • Working knowledge of real estate development fundamentals, including ownership and site control structures, land use frameworks, rezoning mechanics, and the entitlement processes that apply to large-scale industrial and infrastructure projects
  • Practical command of the diligence stack, including what each study can and cannot resolve and how long each one takes in a given jurisdiction
  • Ability to read a civil site plan and a utility one-line and press the engineer who drew it, sufficient to test buildable area, phasing, and infrastructure assumptions rather than accept them
  • Working knowledge of power and energy infrastructure as it relates to data center development — including utility interconnection, behind-the-meter power solutions, and battery energy storage systems — sufficient to track queue position, study milestones, and energization dates against the campus schedule
  • Command of pre-development budgeting and capital forecasting, with enough modeling literacy to see how a schedule slip or a scope change lands in project returns
  • Demonstrated negotiating experience with consultants, contractors, utilities, and public agencies, covering scope, fee structure, and the commitments made to secure an approval
  • Ability to carry several sites in different jurisdictions at once without dropping conditions, deadlines, or commitments, and to reprioritize as sites advance or stall
  • Judgment to escalate, surfacing a schedule or cost problem while it can still be fixed — without waiting to be directed
  • Direct writing, covering internal reports and dashboards as well as external land use applications, producing packages a senior audience can act on without a walkthrough
  • Strong verbal communication, including internal presentations and public speaking at local government meetings
  • Ability to manage projects and teams to a predictable conclusion, and to problem solve by leveraging independent analysis, local relationships, corporate resources, and executive support
  • Curiosity and the ability to network in structured and unstructured settings, surfacing opportunities and challenges early
  • Fluency in Excel for budgets and schedules and PowerPoint for leadership reporting, with comfort in drawing markup and project tracking tools

Location: New York, NY, Morristown, NJ, or remote

Travel Requirement: 50% This position requires regular travel to project sites, jurisdictional hearings, utility and consultant meetings, and Tract Capital offices, with meaningful time in the field during active entitlement periods.

Expected Salary Range: $180,000 - $195,000 Base Salary + Discretionary Bonus

Our products run as hosted cloud services and as on-premises installs at customer sites, so the role needs strong judgement across cloud, hybrid and on-premises designs.

Architecture and strategy

jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

THE COMMUNITY YOU WILL JOIN

Airbnb's Marketing Technology organization builds the infrastructure that powers how we reach and connect with guests and hosts around the world — from audience segmentation and campaign orchestration to last-mile delivery and real-time insights. Our engineers work at the intersection of scale, reliability, and product impact, building platforms that carry billions of messages each year across email, SMS, push, and WhatsApp. We are deeply committed to building AI-natively: agents and LLM-powered automation are becoming core to how we build, operate, and improve our systems.

You'll lead two closely partnered teams that together own Airbnb's communications platform end to end. The Orchestration team builds the systems that let marketing and product teams design and run personalized, event- and list-triggered customer journeys at Airbnb scale. The Delivery team owns the last mile — routing every notification through the right provider, tracking it to a terminal state, and managing contact preferences and vendor relationships. Both teams collaborate deeply with audience segmentation, content, ML, and data engineering teams, as well as product partners across the company.

THE DIFFERENCE YOU WILL MAKE

As the Engineering Manager for this team, you will be the primary technical leader for the systems that decide whether a message reaches a guest or host — and when. You'll set the technical direction, own roadmap execution, and build the kind of team culture where engineers grow and do the best work of their careers, including through deep, genuine adoption of AI-native engineering practices.

The platform is mid-transformation. We are consolidating legacy and next-generation messaging flows onto a single unified path, moving platform health from component metrics to business-impact signals such as campaign delivery SLAs and burn rate, and building end-to-end observability so any owner — human or agent — can answer "what happened to notification X for user Y" in minutes. At the same time, both teams are standing up agentic capabilities: an agent-driven orchestration layer, end-to-end lifecycle testing agents, smart notification scheduling, and AI-assisted on-call triage. You will be the leader who ensures these systems ship with the rigor, reliability, and operational maturity that production-grade messaging and agentic systems demand.

Your leadership will directly determine how reliably Airbnb communicates with its community, how confidently partner teams can build on the platform, and how effectively this team leads Marketing Technology's shift toward AI-native engineering.

A TYPICAL DAY

  • Lead planning, roadmap reviews, and cross-team syncs for Delivery and Orchestration, keeping delivery on track and stakeholders well-informed
  • Run 1:1s with engineers across both teams, with intentional focus on career growth, technical skill development, and early identification of blockers
  • Serve as the primary engineering point of contact for cross-team dependencies — fielding requests from product teams across Airbnb and making clear, reasoned prioritization calls
  • Partner with the Product Manager to sequence the roadmap across journey orchestration, bulk campaign sends, and delivery infrastructure
  • Drive technical strategy for end-to-end observability and SLA-driven delivery: campaign-level delivery tracking, health-gated ramping, dynamic pacing against budgets, and automatic provider failover
  • Oversee the design, delivery, and operational health of production agentic systems: agent-driven orchestration, lifecycle testing agents, smart scheduling, and LLM-assisted on-call triage
  • Champion AI-native development practices across both teams — from AI-assisted coding and review to agents in CI/CD, on-call response, and delivery anomaly detection
  • Own the health and operational maturity of both teams: daytime and 24/7 on-call programs, blameless incident retrospectives, SLO definitions, runbook quality, and third-party messaging vendor escalations
  • Represent the communications platform in org-wide planning cycles and contribute to the broader Marketing Technology engineering strategy

YOUR EXPERTISE

Required

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with 4+ years in an engineering management role leading platform or infrastructure teams
  • Demonstrated AI-native engineering mindset — you use AI tools daily in your own work, have led teams in genuinely adopting AI-assisted development, and have strong opinions about where agents add real leverage vs. hype
  • Experience leading teams that have designed, built, and operated production-grade agentic systems — autonomous or semi-autonomous agent pipelines, LLM-orchestrated workflows, or multi-agent architectures handling real production traffic
  • Strong technical foundation in high-throughput distributed systems: event-driven architectures, message queues and streaming (Kafka or similar), workflow orchestration engines (Temporal or similar), and multi-provider integrations — able to engage credibly in architecture and design conversations
  • Track record of running reliable, customer-facing production services with defined SLOs, including on-call programs, incident management, and operational excellence across teams of varying size and seniority
  • Demonstrated experience managing engineers across a range of seniority levels, including early-career engineers, with a track record of meaningful career growth outcomes
  • Experience owning cross-team platform relationships: managing inbound dependency requests, negotiating priorities, and communicating commitments with confidence
  • Track record of delivering complex, multi-quarter technical roadmaps — including large-scale migrations or legacy system consolidations — in fast-moving environments

Preferred

  • Experience with notification, messaging, or communications infrastructure at scale — email, SMS, push, or WhatsApp delivery.
  • Experience with customer journey orchestration, marketing automation, or lifecycle messaging platforms
  • Hands-on familiarity with agent frameworks and orchestration tooling (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, Autogen, Temporal, or similar) and practical knowledge of where these systems break down in production
  • Experience building end-to-end observability and business-impact alerting for multi-hop asynchronous pipelines
  • Experience managing teams that own 24/7 on-call rotations and production services with external SLAs or vendor dependencies

YOUR LOCATION

This role is eligible for remote work within the United States. Employees may optionally use any of our US office locations. We expect team members to be available during core collaboration hours in their time zone and to participate in occasional onsite gatherings as the team and org schedule them, typically 2–4 times per year.

OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION & BELONGING

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

The best engineers, technicians, and corporate professionals make their teammates better, knowing that complementary skills create force multiplication and drive mission success.

SRM Structures Design Engineer

DESCRIPTION

Long Wall is looking for an experienced Solid Rocket Motor (SRM) Structures Design Engineer to support the design, development, and production of SRMs for our interceptor system. This role is responsible for ensuring SRM motor cases, other primary structure, and secondary structure meet demanding missile interception requirements while maintaining manufacturability at scale. The SRM Structures Design Engineer serves as the technical authority for the design of SRM structural components. Responsibilities include design and analysis of motor cases, internal and external joints, raceways, flight equipment mounting, reviewing and interpreting static fire and flight test data, providing technical oversight and direction to suppliers, and defining requirements and verifying compliance throughout development and production. The successful candidate will establish rigorous design methods while driving efficient program execution. They will work closely with propulsion, ballistics, structures and dynamics, aerodynamics, guidance and control, manufacturing, and systems engineering teams to ensure structural design decisions remain aligned with system-level performance, technical baselines, and program objectives.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design SRM structural components to meet technical requirements, including pressure vessels, vehicle primary structure, and secondary structures.
  • Develop, refine, and validate design methods and tools for motor cases, igniter structure, and vehicle integration.
  • Review and provide oversight to suppliers designing structural components for integration into the Cyclops vehicle.
  • Review test data from component structural tests, including solid rocket motor static tests.
  • Prepare, present, and explain technical results to government partners, customers, and suppliers.
  • Other duties as assigned.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a technical discipline, or equivalent experience in complex aerospace or defense development.
  • 5+ years of experience with solid rocket motors or composite structures.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Proficiency with NX, Creo, or other parametric CAD software.
  • Proficiency with product definition creation, including geometric dimensioning and tolerancing and engineering drawings.
  • Experience with the design and development of filament-wound pressure vessels and other composite structures.
  • Proven ability to operate effectively in fast‑paced environments that combine private‑investment‑driven development with government test requirements.
  • Ability to interpret engineering artifacts, requirements, and configurations and convert them into actionable activities.
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills; capable of aligning engineering teams, surfacing risks early, and maintaining clarity across disciplines.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner closely across technical disciplines with technical authorities (chief engineering, systems engineering, mission assurance), customers, and suppliers to ensure disciplined technical execution.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Hands-on manufacturing experience with composite structures, including filament winding and hand lay-up.
  • Proficiency in MATLAB, Python, C++, FORTRAN, or similar programming languages.
  • Experience supporting missile defense, launch vehicle development, aerospace hardware integration, or other technically complex systems.
  • Familiarity with requirements flow‑down, verification planning, ICD management, and configuration control.
  • Prior experience working within a hybrid program environment (internal rapid development + government‑funded test campaigns).
  • Ability to translate ambiguous technical requirements into executable work.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • This position requires a national security suitability screening following offer acceptance.
  • Ability to sit or stand for extended periods.
  • Ability to use a computer for assignments and communicate effectively in person, via telepresence, and by phone.
  • Ability to travel between Long Wall sites as needed.

This position requires access to information protected under US export control laws, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations and/or the Export Administration Regulations. As such, US person status (including US citizens, U.S. permanent residents, individuals granted U.S. asylum status, or individuals admitted in U.S. refugee status) is a required qualification for this position.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Autonomous Vehicles
jobs.excerpt: Self-driving cars need to know where the road goes, in real time, with no prior map to lean on.
jobs.description:
Self-driving cars need to know where the road goes, in real time, with no prior map to lean on. We’re building the perception-based world model stack that makes this possible. It takes raw multi-sensor input and produces a live, accurate 3D model of lanes, boundaries, crosswalks, intersection topology, and traffic control semantics. It also fuses perception, map, and localization data into a consistent model of the driving environment that the rest of the driving stack depends on.

You will join a team of world-class software engineers improving these algorithms. This is a software engineering role: algorithms are only as good as the software that runs them, so we need an engineer who obsesses over quality, performance, and architecture, and who can turn algorithmic ideas into safe, fast, maintainable code for production vehicles on NVIDIA DRIVE Orin and Thor. Your code will meet ASIL-B/D requirements and ship across L2++, L3, and L4 programs.


What you’ll be doing:

  • Build and own core online world model and context fusion software that runs in the car, from architecture through implementation to deployment.
  • Write production C++ for real-time embedded systems, with a focus on correctness, determinism, and maintainability.
  • Design software architecture, interfaces, and data flows that promote code reuse and clean boundaries across vehicle programs, while meeting CPU, memory, and latency budgets.
  • Profile complex pipelines, find bottlenecks, and deliver measurable improvements in CPU utilization, memory usage, and end-to-end latency, backed by reproducible measurements on Orin and Thor.
  • Develop benchmarks and performance regression tests that track improvements and prevent regressions.
  • Use GPU parallelism (CUDA) where it helps to accelerate compute-heavy mapping components.
  • Implement and integrate algorithmic solutions from the mapping team into NVIDIA’s AV stack, working closely with algorithm engineers to understand and refine them while preserving behavior, output quality, and correctness.
  • Develop to automotive safety standards (ASIL-B/D): apply strong static analysis, follow safety-oriented coding guidelines, and achieve 100% line and branch coverage with rigorous unit and integration tests.
  • Build software that is robust to the varied conditions and failure modes of vehicles operating around the world.
  • Contribute to code reviews and uphold the team’s quality and safety expectations.

What we need to see:

  • PhD with 1+ year, MS with 3+ years, or BS with 5+ years of relevant experience in Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of experience building robust, production-quality software
  • 3+ years of professional modern C++ development, with a strong grasp of memory management, concurrency, and performance.
  • Demonstrated ability to profile and optimize CPU utilization, memory consumption, and latency using profilers and benchmarks under representative workloads.
  • Solid understanding of algorithms and data structures and their impact on performance.
  • Experience designing software architecture and APIs for large, long-lived codebases.
  • A quality-first, systematic approach to debugging and optimization: comfort with static analysis, unit testing, and high-coverage test strategies.
  • Ability to work with algorithm developers and understand their work.
  • Strong communication and analytical skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively across multiple teams.
  • Autonomous and responsible, a strong team player who enjoys solving hard problems, with a passion for robotics and autonomous vehicles.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Software development on embedded, real-time, or automotive platforms, including RTOS experience (e.g., QNX, Linux RT), experience with functional safety standards and processes (ISO 26262, ASIL-B/D), MISRA or AUTOSAR C++ guidelines, and safety-qualified toolchains.
  • GPGPU programming (CUDA) and GPU performance tuning.
  • Cache-aware data layouts, memory allocation optimization, multithreading, or SIMD/vectorization.
  • Experience with 3D geometry and graphics.
  • Experience building efficient, reusable APIs and frameworks for complex systems.

The AP Curriculum and Assessment Team at College Board (125+ staff) collaborates with colleagues across all aspects of the AP Program to develop, manage, and deliver AP’s 43 courses in a wide variety of subject areas. AP® is a rigorous academic program built on the commitment, passion, and hard work of students and educators from secondary schools and higher education. AP provides willing and academically prepared high school students with the opportunity to study and learn at the college level. AP’s course teams comprised of educators and disciplinary experts ensure that course curricula are aligned to higher education expectations and reflect the state of the art in the discipline, contribute to instructional resources and tools for teachers, and develop assessments that allow students in these courses to demonstrate their mastery of course content and skills. AP leads in strategic use of AI to expand student access, strengthen instructional design and professional support, and enhance assessment creation and exam analysis. The Math, Computer Science, and Cybersecurity department, which includes precalculus, calculus, statistics, computer science, cybersecurity, and networking is currently comprised of approximately 22 people supporting 8 courses in the AP portfolio.

About the Opportunity

As the Director I, AP Statistics you will be responsible for preserving and improving the quality and validity of the AP Program’s core deliverables within the subject domain: the exam, the course curriculum, and the professional development content. You are also responsible for item development and management from authoring to administration; training and collaborating with subject-matter experts (SMEs), typically college professors and secondary school teachers. You will ethically and effectively integrate AI technologies in assessment creation and review. This includes judiciously using AI assisted tools to support fairness, validity, and innovation in AP assessments. You will train SMEs on assessment development protocols, translate between academics and technical experts (psychometricians), and collaborate to develop formative assessment materials and resources to support AP Statistics teachers worldwide. You will serve as a point of contact in AP for committees and communities of subject-matter experts and will be responsible for the curriculum and assessment for AP Statistics, and, in partnership with other AP teams, further the strategic growth of AP Statistics across the globe.   • Train and directly supervise Test Development Committee members in AP Statistics as content development contributors and reviewers. Recruit educators for the AP Statistics Development Committee and other opportunities to support AP Program. 
  • Lead the successful scoring of student responses for AP Statistics Exams at the annual scoring event in person and online—the “AP Reading”—and produce AP Reading publications materials for teacher and student use. You plan all year, with increasing intensity in the months leading up to the Reading, ensuring all workflow steps for this incredibly complex event, as well as all post-Reading activities, are accounted for and successfully executed.  

Assessment Quality and Process (10-15%)

The Director, Compliance & Quality Systems owns ECL's Quality Management System (QMS). ECL operates from a single site today and will expand to additional sites in the near future. You'll ensure the QMS is designed to scale, so all sites launch with the same quality standard. You'll build and lead a focused team to drive GMP compliance.

This hands-on leadership role offers the opportunity to shape ECL's QMS, embedding quality processes directly into ECL's novel software-driven laboratory platform. We're looking for a leader with deep compliance expertise, as well as the curiosity and agility to reimagine how those requirements are met in a software-driven, connected environment.

  • Own ECL's QMS processes end to end: document control, deviations, OOS, CAPA, change control, risk management, equipment qualification, supplier quality and GMP training
  • Monitor QMS execution at current and future sites through quality metrics, periodic reviews, and internal audits
  • Ensure the ECL QMS meets client quality requirements and the terms of each Quality Agreement, and that required client notifications are communicated accurately and on time
  • Ensure quality and compliance requirements are embedded in ECL's single software platform

Training

Leadership

Every hotel has that guest: years of stays, the same room, never skips the spa. But their story sits scattered across the PMS, the booking engine, the spa system, and whoever happened to be on shift. Revinate brings that story together. We connect and clean guest data from every system into Rich Guest Profile® data, then put it to work for the people who look after guests.

Reservations answers the phone already knowing the guest. Marketing sends the spa offer to the guest who raved about the spa. Behind it all, Ivy, our AI intelligence layer trained on 17 years of hospitality data, reads the patterns and handles the digital labor.

Revinate powers 1.1 billion Rich Guest Profile® data points across 12,500+ hotels, driving over $24 billion in direct revenue.

Get Revinate. Get superpowers.

The Account Configuration Specialist uses Revinate's proprietary systems to configure, customize, and install a comprehensive suite of SaaS products for new and existing clients. Beyond a single-product or strict telephony focus, this role leads the technical setup and onboarding of Revinate's entire product suite to ensure long-term success and scalable deployment. This role involves working closely with internal teams, external clients, and third-party vendors to understand requirements, navigate technical roadblocks, and ensure the accurate, timely activation of customer accounts.

Top 3 Outcomes for Year One

    1. Develop a strong foundational knowledge of all Revinate SaaS products and the configuration processes required to implement them.

    2. Independently configure and manage customer accounts for multiple core product implementations simultaneously, handling both standard rollouts and complex integrations.

    3. Become an expert on advanced configuration requirements and tier-two tickets, providing cross-functional technical support and resolutions within designated SLA timeframes.

What You’ll Do

    Implementation & Project Execution

  • Lead the customer implementation process end to end, serving as the primary technical point of contact to ensure on-time delivery and a smooth onboarding experience across the entire SaaS product suite.

  • Gather detailed customer requirements and accurately convert them into comprehensive system configurations across multiple product lines to achieve the client's desired outcomes.

  • Organize and lead effective internal and external project meetings, proactively communicating expectations, procedures, and requirements to all stakeholders.

    • Technical Configuration & Integration

  • Execute and manage the hands-on back-end technical setup, customization, and configuration of diverse SaaS systems and solutions.

  • Coordinate with third-party software vendors to acquire necessary technical details and secure required resources for complex system integrations.

  • Validate the correct implementation and intended functionality of all technical components, ensuring seamless communication between internal systems and external integrations.

    • Quality Assurance & Troubleshooting

  • Perform rigorous quality assurance (QA) and thorough testing of product functionality and performance metrics prior to project closure and official launch.

  • Resolve real-time technical product issues encountered during onboarding, utilizing critical thinking to troubleshoot and perform back-end adjustments.

  • Review customer inquiries, research complex technical issues, and provide timely resolutions or escalate to management and engineering when necessary.

    • Customer Enablement & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) on the platform, advising customers on how to maximize the value of their services and providing solutions for potential obstacles during live calls.

  • Act as a critical liaison between the customer and internal product/engineering teams, advocating for customer-requested enhancements to drive continuous product improvement.

  • Manage ongoing project documentation, including the creation, maintenance, and distribution of internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and knowledge resources to enhance service quality.

    • Supplementary Product Support (Telephony)

  • Handle supplementary telecommunications tasks as needed, including managing toll-free and local number inventory, performing routine audits, and executing off-program workflows in accordance with carrier protocols and internal SOPs.

What You’ll Bring

  • An associate's degree or equivalent training, plus at least two (2) years of professional experience in a Project Management, Implementation, or Technical Configuration role.

  • Demonstrated ability to successfully manage a high volume of simultaneous, ongoing implementation projects and competing priorities.

  • Strong technical aptitude with a proven ability to quickly learn new SaaS technologies and master basic to intermediate product features in a fast timeframe.

  • Exceptional problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify complex technical issues and evaluate, recommend, and implement back-end solutions.

  • Intermediate to advanced proficiency with MS Office Suite and Google Workspace; experience using tools to track project deliverables and milestones.

  • Flexible and adaptable to changing time zone requirements necessary to support internal and external customers.

    • Preferred Qualifications / Nice-to-Have

  • Practical experience with technical SaaS software configuration and managing complex system integrations.

  • Familiarity with hospitality systems, specifically Property Management Systems (PMS) such as Opera, roomMaster, or Maestro.

  • Previous experience with telephony-related products, network routing, or telecom configuration.

  • Experience with project management and support software such as Zendesk, JIRA, Asana, Rocketlane, Salesforce, and SendGrid.

People Describe You As

  • Extremely detail-oriented: You excel at following established practices and ensuring that your technical configurations are carried out with absolute precision.

  • A master communicator: You are highly effective at building rapport with customers and internal teams alike. You do not hesitate to jump on a call with a customer to explain a technical setup, test an account, or troubleshoot an issue.

  • Flexible and fluid: You excel at managing multiple projects with unique needs, recognizing and applying patterns to drive efficiency. You thrive on finding innovative solutions to challenges as they arise.

  • Proactive and organized: You easily prioritize competing responsibilities to ensure timely completion. Whether contacting a colleague for missing integration details or updating documentation, you identify the need and take action.

Excited?! Want to learn more? Apply Now!

Our Core Values:

One Revinate - United & Strong, on a single mission together
Built on Trust - It’s the foundation of everything we do
Expect Amazing - We think, dream & deliver big
Customer Love -- When the customer wins, we win
Make it Simpler -- Apply it to everything we do
Hungerness -- Feel it, follow it, be relentless about our success
Grounded in Gratitude - We’re glad to be here & make the most of every day

In de havenomgeving wordt samen met een partner uit de spoorsector gewerkt aan de verdubbeling van het goederenvervoer per spoor tegen 2030. Het huidige spooraandeel bedraagt ongeveer 7%. Het programma richt zich op een aantrekkelijker en efficiënter spoorvervoer in de havenzones.

Een belangrijk onderdeel is de ontwikkeling van een digitaal spoorplatform voor de uitwisseling van informatie tussen de betrokken partijen, waaronder de havenorganisatie, de spoorinfrastructuurbeheerder, spoorwegoperatoren, terminals, verladers en industriële partners.

Om de verkeersstromen in de havenzones beter te sturen en te optimaliseren, wordt een toepassing geanalyseerd en gerealiseerd die end-to-endtransparantie biedt over het door-to-door-goederenvervoer per spoor. De toepassing brengt gegevens uit verschillende bronnen samen en visualiseert die. Zo kunnen treinen, wagons en hun lading vanaf vertrek tot aankomst worden opgevolgd door de verschillende stakeholders in de vervoersketen.

Je maakt deel uit van een agile DevOps-team dat applicaties en componenten voor de haven en de havengemeenschap ontwikkelt en beheert. Als Technical Lead neem je een leidende rol op, stuur je het ontwikkelteam aan en coach je ontwikkelaars.

📝 Jouw profiel

Je brengt de volgende kennis, ervaring en vaardigheden mee:

  • Zeer grondige kennis van Java, Java API's en Spring Boot, in combinatie met ervaring in de ontwikkeling van Java-gebaseerde applicaties.
  • Kennis van microservices en Spring.
  • Kennis van SQL-databases, zoals Oracle.
  • Een sterke focus op clean code en Clean Architecture.
  • Kennis van Infrastructure as Code (IaC) en Terraform.
  • Je bent een Certified Java Developer.
  • Je kunt een ontwikkelteam leiden en ontwikkelaars coachen.
  • Je voert programmatieopdrachten zeer vlot uit, waaronder coderen, testen en debuggen.
  • Kennis van BPMN en Domain Driven Design (DDD).
  • Kennis van DevOps-principes en ervaring met agile ontwikkelmethoden, waarbij je een leidende rol kunt opnemen.
  • Kennis van Git, Jenkins, Sonar en Jira.
  • Kennis van Figma, Grafana, Hibernate, Kafka, KendoUI, Kubernetes en S3 storage.
  • Ervaring met projecten in het domein van railways en spoorwegen.
  • Ervaring met het ontwikkelen, testen en uitrollen van businessapplicaties in een 24x7-context.
  • Professionele en heldere communicatie in het Nederlands en Engels.
  • Je functioneert goed in multidisciplinaire teams.

Headquartered in New York City with close to 600 employees, Movable Ink serves its global client base with operations throughout North America, Central America, Europe, Australia, and Japan.

This role extends the reach of our innovative AI-first personalization across channels and platforms, unlocking new customer touchpoints for the brands who rely on us to tailor their experiences. You’ll collaborate daily with an in-house engineering team, cross-functional partners including partnerships, sales and customer experience, and serve as a primary point of contact for third-party ecosystem relationships. This is a role for a product thinker who loves connecting solutions and people.

  • Conceptualize, develop and launch integrations in close collaboration with engineering team and commercial partners, with a focus on adoption and booking metrics as north stars
  • Foster new and ongoing relationships with third-party messaging partners across technical and business development contacts, maintaining an integration pipeline and roadmap alongside our partnerships team
  • Write pitches, product requirement documents, and user stories to build a shared understanding of user needs and success criteria
  • Manage sprints, features, and enhancements in the backlog
  • Stay abreast of internal and external releases that affect existing and future integrations, providing sufficient runway to implement requisite changes

  • Excellent prioritization skills, capable of balancing short-term wins with long-term strategic goals

  • Skilled communicator who can comfortably switch talk tracks between technical and non-technical audiences

The base pay range for this position is $145,000-$185,000/year, which can include additional bonus depending on the position ultimately offered, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits. jobs.title: MSK Teletherapy Physical Therapist / PTA — Marksville, LA
jobs.excerpt: Treat PeteDME’s MSK Integrated Care patients from home.
jobs.description:
Treat PeteDME’s MSK Integrated Care patients from home. Our program pairs knee and lumbar bracing with physical therapy and remote therapeutic monitoring, delivered through a network of in-home therapists. Remote visits and monitoring are paid per visit and per call.

How you join
Every therapist on the remote caseload starts with six in-person brace fittings on patients from your own current caseload, so you know the devices you will be coaching patients on. Each fitting is a paid clinical visit — intake, fitting, and follow-up — at a flat fee agreed in writing before your first patient. We give you a one-page screening tool to identify candidates among the patients you already see, and we handle the prescription, benefit verification, and the paperwork.

This is not a sales role. We do not ask you to refer; you treat patients you already see.

After six fittings
Teletherapy patient referrals from PeteDME begin: our patients, work from home, on your schedule, paid per visit and per call.

What you get
• Free specialized training and certification in orthopedic bracing.
• AI-generated SOAP notes — no new EMR to learn.
• Keep your current job. This is additional, independent-contractor work alongside it.
• Flat fees fixed in advance; no part of your pay depends on volume or on referrals.

Requirements

    • Active physical therapist or physical therapist assistant license in the state where you practice.
    • Currently working in home health or another in-home setting.
    • You evaluate and provide treatment.

How to apply

    Complete the short questionnaire. It asks about your license, your setting, and your caseload, and it asks you to acknowledge that teletherapy referrals begin after six fittings. A clinical onboarding specialist will reach out within one business day.
