jobs.description:
Make Every Experience Matter

Viseven is an AI-native Intelligent Experiences Enabler for life sciences, helping pharma and biotech organizations move from fragmented content operations to connected, compliant, and measurable omnichannel engagement with HCPs and patients. By combining proprietary technology — eWizard, eVa, Kheiron, and Lexi — with agentic AI and strategic consulting, we support the full content lifecycle: from creation and MLR validation to localization and omnichannel publishing. Our clients include Top 50 life sciences, pharma, biotech, and medtech companies around the globe. 

Role Description:

We are seeking a highly skilled and dynamic Transformation Program Manager to lead and drive the successful implementation of large-scale programmes within our Strategic Clients. This is an exciting, fast-paced, and high-visibility role, working closely with the Sales (Account Directors), Delivery (Delivery Directors), Products and Solution Teams, and the wider Senior Leadership Team to ensure ultimate success, adoption, and Client Satisfaction.
As we evolve and adapt to be a leader in Digital Transformation at scale, this role will be instrumental in guiding and managing transformational projects from initiation to successful implementation.

Responsibilities:

    · Lead external stakeholder engagement strategies that address concerns and ensure ongoing support through established, effective communication channels.
    · Provide leadership for successful programme implementation

    · Ensure good project planning, resource allocation, risk management, and status reporting.
    · Escalate issues as necessary within the project organisation structure
    · Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the success of the programme implementation and adoption.
    · Effectively communicate programme goals, progress, and outcomes to all stakeholders and governance structure
    · Ensure ‘compliance’ with standards, existing framework and governance for the programme.
    · Network with cross-functional teams through the entire project life cycle, ensuring adherence to Transformation programme management best practices
    · Foster successful adoption through key consideration of change management and lead the evaluation of change adoption rates, using data and stakeholder feedback to identify resistance and deploy targeted interventions for improved engagement.
    · Collaborate with senior leadership, V7 workstreams, and key stakeholders to ensure alignment and buy-in for transformation initiatives across the business

Required skills and knowledge:

    · History of being able to manage multiple projects that may overlap or be interlinked when aligning with business requirements
    · Strong leadership skills and the ability to motivate team members.
    · Commercial acumen and experience highly preferable
    · Capability of working under pressure and to tight deadlines

    · Exceptional organisational skills and attention to detail.
    · Self-starter with a bias for action, ability to bring structure to ambiguity and build trust based relationships across the organization
    · Comfortable working within an ever-changing environment in a rapidly growing company
    · Strong change management skills to drive successful outcomes

Why Viseven?

We believe great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and connected. We encourage bold ideas, ownership, and continuous growth. Whether it’s leading new initiatives, shaping products, or expanding your expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to make a visible impact and evolve alongside a global organization.

jobs.excerpt: At Roofr, we’re obsessed with our customers.  We constantly gather feedback to shape, prioritize, and launch the products they truly need.
jobs.description:
At Roofr, we’re obsessed with our customers. We constantly gather feedback to shape, prioritize, and launch the products they truly need. That’s what makes Roofr’s CRM special. We started by building essential sales tools like aerial roof measurements and digital sales proposals. But when our customers asked for a simple, affordable way to manage and scale their entire businesses, we listened. So, we created a CRM that connects these solutions—along with payments, material ordering, and more—into a seamless, powerful platform. With a clear roadmap ahead, we’re excited to continue expanding and leading the market with innovative products.

We have an amazing culture, strong financials, and best-in-class company metrics. It’s an exciting time to be part of an extraordinary startup that is already successful, yet still early enough to offer its team significant growth, equity, and the opportunity to make a real impact.

This position is for an existing vacancy.

***A quick note: some of our emails may be filtered into your spam/junk folder. Please check there regularly for any communications from us, including interview scheduling, next steps, and updates on your application. If you find one of our emails in spam, please mark it as “Not Spam” to help ensure future messages reach your inbox.***

Roofr is looking for a Senior Director, Product Growth to own how we grow through the product. You’ll work at the intersection of product, data, and go-to-market: designing the activation and expansion paths that keep contractors engaged, surfacing product signals that unlock sales conversations, and building a stronger self-serve experience anchored in friction-less SMB UI/UX. You’ll report to the CPO, sit on the product leadership team, and lead a cross-functional Growth team that includes Engineering, Design, Data Science, and a Principal PM as your direct report.

Initial building blocks are already in place. We have a clear activation metric that guides both our self-serve and sales-assist motion, a hybrid model that is actively evolving, and an AI product line in AI Receptionist that is ready to scale. The job is to take what’s working, sharpen it, and build on top of it.

What You’ll be measured on

  • Software adoption across the subscriber base
  • Orchestration of the hybrid motion
  • Self-serve revenue growth, shared with the GM of Measurements

What You’ll get to do

  • Orchestrate the hybrid motion with Sales: Identify the product signals that indicate a contractor is ready for a sales conversation and build the playbooks that turn those signals into pipeline, across both new subscriber acquisition and expansion of the existing base
  • Drive activation and expansion: Own the in-product experience that gets new contractors to value fast and design the expansion loops that drive deeper adoption and multi-product retention across the customer base
  • Grow self-serve revenue: Own the self-serve motion across transactional and subscription products, with particular focus on Measure+ and in-product upgrade paths
  • Lead the team and the metrics: Lead the Growth team, including Engineering, Design, and Data Science, build a fast experimentation culture, and own the growth metrics that matter to leadership

What You’ll bring to the role

  • 8 to 12+ years of product growth experience in B2B SaaS; vertical SaaS is a strong plus
  • Real experience building a hybrid product-led and sales-led motion. You have felt the friction of making these work together, not just read about it
  • Strong activation and expansion instincts. You know how to design user journeys that drive measurable improvement in time-to-value and long-term retention
  • Experience working across both transactional and subscription revenue models
  • Comfortable running experiments end to end: designing them, setting success criteria, and shipping without waiting for perfect conditions
  • Fluent in growth metrics like activation rate, adoption, expansion revenue, and NRR. You run your own analysis
  • Experience with tools like Amplitude, HubSpot, and Snowflake or a comparable data warehouse
  • Experience building or scaling an AI-powered product is a meaningful differentiator
  • Able to lead and develop cross-functional teams in an environment where everyone doesn’t work for you. You work alongside your team, not just above it
  • Clear communicator at every level, from executive to analyst
  • Based in the US or Canada

Compensation Band: $250,000.00 - $300,000.00 (location based)

Our compensation ranges are built using multiple market benchmarks and reflect both the scope of the role and current market data. While many hires fall within the beginning to midpoint of the band to allow for growth over time, we tailor offers based on each candidate’s experience, seniority, and demonstrated impact.

🏠 What we offer (US + Canada)

When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career:

🏝️ Vacation/Paid Time Off:

  • 1st week of employment is mandatory PTO! Start your journey with Roofr by decompressing and recharging - we will see you in week 2!
  • 1 Friday off per month (we call those our laundry days!)
  • Company wide paid shutdown for the week between Christmas and New Years
  • Flexible time off
  • 80% employer-paid benefits in the U.S. and 100% employer-paid premiums for Extended Healthcare and Dental in Canada
  • RRSP/401k match
  • Generous Parental Leave policy

🤝 Perks:

  • We host an annual company retreat with great team building activities
  • Ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career
  • Home office setup stipend
  • Internet and phone allowance
  • Remote first culture
  • Weekly Friday paydays!

🤖 AI Notice

At Roofr, we’re big fans of AI. It helps us write job descriptions that don’t put you to sleep, takes notes during interviews so we can actually listen, and even helps us track down awesome humans like you.

Feel free to use AI to prep, research, or get pumped up for your interview (we see you, ChatGPT power users 👀). But when it’s time to chat, we’d love to meet you, not your AI alter ego. Bring your real, unfiltered self, we promise we will too.

And don’t worry, a real, live human is behind every part of our process. Every application is reviewed by a real person, and you’ll always speak with real humans throughout the interview process. No bots, just good people ☺️

⚠️ Important Notice

We’ve been made aware of an individual impersonating Roofr using a fraudulent domain: roofrr.com (note the extra “r”). Our company takes the security and privacy of job applicants very seriously. We will never ask for payment, bank details, or personal financial information as part of the application process. All our legitimate job postings can be found on our official career site. Please be cautious of job offers that come from non-company email addresses, instant messaging platforms, or unsolicited calls.

To ensure your application is legitimate, please apply directly through our official careers page: .

If you receive any suspicious messages or have questions, reach out to us at .

Your safety and security are important to us — thank you for your vigilance!

Utilities nationwide rely on Leidos for trusted power industry expertise, demonstrated by our work with more than 75 investor-owned utilities and over 100 municipal and cooperative utilities, as well as a growing portfolio of private developer clients.


Your greatest work is ahead!


Leidos’ Power Delivery Solutions (PDS) division is hiring a Lead Relay Settings Engineer to join our Settings, Automation, and Electrification (SAE) group. In this role you will own a utility client’s relay settings program end to end — technical direction, quality, schedule, and the client relationship — and serve as the first-line technical lead for the settings engineers supporting it.


Location: This position is open to fully remote. Proximity to our Duke Energy client in the Carolinas is preferred; a hybrid schedule from the Charlotte, NC office may be considered.


What you’ll be doing:

  • Lead a client relay settings program: work intake, hour estimates, engineer assignments, schedule tracking, and the client’s recurring coordination calls.
  • Serve as the client’s day-to-day technical contact and the first point of technical escalation for the settings team.
  • Develop and review protective relay settings from 4.16 kV through 500 kV — set points, logic, configuration files, and documentation — for line, transformer, bus, breaker failure, capacitor, and generator/IBR applications.
  • Perform final quality review on settings packages before client submittal and lead design-review and challenge meetings on medium and large projects.
  • Maintain the client’s settings standards, philosophies, calculation templates, and short-circuit model; own the settings change-management and as-left reconciliation process.
  • Assemble NERC PRC-019 / 023 / 024 / 025 / 026 / 027 compliance evidence across the program.
  • Resolve client-side technical issues directly with relay manufacturers and field personnel to keep projects on schedule.
  • Onboard, mentor, and train new and developing engineers on client standards and settings practice.
  • Support full project lifecycle activities including construction, commissioning, and event analysis.

What does Leidos need from me?

  • Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering (BSEE) from an ABET-accredited institution.
  • Minimum of thirteen (13) years of relevant experience in power system protection and relay settings development, including experience leading settings work for a major investor-owned utility.

  • Proficiency in ASPEN OneLiner and/or Siemens CAPE for coordination and fault studies.
  • Ability to develop and review settings for SEL, GE Vernova, Hitachi Energy (ABB), and Siemens relays.
  • Deep understanding of transmission line protection schemes (line differential, step distance, pilot) and substation protection schemes (transformer, bus, breaker failure, capacitor).
  • Experience preparing and reviewing high-quality technical reports and settings packages.
  • Experience mentoring and technically reviewing the work of other engineers.
  • Strong client-facing communication skills and the ability to work with staff in remote office locations.
  • Willingness and ability to travel to customer sites, offices, or testing labs on an occasional basis.

Favorable if you have:

  • Master of Science in Electrical Engineering with a power systems emphasis.
  • Engineer-in-Training (EIT) or Professional Engineer (PE) license.
  • Experience with Duke Energy protection standards and settings philosophies.
  • NERC PRC compliance experience.
  • Familiarity with SEL AcSELerator QuickSet / Grid Configurator, GE Vernova EnerVista, and Hitachi PCM600.
  • Python or VBA automation of settings workflows.

jobs.description:
Position Title: Geospatial Analyst/Programmer

Program: Ontario Northern Boreal (ONB)

Position Level: 7

Position Type: Full-time, Term (Leave Cover)

Term: 4 January 2027 to 3 September 2027

Position Location: Remote in Canada

Salary: $74,000 to $84,000 annually depending on experience

Start Date: 4 January 2027

Date written/revised: 29 October 2026

Reports to: Constance O’Connor, Director of ONB Program

Supervises: Not applicable

Benefits: 4 weeks’ vacation, Paid sick and Personal emergency leave, Self-care days, Health and Dental care, Life insurance, RRSP match, DEIJA Team, Weekly Wellness sessions, Mentorship program.

Vacancy: Currently Open

Application Closing Date: November 20, 2026 at 5PM EDT

Position Summary

The Geospatial Analyst/Programmer provides advanced geospatial analysis, programming, database management, and technical expertise to support the conservation objectives of the Ontario Northern Boreal (ONB) Program and broader WCS Canada initiatives.

The position is responsible for developing, maintaining, and enhancing geospatial tools, databases, automated workflows, and analytical products that support conservation planning, ecological assessment, landscape-level monitoring, and natural resource development analyses. This includes maintaining the Ontario Mineral Tracker, supporting ecological atlas and cumulative effects assessment initiatives, conducting geospatial analyses, and producing high-quality cartographic and data visualization products.

Working closely with conservation scientists, researchers, and external partners, the Geospatial Analyst/Programmer identifies innovative applications of geospatial technologies and develops technical solutions that improve decision-making and advance conservation outcomes. The role also contributes to nationally scoped projects focused on ecological integrity, landscape connectivity, climate resilience, critical minerals, and other major land-use and infrastructure initiatives.

Position Objectives

  • Provide advanced geospatial analysis, programming, and technical expertise to support conservation science, planning, and decision-making across the ONB Program and WCS Canada.
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance geospatial databases, analytical tools, and automated workflows that improve organizational efficiency and conservation outcomes.
  • Support strategic conservation initiatives through the application of innovative geospatial technologies, spatial modelling, and data visualization.
  • Strengthen organizational geospatial capacity through technical guidance, resource sharing, training, and GIS licensing support.
  • Collaborate with internal and external partners to develop geospatial solutions that advance shared conservation objectives.

Principal Responsibilities

Geospatial Analysis and Programming

  • Design, develop, maintain, and enhance geospatial databases, analytical tools, automated workflows, and custom applications supporting ONB and broader WCS Canada priorities.
  • Manage and maintain the Ontario Mineral Tracker, including associated databases, automated workflows, web-scraping applications, and reporting products.
  • Conduct geospatial analyses, spatial modelling, and data visualization to support conservation planning, ecological assessments, resource development analyses, and strategic decision-making.
  • Develop reproducible analytical workflows using Python, R, SQL, ArcGIS Pro, and related technologies.
  • Prepare and maintain technical documentation for geospatial databases, analytical processes, scripts, and workflows.
  • Support the development and maintenance of geospatial databases and analytical products for ecological atlas initiatives, cumulative effects assessments, and other conservation science projects.
  • Acquire, manage, integrate, and validate geospatial datasets from multiple sources to support research, monitoring, and conservation planning.
  • Collaborate with scientists and conservation practitioners to identify analytical approaches that inform conservation priorities and policy development.
  • Produce maps, dashboards, visualizations, and other geospatial products that effectively communicate scientific findings and conservation priorities.

Organizational and Strategic Support

  • Provide technical expertise and advice regarding GIS technologies, data management practices, and geoprocessing workflows.
  • Administer GIS software licensing and support organizational access to geospatial resources and tools.
  • Share knowledge, provide training, and promote best practices in geospatial analysis and conservation GIS across the organization.
  • Contribute to project reporting, funding proposals, and technical communications as required.

External Engagement and Knowledge Sharing

  • Represent WCS Canada at conferences, workshops, academic institutions, and professional forums to share conservation research, geospatial innovations, and analytical approaches.
  • Contribute to publications, presentations, articles, blogs, and other communication products that support conservation science and organizational visibility.
  • Develop collaborative relationships with external partners to advance the application of geospatial technologies for conservation outcomes.

Organizational Culture

  • Support WCS Canada’s goal of transforming WCS Canada’s conservation practice through reconciliation with Indigenous Peoples.
  • Collaborate effectively with colleagues across programs and contribute to a positive, inclusive, and respectful workplace.
  • Support WCS Canada's commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, justice, and accessibility in all aspects of work.

Required Qualifications, Skills, Experience

  • Graduate degree in Geomatics, Geography, GIS, Remote Sensing, Computer Science, Environmental Science, Conservation Biology, Landscape Ecology, or a related discipline. Equivalent combinations of education and experience may be considered.
  • Minimum five years of progressive experience in geospatial analysis, GIS database management, spatial modelling, geoprocessing workflow development, and cartographic production.
  • Advanced proficiency with Esri GIS technologies, including ArcGIS Pro and related applications.
  • Demonstrated experience using programming and scripting languages such as Python, R, SQL, Arcade, and the ArcGIS API for Python.
  • Experience designing, managing, and analyzing complex geospatial datasets.
  • Experience working with ecological, environmental, land-use, natural resource, or conservation-related spatial data.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
  • Excellent cartographic design and data visualization capabilities.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, including the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical information to diverse audiences.

Preferred Qualifications, Skills, Experience

  • GIS Professional (GISP), GIS diploma, remote sensing certification, or other relevant professional designation.
  • Experience developing web-based GIS applications, dashboards, or cloud-based geospatial solutions.
  • Experience contributing to scientific publications, technical reports, or applied conservation research.
  • Familiarity with conservation planning, cumulative effects assessment, landscape ecology, natural resource management, or environmental impact assessment.
  • Demonstrated success working collaboratively within interdisciplinary, geographically dispersed, and cross-cultural teams.

How to apply

Please submit your resume with a cover letter explaining your interest in this position and relevant skills and experience.

For questions regarding the position, please contact Constance O' Connor at

For questions regarding the application process, please contact Okechukwu Ezibe at

Application closing date: November 20, 2026 at 5PM EDT

WCS Canada does not use AI to screen, assess or select applicants.

Accessibility and inclusivity

WCS Canada is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible work environment. We are dedicated to providing accommodations throughout the hiring process, in accordance with applicable accessibility and human rights legislation.

If you require accommodations at any stage of the recruitment or selection process, please contact us via email at or by phone at 437-770-2776. We will work with you to meet your needs in a timely and respectful manner.

We recognize that strong candidates may hesitate to apply if they do not meet every listed qualification. If you are enthusiastic about this opportunity and believe you have relevant experience and skills, we encourage you to apply.

About WCS Canada

WCS Canada (www.wcscanada.org) was established as a Canadian conservation organization in July 2004. We are committed to championing accessibility, diversity, and equal opportunity. Our mission is to save wildlife and wild places by improving our understanding of and seeking solutions to critical problems that threaten key species and large wild ecosystems throughout Canada. We implement and support comprehensive field studies that gather information on wildlife needs and then seek to resolve key conservation problems by working with a broad array of actors. WCS Canada has a track record of our science being recognized as relevant, credible and legitimate by researchers, NGOs and agencies. WCS Canada is independently registered and managed, while retaining a strong collaborative working relationship with sister Wildlife Conservation Society (WCS) programs in more than 60 countries.

Diversity and inclusion are core WCS Canada values. We value the diversity of the people we employ and work with and we strive to provide an inclusive and equitable workplace in which we recognize the unique characteristics, skills and experiences of all employees. We are committed to engaging our employees in our diversity, equity and inclusion work and together we aim to create a workplace where all staff feel they belong and can grow.

WCS Canada’s programs occur on the homelands of Indigenous Peoples whose relationships various governments are described in historic Treaties, modern land claim agreements, and negotiations around unceded lands. We recognize and support Indigenous Peoples in Indigenous-led conservation initiatives as well as the international ecological and social commitments and responsibilities to Indigenous Peoples that Canada has signed, including the Convention on Biological Diversity, the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change, the Convention on the Trade in Endangered Species, the United Nations Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples, and the recommendations of the Truth and Reconciliation Commission. Our commitment to collaboration with Indigenous Peoples ranges from provision of scientific advice to co-creation of research and conservation priorities. We respect Indigenous knowledge systems and include Indigenous ways of knowing in research and conservation programs. We engage in land use planning and impact assessment processes that affect Indigenous Peoples, seeking ways to advance conservation as well as opportunities to sustain the livelihoods and cultures of Indigenous communities. We seek to motivate positive conservation outcomes by supporting effective governance and decision-making processes by Indigenous communities, particularly by supporting Indigenous and Community Conserved Areas.

WCS Canada is committed to contributing to the field of conservation science and the professional development of its employees. Employees are encouraged to participate in professional societies and present their research at conferences and meetings, as well as participate in relevant workshops and training opportunities. Employees are likewise encouraged to mentor graduate students, participate in relevant graduate student committees, and pursue adjunct status with universities as appropriate.

Salary: $74,000 to $84,000 annually depending on experience

The role will suit someone who is motivated, curious and keen to keep developing their knowledge of health data analysis, clinical registries and healthcare processes.

jobs.description:
Senior Salesforce Developer – Public Sector Experience

FormativGroup, LLC.

Salesforce Practice • Remote – U.S. with Potential Travel – Full-Time

Is this you

Are you a certified Salesforce Developer with Public Sector experience who thrives on solving complex challenges and building technology that makes a meaningful impact in the public sector? If you bring strong hands-on development expertise, a consultative mindset, and experience delivering secure Salesforce solutions for government clients, we'd love to connect with you!

About the role

The Senior Salesforce Developer role is focused on designing, developing, and delivering scalable, secure Salesforce solutions that support the evolving needs of Public Sector organizations.

As part of FormativGroup's Salesforce Practice, you'll contribute to enterprise implementations across Salesforce Government Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud, helping public sector clients modernize processes, improve operational efficiency, and enhance the services they provide.

You'll bring deep technical expertise across Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, integrations, and Salesforce configuration while collaborating with architects, business analysts, delivery teams, and client stakeholders. This role combines hands-on development with technical solutioning, client engagement, and Agile delivery within complex, regulated environments.

We're anticipating future openings and are connecting now with great talent who'd like to be considered when the time comes.

What You'll Work On

As a Senior Salesforce Developer, you will:

  • Design, develop, enhance, and deploy scalable Salesforce solutions across Governemnt Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and related Salesforce technologies.
  • Develop and maintain Apex classes, triggers, batch and scheduled jobs, Queueable Apex, and asynchronous processing solutions.
  • Build and optimize Lightning Web Components (LWCs) using JavaScript, Apex, and Salesforce platform services to create responsive, user-friendly applications.
  • Configure and enhance Salesforce functionality using Flows, validation rules, approval processes, dynamic forms, record types, page layouts, and custom metadata.
  • Apply both programmatic and declarative development approaches to deliver efficient, maintainable solutions.
  • Design, develop, and maintain integrations between Salesforce and external enterprise systems using REST/SOAP APIs, middleware, and web services.
  • Develop and execute unit tests, integration tests, and deployment validation activities while maintaining Salesforce coding standards and appropriate test coverage.
  • Configure and maintain Salesforce security controls, including Profiles, Permission Sets, Permission Set Groups, Roles, Sharing Rules, and Organization-Wide Defaults.
  • Support data migration, transformation, cleansing, and bulk data management using Data Loader, Workbench, and related integration tools.
  • Collaborate with Solution Architects, Business Analysts, QA teams, Project Managers, and client stakeholders to refine requirements, validate technical approaches, and support successful delivery.
  • Participate in client-facing workshops, technical discussions, and solution reviews, providing insight into development options, feasibility, and Salesforce best practices.
  • Contribute to Agile/Scrum activities, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily standups, retrospectives, and release planning.
  • Support version control, automated deployments, and CI/CD processes using Git, Gearset, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or comparable tools.
  • Maintain technical documentation, development estimates, solution specifications, and project delivery records.
  • Ensure development practices align with Salesforce standards for security, scalability, performance, governance, and compliance within government and regulated environments.

What You'll Bring

You will likely be successful in this role if you have:

  • Active and valid Salesforce certifications, with Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I required.
  • 5–8+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience supporting enterprise applications and complex implementations.
  • Exposure to Agentic development, Salesforce AI technologies, including Einstein AI, Agentforce, or generative AI capabilities.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering Salesforce solutions for Public Sector clients, that include Government Cloud implementations.
  • Advanced Salesforce development expertise, including Apex classes, triggers, batch processing, asynchronous processing, and Lightning Web Components.
  • Strong experience building complex Salesforce Flows and using declarative automation to support business processes.
  • Hands-on development and configuration experience across Salesforce Government Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture, data modeling, object relationships, application design, and platform development patterns.
  • Experience developing and supporting integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, middleware technologies, and web services.
  • Knowledge of Salesforce governor limits, platform constraints, performance optimization, and development best practices.
  • Experience configuring Salesforce security architecture, including Profiles, Roles, Permission Sets, Sharing Rules, Organization-Wide Defaults, and field-level security.
  • Proficiency with JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and modern front-end development practices.
  • Experience participating in Agile/Scrum delivery environments and collaborating across technical and functional teams.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to engage confidently with client stakeholders, technical teams, and business users.
  • Ability to combine hands-on technical execution with thoughtful solution design and consultative problem-solving.

How You Work

The ideal candidate will:

  • Take ownership of development activities, bringing a proactive and solutions-focused approach from requirements through implementation.
  • Navigate complex technical challenges with sound judgment, creativity, and a strong understanding of Salesforce platform capabilities.
  • Collaborate effectively across distributed delivery teams, client stakeholders, and technical disciplines while maintaining clear communication and accountability.
  • Balance development speed with quality, security, maintainability, and long-term platform performance.
  • Adapt comfortably to evolving requirements, competing priorities, and the delivery expectations of government and regulated client environments.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Salesforce Certified Platform Developer II or additional Salesforce Developer, Consultant, or Architect certifications.
  • Cannabis industry experience, particularly within regulated programs or government environments, is a bonus.
  • Experience delivering Salesforce solutions within a consulting firm, systems integrator, or professional services organization.
  • Experience supporting federal, state, or local government agencies.
  • Exposure to MuleSoft or other enterprise integration platforms.
  • Experience with Salesforce DevOps and CI/CD tools such as Gearset, Git, Jenkins, Copado, or Azure DevOps.
  • Experience developing Experience Cloud portals, digital experiences, and Salesforce CMS capabilities.
  • Experience supporting complex Salesforce migrations, modernization projects, or multi-org implementations.
  • Familiarity with secure development standards, governance, and compliance practices for government Salesforce environments.

What Success Looks Like

  • Salesforce solutions are developed and delivered with strong attention to scalability, security, performance, and business requirements.
  • Technical designs, custom development, integrations, and declarative configurations meet project expectations and Salesforce best practices.
  • Client stakeholders and delivery teams benefit from clear technical communication, thoughtful solution recommendations, and reliable execution.
  • Development activities, testing, documentation, and deployments contribute to consistent, high-quality project delivery.
  • You are recognized as a dependable technical contributor who brings strong Salesforce expertise, ownership, and a collaborative approach to solving complex Public Sector challenges.

Why Join FormativGroup

FormativGroup is a PE-backed technology consulting and implementation partner helping organizations modernize complex business platforms, improve delivery outcomes, and scale technology solutions that support long-term growth. We partner with clients across strategy, solution design, implementation, and ongoing support to help move critical initiatives from vision to execution. Our teams bring deep technical expertise, delivery discipline, and a collaborative approach to every engagement.

At FormativGroup, you'll work with people who are practical, collaborative, and focused on solving meaningful business and technology problems. We're growing, which means you'll have opportunities to contribute ideas, work closely with experienced leaders, and help shape how we deliver for clients.

Employment Eligibility

  • This is a U.S.based remote role with potential client travel.
  • To be considered for this position, candidates must reside in one of the following U.S. states: AR, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DE, FL, GA, IA, ID, IL, IN, KS, KY, MA, MD, MI, MN, MO, NC, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, TN, TX, VA, WI, or Washington, DC.
  • Candidates residing outside these states are not currently eligible for consideration.
  • Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S.
  • FormativGroup is unable to sponsor or assume sponsorship of an employment visa for this position

We are committed to pay equity and transparency. The compensation range for this position represents our good faith estimate of the range we reasonably expect to pay for this role at the time of posting. The actual compensation offered will be determined based on factors such as the candidate’s experience, skills, education, work location, and internal equity.

In addition to base pay, employees may be eligible for discretionary bonuses, commissions, or other incentive programs, as well as a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, 401(k), paid time off, etc.

$130,000—$165,000 USD

We are specialists who help the middle market take full advantage of their technology investments with deep, industry-centric expertise, all in one place, to unify fragmented systems. With deep technical expertise across cloud architecture, system integration, AI, and data strategy, we bridge the gap between business goals and modern platforms.

Location: 100% Remote

Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve engineering workflows, and share practical knowledge.

We are looking for a senior engineer who can connect mobile development, backend services, databases, and infrastructure into a reliable development and delivery process.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior Mobile & Platform Engineer who can work across Android and iOS, contribute to our Kotlin Multiplatform architecture, and support our dedicated developers on both platforms.

Your main focus will be enabling the team to deliver effectively: resolving technical challenges, maintaining shared components, improving development workflows, and managing the backend and infrastructure that support the application.

You will also contribute directly to implementation where needed. Depending on your experience and suitability, the role may include technical team leadership for our Android and iOS developers.

Strong GitHub, GitHub Actions, and runner-management experience is essential. Practical experience with AI-assisted and agentic development is equally important.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support our Android and iOS developers with technical decisions, debugging, code reviews, and integration challenges.
  • Develop and maintain shared application logic using Kotlin Multiplatform.
  • Contribute to native Android and iOS development where platform-specific work is required.
  • Maintain a clear architecture across mobile applications, backend services, APIs, and databases.
  • Develop and maintain backend functionality and server-side integrations.
  • Manage database changes, investigate data-related issues, and maintain reliable migration, backup, and recovery processes.
  • Build and improve CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions.
  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot GitHub runners, including self-hosted runners.
  • Improve build reliability, automated testing, deployment processes, and development environments.
  • Manage server-side application deployments, configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
  • Establish effective AI-assisted and agentic coding workflows across the team.
  • Review AI-generated code and ensure that changes are tested, understandable, secure, and maintainable.
  • Help developers and junior team members use AI tools effectively through practical demonstrations and knowledge sharing.
  • Where appropriate, act as technical team lead: coordinate dependencies, guide implementation, review technical decisions, and help the team resolve blockers.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience in mobile software development.
  • Strong Kotlin and Android development experience, together with practical Swift and iOS development experience.
  • Solid hands-on experience with Kotlin Multiplatform and integrating shared code into both mobile platforms.
  • The ability to investigate problems across mobile clients, APIs, backend services, databases, and infrastructure.
  • Practical backend development experience and a sound understanding of API design, authentication, and application security.
  • Strong SQL and relational database experience, including schema changes, migrations, and performance troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on DevOps experience with Linux servers, application deployment, configuration, and operational troubleshooting.
  • Excellent Git and GitHub knowledge, including pull requests, code reviews, branch workflows, and repository configuration.
  • Strong experience with GitHub Actions and configuring and maintaining GitHub runners.
  • Substantial experience using AI coding assistants and coding agents to deliver working software.
  • The ability to establish development workflows that combine coding agents, automated checks, and human review.
  • Clear communication, practical documentation skills, and a willingness to share knowledge.
  • The ability to work independently while supporting other developers constructively.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Previous experience as a technical lead or senior engineer supporting a mobile development team.
  • GPS, BLE, UWB, NFC, or other location and proximity technologies.
  • Testing mobile applications on real devices and investigating platform-specific behavior.
  • Container-based application deployment and reproducible development environments.
  • Monitoring, incident diagnosis, and maintaining reliable backend services.
  • Coordinating changes that affect mobile applications, backend APIs, and database structures together.

Potential Technical Team Lead Responsibilities

For a suitable candidate, the role can include technical leadership of our Android and iOS developers.

This would involve helping the team make consistent technical decisions, breaking down implementation work, coordinating shared dependencies, and maintaining the quality of delivered changes. You should be comfortable mentoring developers and taking responsibility for the technical direction while remaining actively involved in engineering.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • A central role supporting our mobile development team.
  • The opportunity to shape our architecture, infrastructure, and agentic development workflows.
  • Potential technical teamlead responsibility, depending on suitability.
  • Close collaboration with a team that values practical knowledge sharing.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your experience developing for both Android and iOS, including Kotlin Multiplatform.
  • Your backend, database, and server infrastructure responsibilities.
  • Examples of GitHub Actions workflows and runner environments you have configured or maintained.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with examples of delivered results.
  • Your experience supporting developers, mentoring colleagues, or leading a technical team.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio links, GitHub repositories, and released application references are welcome where available.

Intellectual property, privacy and regulatory compliance

Exodigo is the leading underground mapping solution for non-intrusive discovery. Our platforms combine multi-sensor fusion, 3D imaging, and AI technologies to create complete, accurate underground maps that enable confident decision-making for customers across the built world. We transform the project lifecycle for our customers, who include key community stakeholders in the utilities, transportation and government sectors.

We are experiencing sky-rocketing growth and closed a historically large $96M Series B round in July of 2025.

Job description

This is a senior, hands-on production role for a Bentley Systems specialist with proven expertise in creating CAD models and asset data, together with strong Autodesk Civil 3D and BIM workflow experience. The successful candidate will work with engineers, surveyors, and project teams to transform design information, survey data, and existing-condition data into reliable, client-ready deliverables.

What You Will Do:

  • Create and maintain detailed civil engineering drawings (CAD) and 3D models using Bentley Systems base open roads and Open budlings , strong fumiler with Civil 3d and AutoCAD.
  • Develop coordinated BIM deliverables from design drawings, survey data, as-built documentation, and other project inputs.
  • Produce surfaces, alignments, profiles, corridors, grading models, pipe networks, sections, and construction documentation.
  • Create existing-condition models from LiDAR scans and registered point clouds, where applicable.
  • Translate 2D engineering drawings into coordinated 3D models, working directly with designers to capture design intent.
  • Utilities & Existing Conditions: Incorporate survey data, point clouds, and subsurface utility information into models, with an understanding of Subsurface Utility Engineering (SUE) practices and exposure to standards such as PAS128 (UK) or ASCE 38-22 (US).
  • Update models and drawings throughout the project lifecycle and maintain clear version control.
  • Develop and improve templates, standards, object libraries, and repeatable modeling workflows.
  • Coordinate model exchanges and resolve data-quality issues with multidisciplinary contributors.
  • Manage assigned tasks independently and deliver high-quality work within project schedules.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in Bentley OpenRoads, MicroStation, and BIM modeling, preferably on infrastructure projects.
  • Strong experience with Civil 3D and AutoCAD, with knowledge of OpenBuildings Designer (OBD) or Revit considered an advantage.
  • Proven ability to develop accurate 2D drawings and coordinated 3D BIM modelsfrom engineering, survey, and existing-condition data.
  • Strong understanding of civil engineering drawings, survey information, coordinate systems, spatial data, and model setup.
  • Experience delivering BIM/CAD work within ProjectWise environments, including structured workflows and client standards.
  • Understanding of BIM standards and delivery requirements, including ISO 19650, BEPs, and client specifications.
  • Experience with infrastructure projects such as roads, railways, drainage, utilities, land development, or major structures.
  • Strong QA/QC, attention to detail, problem-solving, and ability to work independently while managing multiple assignments and deadlines.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineers, multidisciplinary project teams, and clients, with good technical English.
  • Experience incorporating survey data, point clouds, LiDAR, laser scans, or GISdata into CAD/BIM models is an advantage.

﻿Significant Advantages

  • Experience with scan-to-BIM / point-cloud-to-CAD workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with OpenBuildings Designer (OBD) and 3D MEP modeling.
  • Proficiency in ReCap, Revit, InfraWorks, Navisworks, or similar tools.
  • Experience developing CAD/BIM standards, templates, automation, or production workflows.

jobs.title: Executive Director,  Enterprise Change Management & Adoption
jobs.excerpt: Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes.
jobs.description:
Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.


Labcorp is seeking an Executive Director, Enterprise Change Management & Adoption to join our team!


Primary Responsibilities


1. Enterprise Change Management Strategy & Methodology

  • Define and lead Labcorp’s enterprise change management and adoption strategy aligned to corporate AI, automation, and digital transformation priorities
  • Establish a repeatable, standardized change management methodology and framework (e.g., structured, research-based approaches such as ADKAR / Prosci or equivalent) scaled for enterprise use
  • Ensure change management is embedded at the beginning of major transformation initiatives rather than treated as a downstream communications activity
  • Create scalable approaches that can be deployed consistently across multiple business units and transformation programs

2. Partnership with Workforce Readiness & Transformation

  • Serve as the change and adoption partner to the Executive Director, Workforce Readiness & Transformation, on the AI and Tech-enabled transformation major initiatives
  • Translate workforce impact assessments, future-state role designs, and workforce transition plans into change strategies, stakeholder plans, and adoption approaches
  • Jointly define the division of labor on each initiative so workforce design and change execution are complementary and non-duplicative
  • Co-develop integrated readiness measures that connect workforce readiness with change readiness and adoption
  • Align reskilling and capability-building milestones with adoption and reinforcement timelines

3. Strategic Partnership with IT & AI Transformation

  • Partner closely with Information Technology, Digital Transformation leaders, and the Office of the Chief AI Officer (CAIO) to align change and adoption activities to Labcorp’s AI and digital roadmap
  • Participate in planning and prioritization for major AI, automation, and technology initiatives to proactively identify change impacts and adoption requirements
  • Ensure change management, communications, and adoption activities are incorporated into solution deployment plans and release schedules
  • Drive adoption of enterprise AI tooling, agentic platforms, automation solutions, and emerging technologies
  • Translate technology roadmaps into change impacts, stakeholder actions, and adoption plans

4. Stakeholder Engagement & Leadership Alignment

  • Identify, map, and segment stakeholders across impacted business units, functions, and employee populations
  • Activate and enable executive sponsors, building visible, active, and sustained sponsorship for change
  • Develop and equip a network of change agents, champions, and people leaders to drive adoption at the front line
  • Build leadership alignment and coalition across senior stakeholders on the case for change and the path to adoption
  • Partner with HR Business Partners and business leaders to lead change within their organizations

5. Change Impact & Adoption Assessment

  • Assess the change impacts of AI, automation, and digital transformation initiatives on people, processes, and ways of working
  • Conduct change readiness assessments and identify adoption risks across impacted populations
  • Define adoption requirements and target behaviors for each impacted stakeholder segment
  • Identify sources of resistance early and develop targeted mitigation strategies
  • Partner with Workforce Readiness & Transformation to connect workforce impacts with the change actions required to adopt them

6. Communications & Engagement Enablement

  • Define enterprise change communications strategies that build awareness, understanding, desire, and commitment
  • Partner with Corporate Communications and leadership teams to deliver clear, consistent, audience-specific messaging
  • Develop sponsor, manager, and change-agent communication toolkits and talking points
  • Create engagement approaches that give employees a voice in the change and surface feedback
  • Sequence communications to align with initiative milestones, deployment waves, and adoption moments

7. Change & Adoption Playbook & Operating Model

  • Design, test, and scale a repeatable Change Management & Adoption Playbook
    • Establish enterprise methodologies for:
      • Change impact and readiness assessment
      • Stakeholder analysis and sponsorship activation
      • Communications and engagement planning
      • Resistance management
      • Adoption planning and reinforcement
      • Change measurement and sustainment
      • Continuously refine the playbook based on lessons learned and deployment outcomes
      • Create tools, templates, and frameworks that can be consistently applied across transformation efforts

8. Transformation Execution & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Lead change and adoption workstreams associated with major AI, automation, and digital transformation initiatives
  • Develop resource model and coordinate change resources across the enterprise to support major transformation initiatives
  • Establish repeatable approaches that can be utilized across multiple transformation initiatives
  • Operate as a player-coach leader who actively participates in solving change and adoption challenges
  • Build Enterprise HR capability in change management

9. Reinforcement, Sustainment & Change Analytics

  • Define adoption, reinforcement, and sustainment approaches that embed new behaviors beyond go-live
  • Develop manager and leadership guidance for leading teams through change and reinforcing adoption

Define and track change and adoption success metrics, including:

  • Change readiness and stakeholder sentiment
  • Adoption and usage rates
  • Proficiency and sustained behavior change
  • Speed of adoption and time-to-value
  • Resistance reduction and issue resolution
  • Partner with Finance, IT, and business leaders to connect adoption to measurable business outcomes
  • Establish data-driven methods for prioritizing change investments and interventions

10. Executive Partnership & Governance

  • Serve as a strategic advisor to the CHRO, CIO, CAIO, and senior business leaders on change and adoption
  • Act as a connector across HR, IT, Talent, Learning, Communications, and business teams
  • Provide visibility into change readiness, adoption progress, risks, and outcomes
  • Support enterprise governance processes related to AI, transformation, and organizational readiness
  • Help shape prioritization of transformation initiatives based on change impact and adoption considerations

Measures of Success

  • Enterprise change management strategy and methodology established and adopted
  • Increased adoption rates and sustained behavior change across priority populations
  • Successful deployment of change and adoption playbooks across multiple initiatives
  • Reduced time-to-adoption for major digital and AI initiatives
  • Active, visible sponsorship and strong leader and employee adoption outcomes
  • Early identification and effective mitigation of resistance
  • Measurable business value realized through adoption of transformation investments
  • Seamless, complementary partnership with Workforce Readiness & Transformation across initiatives

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree
  • 12+ years of experience in organizational change management, transformation, organizational effectiveness, or related fields

Additional Job Standards

  • Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-scale change management on large, complex transformation initiatives
  • Expertise in:
    • Change management strategy and methodology
    • Stakeholder engagement and sponsorship activation
    • Change and adoption communications
    • Resistance management
    • Adoption planning, reinforcement, and sustainment
    • Change measurement and analytics
    • Transformation program leadership
    • Deep fluency in a structured change management methodology
    • Experience assessing the change and adoption implications of operational, technology, or business transformations
    • Strong analytical and data fluency, with the ability to translate insights into change decisions
    • Demonstrated ability to work across business, HR, and technology functions
    • Experience building enterprise frameworks, methodologies, or operating models
    • Strong executive presence and stakeholder management skills
  • Experience leading change and adoption for AI-enabled, automation-enabled, or digital transformations
  • Experience partnering closely with technology organizations and workforce transformation teams
  • Experience within healthcare, life sciences, diagnostics, logistics, or other operationally complex environments
  • Consulting, transformation, or organizational effectiveness background
  • Familiarity with adoption analytics and digital adoption platforms

Leadership Profile

  • Enterprise-minded: Connects strategy, technology, people, and business outcomes
  • Change strategist: Understands how people and organizations move through and adopt change
  • Collaborative influencer: Leads through influence in highly matrixed environments
  • Systems thinker: Connects technology transformation with the human change required to adopt it
  • Player-coach: Comfortable both developing strategy and driving hands-on execution
  • Adoption leader: Builds sustained behavior change and reinforcement, not just plans and communications

Role Overview

Labcorp is accelerating toward a digitally enabled, AI-powered operating model that is fundamentally reshaping how work gets done, how roles are defined, and how value is created. Technology deployment alone does not deliver that value — value is realized only when leaders and employees actually adopt new tools, new processes, and new ways of working, and sustain those behaviors over time.

The Executive Director, Enterprise Change Management & Adoption leads Labcorp’s enterprise strategy and execution for organizational change management and adoption across AI, automation, and digital transformation initiatives. This leader ensures that the people side of change — awareness, desire, stakeholder alignment, communications, resistance management, and reinforcement — is planned and executed with the same rigor as the technology itself.


This role partners with the Executive Director, Workforce Readiness & Transformation across every major transformation initiative:

  • Workforce Readiness & Transformation serves as the bridge between business operations, Information Technology, Talent & Learning, HR Business Partners, and enterprise leaders to ensure employees, leaders, skills, roles, and workforce structures evolve alongside technology-enabled change.
  • Enterprise Change Management & Adoption owns the change response, including the change strategy, stakeholder engagement, communications, adoption planning, resistance management, and reinforcement that convert workforce strategies into sustained behavior change and realized value.

Together they ensure that transformation initiatives produce both the right future-state workforce and the adoption required to make it stick. This is a highly collaborative, execution-focused role responsible for establishing a repeatable Change Management & Adoption Playbook and applying it across Labcorp’s most strategic transformation initiatives.


Purpose of the Role

The Executive Director will ensure that enterprise transformation investments translate into adopted, sustained new ways of working through:

  • Enterprise change management strategies that move leaders and employees from awareness to adoption
  • Change impact and adoption assessments tied to digital transformation initiatives
  • Stakeholder engagement, sponsorship activation, and leadership alignment
  • Communications and engagement strategies that build understanding and commitment
  • Resistance identification and mitigation approaches
  • Adoption planning, reinforcement, and sustainment mechanisms
  • Change readiness, adoption, and behavior-change measurement
  • Measurable business value realization through adoption

This role focuses on how people move through change and adopt new ways of working. and ensures the change required to adopt them succeeds.


Why This Role Matters

Technology does not create value on its own. Value is realized when organizations successfully change how people work, lead, communicate, and sustain new behaviors.


Where Workforce Readiness & Transformation prepares the workforce — the roles, skills, and structures of the future — this role ensures the organization actually adopts those changes. It is the execution complement that turns readiness into results.


By leading enterprise change management and adoption, this role ensures Labcorp captures the full value of its AI, automation, and digital transformation investments — helping leaders and employees embrace new ways of working and make them stick in an increasingly AI-enabled enterprise.

Application Window: Application window will close on November 13, 2026


Pay Range: $200,000-$220,000

All job offers will be based on a candidate’s skills and prior relevant experience, applicable degrees/certifications, as well as internal equity and market data. The position is also eligible for an annual bonus under the Labcorp Bonus Plan. Bonuses are payable based on corporate and/or business segment performance and are subject to individual performance modifiers. Compensation may also include discretionary short- and long-term incentive packages.


Benefits: Employees regularly scheduled to work 20 or more hours per week are eligible for comprehensive benefits including: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, STD/LTD, 401(k), Paid Time Off (PTO) or Flexible Time Off (FTO), Tuition Reimbursement and Employee Stock Purchase Plan. jobs.excerpt: Що у нас є: — реалізований робочий продукт — новий продукт, який ми вже розробили й тепер хочемо активно просувати — команда класних спеців (програмісти, сейли, дизайнер, копірайтер і т.
jobs.description:
Що у нас є: — реалізований робочий продукт — новий продукт, який ми вже розробили й тепер хочемо активно просувати — команда класних спеців (програмісти, сейли, дизайнер, копірайтер і т.д.) — ресурси та купа ідей для наступних запусків.

І зараз нам потрібен маркетолог, який допоможе перетворювати ці ідеї на реальні результати.

Ми не шукаємо маркетингового гуру з досвідом запуску двадцяти стартапів. Нам цікава людина з хорошою маркетинговою базою, кількома роками досвіду в IT та бажанням пробувати нове.

Така, якій цікаво розібратися, чому один канал працює, а інший ні, яка готова тестувати нестандартні гіпотези, не боїться експериментувати й любить, коли результат роботи можна побачити в цифрах.

Що потрібно буде робити:

  • Підтримувати маркетинг KeyApp: процеси налаштовані й працюють, тож винаходити велосипед не доведеться. Але якщо бачиш, як зробити краще, ми тільки за.
  • Брати участь у запуску нових продуктів: досліджувати ринок, конкурентів та аудиторію, визначати позиціонування, формувати й реалізовувати Go-to-Market стратегії.
  • Генерувати й тестувати маркетингові гіпотези. Шукати нові канали залучення: SEO, PPC, контент, LinkedIn, email, спільноти, партнерства та будь-які інші інструменти, які можуть дати результат.
  • Працювати з воронкою залучення: від першого знайомства з продуктом до реєстрації, покупки та повернення клієнта. Шукати точки втрати конверсії та можливості її покращення.
  • Аналізувати маркетингові та продуктові метрики, оцінювати ефективність каналів, експериментів і вкладених ресурсів. Не просто збирати цифри, а розуміти, що з ними робити далі.
  • Використовувати AI-інструменти для досліджень, генерації ідей, аналізу даних, автоматизації та прискорення маркетингових процесів.
  • Співпрацювати з розробниками, дизайнерами, PPC-спеціалістом та Sales. У нас є кому реалізовувати ідеї, головне розуміти, що і навіщо ми робимо.
  • Долучатися до пошуку нових продуктових можливостей: досліджувати перспективні ніші, вивчати потреби аудиторії та пропонувати ідеї для майбутніх продуктів.

Що пропонуємо:

  • Можливість реально впливати на продукт. Твої ідеї не мають проходити сім кіл погоджень. Якщо бачимо потенціал, обговорюємо, тестуємо й дивимося на результат.
  • Готову команду для реалізації. Не потрібно самому одночасно бути маркетологом, програмістом і дизайнером.
  • Різноманітні завдання. Тут буде і робота зі зрілим міжнародним продуктом, і запуск нових сервісів, і можливість долучатися до створення наступних.
  • Стабільну зарплату у твердій валюті. Скільки домовились, стільки й отримуєш. Завжди вчасно, без неприємних сюрпризів.
  • Фінансовий бонус. За результатами роботи, адже круті результати мають винагороджуватися.
  • Час на відпочинок і турботу про себе. 24 календарні дні оплачуваної відпустки та лікарняні.
  • Work-life balance. 8-годинний робочий день, субота й неділя — вихідні. Без культури овертаймів, бо ми впевнені: хто добре відпочиває, той добре працює.
  • Повний remote. Працюй звідти, де тобі комфортно. Головне для нас — результат, а не присутність в офісі.
  • Простір для розвитку та експериментів. Оплачуємо професійне навчання й конференції, підтримуємо нові ідеї та даємо можливість реалізовувати їх на практиці.
  • Здорову корпоративну культуру. У нас прийнято говорити прямо, бути чесними, відкритими й поважати одне одного. Любимо жарти.

Що для нас важливо:

  • Профільна освіта в маркетингу та 1−3 роки практичного досвіду маркетологом в IT, бажано в продуктовій компанії.
  • Розуміння принципів digital-маркетингу, побудови маркетингових воронок та основних метрик: CAC, LTV, CPA/CPI, конверсій.
  • Практичний досвід роботи хоча б із 2−3 каналами залучення клієнтів: PPC, SEO, email, LinkedIn, SMM або іншими.
  • Досвід роботи з маркетинговою аналітикою (GA4 або аналогами), UTM-мітками та оцінкою ефективності кампаній.
  • Впевнене використання AI-інструментів у щоденній роботі.
  • Англійська від B1—B2 для роботи з міжнародними ринками, дослідженнями та англомовними матеріалами.
  • Уміння самостійно організовувати роботу, ставити зрозумілі завдання іншим спеціалістам і доводити свої ідеї до реалізації.

Але найголовніше для нас — твій підхід до роботи.

Ми шукаємо людину, яка:

  • Ініціативна. Не чекає, поки їй принесуть готовий план, а сама пропонує, що ще можна спробувати.
  • Допитлива. Любить розбиратися в нових продуктах, технологіях, ринках та інструментах.
  • Самостійна. Уміє перетворити ідею на конкретні дії, організувати процес і довести його до результату.
  • Не боїться експериментів. Розуміє, що не кожна гіпотеза спрацює з першого разу, але з кожної можна зробити висновки.
  • Дружить із цифрами. Уміє аргументувати рішення даними, а не лише відчуттям, що «це має зайти».
  • Хоче розвиватися. Не обмежує себе одним маркетинговим каналом і готова освоювати нові напрямки.

Буде плюсом:

  • Досвід у B2B, SaaS, mobile marketing або ASO.
  • Участь у запуску нового продукту чи виході на новий ринок.
  • Базові навички роботи з Canva, Figma, CapCut.
  • Власні проєкти, блог, канал чи будь-які інші маркетингові експерименти, які ти запускав/запускала самостійно.

Keyapp — українська продуктова IT-компанія, яка створила платформу для просування мобільних застосунків і допомагає збільшувати органічний трафік для iOS та Android по всьому світу.

Ми працюємо з логікою продукту, даними, API та інженерними рішеннями, які допомагають краще розуміти ринки мобільних застосунків.

Are you someone who enjoys solving complex data problems, connecting the dots, and finding better ways to get things done?

If you enjoy tackling difficult data challenges — and finding ways to make them easier to solve the next time — we'd love to hear from you.

Candidates who live within 50 miles of Boston, MA; Portsmouth, NH; Seattle, WA; Columbus, OH; or Plano, TX will follow a hybrid schedule, coming into the office two days per week. Otherwise, this role is remote with occasional travel.

  • Build reusable knowledge: Document data sources, business logic, and prior analyses to make future requests easier to understand and fulfill.
  • Drive visibility and accountability: Develop and maintain reporting that provides senior leadership with visibility into regulatory request status, progress, and emerging challenges, highlighting risks and issues that may require escalation or leadership support.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.excerpt: About Alchemy Analytical Group AAG is a leading manufacturer of consumables for life science analytical instruments, helping scientific and industrial customers by providing the key products they need to run their labs.
jobs.description:
About Alchemy Analytical Group
AAG is a leading manufacturer of consumables for life science analytical instruments, helping scientific and industrial customers by providing the key products they need to run their labs. Headquartered in Southwest Michigan, we operate 13 business units across the U.S., Canada, UK, and Ireland., with revenues exceeding $100 million.

Backed by Kanbrick, a long-term investment partner, we’re building the systems, processes, and technology needed to support our next stage of growth. That creates an opportunity for people who enjoy solving complex problems, building scalable solutions, and helping transform how data is used across the business.

The Role
AAG runs on data spread across companies, sites, and systems that operate largely independently. We are building a consolidated data warehouse: the one place where the group’s data is reliable, current, and usable for those running the business. This infrastructure will be the foundation by which we operate and scale the business, from the CEO to the shop floor, and is intended to support every function including Commercial, Manufacturing, Finance, Marketing, etc.

Reporting to the AAG Global Director of Strategy & Corporate Development the Data Engineer will:

  • Lead the creation of production-grade infrastructure. Develop reliable, documented, and stable technology to run reporting and decisions against.
  • Build and maintain data pipelines. Get data flowing into the warehouse cleanly and consistently from across AAG’s companies and systems (e.g., ERP, CRM, shop floor data tracking, etc.) and keep it flowing as sources change.
  • Own the reporting layer. Shape raw data into models that people can use, so the business gets answers. Build and maintain reporting that ties the numbers to how the companies operate.
  • Take ownership of the system. Working alongside current technical leadership, take over its development and day-to-day maintenance.
  • Technical foundations. You are comfortable with SQL and a modern data stack, building ELT pipelines, modeling data in a cloud warehouse, and working in code rather than only in BI tools.

Requirements

Who We’re Looking For
This is a build role with real ownership from day one and a clear path to broader responsibility:

  • A data or analytics engineer who has built or substantially contributed to data pipelines or a warehouse and wants to own one end to end.
  • A software engineer who has gravitated toward data infrastructure and wants a system to call their own.
  • A technically strong analyst who has outgrown spreadsheets and BI tools and has started building the pipelines behind them.
  • A quick learner who can work with the Strategy & Corporate Development team to translate user requirements from the CEO and AAG Leadership Team into code.

What will make someone thrive here is less about background than disposition:

  • An ownership instinct. You treat the system as yours, including the highlights of new module releases and the unglamorous maintenance that keeps it trustworthy.
  • Comfort with ambiguity. You make progress before every requirement is defined, and you ask the right questions as you go.
  • A bias toward solutions that work. You take an 80/20 approach to get to solutions efficiently, then refine and harden where needed.

Skills, software and tools
Nexus runs on Azure. Fivetran lands data from the group’s ERP systems into Databricks, where a medallion model (bronze, silver, gold) governed by Unity Catalog is built in SQL and Python and deployed from GitHub. The gold layer is mirrored nightly into Azure PostgreSQL and served through an Entra gated web portal.

The essentials below are the foundations. Everything under nice to have is something you can pick up here. If you meet most of the essentials, apply: we are hiring for trajectory, not for a checklist.

Essential: SQL · Python · Azure · Databricks · Dimensional modeling · ELT Pipelines · CI/CD and Github / branching · AI-native development and experience with Codex or Claude Code

Nice to have: Finance and accounting literacy · ERP systems · Manufacturing data / process experience

This role can be remote in the U.S., UK, or Ireland or in person at one of our locations (Stevensville, Michigan (US), Devon (UK), or Strathaven (Scotland)). The role will also require periodic (<10%) domestic and international travel.

Job Family:
