What You Will Do:

As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer Lead, you will work directly with clients and multidisciplinary delivery teams to turn complex business and mission needs into practical, production-ready AI solutions. You will operate at the intersection of AI, software engineering, data, and client delivery, moving quickly from ambiguous problems to working prototypes, integrated solutions, and scalable implementation patterns.

This role combines hands-on engineering, client-facing technical leadership, innovation, and team development. You will lead complex forward deployed engagements while helping build the next generation of Forward Deployed Engineers through hands-on mentorship, technical coaching, and repeatable engineering and delivery best practices.


Forward Deployed Engineering & Solution Delivery

  • Lead forward deployed engineering engagements, partnering directly with clients to understand complex workflows, identify high-value opportunities, and translate business and mission needs into working AI solutions.
  • Rapidly design, prototype, test, and deploy generative AI and agentic AI applications within complex enterprise environments.
  • Build advanced AI solutions using leading large language models, APIs, developer tooling, and enterprise AI platforms.
  • Translate ambiguous and evolving requirements into practical technical designs, prototypes, and production-ready solutions.
  • Design and implement agentic architectures incorporating Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent-to-agent (A2A) communication, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool use, structured outputs, orchestration, context management, and human review where appropriate.
  • Lead technical discovery sessions, architecture discussions, demonstrations, and hands-on solution working sessions with client stakeholders.
  • Partner directly with users throughout implementation to gather feedback, diagnose challenges, refine solutions, and drive adoption.
  • Identify innovative and practical ways to apply emerging AI capabilities to complex client challenges while balancing usability, performance, security, maintainability, and responsible AI.

Engineering & Integration

  • Architect, build, and maintain integrations with internal and external systems using APIs, services, data pipelines, and modern application development practices.
  • Design AI applications and agents that interact with enterprise data, tools, business systems, APIs, and other agents.
  • Design and implement MCP-based integrations connecting AI applications and agents with enterprise tools, services, and data sources.
  • Design and implement A2A and multi-agent patterns enabling specialized agents to coordinate and communicate as part of broader workflows.
  • Design and implement RAG solutions, including enterprise knowledge retrieval, embeddings, vector search, grounding, and related retrieval patterns.
  • Apply modern software engineering practices to move solutions from rapid prototype through testing, deployment, and operational support.
  • Work with relational databases, vector stores, retrieval systems, APIs, and related data patterns to support application state, knowledge retrieval, traceability, and auditability.
  • Implement testing, evaluation, logging, monitoring, and observability for AI-enabled applications and agentic workflows.
  • Diagnose complex technical and integration issues across applications, models, agents, APIs, data, and infrastructure.
  • Establish reusable technical patterns and accelerators that improve the quality and speed of future implementations.

Client & Technical Leadership

  • Serve as a trusted senior technical advisor to clients on complex generative AI and agentic AI initiatives.
  • Build relationships with technical, business, data, and leadership stakeholders, connecting client needs with practical technical solutions.
  • Communicate complex technical concepts, solution options, risks, and trade-offs clearly to technical teams, business stakeholders, and senior client leaders.
  • Facilitate technical discovery and working sessions that turn ambiguous client problems into actionable engineering decisions and solution approaches.
  • Present prototypes, solution demonstrations, architecture decisions, and technical recommendations to client stakeholders.
  • Ask effective questions, listen to client needs, and adapt technical approaches based on business, mission, user, and technology considerations.
  • Challenge assumptions constructively and propose innovative approaches when conventional solutions do not adequately address the problem.
  • Balance rapid experimentation and creative problem-solving with the engineering discipline required to deliver reliable, secure, maintainable, and scalable solutions.

FDE Capability Building & Mentorship

  • Mentor and develop junior and mid-level engineers into effective Forward Deployed Engineers, building both their technical engineering skills and client-facing delivery capabilities.
  • Coach team members on FDE best practices, including technical discovery, problem decomposition, requirements translation, rapid prototyping, solution design, client communication, demonstrations, implementation, troubleshooting, and knowledge transfer.
  • Provide hands-on technical direction, architecture guidance, code review, pairing, and engineering mentorship.
  • Develop and promote reusable FDE playbooks, engineering standards, solution patterns, accelerators, and implementation best practices.
  • Coach team members on modern agentic AI engineering patterns, including MCP, A2A, RAG, tool use, orchestration, evaluation, and responsible AI practices.
  • Help engineers become comfortable operating in ambiguous client environments and moving independently from problem identification through working solution.
  • Create opportunities for junior team members to progressively assume responsibility for technical discovery, client discussions, demonstrations, solution ownership, and technical leadership.
  • Foster a culture of experimentation, continuous learning, collaboration, technical excellence, and responsible AI development.
  • Capture and share lessons learned across engagements to continuously improve FDE practices and delivery quality.

What You Will Need:

  • Must be able to OBTAIN and MAINTAIN a Federal PUBLIC TRUST;. Candidates with an ACTIVE PUBLIC TRUST or SUITABILITY are preferred.
  • SEVEN (7+) or more years of overall work experience.
  • Experience in software engineering, data engineering, AI/ML engineering, solution engineering, or a related technical role.
  • Experience working as a Forward Deployed Engineer, Forward Deployed Software Engineer, Forward Deployed AI Engineer, or in a comparable client-embedded engineering role, including translating ambiguous client requirements into working technical solutions.
  • Hands-on experience designing and building generative AI, large language model, or agentic AI solutions.
  • Hands-on experience developing solutions using Claude APIs, Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, tool use, Custom Skills, or comparable enterprise large language model platforms and developer tooling.
  • Hands-on experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and its use in connecting AI applications or agents with tools, services, data sources, or enterprise systems.
  • Hands-on experience with agent-to-agent (A2A) and multi-agent solution patterns, including communication or coordination among specialized agents.
  • Hands-on experience designing and implementing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) solutions, including enterprise knowledge retrieval, embeddings, vector search, and grounding LLM applications with authoritative data or content.
  • Hands-on experience designing agentic AI solutions using tool use, structured outputs, context management, orchestration, and human-in-the-loop patterns.
  • Strong software engineering experience using modern programming languages, APIs, services, and application development frameworks.
  • Experience integrating AI applications and agents with enterprise systems, databases, APIs, tools, and data sources.
  • Experience developing reliable, maintainable, testable, and well-documented production code.
  • Demonstrated experience mentoring and developing engineers, including coaching team members on engineering standards, technical problem-solving, solution delivery, and client-facing responsibilities.
  • Strong client communication and consulting skills, with demonstrated ability to work effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders, and senior client leaders.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical discovery and translate ambiguous business or mission problems into actionable technical requirements and working solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex technical implementations and providing technical direction to engineering or multidisciplinary teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to think innovatively, challenge conventional approaches, rapidly evaluate emerging technologies, and develop creative technical solutions to complex or undefined problems.
  • Strong written, verbal, presentation, facilitation, and interpersonal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical concepts, architecture decisions, risks, recommendations, and trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.

What Would Be Nice To Have:

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university.
  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical field.
  • Experience delivering AI, data, or software solutions within Federal Government, healthcare, financial services, or other highly regulated environments.
  • Experience deploying generative AI and agentic solutions on major cloud and enterprise AI platforms such as Microsoft Azure / Azure OpenAI, AWS / Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud / Vertex AI, Databricks, or comparable platforms.
  • Experience with modern AI and agent development frameworks and patterns, such as LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or comparable orchestration frameworks.
  • Experience operationalizing generative AI solutions, including LLM evaluation, tracing, observability, prompt and model management, guardrails, cost optimization, and production monitoring.
  • Experience designing secure AI architectures incorporating identity and access management, secrets management, API security, data protection, authorization, auditability, and responsible AI controls.
  • Experience working with containers, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and cloud-native deployment patterns, including technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or Terraform.
  • Experience with knowledge graphs, graph databases, advanced retrieval techniques, hybrid search, reranking, or other approaches that improve the quality and reliability of enterprise RAG solutions.
  • Experience developing reusable AI accelerators, reference architectures, engineering frameworks, or platform capabilities that can be applied across multiple teams or client engagements.
  • Experience contributing to technical strategy, solution architecture, estimation, proposal development, technical demonstrations, or client pursuit activities.
  • Relevant cloud, AI, data, or security certifications.
  • Active Federal Public Trust, Secret, or higher-level security clearance.
The annual salary range for this position is $149,000.00-$248,000.00. Compensation decisions depend on a wide range of factors, including but not limited to skill sets, experience and training, security clearances, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs.

We aim to help these organizations unlock significant business value by deploying GenAI at scale, helping to ensure they stay at the forefront of technological advancement and maintain a competitive edge in their respective markets.

About Job

Overview
We are seeking a Power Platform and Fabric professional to design, build, and deliver an end-to-end lessor scorecard solution. The role replaces manual, spreadsheet-based scorecard tracking with a structured, automated, and secure reporting system, and hands it over to Microsoft owners with full documentation.

Key Responsibilities

1. Environment Setup

  • Stand up Power Platform environments (Dev / Test / Prod) with Dataverse, DLP policies, and approved connectors
  • Configure Power BI and Fabric workspaces per environment, including capacity and naming conventions
  • Provision a SQL database (Azure SQL or Fabric SQL) for structured scorecard data
  • Set up security groups, service principals / service accounts, and source control for solutions and reports

2. Data Integration (ETL)

  • Inventory current data sources (Excel trackers, SharePoint lists, emails, existing systems)
  • Replace free-form spreadsheets with structured data entry (Power Apps / Forms into Dataverse or SQL)
  • Build Fabric pipelines and dataflows to load, clean, and validate data on a schedule
  • Design a star-schema semantic model (lessor, property, period, metric) as the single source for reporting

3. Automation and AI

  • Build Power Automate flows for scorecard requests, reminders, approvals, and escalations
  • Implement automated data-quality checks with exception routing to data owners
  • Where it adds value, apply AI capabilities (e.g., Copilot Studio, AI Builder) to extract data from submitted documents, draft lessor summaries, or answer questions on scorecard status

4. Metrics and Reporting

  • Define the metric catalog with business stakeholders: KPI definitions, formulas, thresholds, and owners
  • Develop Power BI reports, including portfolio overview, lessor scorecard, trends, and drill-down
  • Configure email alerts and subscriptions for threshold breaches and periodic management packs
  • Build Power App views for operational users to submit, review, and act on scorecards

5. Monitoring and Access Control

  • Implement role-based access (workspace roles, Dataverse security roles, row-level security in Power BI)
  • Set up pipeline and refresh monitoring with failure alerts, plus usage and adoption tracking
  • Establish ALM with deployment pipelines (Dev → Test → Prod) and change control
  • Deliver documentation, runbooks, and knowledge transfer to Microsoft owners

Required Skills

  • Hands-on experience with Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, and Power BI
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric (pipelines, dataflows, lakehouse/warehouse) and SQL
  • Strong data modeling skills, including star-schema design and DAX
  • Familiarity with Power Platform governance, security, and ALM practices
  • Ability to work directly with business stakeholders to define metrics and requirements

Salary: $85K/Annum

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Engineer - EMEA
jobs.excerpt: Who are Tyk, and what do we do? The Tyk API Management platform is helping to drive the connected world and power new products and services.
jobs.description:
Who are Tyk, and what do we do?

The Tyk API Management platform is helping to drive the connected world and power new products and services. We’re changing the way that organisations connect any number of their systems and services. Whether internal, external, public or highly encrypted systems, Tyk helps businesses drive value across the retail, finance, telecoms, healthcare, or media industries (to name just a few!)

If you’ve banked online, used an app to check the news, or perhaps even driven a connected car, API’s, and by extension, Tyk, make that possible. Founded in 2015 with offices in London - UK, London - Ontario, Atlanta and Singapore, we have many thousands of users of our B2B platform across the globe. Brands using Tyk range from Lotte, Bell, T Mobile, to RBS, Capital One and Vinci. We have a varied user base hailing from every continent – even Antarctica.

Our Mission

Tyk is on a mission to connect every system in the world. We’ve started by building an API Management platform.

Total flexibility, default remote, radical responsibility

We offer unlimited paid holidays and remote working from anywhere in the world, for everyone, Why? Tyk was founded on the principle of offering flexibility and autonomy to our employees, we believe this allows our employees to achieve their best results. It also means we can build the best possible team, location and working hours are no barrier.

If this sounds like an environment that you believe could work for you then read on to find out more.

About the role

As a Senior Customer Success Engineer at Tyk, you'll be a strategic and technical leader within the Customer Success organization. The team owns traditional support, but this role goes well beyond reacting to issues. You'll help build a proactive Customer Success function focused on long-term customer trust, early risk detection, a better customer experience, and making sure customers get the most value from Tyk.

You'll lead high-priority and technically complex engagements, mentor Customer Success Engineers, and work with Engineering, Product and Account Management to turn customer challenges into improvements across the business.

Your focus is your region. You'll work alongside the Customer Success Engineers there to raise their technical understanding, share knowledge and close gaps, so the region handles more complex work independently.

A key part of the role is improving how the team operates. You'll build processes that strengthen customer relationships, improve technical delivery and let the team scale. You'll also champion AI across Customer Success: faster debugging and investigation, better knowledge sharing, and less repetitive work.

You're the person people turn to when things get complex, whether technical, customer-facing, operational or cross-functional.

Key responsibilities

Escalation management

  • Proactively oversee the Zendesk queue, making sure SLAs are met and stepping in on critical escalations.
  • Act as an escalation point for systemic issues, leading incident resolution. Escalations come to you before going to Product.
  • Work with Senior and Principal engineers across regions to resolve recurring support workflow challenges.
  • Guide triage practices so issues are isolated quickly and accurately across the team.

Mentorship and team development

  • Coach and mentor Customer Success Engineers in your region on technical depth, customer engagement, ownership and handling complex situations independently.
  • Set a high standard for technical quality, communication, accountability and customer ownership.
  • Flag capability gaps to Customer Success leadership and help close them through training, documentation and hiring input.
  • Support engineers through complex cases while building their confidence to lead them independently.
  • Foster a culture of learning, knowledge sharing, collaboration and constructive feedback.

Proactive customer engagement

  • Build trusted relationships with key Enterprise customers through regular account syncs, acting as their senior technical partner.
  • Lead onboardings and regular syncs for Enterprise customers, whose complex environments need senior-level judgement. Onboardings are completed to the checklist.
  • Partner with Account Management to spot customer risk, recurring pain points and opportunities before they become escalations.
  • Help improve proactive engagement processes, so the team builds relationships rather than only answering tickets.

Technical excellence and innovation

  • Lead deep technical investigations, including complex debugging and source code analysis.
  • Innersourcing is strongly encouraged: contribute bug fixes, small features or workarounds to the product to unblock customers, and help other engineers do the same.
  • Build and adopt tools, automation and AI to reduce response and resolution time.
  • Maintain ticket quality, so Product receives actionable, high-quality submissions.
  • Anticipate platform-wide issues and prevent them through architecture awareness.
  • Keep critical knowledge documented: the Zendesk knowledge base, debugging guides and external documentation.

Operations and cross-team collaboration

  • Meet escalation SLAs and play a key role in the on-call rotation for 24/7 global support.
  • Own high-severity incidents and critical customer escalations.
  • Review team metrics regularly and help set team goals and focus areas.
  • Represent Customer Success in company initiatives, and help evolve support policies such as SLAs, escalation procedures and "won't fix" standards.

Voice of the customer and long-term impact

  • Contribute evidenced trends to the monthly Voice of the Customer digest to Product.
  • Lead root cause analysis and post-mortems for major incidents from the Customer Success side.
  • Reduce ticket volume by finding recurring pain points and proposing durable fixes in the platform or documentation.
  • Help evolve support strategy as Tyk grows, influencing structure, tooling and hiring.

Requirements

What we're looking for

  • Extensive experience in technical support, Customer Success Engineering or similar roles, with proven leadership in complex escalations and systemic improvements.
  • Experience coaching or mentoring engineers.
  • Strong technical depth and a hands-on engineering mindset: reproducing problems, working through logs and configuration, reading source code, and diagnosing issues across distributed systems.
  • Strong Docker and Kubernetes knowledge, including debugging deployments, networking, configuration, scaling and application behaviour in containerized environments. This is essential.
  • Experience deploying and troubleshooting on-premise environments, including standing up representative customer environments.
  • Strong background with large Enterprise customers and complex technical environments.
  • Strong experience with APIs and API Management: gateways, authentication, networking, traffic flows and distributed architectures.
  • Comfort learning technologies beyond Tyk, such as Redis, MongoDB, SQL databases, load balancers, proxies, SSO, OAuth/OIDC and Identity Providers.
  • Comfort contributing product code and documentation changes.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to lead without authority, influencing Product, Engineering, Account Management and Customer Success.
  • Passion for operational excellence, automation, AI adoption and scalable Customer Success practices.
  • A growth mindset: curiosity, humility and a desire to keep improving yourself and those around you.
  • Comfort working with customers across regions, with willingness to join rotational on-call shifts, including weekends.

Why Customer Success @ Tyk?

Tyk is on a mission to simplify API and service management for everyone. As a Senior Customer Success Engineer, you'll shape the future of Customer Success, not just as a service but as a strategic advantage. You'll lead initiatives, mentor engineers and work with passionate people around the globe.

Benefits

Here’s why you should join us:

  • Everyone has unlimited paid holidays.
  • We have total flexibility in hours, as we believe creativity flows better when our people are given freedom to decide when they are most productive. Everyone is unique after all.
  • Employee share scheme
  • Generous maternity and paternity leave
  • Volunteering Days
  • Company retreats
  • Employee Wellbeing platform

We all share the same vision - we value authenticity, respect, responsibility, independence, honesty, diversity and inclusion and most importantly treating others how you wish to be treated. We look for like-minded people who bring their personalities to work everyday, strive to achieve their personal goals and who are willing to challenge the way we do things, why? - to make what we do even better!

Our values tell the story of Tyk - here’s how:

  • It’s ok to screw up!

We’ve found that it’s often the ‘stupid’ or unexpected ideas that turn out to be the successful ones - so try it, at least we can say we have!

  • The only stupid idea, is the untested one!

It’s in our DNA - starting a business with founders 12 hours apart, giving our gateway away for free - sure, we did that, and we’d do it again!

  • Trust starts with you - make it count!

Trust is a two-way street - instil it from day one!

  • Assume best intent!

We have each other’s back - we’re all on the same team. Think before you speak or act.

  • Make things better!

Always try to leave things better than when you found them - change is constant, inevitable and embraced! Be that change we want to see.

jobs.title: Information Security Lead
jobs.excerpt: Who we are: Mama Money is a growth-stage fintech on a mission to improve the financial lives of migrants and underserved communities across Africa and beyond.
jobs.description:
Who we are:

Mama Money is a growth-stage fintech on a mission to improve the financial lives of migrants and underserved communities across Africa and beyond. What started in 2015 as a cross-border payments service has grown into a multi-product financial platform — giving people the tools to send, save, and manage money on their own terms, at a socially fair price. Payments were just the beginning; today Mama Money is building the fuller financial toolkit our customers need, all under one roof.
Mama HQ is in beautiful Cape Town. We're 157 people strong (and counting), representing 19 countries across Africa, Asia, the UK, and Europe. Everything we build is in service of people who deserve better — and our culture reflects that same commitment. We've had good times and tough times, but the focus never shifts: people over profit, always.

The role, in short:

    You'll own security at Mama Money end to end. Your main focus is our APIs and the third-party calls our products depend on: payout partners, banks, card and KYC providers. Endpoints come second, but they matter too.
    This is a lead role, not a management layer. You'll set the standards and make the calls, and you'll also do the work: threat modelling, reviewing code and integrations, running incidents. Endpoint security is managed day to day by our outsourced provider. You'll work with them directly, but the accountability for security sits with you.
    A big part of the role is explaining risk clearly to engineers, leadership and regulators, so clear writing matters as much as technical depth.
    After-hours: you'll be the escalation point for security incidents.

What you'll actually be doing:

  • API and integration security: Own the security of our public and partner APIs. Set the standard for authentication, secrets handling, request signing, rate limiting and input validation.
  • Threat model every new partner integration before it goes live, and review existing ones.
  • Monitor third-party calls for anomalies and failures, and make sure we can trace what was sent where.
  • Edge and traffic protection: Own and manage our WAF. Write and tune its rules, manage bot and DDoS protection, and keep false positives low enough that customers aren't blocked.
  • Set up alerting on unusual traffic, such as spikes in volume, failed logins, unusual geographies or suspicious API usage. Investigate alerts and act on them fast.
  • Secure development: Work with engineering to build security into how we ship: code review, dependency and secrets scanning, and SAST/DAST in the pipeline.
  • Run penetration tests and own remediation until findings are closed. Third-party risk: Assess the security of partners and vendors before we connect to them, and keep that review current.
  • Endpoint security: Own the relationship with our outsourced provider. Set the standards, hold them to SLAs, review their reporting and close the gaps.
  • Security operations and incident response: Own monitoring and alerting, the incident response plan and tabletop exercises. Lead incidents when they happen.
  • Compliance: Own the security controls in our ISMS under ISO 27001. Support audits with working evidence, and keep us aligned with POPIA and FSCA, Prudential Authority and SARB cybersecurity requirements.
  • Work with our System Administrator on access management, least privilege and access reviews.
  • Run security awareness for the whole company, and keep documentation and runbooks current.

What we're looking for:

  • 6+ years in information security, with at least 3 in application, API or cloud security.
  • Hands-on API security: OAuth 2.0 and OIDC, JWT, mTLS, request signing, and the OWASP API Security Top 10.
  • Practical AWS security: IAM, KMS, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub, WAF.
  • Experience threat modelling systems and reviewing code for security issues.
  • Experience scoping penetration tests and driving remediation.
  • Experience leading incident response, from detection to post-mortem.
  • Experience managing an outsourced security provider against clear standards.
  • Scripting in Python or Bash, enough to automate checks and pull evidence.
  • One or more of: CISSP or CISM; OSCP, OSWE or GWAPT; AWS Certified Security, Specialty.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in a regulated environment, ideally payments or banking; FSCA, SARB or FIC exposure is a plus.
  • PCI DSS experience.
  • ISO 27001 implementation or audit experience.
  • SIEM and detection engineering.
  • Kubernetes and container security.
  • Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code.

Why Mama?

We build products that help people do more with their money — from sending money home, to saving, to accessing money in ways that feel safe and simple. The work matters because it helps real people in real ways, every single day.
We're not afraid to give things a go, and we take ownership of what we do. We keep learning, support each other, and stay focused on what matters most. If you're after meaningful work and a team that genuinely cares about what they're building — this could be your next move.

Mama's values:

  • Making it easier for customers
  • Give it a go
  • Just own it

jobs.description:
EVERSANA is expanding its Salesforce delivery capacity as part of the AI Hub initiative — and doing so with a new expectation: developers work AI-first. The Sr. Salesforce Developer — AI-Augmented builds and ships Salesforce Health Cloud (ACTICS) features while using AI development tooling as their primary way of working and consuming the agents produced by the AI Hub Center of Excellence.

This is a senior hands-on Salesforce role for someone who is fluent in Apex, LWC, and SOQL and is energized — not threatened — by AI-accelerated development. The role delivers roadmap features faster by pairing strong Salesforce engineering with AI-assisted coding, test generation, and COE-built workflow agents. Both FTE and contractor variants of this role exist; responsibilities are identical.

Mission: Deliver Salesforce Health Cloud features on the ACTICS roadmap, accelerated by AI-first tooling and COE-built agents — at a higher velocity and quality bar than traditional development.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Salesforce Delivery

  • Design, build, and ship Salesforce Health Cloud features using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL, and Flow, per the ACTICS roadmap.
  • Build and maintain Salesforce integrations via REST APIs and Platform Events, coordinating with the MuleSoft integration team.
  • Deliver against sprint commitments in a parallel-track delivery model with compressed timelines.

AI-Augmented Practice

  • Use AI development tooling — Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot — as primary daily tooling, not as an optional aid.
  • Consume COE-built agents (intake automation, missing-information workflow, QNCR reporting, workload queue intelligence) within Salesforce workflows.
  • Practice test-first AI prompting: generate and validate unit tests and Apex test coverage with AI assistance.
  • Validate all AI-generated code against ACTICS quality standards before commit; treat AI output as a draft to be reviewed, never as final.

Collaboration & Quality

  • Pair with the AI Solutions Engineer on Salesforce-side agent integration and on exposing Salesforce data and actions to agents safely.
  • Contribute reusable prompts and patterns to the shared prompt/pattern library, and provide feedback that improves COE agents.
  • Participate in code reviews — both giving and receiving — with attention to the correctness of AI-generated work.
  • Uphold PHI/HIPAA handling standards in all Salesforce and AI-assisted work.

MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

  • 5+ years of Salesforce development experience, including Apex, LWC, and SOQL.
  • Experience with Salesforce Health Cloud or a comparable Salesforce industry cloud.
  • Experience building Salesforce integrations (REST APIs, Platform Events, external services).
  • Demonstrated use of — or strong readiness to adopt — AI-assisted development tooling (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Einstein for Developers).
  • Sound understanding of prompt engineering for code generation and of how to review AI-generated code critically.
  • Comfortable delivering in a fast-paced, compressed-timeline, parallel-track environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce Platform Developer I/II certification.
  • Healthcare, life-sciences, or Patient Services domain experience.
  • Exposure to AI agents, RAG, or LLM-based workflows in a development context.
  • MuleSoft or DataWeave familiarity.

Tools & Stack

  • AI development: Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Einstein for Developers.
  • Salesforce: Salesforce Platform, Health Cloud, ACTICS.
  • Integration: MuleSoft / DataWeave.
  • Lifecycle: Git, Azure DevOps, JIRA.

First-Year Success Measures

  • Consistent delivery of ACTICS roadmap features at the team's AI-accelerated velocity targets.
  • AI development tooling used routinely, with measurable contribution to code-generation and test-automation metrics.
  • COE-built agents successfully integrated into Salesforce workflows for at least the priority use cases.

jobs.excerpt: About UpstartAt Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans.
jobs.description:
About Upstart

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team

Upstart’s Servicing team supports borrowers after loan origination and works to improve outcomes for investors and borrowers. The team is building data-informed approaches across areas such as collections, loan assistance, payment experiences, and borrower communications, with a meaningful opportunity to apply machine learning to problems that have often been addressed manually.

As a Senior Applied Scientist on the Servicing team, you will build predictive and causal models and translate their outputs into decisions that improve how loans are serviced. You’ll partner with Product, Engineering, and Servicing and Collections Operations to evaluate interventions and shape data-informed approaches to payment plans, loan modifications, communications, and autopay.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Develop and evaluate machine-learning models that predict borrower repayment behavior and other servicing outcomes.
  • Apply causal inference and experimentation to measure the impact of servicing interventions, including loan modifications and payment assistance.
  • Translate model predictions and treatment-effect estimates into practical decision algorithms and actions.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering on payment experiences, autopay, and borrower communications, and with Servicing and Collections Operations on collections strategy and agent-performance insights.
  • Identify and develop machine-learning opportunities in servicing areas that have historically relied on manual optimization.
  • Explain analytical choices, tradeoffs, and findings to technical and non-technical partners to inform high-stakes operational and product decisions.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Graduate degree in mathematics, applied mathematics, statistics, physics, econometrics, operations research, computer science, or a related quantitative field.
  • Experience applying causal inference methods and experimentation to real-world decisions in an applied science or data science context.
  • Applied statistics, probability, and experimental-design expertise used to build or evaluate models or interventions.
  • Production-quality coding experience in Python, including data manipulation and algorithm implementation.
  • 2+ years of experience conducting machine-learning, statistical-modeling, or applied quantitative research in an academic or industry setting.

Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in a quantitative field.
  • Experience with payment products or payment experiences, such as autopay, recurring payments, or payment plans.
  • Experience with causal machine-learning methods or treatment-effect modeling.
  • Experience with supervised learning, model evaluation, and feature engineering, especially with large or complex datasets.
  • Experience taking work from exploratory analysis and experimentation through production model development while maintaining analytical rigor and model reliability.
  • Ability to translate broad servicing or business problems into structured research questions and communicate complex findings as actionable recommendations.

Position location

This role is available in the following locations: Remote — United States.

Travel requirements

As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S or Canada (outside of Quebec) but are expected to spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites and in-person meetings. The onsite cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

Individual pay is also determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Job Description

We have an exciting opportunity for a Project Specialist at UL Research Institutes. This is a remote Opportunity.


The Project Specialist supports accurate, timely, and compliant financial administration across the organization. This role manages expense and invoice processing, purchase order creation, vendor onboarding, expense tracking, and financial reporting through Workday while providing dependable support to managers and the Education Director


UL Research Institutes:

At UL Research Institutes (ULRI), we expand the boundaries of safety science to create a more secure and sustainable world. For more than a century, we have studied the unintended consequences of innovation, designed solutions to mitigate risk and shared our findings with academia, scientists, manufacturers, and policymakers across industries. We identify critical safety and sustainability issues, asking the tough questions because we believe a safer world begins with knowledge.


Build a safer, more secure, and sustainable future with us. Join us and work with our Research Experiences & Education teams who conduct the research required to produce that knowledge and put into practice.


IREE:

The Institute for Research Experiences & Education advances UL Research Institutes’ public safety mission by bringing ULRI safety science research and UL Standards & Engagement standards to students and educators across the education continuum through open-access platforms and resources shaped by educational research. Embracing a model in which the expertise of educators and researchers inform each other, our institute engages educators and youth in rigorous learning and educational experiences that build awareness, knowledge and skills, and critical thinking so everyone can see themselves as part of the safety sciences.


What you’ll learn and achieve:

As the Project Specialist, you will play a key role in the rapid growth of ULas you:

  • Enter and maintain financial information for expense reports and invoices, ensuring transactions are accurately coded, properly documented, and processed in a timely manner.
  • Create purchase orders and coordinate required legal and administrative processes to support vendor engagements and business purchases.
  • Set up and maintain records for new vendors in Workday, ensuring required information and documentation are complete and accurate
  • Monitor and maintain expense tracking tools, follow up on outstanding submissions, and ensure expense reports are submitted and processed according to established procedures. Prepare and submit expense reports on behalf of leaders, ensuring supporting documentation is complete and expenses are accurately recorded.
  • Review financial information and identify discrepancies in reporting, timelines, and required documentation, following up as appropriate to support accurate and timely processing. Maintain organized financial records and follow applicable organizational policies and procedures related to purchasing, expenses, vendor management, and financial reporting.
  • Collaborate and communicate effectively with internal teams, leaders, vendors, and other stakeholders to support accurate and timely financial administration.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What you’ll experience working at UL Research Institutes:We have pursued our mission of working for a safer, more secure, and sustainable world for nearly 130 years, embedding conscientious stewardship into everything we do.

  • People: Our people make us special. You’ll work with a diverse team of experts respected for their independence and transparency and build a network, because our approach is collaborative. We collaborate across disciplines, organizations, and geographies to build the global scientific response that today’s global challenges require.
  • Interesting work: Every day is different for us here. We see what’s on the horizon and use our expertise to build the foundations of a safer future. You’ll have the opportunity to push the boundaries of human understanding as part of a team working to advance the public good.
  • Grow and achieve: We learn, work, and grow together through targeted development, reward, and recognition programs.
  • Values. Four core values guide our work: collaboration, respect, integrity, and beneficence. By living our values, we inspire the trust essential to fulfilling our mission and foster the partnerships that enable us to pursue a beneficent future in which we all can thrive.
  • Total Rewards: All employees at UL Research Institutes are eligible for bonus compensation. We offer comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans and a generous 401k matching structure of up to 5% of eligible pay. Moreover, we invest an additional 4% into your retirement saving fund after your first year of continuous employment. Depending on your role, you may be able to discuss flexible working arrangements with your manager. We also provide employees with paid time off, including vacation, holiday, sick, and volunteer days.

What makes you a great fit:

While no one candidate will embody every quality, the successful candidate will bring many of the following professional competencies and personal attributes:

  • Strong attention to detail with a commitment to accuracy and quality.
  • Highly organized and skilled in managing multiple tasks, priorities, and deadlines.
  • Effective problem-solving skills with the ability to identify discrepancies and resolve routine issues.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment and discretion when handling confidential or sensitive information.
  • Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across teams and with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Demonstrates accountability and consistent follow-through on assignments and responsibilities.
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities and respond effectively to time-sensitive assignments.

Professional education and experience requirements for the role include:

  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, accounting, or a related field.
  • Minimum 4 years of experience in financial administration, bookkeeping, accounts payable or expense administration.
  • Working knowledge of expense reporting, invoice processing, purchase orders, and vendor administration.
  • Experience using Workday or a similar financial management system.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and other relevant business applications.

About UL Research Institutes and UL Standards & Engagement

UL Research Institutes and UL Standards & Engagement are nonprofit organizations dedicated to advancing safety science research through the discovery and application of scientific knowledge. We conduct rigorous independent research and analyze safety data, convene experts worldwide to address risks, share knowledge through safety education and public outreach initiatives, and develop standards to guide safe commercialization of evolving technologies. We foster communities of safety, from grassroots initiatives for neighborhoods to summits of world leaders. Our organization employs collaborative and scientific approaches with partners and stakeholders to drive innovation and progress toward improving safety, security, and sustainability, ultimately enhancing societal well-being.

jobs.title: NEN Solution Engineering – Sr. Voice Engineer
jobs.excerpt: We are seeking a seasoned, hands-on Senior VoIP, VTC, and Telephony Solution Engineer to support the design, integration, validation, deployment, and sustainment of enterprise Unified Communications and Collaboration solutions.
jobs.description:
We are seeking a seasoned, hands-on Senior VoIP, VTC, and Telephony Solution Engineer to support the design, integration, validation, deployment, and sustainment of enterprise Unified Communications and Collaboration solutions.

Reporting to the Voice/VTC Manager, this position will serve as a senior technical contributor and may act as the technical lead for assigned projects, workstreams, or engineering efforts. The engineer will be responsible for developing solutions to complex technical problems that span multiple systems or disciplines and for helping ensure assigned solutions are secure, resilient, supportable, and operationally ready.

The engineer may provide technical direction, coordinate the work of engineers supporting an assigned project, review engineering products, and mentor less-experienced team members, but will not be responsible for employee performance management, staffing decisions, or organizational workforce planning.

The successful candidate will remain actively engaged in requirements analysis, alternatives analysis, solution architecture, detailed design, laboratory validation, implementation planning, system integration, testing, and Tier 3/Tier 4 engineering escalations. The position will work closely with Transport Engineering, Network Operations, Cybersecurity, program leadership, customers, telecommunications carriers, and technology vendors.


Key Responsibilities


1. Technical Project and Workstream Leadership

  • Technical Execution: Lead the technical planning and execution of assigned VoIP, VTC, telephony, and collaboration projects or workstreams.
  • Project Coordination: Coordinate engineering activities across multiple technical areas, identify dependencies, track technical milestones, and support the timely completion of project deliverables.
  • Technical Direction: Provide technical guidance to engineers assigned to a project, review engineering work products, and help resolve technical issues that could affect cost, schedule, performance, or operational readiness.
  • Risk Management: Identify technical risks, constraints, assumptions, and dependencies and recommend practical mitigation approaches to project and engineering leadership.
  • Estimating and Planning: Support the development of engineering estimates, bills of material, staffing assumptions, implementation schedules, and levels of effort.
  • Technical Mentoring: Mentor and support other engineers through design reviews, peer reviews, troubleshooting activities, and knowledge-sharing sessions.

2. Systems Engineering and Solution Lifecycle

  • Requirements Analysis: Analyze operational, functional, technical, cybersecurity, performance, availability, and supportability requirements for assigned solutions.
  • Alternatives and Trade Studies: Evaluate technical alternatives based on capability, cost, risk, interoperability, lifecycle status, security, supportability, and implementation complexity.
  • Requirements Allocation: Translate customer and program requirements into system, subsystem, interface, configuration, and testing requirements.
  • Solution Documentation: Develop and maintain high-level designs, low-level designs, interface definitions, bills of material, configuration baselines, implementation procedures, rollback plans, test plans, and as-built documentation.
  • Verification and Validation: Plan and perform laboratory validation, interoperability testing, system testing, acceptance testing, and other verification activities needed to confirm that solutions satisfy defined requirements.
  • Configuration and Quality Control: Apply established engineering, cybersecurity, configuration-management, and quality-assurance processes throughout the solution lifecycle.
  • Operational Transition: Support the transition of new or modified solutions to operations by confirming that monitoring, documentation, support procedures, training requirements, and operational dependencies have been addressed.

3. Voice, Video, and Collaboration Solution Engineering

  • Solution Design: Design and integrate enterprise voice, video teleconferencing, Session Initiation Protocol, Session Border Controller, telephony, and collaboration solutions.
  • Enterprise Telephony: Engineer enterprise dial plans, E.164 number normalization, digit manipulation, call routing, SIP trunking, carrier interconnections, PSTN services, voice gateways, voicemail, and emergency-calling capabilities.
  • VTC and Collaboration: Design and integrate multi-vendor VTC and audiovisual collaboration environments, including Cisco Room Series and Webex devices, Poly, Microsoft Teams Rooms, Crestron, Zoom Rooms, and comparable technologies.
  • Cloud and Hybrid Integration: Develop integrations between on-premises voice infrastructure and cloud collaboration platforms such as Microsoft Teams Phone, Direct Routing, Operator Connect, Webex Calling, and comparable services.
  • Availability and Resiliency: Develop technical requirements and designs for high availability, geographic redundancy, survivability, disaster recovery, capacity management, and service continuity.
  • Technology Evaluation: Conduct product evaluations, proof-of-concept activities, interoperability testing, and technical risk assessments for new or replacement voice, video, and collaboration technologies.
  • Technical Roadmaps: Contribute technical analysis, lifecycle data, recommendations, and implementation considerations to technology-modernization and product-roadmap activities.

4. Hands-On Engineering and Technical Escalation

  • Configuration and Deployment: Configure, integrate, test, and deploy IP telephony systems, SIP proxies, voice gateways, Session Border Controllers, VTC systems, and unified communications platforms.
  • Session Border Controllers: Configure and troubleshoot enterprise SBC technologies, including AudioCodes, Ribbon, Cisco CUBE, Oracle Communications Session Border Controller/Acme Packet, or comparable platforms.
  • Complex Troubleshooting: Resolve complex voice and video problems involving call routing, signaling, media negotiation, interoperability, packet loss, jitter, latency, one-way audio, call quality, and service availability.
  • Root-Cause Analysis: Perform detailed technical investigations, identify underlying causes, develop corrective actions, and document lessons learned.
  • QoS and Transport Integration: Collaborate with Transport and Network Engineering to design and validate end-to-end Quality of Service, including DSCP and Layer 2 Class of Service marking, queuing, shaping, policing, call-admission control, bandwidth planning, and class-of-service mapping.
  • Network Analysis: Evaluate routing, switching, VLAN, firewall, Network Address Translation, DNS, certificate, and transport conditions that affect voice and video services.
  • Monitoring and Service Assurance: Support monitoring, alerting, call-quality analytics, call-detail records, capacity reporting, and trend analysis for enterprise voice and video services.

5. Stakeholder and Vendor Coordination

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with Transport Engineering, Network Operations, Cybersecurity, program management, customers, and operations personnel to align technical solutions with infrastructure, security, and operational requirements.
  • Technical Communication: Explain technical issues, risks, alternatives, and recommendations to engineers, project leaders, client team members, and other stakeholders.
  • Design Reviews: Lead or participate in technical interchange meetings, peer reviews, architecture reviews, test-readiness reviews, and implementation-readiness reviews.
  • Vendor Coordination: Coordinate technical activities with equipment manufacturers, software providers, telecommunications carriers, SIP service providers, subcontractors, and system integrators.
  • Technical Influence: Develop well-supported technical recommendations and work with project and engineering leaders to gain acceptance of proposed designs, processes, or corrective actions.

Required Experience and Education

  • Must be a U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain a Secret Security Clearance.
  • Professional Experience: Typically requires a bachelor’s degree and 8–12 years of relevant experience, or a master’s degree and 6–10 years of relevant experience. Equivalent relevant education, certifications, and practical experience may be considered.
  • Technical Background: Progressive engineering experience in VoIP, VTC, enterprise telephony, unified communications, collaboration systems, networking, or a closely related technical discipline.
  • Project Leadership: Demonstrated experience leading the technical execution of complex projects, workstreams, implementations, or engineering efforts that involve multiple technologies or technical disciplines.
  • Engineering Lifecycle: Experience performing requirements analysis, solution design, alternatives analysis, integration, testing, implementation planning, documentation, and transition to operations.
  • Technical Mentoring: Experience providing technical guidance, peer review, training, or mentoring to other engineers. Formal supervisory or people-management experience is not required.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related field.

Preferred Technical Proficiencies

  • VoIP and Telephony Protocols: Strong knowledge of SIP, SDP, RTP/RTCP, SRTP, H.323, MGCP, ISDN/PRI, and related signaling and media protocols.
  • Call-Control Platforms: Experience with enterprise platforms such as Cisco Unified Communications Manager, Cisco Unity Connection, Microsoft Teams Phone, or comparable on-premises and cloud-based call-control systems.
  • Dial Plans and Carrier Services: Experience with enterprise dial plans, E.164 numbering, digit manipulation, SIP trunks, PSTN connectivity, carrier interconnections, voice gateways, voicemail, and emergency calling.
  • VTC and Collaboration Systems: Experience designing, integrating, deploying, or supporting Cisco, Poly, Microsoft Teams Rooms, Zoom Rooms, Crestron, Webex, or comparable collaboration technologies.
  • Session Border Controllers: Experience configuring and troubleshooting AudioCodes Mediant, Ribbon SBC, Oracle Communications Session Border Controller/Acme Packet, Cisco CUBE, or comparable SBC platforms.
  • Cloud and Hybrid Voice: Experience integrating on-premises telephony with cloud collaboration services, including Microsoft Teams Direct Routing, Operator Connect, Webex Calling, or comparable platforms.
  • Network and QoS Analysis: Strong working knowledge of IP networking, routing, switching, VLANs, firewalls, Network Address Translation, SIP and media traversal, packet analysis, QoS policy design, and bandwidth planning.
  • Security and Identity: Working knowledge of SIP TLS, mutual TLS, SRTP, certificates and PKI, directory services, identity integration, secure configuration baselines, vulnerability remediation, and configuration management.
  • Troubleshooting Tools: Demonstrated ability to use Wireshark, platform traces, SBC logs, call-detail records, monitoring systems, and other diagnostic tools to isolate signaling, media, network, and interoperability problems.

Leadership and Communication Skills

  • Ability to independently lead complex technical efforts while collaborating effectively with project managers, engineering leaders, customers, and operations personnel.
  • Ability to provide technical direction and mentorship without relying on formal supervisory authority.
  • Strong judgment and decision-making skills, including the ability to evaluate alternatives and balance technical performance, cost, schedule, risk, security, and supportability.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts, risks, and recommendations to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Ability to influence project and team leaders through sound engineering analysis, clear documentation, and well-supported recommendations.
  • Strong customer and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to establish expectations, communicate constraints, and resolve technical disagreements.
  • Demonstrated problem-solving ability and experience working through complex or high-pressure engineering and operational situations.
  • Commitment to knowledge sharing, process improvement, engineering quality, and continuous technical development.

Preferred Certifications and Qualifications

  • Cisco Certified Network Professional Collaboration or a comparable voice, video, networking, or unified communications certification.
  • Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert Collaboration is beneficial but not required.
  • Current Microsoft certification related to Microsoft Teams Phone, collaboration communications systems, or an equivalent technology.
  • Current AudioCodes, Ribbon, Cisco, Microsoft, or comparable voice and collaboration certification.
  • Experience developing technical proposals, statements of work, bills of material, levels of effort, implementation plans, or technical risk assessments.
  • Experience with automation or scripting for telephony administration, data collection, validation, or provisioning using PowerShell, Python, REST APIs, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience supporting geographically distributed, highly available, or mission-critical voice and video environments.

As an Account Executive at Whistic, you'll drive revenue growth through both new customer acquisition and strategic account expansion.

You'll own the sales process from initial engagement through close, while also building relationships with existing customers to identify new opportunities across business units, stakeholders, and platform capabilities.

You'll engage with security, risk, compliance, IT, and executive stakeholders to understand their business priorities and demonstrate how Whistic can help them work more efficiently, reduce risk, and achieve better outcomes.

Success in this role requires strong business acumen, consultative selling expertise, technical curiosity, and the drive to consistently deliver results.

Sell Value and Deliver Results

Help Shape How We Grow

jobs.title: Staff Decision Scientist, Direct Revenue (AI Native)
jobs.excerpt: About Life360Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love.
jobs.description:
About Life360

Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 107.7 million monthly active users (MAU), as of September 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit .

Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above.

We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

No other team at Life360 touches every product decision, every experiment, and every revenue lever. Data & Analytics is a 60+ person organization spanning data engineering, analytics engineering, data science, and ML. We're building it to be AI-native, where automation handles the volume so our people can focus on understanding why users behave the way they do, establishing what actually causes what, and turning those findings into action.

About the Job

Tens of millions of families use Life360 every month. Turning that trust into a durable subscription business, without breaking what makes members love the product, is one of the most consequential problems at the company. This role sits at the center of it.

As the Staff Decision Scientist for Direct Revenue, you'll be the analytical partner to the leaders who run our subscription business. You'll work on the questions that set the direction of the company: how we package and price membership, which new offerings are worth building, where and how we expand internationally, and what drives a member to subscribe, stay, or leave. Your analysis will go straight to the people making those calls, and you'll be in the room when they're made.

That means more than answering the questions you're given. You'll reframe the ones that are off, push back when the evidence points somewhere leadership doesn't want to go, and set honest expectations about what the data can and can't tell us. You'll also be a senior voice on the team, mentoring Decision Scientists and raising the bar for how we tell stories with data across the org.

This is not a production ML role (we have a dedicated Data Science / MLE team for that). Your primary tools are statistical inference, clear thinking, and the judgment to know which question matters most.

You'll report into the Data & Analytics leadership team and work alongside data engineers, analytics engineers, data scientists, and ML engineers.

For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $118,500 to $218,500 USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is 164,000 to 193,500 CAD. We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers.

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.

What You’ll Do

  • Be leadership's thought partner on monetization. Work directly with the executives who own subscription revenue. Bring them a point of view on where the next dollar of revenue comes from, and the evidence to back it.
  • Shape how we package, price, and sell membership. Lead analysis on tiers, pricing, paywalls, trials, and upgrade and downgrade paths, balancing near-term revenue against long-term member value.
  • Size and test new revenue opportunities. Build the case for (or against) new offerings and bundles across the app (Tile, Pet GPS, etc.) from first sizing through test design and post-launch read.
  • Guide international expansion. Help decide which markets to prioritize and how to adapt pricing and packaging by market, using local willingness-to-pay, conversion, and retention data.
  • Tell stories that change decisions. Turn complex analysis into a clear narrative with a recommendation. A great insight that nobody acts on is a failed insight.
  • Go beyond predictive correlation to causation. Use A/B tests, pricing experiments, and causal inference to measure what actually moves conversion, retention, and LTV.
  • Shape the AI-native analytics stack. Lead adoption of tools and agent workflows that make monetization analysis faster and more self-serve, so the team spends its time on judgment, not plumbing.
  • Push back and manage expectations. Say no to the wrong question, reset unrealistic targets with data, and keep stakeholders aligned on what we know, what we don't, and what it'll take to find out.
  • Mentor and multiply. Coach Decision Scientists on framing, causal rigor, and executive communication. Review their work, help them prepare for leadership readouts, and grow the next generation of strategic analysts.

What We’re Looking For

Core Expectations

  • Executive presence: You're credible with senior leaders. You can hold a room, handle hard questions in real time, and disagree without damaging the relationship.
  • Storytelling and clarity: You lead with the answer, cut what doesn't matter, and adapt the message to the audience, whether that's a CEO, a PM, or an engineer.
  • Courage to push back: You'll tell leadership what the data says even when it's not what they hoped. You do it directly and with respect.
  • Stakeholder judgment: You manage competing asks, set realistic expectations, and protect focus for the work that matters most.
  • Ownership mentality: You take responsibility from framing the question through delivering the recommendation and tracking its impact. You're accountable for decisions changed, not analyses delivered.
  • Commitment to mentorship: You get real satisfaction from making other people better, and you have a track record of doing it.
  • AI-native working style: You use AI tooling (Claude Code or equivalent) as a genuine development partner: delegating discrete tasks, reviewing outputs critically, and running parallel workstreams.

Required Experience & Qualifications

  • 8+ years in an analytics, data science, or decision science role at a consumer tech company.
  • Direct experience with subscription monetization: pricing, packaging, paywalls, conversion, or churn.
  • Advanced degree in a quantitative field (economics, statistics, quantitative social science, operations research) or equivalent practical experience.
  • Demonstrated experience with causal inference methods in applied settings (e.g., difference-in-differences, instrumental variables, regression discontinuity, synthetic controls, propensity score matching).
  • A track record of partnering with executives and influencing major revenue or strategy decisions, with specific examples.
  • Experience designing and analyzing pricing or monetization experiments, using platforms such as Statsig, Optimizely, or similar.
  • Experience formally or informally mentoring other analysts or data scientists.
  • Proficiency in SQL and Python/R for statistical analysis.

Nice to Have Qualifications

  • Experience with freemium or multi-tier subscription models.
  • Experience with international pricing or multi-market launches.
  • Familiarity with pricing and marketplace analytics.
  • Experience building dbt models or contributing to analytics engineering workflows.
  • Experience with hardware-plus-subscription bundles.

Experience with LTV modeling or willingness-to-pay research (e.g., conjoint, Van Westendorp).

AI-Native Expectations

We expect everyone on Data & Analytics to work with AI every day. For this role, that looks like:

  • Daily use: You use Claude Code or an equivalent tool as a working partner for SQL, Python/R analysis, experiment readouts, and first drafts of leadership memos. You delegate well-scoped tasks, run parallel workstreams, and can describe which parts of your last analysis AI handled and which you did yourself.
  • Judgment and ownership: You review AI output critically before it reaches anyone. You check the queries, the statistical assumptions, and the causal claims. You are accountable for every number and recommendation you deliver, whoever or whatever drafted it.
  • Velocity: You use AI to cover more ground. Sizing an opportunity, building a test design, or reading out a pricing experiment should take days, not weeks. You spend the time you save on framing the question and on the decision.
  • Team leadership: You share what works with the Decision Scientists you mentor and with the wider team, such as prompts, agent workflows, and review checklists. You help raise the team’s AI fluency, not only your own.
  • Continuous learning: You keep up with new tools and techniques for experimentation, causal inference, and monetization analytics, and you bring concrete recommendations to the team about what to adopt and what to skip.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for US employees). We offer life and disability as well as supplemental plans for medical and dental for Canadian employees.
  • 401(k) plan with company matching program in the US and RRSP with DPSP plan for Canadian employees.
  • Paid parental leave.
  • Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being.
  • Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns.
  • Learning & Development programs.
  • Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment.
  • Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers.

AI Usage: We use AI to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Life360 hiring teams

Life360 Values

Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference

  • Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.
  • Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard.
  • Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families.
  • High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done.

Our Commitment to Belonging

Life360 is an equal opportunity employer. We don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected status. We believe diverse perspectives make us better, and we’re building a workplace that reflects the communities we serve. Don’t meet every qualification? Apply anyway.

This role combines technical product management with user experience and conversion optimization. You'll help investigate where patients abandon questionnaires, understand why certain steps create confusion, and support improvements that make the journey from initial intake to completed checkout more effective.

You'll gain hands-on experience with product discovery, technical requirements, testing, analytics, and feature launches while taking ownership of smaller product improvements.

  • Help improve questionnaire navigation, conditional questions, form validation, and the clarity of patient instructions.

As a VP, Controller, you'll help oversee Evergreen Nephrology's accounting operations, ensuring accuracy, integrity, and timeliness across financial reporting. Other duties consistent with this role, as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 12 years of experience in accounting or finance, with at least 4 years in a leadership role

  • Strong leadership and team management abilities, with a focus on driving performance and accountability
  • High level of integrity and ethical standards
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy
  • Intermediate skills with MS Office Suite of products including Outlook and Teams
  • Able to work effectively in a primarily remote environment:

    • Evergreen will provide remote employees with telephony applications and equipment to meet the business requirements for their role
    • Employees must work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information

Compensation

The base salary pay range for this role is $190,000 to $235,000 annually. Exact compensation will be determined based on experience, education, and other role-specific factors. Placement toward the higher end of the range is typically reserved for candidates who meet all preferred qualifications and have highly relevant experience for the role.

This role is also eligible for an annual bonus.

Australia Wide, Work from Home | Full-time | Permanent WFH

Before you read any further, answer these five questions honestly.

Q1. Do you have a strong track record in inside sales, telesales or phone-based account management?

Still reading? Good. Here is everything you need to know.

ABOUT THRYV

Thryv has been helping local businesses compete for over 125 years, from print directories to an AI-powered platform built to grow small businesses through digital marketing. The businesses we work with are the plumber trying to get found on Google, the salon owner who never has time to follow up, the family restaurant competing against chains with bigger budgets.

We give them the tools to compete. And we give the people who work here a career worth having. Our culture runs on accountability, genuine relationships and doing the right thing. We take ownership, back each other and when it goes well, we celebrate it properly.

Be part of the growth story

Thryv is in a major growth phase across Australia and New Zealand, with 36 roles currently open and a further 40 to 50 positions coming. The Inside Sales team is at the heart of that growth. This is not a role you join and wait for things to happen. You are joining at exactly the right moment, with real opportunity to grow with the business as it scales.

This is a permanent, full-time work-from-home role. You are not expected in an office. You are not tied to a capital city. Whether you are in regional Victoria, rural Queensland, a coastal town or a suburb with a long commute, if you have a strong sales and account management background and a good internet connection, this role works for you.

You will manage the full sales cycle over the phone and video, reaching out to existing Thryv customers and new prospects, growing accounts, closing deals and hitting monthly targets. You will have the structure of a high-performing team behind you with the autonomy to manage your day from your own space.

Already doing great account management work but spending two hours a day in the car? This role was built for you.

  • Managing the full sales cycle from first contact and qualification through to close and onboarding handover
  • Upselling and cross-selling relevant Thryv digital marketing solutions to an existing customer portfolio
  • Hitting monthly sales targets and contact centre KPIs consistently
  • Maintaining accurate pipeline records and reporting results to your Account Director
  • Collaborating with internal teams to ensure a smooth experience for new clients
  • Staying sharp on Thryv product updates and what is happening in the SMB market

YOU'LL DO WELL HERE IF...

  • You build genuine rapport over the phone, clients trust you and look forward to your calls

  • You live regionally, rurally or face a long commute and want a permanent WFH role that plays to your strengths

WHAT'S ON OFFER

Total package $95.8K at OTE

Base $65K + 12% super $7.8K + $23K OTE

50% OTE guaranteed for your first three months. Targets are real and attainable.

Performance pays here. The harder you work, the more you earn.

  • Genuinely permanent WFH: No office, no commute, no compromise, wherever you are in Australia
  • Be part of the growth story: 36 roles open now with 40 to 50 more coming, join at the right moment

  • Performance pays: Your effort drives your income, the harder you work the more you earn
  • Career pathways: Thryv is growing fast and promoting from within, your timing is right
  • A team behind you: Full structure, coaching and support even when you are working from home

RECRUITMENT TIMELINE

We recruit on a rolling basis, with strong candidates shortlisted and interviewed as applications come in.

WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

Apply now, we are moving fast and so should you.
