jobs.title: Director, Machine Learning
jobs.excerpt: Narvar is Growing!  We're looking for a leader to own the machine learning systems behind post-purchase commerce — identity, fraud, and the intelligence layer that agentic AI runs on.
jobs.description:
Narvar is Growing! We're looking for a leader to own the machine learning systems behind post-purchase commerce — identity, fraud, and the intelligence layer that agentic AI runs on.

Hundreds of millions of consumers interact with Narvar every year, across 20B+ orders and 1,300+ retail brands. That data powers three systems: Graphite, our identity resolution engine that ties fragmented consumer data into a single verified identity across retailers; IRIS, our fraud and returns-abuse detection engine built on top of it.

You'll own the ML organization behind all of it — the models, the platform they run on, and the people who build them. This is a role for someone who wants a system with real consequences: fraud decisions that move retailer margin, identity resolution that agents make automated decisions on, and an adversary on the other side who adapts every quarter.

For this role, you should be located in Canada and able to work within EST/EDT OR PST hours. We are fully remote.

Day-to-day

  • Own the ML charter across identity resolution, fraud and abuse detection, risk scoring, and consumer intelligence — strategy, roadmap, and delivery
  • Build and grow a high-performing, globally distributed team of ML engineers; hire, coach, and develop senior ICs and managers
  • Set the technical bar for how models get built, evaluated, deployed, and monitored — and hold the org to it
  • Push identity resolution coverage, precision, and profile classification accuracy against a measured, frozen-holdout baseline — not against vibes
  • Own IRIS model performance end-to-end: detection rate, false-positive rate, label quality, and the feedback loops that keep both honest as fraud patterns shift
  • Build the ML platform layer — feature stores, training pipelines, model registry, online serving, drift and performance monitoring — so model velocity isn't bottlenecked on infrastructure
  • Partner with the AI engineering team so identity and risk signals are first-class inputs to NAVI's agent decisions
  • Work directly with Product, Engineering, Security, and Customer Success to translate messy retailer problems into ML problems worth solving — and to say no to the ones that aren't
  • Own build-vs-buy and data-partner decisions (third-party identity data, enrichment providers), including the economics
  • Communicate model performance, risk, and tradeoffs credibly to executives, retailers, and the board

What We're Looking For

We care more about judgment and ownership than credentials.

You're likely a strong fit if you:

  • Have 12+ years in engineering with 5+ years managing ML or data teams, including managing managers or senior ICs
  • Are an engineer at heart — you can still read a training pipeline, review a feature spec, and tell when an eval is measuring the wrong thing
  • Have shipped ML systems that make consequential automated decisions in production, and have owned them after launch — drift, retraining, incidents, and all
  • Have deep experience with at least one of: entity resolution / identity graphs, fraud and abuse detection, risk scoring, or anomaly detection at scale
  • Understand what makes ML different from software: labels are noisy and delayed, systems fail silently, offline metrics lie, and last quarter's model is fighting last quarter's adversary
  • Have opinions about evaluation — precision/recall tradeoffs on heavily imbalanced data, holdout hygiene, feedback loops where the model's own decisions contaminate future labels
  • Have built or scaled ML infrastructure: feature pipelines, training orchestration, online model serving with real latency budgets, monitoring and alerting
  • Are fluent in Python and comfortable in a modern data stack (Spark, Airflow or equivalent, streaming, cloud data warehouses — we run on GCP)
  • Have hired well, retained well, and can point to engineers whose careers got better on your watch
  • Excel in a fast-paced environment with a flat structure — you set direction by earning trust, not by mandate
  • Have a BS/MS in computer science, statistics, or an equivalent background

Bonus points

These aren't hard requirements, but strong indicators:

  • You've worked on identity resolution or graph systems against third-party consumer data (credit bureau, telecom, or similar), including the matching logic and confidence scoring underneath
  • You've operated adversarial ML systems where attackers actively adapt to your detection
  • You've built real-time inference paths where identity or risk has to be resolved inside a request budget
  • You've worked in retail, payments, fintech, insurance, or marketplace trust & safety
  • You've partnered closely with LLM/agent teams and understand how structured ML signals ground agentic decisions
  • You've navigated privacy, consent, and data-governance constraints on consumer identity data
  • You've done 0→1 — stood up a function, a platform, or a data partnership from nothing
  • You use modern tooling (including AI-assisted development workflows) to increase leverage, not outsource thinking

Why ML at Narvar?

Because the data is genuinely rare and the problems are genuinely hard.

  • The dataset is a moat. Cross-retailer visibility across 20B+ orders means we can see coordinated fraud patterns no single retailer can — a returns abuser hitting five brands looks like a good customer at each one.
  • The problem is adversarial and unsolved. Returns fraud and policy abuse are growing faster than retail itself, and the counterparty adapts. There is no off-the-shelf answer.
  • The stakes are measurable. Fraud loss, false-positive cost, identity coverage, resolution rate. Not vanity metrics.
  • It feeds something bigger. As AI shopping agents enter commerce, every agent will need a trust layer for returns, claims, and delivery promises. Identity and risk are that layer — and you'd own it.
  • The work is greenfield enough to matter. Real-time resolution, cold-start modeling, historical backfill, new data partnerships — these are decisions still being made, not legacy you inherit.

Why Narvar (from an engineer's perspective)?

  • Real scale, real customers, real consequences
  • Startup-level ownership with platform-level impact
  • Teams that value thinking, judgment, and responsibility
  • Low ego, high trust, and room to do your best work

    We're on a mission to simplify the everyday lives of consumers. Post-purchase is a critical phase of the customer journey. That's why we created Narvar - a platform focused on driving customer loyalty through seamless post-purchase experiences that allow retailers to retain, engage, and delight customers. If you've ever bought something online, there's a good chance you've used our platform!

    From the hottest new direct-to-consumer companies to retail’s most renowned brands, Narvar works with GameStop, Neiman Marcus, Sonos, Nike, and 1300+ other brands. With hubs in San Francisco, Atlanta, London, and Bangalore, we've served over 125 million consumers worldwide across 10+ billion interactions, 38 countries, and 55 languages.

    Pioneering the post-purchase movement means navigating into the unknown. Our team thrives on this sense of adventure while nurturing a mindset of innovation. We're a home for big hearts and we leave our egos at the door. We work hard but we always make time to celebrate professional wins, baby showers, birthday parties, and everything in between.

    We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

The range reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across Canada. Within the range, individual compensation packages are based on factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to, skill set, education and certifications, and work location.

The Senior Training Consultant serves as a subject matter resource for assigned solutions, supports onboarding and development of less experienced team members, and advises internal and external stakeholders on difficult training matters without direct supervisory responsibility.

Responsibilities

  • performance training needs, consult product and operational subject matter experts, identify appropriate learning resources and contacts, resolve mutual problems, and advise stakeholders on difficult learning matters.

For more information, visit 

About the role

The Customer Success team is an integral part of Logile’s ability to ensure customers find the most value in their implementation and have continuous support in achieving their business goals. You will be responsible for building and maintaining effective relationships with customers and maximizing their lifetime value within the assigned customer portfolio. This will be accomplished by delivering a great customer experience and expanding the use of Logile products, as well as delivering results and value that exceed customer expectations. Through the relationship the CSM cultivates, you will assist in achieving customer success and growth by identifying add-ons and additional product or services opportunities. The Customer Success Manager will be involved in each assigned project, beginning with project readiness, to help assess and define each customer’s long-term goals. During this time, the CSM will develop relationships with key customer stakeholders and position themselves as a resource for the customer’s team. Additionally, the CSM will act as an advocate for the customer’s needs and goals after each project implementation. This will take many forms including conducting regularly scheduled touch base calls with customer representatives, driving QBRs, managing escalated tickets, and advising internal Logile teams on how to best approach a customer’s needs.

Responsibilities

The Customer Success Manager will represent multiple customers and is responsible for the customers’ long-term success from the time they begin their partnership with Logile. Primary responsibilities are broken into 5 key areas:

Customer Relationship & Strategic Partnership

  • Establish strong, trust-based relationships with key stakeholders across all levels of assigned customer organizations.
  • Act as the customer’s strategic advisor and internal advocate, ensuring their goals and feedback inform product development and service delivery.
  • Conduct regular Executive Business Reviews (EBRs) to assess performance, surface new opportunities, and align strategic objectives.

Value Realization & Success Planning

  • Partner with customers to co-develop Success Plans with clear goals, KPIs, and milestones aligned to their desired outcomes.

  • Identify and remove barriers to adoption by leveraging customer enablement resources, training, and best practices.

Account & Renewal Coordination

  • Proactively monitor all upcoming renewals, including key contractual usage metrics.
  • Execute simple renewals where there are not substantive changes to the contractual agreement, ensuring timelines, value, and customer satisfaction are managed efficiently.
  • Collaborate with Account Managers on strategic renewals and expansion opportunities, ensuring seamless execution.
  • Develop strong advocates across the assigned customer portfolio.
  • Maintain key metrics within the Logile Customer Success platform necessary for tracking and communicating key Customer Success metrics within the company.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Work closely with Product, Support, Sales, and Implementation teams to ensure a consistent and valuable customer experience.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable enablement materials, such as onboarding guides and success playbooks.
  • Provide insights to the Product team based on customer feedback and usage trends to influence roadmap decisions.
  • Act as a point of escalation for support and relationship issues including Ticket Escalation and Resolution concerns.

Internal Enablement & Team Contribution

  • Mentor and support junior Logile team members to build internal capability.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of customer success processes and tools.
  • Participate in cross-functional initiatives aimed at improving customer satisfaction, loyalty, and Net Promoter Score (NPS).

Success Metrics

  • Customer Retention Rate: Drive renewals by consistently delivering value and cultivating strong, long-term customer relationships.
  • Customer Health Score: Monitor and improve customer engagement and satisfaction using established health scoring frameworks.
  • Customer Satisfaction (CSAT): Maintain high CSAT scores across all touchpoints, including onboarding, support, and ongoing interactions.
  • Net Promoter Score (NPS): Enhance customer advocacy and increase referral opportunities by delivering exceptional experiences.

jobs.excerpt: Marathon Health is a leading advanced primary care provider, partnering with employer and union plan sponsors to improve health for millions of Americans.
jobs.description:
Marathon Health is a leading advanced primary care provider, partnering with employer and union plan sponsors to improve health for millions of Americans. With nationwide onsite, nearsite, and network health centers, and virtual primary care, Marathon delivers a value-based model that enhances the healthcare experience for members and providers, while driving meaningful cost savings for plan sponsors. Marathon is proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work®, reflecting the company's commitment to building an inclusive, high-trust culture where all employees can thrive. Learn more at

ABOUT THE JOB

This Business Analyst sits at the center of how clinical work gets specified, built, and released across our clinical application ecosystem — athenaOne, Cority, OhMD, Avo, and RubiconMD — with a particular focus on EMR implementation support. You will turn client and operational needs into clear, complete, build-ready requirements; safeguard the integrity of the data and reporting that flow out of our clinical systems; and own the intake and release-note processes that keep implementations moving and stakeholders informed.


This is a role for someone who likes to bring order to complexity: tracing a request from first conversation through configuration and go-live, catching gaps before they become rework, and making sure the clinical value of the team's work is visible to the people who need to see it.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Implementation intake and documentation

  • Own the implementation intake process end to end: gather Configuration Document details, confirm client-specific decisions (go-live timing, implementation type, Operations assignments, equipment, and data-migration needs), and complete setup documentation so the Configuration Team has everything it needs before work begins — with no gaps requiring back-and-forth.
  • Trace the full lifecycle of a request, from initial documentation through Project Manager and Technical Product Manager handoff to work entering Azure DevOps (ADO).

Requirements and backlog support

  • Translate operational and clinical needs into well-formed ADO stories, with the detail and acceptance criteria needed for refinement and sprint planning.
  • Support backlog grooming and sprint ceremonies, partnering with the Configuration and Technical Product teams to keep work ready and prioritized.

Data and reporting validation

  • Serve as a standing checkpoint for data and reporting outputs, validating them against the source application (front-end validation) before they are treated as reliable.
  • Identify where reporting discrepancies originate, know who to involve, and work to catch issues earlier in the cycle.

Release notes and value communication

  • Own the release-notes process: confirm stories are correctly marked for inclusion, formatting is consistent, and content is complete and clearly understood by its intended audience.
  • Review ADO stories to identify clinical value worth surfacing, and present clinical items to the applicable committee in a way that resonates with that audience.

Process improvement and governance

  • Identify and help implement ways to streamline implementation intake, reducing friction and rework between request, documentation, and ADO entry.
  • Support the broader Clinical Applications team's configuration, support, and governance functions, including change-control and peer-review processes for clinical configuration.
  • Take on project management duties for special projects as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelors degree in related field and 2+ years of business analyst, systems analyst, or similar experience, ideally in a healthcare, clinical, or health-technology setting, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

DESIRED ATTRIBUTES


  • Experience gathering requirements and writing clear user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Familiarity with EMR/EHR platforms — athenaOne experience is a strong plus — and with clinical application tools such as Cority, Avo, OhMD, or RubiconMD.
  • Hands-on experience with a work-management / backlog tool (Azure DevOps strongly preferred) and agile ceremonies such as grooming and sprint planning.
  • Strong attention to detail and a demonstrated ability to validate data and catch discrepancies before they reach downstream users.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to present to cross-functional and committee audiences.
  • Exposure to clinical implementation, configuration, or go-live support.
  • Understanding of clinical reporting, data-quality concepts, or value-based care workflows.
  • Experience with change-control, release management, or clinical configuration governance.

Pay Range: $70,000 - $100,000/yr

The actual offer may vary dependent upon geographic location and the candidate’s years of experience and/or skill level.

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionAbout Us At Utila, you’ll help build the modern, enterprise-grade platform that powers digital asset operations for more than 300 global institutions.
jobs.description:
Description

About Us

At Utila, you’ll help build the modern, enterprise-grade platform that powers digital asset operations for more than 300 global institutions. Our technology secures $20B+ in monthly transaction volume and has protected over $100B to date, and we’re growing fast, backed by $50M in funding and a rapidly expanding customer base.

We work on mission-critical systems that demand innovation, precision, and deep technical expertise. If you’re excited by complex challenges, want to work with exceptionally strong teammates, and are looking to make a real impact on the future of financial technology, you’ll feel right at home here.

Join us, and help build something big.

How we work
From an idea, problem, or opportunity to the final product. We have the autonomy to make decisions, challenge what can be better, and the responsibility to make it happen. We look past specific tasks or product requirements to understand their impact on our customers, our product, and the company, while finding ways to improve it.

This fast-paced, high-standard culture isn’t for everyone. And that’s okay.

Responsibilities

The role

You’ll lead two areas on our Sales Engineering team: Utila’s technical partnerships and our bids (RFPs, RFIs, DDQs, and security questionnaires). We’re looking for real technical depth: someone who isn’t satisfied until they understand how a system works end to end, and who can turn that understanding into a clear picture for engineers, executives and procurement teams alike.

Both areas rely on the same core skills: deep Utila product knowledge, mapping our fit to client systems, and translating that into an actionable story. Bids reveal where deals stall and which partners can close the gap, while partnerships provide the leverage to win bids.

This is a pre-sales role. You’ll work closely with sales, BD, product, engineering, security, and marketing, and you’ll face partners and prospects directly. You won’t run discovery, demos, POCs or sales cycles.

What you’ll lead

Technical partnerships:

  • Lead the technical scope of each partnership: validate the joint solution, scope the integration, and work through the technical details with the partner’s team.
  • Be the technical counterpart to partners’ engineering and product teams, while BD leads the commercial terms.
  • Spot new partnerships that would help win deals, including ones outside the current pipeline, and make the case to SE for why they matter.
  • Write and maintain each partnership’s documentation, architecture diagrams, and collateral.
  • Enable sales, marketing, and SE on each partnership: what it does, who it’s for, and how to position it.

Bid management:

  • Run each RFX end to end, from intake to submission.
  • Bring in the right people across product, engineering, security, legal, and commercial, so each part is answered well and on time.
  • Shape the bid strategy for each RFX: how Utila is positioned, which partners to co-bid with, and how the joint solution fits together. Build the case and drive it to a decision with SE and commercial leadership.
  • Answer the technical content as a product expert across Utila’s custody architecture, policy engine, supported chains, APIs, and compliance posture, pulling in SE and product for edge cases and new areas.
  • Support the SE leading the deal in later bid stages, such as clarification calls, finalist presentations, and security reviews.
  • Run our RFP answer library and the in-house AI tooling that drafts responses and keeps the library current, so each bid makes the next one faster.

Requirements

What you bring

  • 3+ years in a technical role that faced customers or partners, such as sales or solutions engineering, solutions architecture or partner engineering. Technical bid management experience is a plus when paired with the engineering depth below.
  • Real engineering depth from building or running systems yourself, for example in software engineering, solutions architecture, security or infrastructure. You can read code, call APIs directly and reason about how distributed systems, key management and security controls fit together.
  • You’re comfortable going deep with a partner’s engineering team or a bank’s security architects, and you’d rather test something yourself than take a doc’s word for it.
  • Curiosity about how things work. You go deep until you understand something, then explain the bigger picture to technical and business audiences alike.
  • Clear, precise writing. You can turn a complex architecture into an answer a bank’s security team or a partner’s CTO will trust.
  • Strong organization under deadlines. You’ve run several deliverables in parallel and kept many stakeholders on track.
  • Confidence with external audiences, including senior technical, security, and compliance reviewers.

Nice to have

  • Experience with digital assets, stablecoins, payments, or custody.
  • Familiarity with MPC, wallet infrastructure or blockchain protocols such as EVM chains and Solana.
  • Experience with RFP tools such as Loopio, and with institutional security questionnaires and frameworks such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001.
  • Experience selling to or partnering with banks, payment firms or other regulated financial institutions.

Requirements

We are looking for a talented Kotlin Engineers to join our team and take responsibility for the development and maintenance of certain areas of client’s product and its European versions.

As a engineer, you will work in a dynamic environment with a team that aims to continuously improve and develop the platform. Your role will be focused on select areas of the client’s site, which means responsibility will be dispersed across the team, and you will have a real impact on shaping the user experience.

    • 14 000 - 20 000 PLN net on B2B - depending on your experience

    • ~11 718-16 740 gross/month employee contract- depending on your experience

  • Growth in DDD and event-driven architecture, built into how our services work, plus Kotlin, BigQuery, microservices and AI tools in daily work

jobs.description:
SENIOR U.S. TAX PREPARER (DRAKE TAX) AND AI FIRST FINANCIAL CONTROLLER

Full time | Remote in Vietnam or the Philippines | Minimum 4 hours daily overlap with Vietnam time (UTC+7)

Savvy | Finance operations supporting multiple U.S. businesses

THE OPPORTUNITY

Are you genuinely experienced in preparing U.S. business tax returns in Drake Tax, confident running a U.S. month end close, and ambitious about using AI to make financial operations better? This is a rare opportunity to own both the numbers and the systems behind them.

We are seeking an experienced, hands on professional to support a portfolio of U.S. ecommerce, technology and marketing businesses. You will deliver accurate financial reporting, prepare business tax returns for professional review, identify problems before they grow, and build practical AI assisted workflows. You will work closely with business leadership and be judged on results, not activity.

This is a senior execution role, not a general bookkeeping or data entry position. Actual Drake Tax experience is essential.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

U.S. business tax preparation | Drake Tax

  • Prepare federal business returns in Drake Tax, including Forms 1120, 1120S and 1065 as appropriate to your experience and assigned entities, with related schedules and K1s.
  • Build reviewer ready tax workpapers from source records, trial balances and reconciliations. Identify book to tax differences, depreciation issues, missing records and unusual transactions.
  • Resolve Drake diagnostics, maintain an accurate return status tracker, and prepare complete packages for final review and authorized filing.
  • Support federal and state filing calendars, 1099 reporting, sales tax and other tax schedules as assigned. Coordinate complex or international reporting with the designated U.S. tax adviser.

Financial controller | U.S. accounting

  • Own the accounting close for multiple U.S. entities, including bank and card reconciliations, journal entries, accruals, prepayments, deferred revenue and intercompany balances.
  • Deliver an accurate monthly close package by the tenth day of the following month, including profit and loss, balance sheet, cash flow, major reconciliations, and a concise variance and exceptions report.
  • Reconcile sales, payment processor settlements, merchant fees, refunds, receivables and marketing expenses to the general ledger. Experience with PayPal, Stripe, NMI, Meta or Google is valuable.
  • Maintain clear accounting policies, a close checklist, supporting schedules, a cash visibility report and a reliable audit trail. Escalate risks early.

AI first finance operations

  • Use approved AI and automation tools to accelerate document extraction, categorization, reconciliation checks, financial analysis and draft reporting.
  • Create repeatable prompts, controls and workflows that reduce manual work without reducing accuracy or accountability.
  • Verify every material output against original records. Never enter confidential taxpayer information, financial credentials or client records into unapproved AI services.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Within your first 90 days, you will understand the assigned entities, establish a documented close and tax calendar, deliver reliable reconciled monthly reporting, prepare Drake tax workpapers to review standard, and demonstrate at least one measurable improvement to a finance workflow using appropriately controlled AI.

NONNEGOTIABLE QUALIFICATIONS

  • At least two U.S. tax filing seasons personally preparing U.S. business returns in Drake Tax. You must be able to identify the filing years, return types, approximate volumes and work you personally completed. Experience using only other tax software does not qualify.
  • At least three years of hands on U.S. accounting experience, including reconciliations, journal entries, financial statements and month end close.
  • An active and valid IRS Preparer Tax Identification Number (PTIN), maintained for the periods in which it is required. Verification will occur privately during hiring; do not include your PTIN number in the application.
  • Strong working experience in QuickBooks Online or Xero, plus advanced Excel or Google Sheets for financial analysis and reconciliations.
  • Real examples of using AI or automation responsibly in accounting, tax or financial reporting, including how you checked results for accuracy.
  • Clear written and spoken English, sound judgment, reliable execution, and the ability to explain discrepancies without being prompted.
  • Residence in Vietnam or the Philippines, a secure remote working environment, and at least four hours of consistent daily overlap with Vietnam working hours (UTC+7).

EXPERIENCE THAT WILL SET YOU APART

  • Enrolled Agent or CPA qualification, with active credentials where applicable.
  • Multi entity U.S. accounting, ecommerce, payment processing or performance marketing finance.
  • Strong command of book to tax reconciliations, S corporation and partnership schedules, and state business tax compliance.
  • Experience supporting international U.S. reporting, including Forms 5471 or 5472, under specialist supervision.
  • A demonstrated record of shortening close cycles, building useful finance automations, and communicating directly with management.

WHY JOIN

You will own meaningful work across real U.S. businesses, have direct visibility into business decisions, and help shape an AI enabled finance function rather than simply maintain yesterday's processes. The role is full time and remote. Compensation will reflect verified skills and experience, and applicants should state their expected monthly amount in USD.

HOW TO APPLY

Apply through our BambooHR posting with your resume and brief, specific answers to the questions below. A generic cover letter is not required. We value demonstrated competence more than polished claims.

Required application questions | Free text

  1. Which U.S. tax filing seasons have you personally prepared in Drake Tax? Identify tax years, Drake desktop or online, Forms 1120, 1120S or 1065 prepared, and approximate returns completed per season.
  2. Describe your hands on process for preparing a Form 1120S or 1065 in Drake, from trial balance to reviewer ready return. Explain at least one common reconciliation or diagnostic you resolve.
  3. Describe the most demanding U.S. month end close you personally managed: number of entities, accounting software, key reconciliations, reporting deadline and one problem you solved.
  4. Is your PTIN current for 2026, and what is your plan for the next filing season? Describe its status only, without providing the number.
  5. Describe a real AI or automation workflow you used in finance or tax work, the result achieved, how you independently verified accuracy, and how you protected confidential data.
  6. Which accounting platforms and spreadsheet functions do you use regularly? Give one practical reconciliation or reporting example.
  7. State your country of residence, the exact hours you can work in Vietnam time, earliest start date, and expected monthly compensation in USD.

Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a paid practical assessment using fictional financial and tax records. We will assess real Drake competence, U.S. accounting judgment, accuracy, confidentiality and communication.

Do not upload real tax returns, taxpayer names, Social Security numbers, employer identification numbers, account details or PTIN numbers. We will never request confidential client records at the application stage.

About 8 West Consulting

8 West Consulting provides consultancy services and software solutions to clients across the US, Europe and the UK. We work in sectors including insurance, healthcare and retail, helping organisations tackle complex technology challenges and modernise critical platforms.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a hands-on Lead Quality Engineer to advance test automation and AI-enabled quality engineering across enterprise client teams. You will establish pragmatic technical direction, help several projects adopt repeatable practices and lead improvements to testing capability, while personally delivering automation, dependable test data and quality support on live engagements.

This is not a strategy-only or people-management role. You will lead by building, demonstrating and coaching, helping teams move from manual-heavy testing towards reliable automation. The challenge is to make progress across established applications and different project needs, within enterprise controls and ongoing client commitments.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead cross-team transformation. Assess testing maturity across enterprise teams, prioritise common opportunities and lead phased adoption of automation, AI-assisted testing and better data practices.
  • Stay hands-on. Personally write and debug UI, API, integration and data tests; solve difficult automation problems, investigate defects and support releases.
  • Set technical direction. Define pragmatic quality engineering principles, review solutions and guide tool choices across projects while allowing for different client architectures and constraints.
  • Build shared test data capability. Design and implement reusable builders, fixtures, seeding and reset patterns for complex systems; enable independent tests across teams and environments.
  • Scale AI-enabled testing. Implement AI-assisted test design, case and script generation, synthetic data creation and failure analysis, then establish validation, safe-use practices and repeatable adoption.
  • Create reusable engineering practices. Establish lightweight patterns for frameworks, CI/CD, test reporting and governance; coach teams to apply them rather than create a central delivery bottleneck.
  • Develop engineering capability. Pair with testers and developers across projects, review implementations, mentor senior engineers and build practical training and adoption plans.
  • Influence senior stakeholders. Explain quality risks, investment choices, technical trade-offs and transformation progress to engineering leaders, delivery managers and client decision-makers.
  • Own outcomes across teams. Measure adoption and results across projects, including regression effort, test stability, independent data setup, AI effectiveness, feedback speed and release confidence.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Multi-team enterprise transformation. Has personally led substantial testing improvements across several teams, applications or workstreams in an enterprise environment, with clear evidence of adoption and delivery outcomes.
  • Recent hands-on engineering. Strong coding, debugging and automation skills, including direct work on production test suites in C#, TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, Java or equivalent.
  • AI implementation and adoption. Implemented AI-assisted testing on real enterprise projects and helped other engineers adopt it; can demonstrate verified test/data generation, practical safeguards and measured results.
  • Complex test data engineering. Has personally built reusable, isolated test datasets and shared patterns for relational or integrated systems using SQL, APIs, fixtures and builders; manages integrity, synthetic/masked data and reset.
  • Automation architecture and standards. Able to set sensible patterns across UI, API, integration, contract, data and regression tests, review designs and balance reuse with project-specific needs.
  • Microsoft-based environments. Practical experience testing .NET, SQL Server and/or Azure applications, including Azure DevOps or equivalent pipelines, Git and engineering workflows.
  • Tooling and delivery integration. Broad experience with Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, Postman or equivalents, plus CI/CD integration, test environments and flaky-test diagnosis.
  • Cross-project change leadership. Has built practical roadmaps, gained support across teams and delivered improvements incrementally despite competing deadlines and legacy constraints.
  • Executive communication and coaching. Can influence engineering and business leaders without formal authority, explain investment and quality trade-offs, and develop engineers through pairing and mentoring.

Desirable Experience

  • Regulated enterprise environments. Insurance, healthcare, financial services or other controlled industries, with experience of auditability, privacy and sensitive test data.
  • Advanced AI quality practices. AI-assisted test-suite maintenance, agentic testing workflows, LLM evaluation, repeatable AI-feature test datasets or governance for AI testing tools.
  • Specialist testing. Performance/load, security, accessibility (WCAG), API contracts, complex integrations or data-heavy application testing.
  • Broader platforms and consultancy. Cloud-native, distributed, legacy or mobile systems; multi-client consulting, reusable accelerators or relevant testing and Azure certifications.

Personal Profile

You are a credible technical leader who still enjoys writing code and testing software. You can see patterns across different client environments without imposing unnecessary process. You solve difficult automation and data problems yourself, mentor others patiently and communicate clearly with senior stakeholders. You are realistic about AI, security and the pressure of live delivery.

What Success Looks Like

Multiple client teams adopt reliable automation, independent test data and verified AI-assisted testing practices that fit their delivery needs. Reusable approaches reduce duplicated effort, engineers gain confidence and the improvements are sustained beyond a single project. Progress is visible in adoption, feedback speed, test stability and release confidence, alongside dependable hands-on client delivery.

The Risk & Compliance Director will be accountable for the delivery of an effective and efficient Risk & Compliance infrastructure and function across the Consulting, Technology and Forensics business units within the Davies Global Solutions Division.

The Risk & Compliance Director will understand the regulatory and compliance obligations impacting the aligned business units. Where those business units are directly regulated, the role holder will ensure that all regulatory permissions are secured and that all appropriate steps taken across the relevant business units to ensure ongoing compliance with such direct regulatory obligations in a commercial and economic manner.

Where the aligned business units are not directly regulated but required to align to regulatory frameworks, the Risk & Compliance Director will work with the Divisional CEO and business unit leads to ensure that appropriate and pragmatic steps are identified that enable such alignment in an equally commercial and economic manner.

The successful candidate will inherit and continue to build, promote and endorse a culture in which accountability for appropriate risk & compliance issues fall upon all colleagues within the Division.

By nature of the territorial footprint of the Global Solutions business, the Risk & Compliance Director is required required to provide support across multiple time-zones, and where appropriate, engage in both domestic and international travel.

Key Responsibilities

The role requires a thorough understanding of the Group’s enterprise risk management framework and appetite, together with the Group’s overarching compliance framework as well as the risk, compliance and regulatory rules and obligations specifically impacting the aligned Division.

In addition to direct knowledge and working experience of these frameworks, the role holder will require broad, up-to-date knowledge pertinent regulation and legislation and the management of enterprise risk management and compliance frameworks.
  • Defining, developing, and maintaining a target operating model for the aligned business unit / sub-divisional risk & compliance functions, and operating that function in line with stated budgets.
  • Embedding all Group risk & compliance frameworks, policies and procedures across the aligned business units / sub-Division, and where necessary working with the Group CRO to identify all required local derogations and supplements to those frameworks to meet business area specific (including territorial or regulatory) requirements.
  • Embedding all such policies, procedures, and frameworks across the aligned business units, including all local entities / service lines and territories to ensure regulatory and legislator compliance across the same.
  • Developing and leading an effective, high-performance risk & compliance function and team within the aligned business units / sub-division, retaining, and attracting key talent to ensure continuous improvement in staff competencies, skills, and knowledge.

  • Providing senior leadership and oversight of effective risk & compliance management, across the aligned business units / sub-division and as an extension of the Group’s overall Governance, Risk & Compliance function.
  • Helping to raise the bar in how we protect both Divisional and overall Group business interests by the development and deployment of an effective risk & compliance infrastructure.

At Stitch, we’re building something extraordinary. As a fast-growing team of passionate marketing technologists, architects, and strategists, we bring together our diverse backgrounds and experiences to work towards one common goal: make marketers’ lives easier with Braze.

Customer engagement is becoming increasingly complex, but with the right technology, processes, and strategies in place, marketers can achieve great things. We're motivated to be drivers of what the future of martech looks like by building solutions that work.

We’re all in on Braze as the leading customer engagement platform and the cornerstone of the modern martech stack. As an Orbit-level certified Braze partner (the highest level of partnership), we work alongside marketers from some of the world’s most beloved brands to stitch together innovative solutions, better processes, and smarter strategies that make marketing magic happen in Braze.

About This Role

As a Solution Architect at Stitch, you'll be responsible for gathering and analyzing technical requirements to ensure seamless integration of Braze and partner technologies within our clients’ marketing technology stacks. You'll develop detailed functional design specifications, outlining workflows and user journeys that align with business goals. You'll also design and implement scalable, end-to-end solutions that support personalized customer experiences, managing complex data structures, user attributes, and event tracking. Additionally, you'll leverage Braze’s segmentation tools to create dynamic audience segments, while crafting multi-channel campaign flows using Braze’s Canvas tool to drive customer engagement through automated messaging and real-time interactions.

What You’ll Do

  • Collaborate with other Stitchers on the Delivery team, including Business Strategists, Marketing Strategist, and Technical Producers (email developers) to gather and analyze technical requirements, ensuring Braze and partner technologies are optimally configured within the customer’s existing martech stack
  • Provide detailed documentation, define integration points, and ensure seamless data flow across platforms.
  • Develop comprehensive functional design specifications that outline how Braze’s features will support the customer's business goals. This includes defining workflows, user journeys, and business rules to deliver an efficient and scalable solution
  • Design and implement end-to-end solutions that bridge the gap between business objectives and technical execution. You'll ensure the architecture is robust, scalable, and tailored to meet specific customer needs while integrating seamlessly with the broader technology ecosystem
  • Build and manage complex data structures, including user attributes and events, to support personalized customer experiences. You'll define how customer interactions and behaviors are tracked and leveraged to enhance engagement strategies
  • Utilize Braze’s segmentation tools to design dynamic and static audience segments based on user behaviors, preferences, and lifecycle stages. You'll ensure that segments are leveraged effectively for targeted messaging and personalized campaign experiences
  • Design and implement sophisticated campaign flows using Braze’s Canvas tool, incorporating multi-step, multi-channel journeys that drive customer engagement. You’ll develop logic to automate actions, such as messaging triggers and conditions, based on real-time customer interactions and behaviors
  • Bring new ideas, recommendations, and solution write-ups to other Solution Architects directly, within projects, or during office hours
  • Effectively manage your time to achieve quarterly billable hour targets
  • Stay informed about the latest advancements in Braze and its technology integration partners, as well as other relevant technologies in the marketing technology space by earning and maintaining a minimum of 3 Braze certifications, including the Braze Digital Strategist certification
  • Occasionally travel, up to 20%, to client sites to actively participate in strategic discussions with a high level of engagement
  • Perform additional duties as assigned and needed

What Does Success Look Like In This Role?

  • You are confident in developing and clearly communicating customer solutions to meet client needs, including helping with coding/scripting examples and proof of concepts
  • Not only are you an awesome technical expert, but you’re also an amazing consultant. This means that you are confident meeting with our clients and bringing a strong point of view to them around best practices and creative solutions. You approach your clients’ needs with curiosity and ask questions to develop a deeper understanding of how Stitch can best serve them
  • You show up to every meeting with our clients and other Stitchers prepared and engaged. Every point of communication - Slack, email, Zoom meeting, or in-person meeting - is an opportunity to impress our clients. You are responsive and work with a sense of urgency
  • You consistently meet deadlines. We know, we know, this seems obvious! But it’s important. We are a professional services business, so our success depends on the satisfaction of our clients.   • You manage your weekly schedule well to consistently meet Stitch’s broader quarterly billable targets. You’ll be juggling a variety of activities during the week, including heads-down coding, client meetings, Stitch office hours, pursuing certifications, and time-tracking. Deputy is a global SaaS workforce management company with hubs in Sydney, Melbourne, San Francisco and London, plus team members working remotely across the United States. Our platform serves over 1.5 million workers and 375,000 workplaces across 100+ countries. We are backed by top global investors and recently achieved Unicorn status.
At Deputy, we’re improving the world of work, one shift at a time, for 80% of the world’s workforce: hourly workers. These are the dedicated employees who keep our world running – from baristas to nurses, cleaners to delivery drivers, florists to factory workers. Despite their vital role in society, most workplace technology has focused on those workers who sit behind a desk, but at Deputy, we transform the frontline. When businesses use Deputy, their workplaces thrive – the business is more profitable, compliant, and productive, while the workers are more engaged and happier at work.
We're becoming an AI-native company, a commitment that means you'll be empowered (and expected) to use AI tools and thinking in your day-to-day work. You'll have the training, support, and freedom to use AI responsibly and creatively to spark ideas, solve problems faster, and unlock new ways of working.
If you’re passionate about creating solutions that put people first and helping businesses and their teams thrive, join us at Deputy and make an impact where it matters most!

Role Overview

As a Senior Customer Success Manager (Senior CSM) at Deputy, you are the trusted strategic partner and customer advocate for a dedicated portfolio of high-value Mid-Market and Enterprise customers (typically accounts with 250+ to 1,000+ RTE). You engage during implementation by shadow-managing alongside Professional Services—ensuring seamless alignment, intervening proactively if roadblocks arise, and taking formal ownership at Go-Live. Across the customer lifecycle, you drive adoption, mitigate churn risk, lead strategic EBRs, and partner closely with Account Management to identify and qualify expansion opportunities.

This role will be joining our CSM team on a 12 month fixed term contract.

Key Responsibilities

    1. Implementation Partnership & Lifecycle Transition

  • Implementation Shadow-Management: Actively shadow-manage accounts during the onboarding and implementation phase alongside Professional Services to ensure early stakeholder alignment, validate configuration against business goals, and step in swiftly to mitigate risk if milestones or timelines stall.

  • Go-Live Handoff: Lead a frictionless transition from implementation to steady-state operations, ensuring zero loss of institutional context and delivering immediate continuity for customer admins and executives.

    • 2. Strategic Account Ownership & Relationship Management

  • Trusted Advisor: Build and nurture multi-threaded relationships across executive and operational leadership (HR, Operations, Payroll, and C-Suite).

  • Mutual Success Planning: Co-create, maintain, and execute customer-specific Mutual Success Plans aligned with strategic business objectives, operational workflows, and quantifiable ROI.

  • Executive Business Reviews (EBRs / QBRs): Prepare and facilitate high-impact business reviews to showcase delivered value, present adoption metrics, share product roadmap updates, and realign on executive priorities.

  • Customer Advocacy & Proof Points: Cultivate referenceable customer relationships, partnering with Marketing to produce case studies, customer quotes, reference calls, and review platform engagement (e.g., G2).

    • 3. Product Adoption, Enablement & Ecosystem Navigation

  • Drive Depth of Adoption: Monitor portfolio usage telemetry, guiding customers on best practices to deepen adoption of core and advanced modules (e.g., smart scheduling, award interpretation, timesheets, and payroll readiness).

  • Tech Ecosystem Alignment: Comfortably navigate and advise on enterprise software ecosystems, troubleshooting and guiding standard workflows involving HRIS, payroll, and POS integrations (e.g., ADP, BambooHR, Gusto, Xero).

  • Strategic Enablement: Conduct tailored consultative workshops and optimization sessions to help customers operationalize new product capabilities.

  • Internal Feedback Loop: Synthesize customer feedback, recurring friction points, and feature requests to champion customer needs with Product, Engineering, and Design.

    • 4. Retention & Proactive Risk Mitigation

  • Churn Prevention & Health Tracking: Continuously evaluate account health scores, platform telemetry (via Vitally/Salesforce), and support ticket trends to detect early indicators of risk or "silent churn."

  • Escalation Management: Act as the senior point of escalation for complex account issues, mobilizing Support, Professional Services, and Product teams to resolve critical blockers.

  • Renewal Partnership: Partner proactively with Account Managers (AMs) 90–120 days ahead of renewals, sharing usage health, relationship sentiment, and delivered ROI to ensure predictable, on-time contract renewals.

    • 5. Growth, Expansion & Commercial Partnership

  • Expansion Identification: Uncover organizational changes, new business units/locations, or unmet operational workflows suitable for add-on modules (e.g., Deputy HR, advanced compliance, payroll sync) or seat growth.

  • Pipeline Enablement: Scope and qualify expansion leads before passing them seamlessly to Account Managers to close commercial agreements.

    • 6. Team Leadership & Operational Excellence

  • Mentorship: Provide coaching, deal support, and onboarding guidance to Associate and Mid-level CSMs across the Customer Success organization.

  • Playbooks & Tooling: Contribute to internal CS best practices, standard operating procedures, EBR templates, and health check playbooks.

What You Bring (Qualifications)

  • Experience: 5 to 8+ years of B2B SaaS Customer Success or Strategic Account Management experience, with at least 2+ years managing Mid-Market or Enterprise accounts.

  • Ecosystem Acumen: Strong comfort understanding and navigating SaaS tech ecosystems, integration touchpoints (APIs, webhooks, SSO), and upstream/downstream data flows between operational tools and payroll/HR systems.

  • Executive Presence: Proven track record of leading high-stakes meetings, workshops, and EBRs with senior leadership (COO, VP HR, Head of Payroll).

  • Process & Tooling Fluency: Hands-on experience working with modern CS and CRM tech stacks (e.g., Salesforce, Vitally or Gainsight, Jira, Slack).

  • Problem-Solving Rigor: Demonstrated ability to step into complex or stalled customer situations, diagnose root causes, and align internal cross-functional resources to drive swift resolution.

  • Domain Knowledge: Direct background in Workforce Management (WFM), HR tech, payroll, or time-and-attendance platforms is strongly desired.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Net Dollar Retention (NDR) & Gross Retention Rate (GRR): Achieve portfolio retention targets (standard benchmark: ≥110% NDR / ≥95% Gross Retention).

  • Platform Utilization & Health: Maintain target health scores and active feature utilization across assigned accounts.

  • Executive Engagement: Execution rate and quality score for scheduled BRs and active Mutual Success Plans maintained in Vitally.

  • Customer Satisfaction: Achieve portfolio-level CSAT and stakeholder NPS targets (typically average stakeholder NPS 35+).

  • Expansion Pipeline Generated: Total qualified expansion pipeline (leads and seats/ARR) handed over to Account Management.

Work Environment & Travel

  • Work Model: Remote

  • Travel Requirements: 10% to 15% travel required for on-site Executive Business Reviews, high-priority customer workshops, and occasional company offsites.

Employee Perks

- Enjoy a flexible work policy (with a work-from-home stipend to set you up for success at home!)
- Own a piece of Deputy through our Employee Share Ownership Plan (ESOP)
- Take paid parental leave to support you and your family
- We’ll match your 401k contributions to help you save for the future
- Access mental health support with Spring Health
- Get comprehensive health benefits
- Use our commuter reimbursement program
- Take additional leave days — including 20 PTO days, study assistance, celebration days and volunteering
- Join our global working groups; focused on collaboration, belonging and connection
Deputy believes in equal opportunity and that inclusiveness and diversity promotes innovation. Our global team members are from a variety of cultures. And we welcome different perspective and skills.

About Spark Advisors

We're building healthcare tech for a system that desperately needs it.

Spark is fixing that. We’re the fastest-growing Medicare platform in the country, combining AI, an industry-leading CRM, and client services to transform how 10,000+ brokers acquire, enroll, and support clients in their local communities.

Join a talent-dense team from Square, Ramp, Yext, Oscar, and Cedar — backed by Primary Ventures and Viewpoint Ventures — that is serious about building technology to expand access to quality healthcare. Healthcare is overdue for innovation. Let’s redefine what its future looks like — together.

Summary

Spark is looking for a Director of Software Engineering to lead engineering across our broker productivity product and core platform. You'll make sure our platform keeps up with a fast-growing customer base, and you'll keep our web-based broker platform sustainable as it scales.

In this role, you'll own engineering delivery for multiple squads, along with the practices that span all of software engineering. You'll partner with product leaders on roadmaps, own our infrastructure roadmap, and be the point person for the security of our software platform. Today you'll manage engineers directly through strong tech leads. As the organization grows, you'll build and manage a layer of engineering managers. Reporting to our SVP of Engineering, you'll be the default owner for software engineering problems that don't have a clear home, so teams can stay focused on what they do best.

More about our stack and the role

  • Our stack is Python, Django, Celery, Vue, Redis, and Postgres, deployed on AWS with modern tooling for version control, continuous deployment, testing, and observability
  • You'll manage around six engineers across three squads at full headcount, and own the hiring plan as we grow
  • We operate in a HIPAA-regulated environment, and security and compliance are part of how we build
  • Every leader at Spark stays hands-on in some way. In this role that means design reviews, specs, code reviews, and spikes, while staying on the critical path for no more than one project at a time

What You'll Do

  • Drive engineering delivery for our broker productivity squads, partnering with product on sequencing, scoping, and delivery commitments
  • Own and communicate our infrastructure roadmap, including platform migrations, vendor integrations, sustainability work, and AI enablement
  • Lead security for our software platform, including pen test and audit remediation, in partnership with our IT, DevOps, and data teams
  • Own engineering-wide practices across all squads: cross-squad coordination, onboarding, QA and testing, and bugs and support processes
  • Hire senior and staff engineers, develop tech leads, and design a team structure that scales
  • Take ambiguous problems from definition to resolution, deciding what to own, what to delegate, and what to decline
  • Represent software engineering in company-wide planning and cross-functional work

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years in software engineering, including meaningful time in a startup environment
  • 3+ years managing engineers, including leading multiple teams or managing through tech leads. Experience managing managers is a strong plus
  • Strong technical foundation in web applications (Python/Django or similar, and JavaScript frameworks like Vue or React), with the judgment to review designs and code credibly
  • Experience owning a platform or infrastructure roadmap and explaining it to non-technical leadership
  • Experience delivering large migrations or third-party integrations
  • Working knowledge of application security and compliance in a regulated environment (HIPAA, SOC 2, or similar)
  • Proven track record hiring and developing senior engineers and tech leads
  • Comfort working across many kinds of problems at once, with good judgment about where to spend your time
  • Strong written and verbal communication, especially with leadership and cross-functional partners

Compensation

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our company’s size and industry, and are one part of the total compensation package that also includes equity, benefits, and other opportunities at Spark. In accordance with New York City, Colorado, California, and other applicable laws, Spark is required to provide a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. Individual pay decisions are ultimately based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, geography, and balancing internal equity. A reasonable estimate of the current salary range is listed below. We expect most candidates to fall in the middle of the range. We also believe that your personal needs and preferences should be taken into consideration, so we allow some choice between equity and cash.

Base Salary
$230,000—$260,000 USD

Why you should join our team

By joining Spark, you will get in on the ground floor of a fast-moving, well-funded, and mission-driven startup where you will have a profound impact on the brokers and beneficiaries we serve. And you'll learn, grow, be challenged, and have fun with your team while doing it.

We strive to help you and your family thrive. We're committed to supporting your happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing a comprehensive benefits program. In addition to your base salary, we also offer:

  • Equity compensation
  • Health care, including dental and vision
  • Flexible work location; co-working available
  • 401k
  • Paid Time Off
  • Monthly Remote Work Stipend (help cover costs of home-office needs)
  • Paid Parental Leave
    • Up to 14 weeks for birthing parents
    • Up to 8 weeks for non-birth parents
  • 11 paid holidays
  • 2 week sabbatical at 5 years of employment
  • Wellbeing Perks through SpringHealth, Calm, and more!

Compliance

Spark is a proud participant in E-Verify. As part of our commitment to compliance, we use the E-Verify program to confirm the employment eligibility of all employees working in the United States. For more information about E-Verify, please visit.

Furthermore, for security and compliance requirements, we’re unable to accommodate international remote work. While we fully support travel and time off, all work must be conducted from an approved location within the U.S.

jobs.description:
Analyst, ERP and Corporate Finance, Trexon, An Amphenol Company

FLSA Status: Salary, Exempt

Reports To: Manager, ERP Team; dotted line to Trexon Controller

Direct Reports: None

Location: Remote-first (U.S.), with travel to Trexon sites as required

Travel: Up to 50%, concentrated in implementation and go-live periods

Summary

Trexon is a manufacturer of specialty cable, wire harness and interconnect solutions serving leading customers in the space, defense, medical, industrial and other specialty end markets. Trexon is a group of seven business units across the U.S., with $200M+ in annual revenue and nearly 900 employees and is part of Amphenol Corporation (NYSE: APH), a global leader in interconnect and sensor solutions.

Trexon is actively seeking an Analyst, ERP and Corporate Finance. Reporting to the Manager, ERP Team, with a dotted line to Trexon’s Controller, the Analyst is an individual contributor who supports the business units’ ERP systems and the corporate finance initiatives that run on them. The role is remote and requires up to 50% travel to our sites, concentrated in implementation and go-live periods.

On the ERP side, the Analyst supports Trexon’s ERP environment, with Epicor as the primary platform, from configuration and upgrades through site rollouts and post-go-live support. Working with business unit finance teams, the ERP team and IT, the Analyst translates finance requirements into system configuration, reports and procedures, and supports users through documentation and training.

On the finance side, Trexon’s corporate finance team is introducing and strengthening controls and procedures across the business units and corporate function as part of Amphenol’s public company environment. These cover areas such as inventory, intercompany reporting, revenue cut-off, customer and credit controls, and period-end reviews. The Analyst helps business units put these initiatives into practice in their local ERP and close routines, builds the reports and evidence they need, and tracks open items to completion. The role works from established corporate policy and is focused on execution.

Effective communication is integral to the role. The Analyst must explain system and procedural requirements clearly to site finance, operations and IT teams, and keep work moving across several business units at once. The ideal candidate combines accounting knowledge with hands-on ERP experience and the organization to manage multiple initiatives across sites.

Key Responsibilities

ERP Functional Support

  • Support Epicor implementations, site rollouts and version upgrades from project kickoff through go-live and post-go-live stabilization.
  • Configure and maintain finance and inventory modules, including general ledger, accounts payable and receivable, and costing setup, in line with corporate standards.
  • Gather requirements from site finance teams and translate them into system specifications, reports and process changes, working with the application development and ERP teams.
  • Design testing plans with site users, validate custom code and reports, and document results to meet corporate validation requirements.
  • Provide functional support to resolve end-user issues through the ticketing system, phone and email, and escalate to the right team as needed.
  • Write procedural documentation and conduct user training to improve ERP use and consistency across sites.
  • Maintain ERP user access, security roles and change records in support of Amphenol IT and internal control requirements.

Corporate Finance Initiatives and Controls

  • Partner with Trexon’s corporate finance team and business unit controllers to carry out new corporate controls and procedures initiatives at each business unit, tracking each from kickoff to completion.
  • Assess whether each business unit’s ERP can support a new requirement and, where it cannot, document and implement an alternative procedure.
  • Build and maintain ERP reports and review routines that support month-end procedures, including intercompany inventory identification, inventory valuation, received-not-invoiced aging, and customer change and credit limit reporting.
  • Support inventory control routines at the business units, including physical and cycle count procedures, excess and obsolete reserve calculations, and labor and overhead rate updates.
  • Document procedures and retain evidence of control performance so business units can support periodic self-assessments and internal audit requests.
  • Maintain the initiative tracker and report status, risks and open items to the Controller and the Manager, ERP Team on a regular cadence.
  • Provide ERP data for corporate reporting requests, financial package reviews and budget and forecast support.
  • Perform other job-related duties as requested by management.

Key Competencies

  • Hands-on analyst, comfortable moving between accounting detail and system configuration.
  • Working knowledge of manufacturing accounting, including how inventory, cost and shop-floor transactions reach the general ledger.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Ability to turn business requirements into clear specifications, reports and procedures.
  • Practical approach to controls, applying corporate requirements in a way that fits each business unit’s size, systems and processes.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including documentation and user training.
  • Ability to manage several initiatives across sites at once and meet deadlines in a compressed corporate reporting calendar.
  • Ability to collaborate with site finance, operations, IT and corporate teams in a multi-faceted environment.
  • Ability to handle confidential financial and personnel information appropriately.
  • Self-motivated and positive team player.
  • Ability to work flexible hours as needed, particularly around go-lives and period-end close.

Qualifications

Must be a U.S. Person as defined under ITAR (22 CFR 120.62) due to aerospace and defense customer compliance.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in accounting or finance, or equivalent experience, is required; CPA or MBA a plus.

Experience: Minimum five (5) years of combined experience in manufacturing or business unit accounting and ERP financials, including at least three (3) years within a manufacturing organization. Experience participating in ERP implementations, site rollouts or upgrades is required. Experience supporting internal controls, audit readiness or procedure documentation is a plus.

Knowledge: Working knowledge of US GAAP, general ledger structures, inventory and cost accounting, and the month-end close. Hands-on experience with ERP financials required; Epicor 10 or Kinetic preferred. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills required. Experience building reports with Power BI or Epicor reporting tools (BAQs, SSRS) preferred. Familiarity with SAP BPC or other consolidation platforms, and with Jira or similar ticketing tools, is a plus. Demonstrated ability to improve processes and diagnose problems. Training will be provided on internal Trexon and Amphenol processes and systems, as required for this position.

Compensation and Benefits

Trexon provides competitive compensation, with starting salaries determined by individual qualifications, relevant experience, and internal equity.

Trexon also offers a comprehensive benefits program, including medical, dental and vision coverage, paid time off, and a 401(k) plan with employer match.

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit for extended periods of time. The noise level in the work environment is usually low.

This is a direct hire position. Trexon is not enlisting recruitment support to fill the role at this time.

Salary Transparency
$100,000—$120,000 USD

Chi è Tendium

Tendium utilizza l’intelligenza artificiale per automatizzare i processi legati agli appalti pubblici. Dalla nostra fondazione nel 2018 siamo cresciuti fino a circa 100 persone e continuiamo ad espanderci rapidamente. L’Italia è uno dei nostri principali mercati di crescita e stiamo costruendo il nostro team commerciale dedicato al mercato italiano.

Se desideri saperne di più sulla nostra cultura aziendale e su cosa puoi aspettarti lavorando in Tendium, puoi leggere maggiori informazioniqui.

Il ruolo

Come SDR, sarai il primo punto di contatto con i potenziali clienti nel mercato italiano e avrai un ruolo centrale nella nostra crescita.

Ti occuperai di

  • Individuare e contattare i decisori di aziende che vendono o desiderano vendere al settore pubblico.

  • Qualificare le opportunità commerciali in base al valore concreto per il cliente.

  • Gestire i lead in entrata e garantire un seguito tempestivo.

Chi cerchiamo

Cerchiamo persone all’inizio della carriera o con esperienza nelle vendite.

Profilo junior

Non è richiesta esperienza precedente nelle vendite. Offriamo formazione e coaching per aiutarti ad avere successo.

Profilo con esperienza

Se hai esperienza come SDR o nelle vendite B2B potrai assumere maggiori responsabilità fin dall’inizio.

Ci piacerebbe che tu

  • Volessi crescere nelle vendite e accogliessi volentieri i feedback.

  • Avessi perseveranza e continuassi anche di fronte a un no.

  • Ti preparassi alle conversazioni con i clienti.

  • Imparassi rapidamente a usare nuovi strumenti e ti sentissi a tuo agio con l’AI.

  • Parlassi e scrivessi correntemente in italiano.

  • Avessi una buona padronanza dell’inglese in un contesto professionale.

  • Fossi ambizioso, orientato agli obiettivi e desideroso di crescere nelle vendite.

Requisiti preferenziali ma non indispensabili

  • Esperienza nelle chiamate a freddo o nelle vendite B2B.

  • Esperienza negli appalti pubblici o nel B2G.

  • Esperienza con HubSpot o altri sistemi CRM.

  • Esperienza in aziende in rapida crescita.

  • Conoscenza dello svedese, del danese, del finlandese o del tedesco.

Il team

Entrerai a far parte di un team commerciale ambizioso e collaborativo con oltre 30 colleghi.

Crescita professionale

Utilizziamo strumenti moderni e AI per rendere più efficienti ricerca, prospezione e analisi. Esistono concrete opportunità di crescita verso ruoli di Account Executive o specialistici.

  • Retribuzione fissa + provvigioni senza tetto massimo + benefit

  • Coaching settimanale con il Sales Manager

  • Supporto da parte di colleghi e venditori esperti

  • Obiettivi chiari e piani di sviluppo individuali

Selezioniamo i candidati su base continuativa, quindi ti invitiamo a candidarti il prima possibile tramite Teamtailor.

Se la tua candidatura verrà selezionata per la fase successiva, ti chiederemo di registrare due brevi video:

  1. Una breve presentazione di te stesso/a.

  2. Una presentazione di Tendium, come se fossimo un potenziale cliente.

Se supererai questa fase, incontrerai successivamente il Sales Manager e il team con cui lavorerai.

Per rendere il processo ancora più efficiente, ti invitiamo ad accedere al tuo profilo Connecte ad aggiungere le tue referenze in qualsiasi fase del processo di selezione. and add your references at any stage.

Non vediamo l’ora di ricevere la tua candidatura e di conoscerti meglio durante il processo di selezione.
