jobs.excerpt: SENIOR PRODUCT DESIGNER, DESIGN SYSTEMSLocation: Remote (U.
jobs.description:
SENIOR PRODUCT DESIGNER, DESIGN SYSTEMS

Location: Remote (U.S.)

Department: Engineering

Reports to: Chief Technology Officer

Owns UX across 360 Privacy’s product, using the company’s design system and AI tools to turn ideas into mockups, customer report designs and on-brand materials in hours instead of weeks.

// ABOUT US

360 Privacy is the leader in digital exposure reduction for enterprises, executives, and high-profile individuals. Powered by its proprietary 360 Strata platform, the company combines automated detection, exposure removal, and analyst-led intelligence to reduce personal risk at its source. By unifying data broker removal, social media and dark web monitoring, real estate exposure detection, and continuous analyst-driven investigations, 360 Privacy helps cybersecurity, physical security, and executive protection teams close digital attack pathways before they are exploited.

// JOB SUMMARY

The Senior Product Designer, Design Systems owns UX across 360 Privacy’s product. This role will own UX work and decisions for our platform. It needs business context, design taste and technical understanding in equal measure, and it is an AI-native role for a designer who works through a design system. 360 Privacy already has a complete system built in Claude: design tokens, a full component set, and documented rules for how each component should be used. This role takes it over, evolves it, and uses it every day to turn product ideas, roadmaps and leadership updates into polished mockups, customer-facing PDF report designs, slides and documents. Using the existing design system, AI tools draft quickly and this role’s time goes to judgment, refinement and craft.

This is the company’s only design role, and its work is prioritized in this order: product UX ownership, the design system that supports it, the digital exposure risk reports, then leadership and enablement materials as capacity allows. This is not a front-end engineering role; it does not own production code. It is also not a role that solves each feature with new layouts. Engineers build from what this role specifies, AI tools draft from what it documents, and the job is to make reinvention unnecessary.

// KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

OWN PRODUCT UX

▪ Own UX decisions across the product, from flows and information architecture to interaction details, and make the call rather than waiting for sign-off.
▪ Ground each design in the business goal, the customer’s context and what engineering can realistically build.
▪ Be the central point for all things UX: the person product, engineering and leadership go to for UX answers, bringing in the CTO only for decisions with major business or technical impact.

OWN AND EVOLVE THE DESIGN SYSTEM

▪ Maintain design tokens for color, typography, spacing, elevation and radius, with semantic names that engineers and AI tools can apply without guessing.
▪ Keep the component set small and deliberate so engineers pick from known variants, and extend core view patterns (explorer, detail and dashboard views; panels, widgets, drill-downs and edit modals) so new features slot into an existing pattern.
▪ Keep the system’s rules in plain language and its documentation machine-readable (token files, component reference, usage rules), so people and AI tools follow it reliably.

PRODUCE WORK THROUGH THE SYSTEM

▪ Build high-fidelity, interactive prototypes in Claude to test flows and features, using only system components and tokens.
▪ Turn roadmaps, strategy notes and status updates into polished, on-brand slides and documents for leadership and customers, and build enablement materials (one-pagers, feature explainers, battle cards, support guides) for marketing, sales and CX.
▪ Review AI-generated output for off-system colors, one-off styles and pattern drift, and fix the documentation when a tool keeps getting something wrong.
▪ Build reusable templates, example artifacts and prompt patterns so anyone on the team can produce on-brand work.

DESIGN DIGITAL EXPOSURE RISK REPORTS

▪ Design a family of PDF report templates, each tuned to its reader: an executive summary of risk level, trend and decisions; an analyst view of findings, evidence and severity; and an action-oriented checklist of what to fix, who owns it and how to verify it.
▪ Turn complex risk data into charts, scores and summaries a non-technical reader understands in under a minute.
▪ Design for print and PDF (page breaks, readable density, accessible severity colors, layouts that hold up in grayscale), and build report layouts, chart styles and severity language into the system.

PARTNER ACROSS THE TEAM

▪ Join product discovery early with your PM and carry the work through feedback and launch.
▪ Hand engineers specs that name patterns and variants, not pixel-tuned one-offs, and flag when feature work reaches for custom styling, a sign the system is missing something.
▪ Keep accessibility (contrast, focus states, readable data density) built into the system from the start.

// REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

▪ 5+ years of product design, including at least 2 owning or co-owning a design system (tokens, components, documentation).
▪ A track record of owning UX decisions for a product end to end, not just executing someone else’s direction.
▪ Business context, design taste and technical understanding: you connect design decisions to business goals, hold a strong, well-reasoned point of view on what good looks like, and understand enough about how software is built to design what engineering can ship.
▪ AI-native way of working: AI tools are how you design, not an add-on to a Figma workflow. Your portfolio shows work you produced with AI tools, the prompts, templates or documentation you wrote to get consistent output, and how you caught and fixed what the tools got wrong.
▪ A track record of getting a design system adopted by engineers and other teams, not just built.
▪ Strong visual craft for dense, data-heavy interfaces such as dashboards, tables and admin tools, carried across product UI, decks and documents.
▪ Information design for reports: a portfolio piece that turns dense or technical data into a document tailored to a specific audience, such as executives versus practitioners.
▪ Clear technical writing: you can explain a rule, its reason and its exceptions in a few sentences that both people and AI tools follow.
▪ Working knowledge of how design tokens map to implementation (for example, Tailwind or CSS variables) so your specs are buildable. Reading code is helpful; writing it isn’t required.
▪ User experience first, with system discipline: you tailor each flow to the persona using it, work within the system, and weigh the engineering impact of every decision before you propose it.
▪ Speed and product partnership: you complete design and feedback loops for features and decks in 1 to 2 weeks, run larger work like the report family on a milestone plan, and treat PM feedback as part of the process rather than a final review.

// PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

▪ Background in B2B security, privacy or data products; you can hold a substantive conversation about severity and remediation, not just the interface.
▪ Familiarity with headless component libraries (such as Radix) and how a visual layer sits on top of them.
▪ Motion and data visualization chops for charts, widgets and status indicators.

// SUCCESS MEASURES

Success in this role includes:

FIRST 90 DAYS

▪ Making day-to-day UX decisions independently, with the CTO out of the critical path for routine UX work.
▪ Full command of 360 Privacy’s design system: you can explain any rule and the reason behind it.
▪ Deep fluency in the problem 360 Privacy exists to solve, the work the company actually delivers, and the broader ecosystem in which it operates. By the end of your first 90 days, you should be able to explain the company’s value, and the genuine complexity behind that value, to anyone you encounter in the course of your work.
▪ At least one feature carried from discovery to launch with a PM, built entirely from system components.
▪ Executive exposure risk report template live with customers.

BY END OF YEAR ONE

▪ Product, engineering and leadership treat you as the owner of UX.
▪ The full report family (executive, analyst, action-oriented) in customer use.
▪ Engineers build new features from existing patterns, and custom styling is rare.
▪ Marketing, sales and CX produce on-brand materials from your templates without needing you.
▪ AI tools produce drafts the team uses with light edits, not rework.

This position must be performed from within the United States.

jobs.description:
In this role, you will build and lead Prosci's new Global Services Operations & Excellence team: the operational engine behind our training and advisory delivery worldwide and the owner of the client experience it produces. You will shape the team's charter, structure and operating model, and use it to turn delivery strategy into predictable, scalable and profitable execution across North America, EMEA and APAC. You also partner with the VP, Global Service Delivery, so they can focus on strategy, client relationships and growth.

Since our founding in 1994, Prosci has been laser-focused on change. By combining our deep understanding of people with a proven methodology rooted in the creation of the ADKAR® Model, we’ve helped countless people and organizations thrive. Our solutions empower customers with lasting change resiliency through a unique blend of training, advisory services, and licensing options, including Kaiya™, Prosci's expert change management AI tool.

At Prosci, we are a purpose-driven organization full of passionate, curious, and results-oriented people. Working at Prosci means being part of a dynamic team that is dedicated to our purpose of creating a world where change is done right. Join us and be part of a culture that thrives on continuous learning, growth, and making a difference.

Check out our website for more about our team and approach: .

Key Responsibilities

Key role responsibilities include but are not limited to the following:

Run delivery operations and capacity

  • Plan global capacity and resources for instructors and consultants.
  • Forecast demand two or more quarters ahead.
  • Schedule and staff public, virtual, onsite and advisory engagements across time zones.
  • Manage the delivery lifecycle from sales-to-delivery handoff through logistics, delivery, close-out and billing handoff.
  • Set up escalation paths and resolve delivery issues quickly, including cancellations, instructor gaps and client escalations.

Drive performance, quality and financials

  • Define and report delivery KPIs: utilization, on-time delivery, cancellation and reschedule rates, CSAT/NPS, cost per delivery and delivery margin.
  • Build and maintain operational dashboards for the VP and leadership team.
  • Partner with Finance on delivery forecasts, budgets, cost control and revenue recognition.
  • Review quality and financial results together so efficiency gains never come at the expense of the client experience.

Raise service delivery excellence

  • Define what excellent Prosci delivery looks like and build a global delivery quality framework, including standards, session observations and quality audits.
  • Establish and lead the instructor and consultant quality program: onboarding, certification, performance reviews, coaching and exit decisions.
  • Own the client experience from booking through post-session follow-up.
  • Run the client feedback loop: collect, analyze and act on feedback, and share insights with Product and Content.
  • Track excellence metrics such as first-time-right delivery, repeat bookings and quality scores by instructor and consultant.
  • Ensure clients receive a consistent Prosci experience in every region and format.

Build and lead the Global Services Operations & Excellence team

  • Define the team's charter, scope and operating model, including how it works with regional delivery teams and the VP, Global Service Delivery.
  • Design the team structure and roles, build the hiring plan, and recruit and onboard the founding team. [CONFIRM: planned team size and hiring phases]
  • Bring existing operations, scheduling and quality activities into the team, with clear ownership and a smooth handover.
  • Set the team's operating rhythm: planning cycles, governance forums, reporting cadence and decision rights.
  • Design, document and improve global delivery processes and SOPs, balancing global standards with regional needs.
  • Own or co-own delivery systems (PSA/ERP, scheduling, LMS, BI) and drive adoption.
  • Identify and implement automation and AI opportunities that let delivery scale without growing headcount at the same rate.
  • Lead, coach and develop a distributed team as it grows, building its capability and a culture of operational discipline and service excellence.
  • Represent Service Delivery in cross-functional forums and stand in for the VP where needed.
  • Lead change within the team and delivery network, applying the Prosci Methodology.

Requirements

Based on this role’s scope and responsibilities, we are seeking candidates with the following minimum qualifications, skills, attributes, and competencies. Preferred qualifications are also noted.

Competencies

Drives Results: builds a team that delivers against agreed operational and financial targets.

Customer Focus: builds a client-first mindset in the team and delivery network.

Collaboration: builds strong working partnerships across Sales, Finance, Product and Content, and People.

Leads Change: builds the team's ability to adopt and sustain change.

Builds Effective Teams: forms a new team with a shared purpose, clear roles and strong accountability.

Develops Others: builds the team's skills through coaching and feedback.

Decision Quality: builds sound, data-informed decision making in the team.

Technical Skills

  • Hands-on experience with PSA/ERP and BI tools, such as Certinia, Salesforce, Kantata, Power BI or Tableau.
  • Strong financial acumen: delivery margin, forecasting, budgets and working with Finance.
  • Capacity planning, scheduling and utilization management for a delivery workforce of employees and/or contractors.
  • Process design and improvement; Lean, Six Sigma or ITIL knowledge is a plus.
  • Experience applying automation or AI to operational workflows (preferred, but not required).

Working with AI at Prosci

As a people leader building a new team, you embed AI in how it works from the start to make delivery operations faster, more consistent and more scalable. You encourage experimentation, share what works and help people build confidence with new tools. You uphold Prosci's data security, confidentiality and intellectual property governance in every use of AI.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years in service delivery, professional services or training operations, including 3+ years leading multi-region operations.
  • Experience building a new operations, service excellence or similar function from the ground up, including org design, hiring and setting up operating rhythms.
  • A track record of measurable improvement, such as higher utilization, lower delivery cost, faster time-to-deliver or better client satisfaction.
  • Experience building delivery quality or client experience programs, including standards, facilitator quality reviews and feedback loops.
  • Experience leading managers or coordinators across time zones.
  • Clear communication, moving comfortably between VP-level strategy and day-to-day problem solving.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
  • Preferred: background in training, education, consulting or learning services; experience scaling from mid-size to global; experience across North American, European and Asia-Pacific markets.
  • Preferred: Lean, Six Sigma, ITIL or PMP credentials; familiarity with change management; Prosci certification is a plus.

Additional Information

Travel Requirements: This role requires 20% travel.

Work Location: This is a remote role.

Compensation: Competitive annual base salary for this role depending on the candidate’s overall qualifications and experience. This role is eligible for inclusion in our bonus program.

Benefits

Benefits: Through our experience and strategic focus on the people side of change, we know that by taking care of our people, we are taking care of our business. In addition to the compensation detailed above, we offer a comprehensive benefits package, including paid time off, holidays and access to LinkedIn Learning. Our “mostly virtual” culture is vibrant with many opportunities to collaborate with colleagues from around the world, get involved in employee-led interest and resource groups, and to meet up with team members at in-person local or market-wide events.

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Senior Solutions Architect on GitLab's India team, you'll be a trusted advisor to prospects, customers, and partners across India. You'll help them understand how GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform addresses technical requirements and business goals across the software development lifecycle. This role supports Commercial and Enterprise segments in India's Southern Region. Experience with Global Capability Centers (GCCs), Digital Native organizations, and startups is highly valued given the accounts you'll support.

You'll partner closely with Account Executives and cross-functional teams to own technical evaluations, including proofs of value and workshops, shape solution architectures, and bring customer feedback to Product Management. You'll also occasionally support regional go-to-market partners that provide Professional Services. Your work will help customers adopt GitLab successfully, support revenue growth through solution selling, and build long-term, trusted relationships.

What you’ll do

  • Lead technical discovery, demonstrations, and validation to show how GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform meets customers' technical and business needs across the software development lifecycle.
  • Own the technical evaluation process, including solution design, proofs of concept or value, workshops, and technical contributions to tenders, audits, and value stream assessments.
  • Collaborate with Account Executives and regional sales teams across Commercial and Enterprise segments to shape account strategies for new customer acquisition and expansion, with a focus on GCC, Digital Native, and startup accounts.
  • Support regional go-to-market partners that provide Professional Services, helping them deliver consistent technical guidance and apply effective practices during partner-led engagements.
  • Represent GitLab at online and in-person marketing events, including webinars, industry events, presentations, roundtables, panels, demonstration days, and hackathons.
  • Build trusted relationships with technical practitioners and business leaders, guide GitLab-driven transformation, and help customers become GitLab advocates.
  • Advise customers on modern software development, continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD), security, and cloud practices to improve their return on investment.
  • Share customer feedback, use cases, and competitive insights with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing while continuing to build expertise and reusable guidance in GitLab, DevSecOps, AI, and cloud technologies.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience guiding Commercial and Enterprise customers through solution design and evaluation in technical presales, consulting, or a similar role.
  • Experience working with India's GCCs, Digital Native organizations, and startups is highly valued.
  • Knowledge of the end-to-end software development lifecycle, including modern DevSecOps practices and CI/CD workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with GitLab or comparable source control, CI/CD, and collaboration platforms, with the ability to connect platform capabilities to customer use cases.
  • Practical knowledge of cloud computing concepts and related technologies, including deployment, security, and operations options.
  • Ability to lead proofs of concept or value, contribute to tenders or audits, and design and run workshops or value stream assessments.
  • Clear technical communication and presentation skills, with the ability to adapt your message for practitioners and senior business and technical decision-makers.
  • Skill in building trusted relationships, listening with empathy, advocating for customers, collaborating with go-to-market or Professional Services partners, and continuously learning new technologies.

About the team

The Solutions Architect team is part of GitLab's Sales organization and serves as the technical counterpart to Account Executives. This role focuses on Commercial and Enterprise opportunities across India's Southern Region and works with Account Executives, the broader go-to-market team, and regional partners that provide Professional Services. The team advises on architecture, runs technical evaluations such as proofs of value, and guides customers through digital transformation. We collaborate asynchronously with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to share effective practices, create reusable technical resources, and represent the voice of the customer. Our focus is helping customers modernize software delivery, adopt GitLab at scale, and navigate a changing AI and DevSecOps landscape.

jobs.description:
Location: Home-based in the UK.

Salary: £32,000 - £34,000 per annum, depending on experience

Contract: Permanent, full-time or 0.8 FTE

Working pattern: We offer a fully flexible working environment

Annual leave: 25 days of annual leave per annum, plus 3 additional days over Christmas

Additional Benefits: Comprehensive Employee Assistance Programme (EAP)

The role

We are looking for an experienced and organised Senior Finance Coordinator to join the Common Purpose Finance team.

This is a role for someone with a strong foundation in accounting and finance administration, excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage a varied workload with accuracy and consistency. You will play an important part in ensuring that our financial records are complete, accurate and up to date, supporting the smooth running of finance operations across the group.

Working closely with the Finance team and colleagues across different business units, you will take responsibility for a range of day-to-day financial activities, including sales invoicing, accounts receivable, payment processing, reconciliations and financial administration. You will help ensure that financial transactions are recorded correctly and that entries are maintained through to trial balance level across the group of companies.

The role involves both regular financial processes and responding to changing operational needs. You might spend one day preparing sales invoices, following up overdue payments and processing staff expenses, and the next supporting month-end reconciliations, preparing information for VAT returns or responding to audit queries. You will also help monitor cash flow, coordinate foreign currency purchases and support colleagues with finance-related questions.

You will need to be comfortable working with financial information, applying fundamental accounting principles and using financial systems and Excel to maintain accurate records. Equally important will be your ability to build effective working relationships with colleagues across different functions and countries, communicate clearly and ensure that queries and requests are followed through.

We are looking for someone who can take ownership of their responsibilities, anticipate what needs attention and manage competing deadlines without compromising accuracy. You will be expected to use your judgement and initiative to identify issues, work through problems and find practical solutions. This means being able to think logically, remain calm under pressure and take a considered, solution-focused approach when dealing with unexpected challenges or competing demands. You will be a dependable member of the Finance team, helping ensure that financial processes are completed efficiently and that colleagues across Common Purpose have the financial support and information they need.

This is not simply a finance administration role. It is about taking responsibility for important financial processes, maintaining the accuracy and integrity of our financial records and contributing to the effective financial management of the organisation.

Financial operations and accounts receivable

  • Invoice processing – preparing and issuing sales invoices accurately and in a timely manner, ensuring that the relevant information and project details are recorded correctly.
  • Accounts receivable and debt collection – monitoring outstanding invoices, following up overdue payments and taking appropriate action to support the timely collection of debts.
  • Participant payments – coordinating and processing participant payments, particularly during programme delivery, ensuring payments are handled accurately and within required timeframes.
  • Proforma payments – processing proforma payments and ensuring the necessary information and supporting documentation are maintained.
  • Foreign currency purchases – coordinating foreign currency purchases to support the organisation's operational and financial requirements.

Financial administration and monthly processes

  • Staff expenses – reviewing and processing staff expenses on a fortnightly basis, ensuring claims are accurate and comply with relevant procedures.
  • TravelPerk invoice processing – managing the monthly processing of TravelPerk invoices and ensuring transactions are recorded accurately.
  • Project code management – maintaining the project code sheet and ensuring relevant financial information is kept up to date.
  • Business unit support – supporting business units with financial trackers and related information, ensuring records are maintained accurately and consistently.
  • Finance inbox management – monitoring the Finance inbox and responding to or coordinating internal and external finance queries, ensuring requests are dealt with promptly and followed through.
  • Financial administration – providing wider finance administration support and helping maintain efficient and consistent financial processes across the organisation.

Financial controls, reporting and reconciliations

  • Month-end reconciliations – completing assigned month-end reconciliations, investigating discrepancies and ensuring financial records are accurate and up to date.
  • General ledger accuracy – applying fundamental accounting principles to ensure financial transactions are correctly recorded, organised and maintained through to trial balance level across the group of companies.
  • Cash flow monitoring – supporting the monitoring of cash flow and maintaining visibility of relevant financial information to assist the Finance team with cash management.
  • VAT returns – supporting the preparation of the UK Group VAT return on a quarterly basis, ensuring the relevant information is accurate and available within required deadlines.

Audit and compliance support

  • Year-end audit support – supporting the Finance team during the annual audit process, gathering financial information and documentation and responding promptly to audit queries.
  • Ledger accuracy and audit preparation – assisting with checks and reconciliations to support the accuracy and completeness of financial ledgers ahead of and during the audit process.
  • Audit queries and follow-up – coordinating responses to requests from auditors and colleagues, ensuring queries are addressed accurately and within agreed deadlines.

What you’ll bring

We are looking for someone with a solid grounding in accounting and finance administration who can combine strong technical and numerical skills with excellent organisation and attention to detail. You will be confident managing recurring financial processes, working with financial systems and supporting colleagues across the organisation.

You will bring:

  • Problem-solving and initiative – you are a logical and solutions-focused thinker who uses sound judgement and takes initiative to resolve issues. You are comfortable working under pressure, assessing situations, identifying practical solutions and knowing when to escalate matters.
  • Finance and accounting experience – experience working in a finance or accounts role, with a good understanding of fundamental accounting principles and financial processes.
  • Accounts receivable experience – experience raising sales invoices, monitoring outstanding balances and following up overdue payments.
  • Financial processing and administration – experience managing a range of financial transactions and administrative processes accurately and efficiently with the ability to identify discrepancies and investigate issues.
  • Reconciliation skills – an understanding of financial reconciliations and the importance of maintaining accurate and complete financial records.
  • Strong Excel skills – confidence using Excel to maintain financial trackers, organise information and work with data. You will also be comfortable using Outlook, Word and other Microsoft Office applications.
  • Excellent organisation and attention to detail – the ability to manage financial information carefully, maintain accurate records and ensure tasks are completed thoroughly.
  • Ownership and follow-through – the ability to take responsibility for assigned tasks, monitor outstanding actions and ensure queries and processes are followed through to completion.
  • Relationship-building skills – the ability to establish effective working relationships with colleagues across different functions, business units and cultures, and to provide clear and helpful support.
  • Prioritisation and adaptability – the ability to manage a high workload, multiple tasks and competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment, while maintaining accuracy and quality.

All applicants must also

  • Be comfortable working independently and also as part of a collaborative, geographically dispersed team.
  • Have a sound understanding of basic accounting principles and financial administration.
  • Have strong numerical, analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Be confident using Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, and comfortable learning and using digital finance systems.
  • Have excellent organisational skills and a high level of attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Be able to manage competing priorities and meet regular financial and reporting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Be comfortable working independently, taking ownership of responsibilities and knowing when to seek guidance or escalate an issue.
  • Have strong written and verbal communication skills and be confident responding to internal and external queries.
  • Be committed to Common Purpose's independent and non-aligned approach to its work.

What we offer

  • Purpose – the opportunity to work with a global community of people who are contributing to organisations and communities in different ways
  • Influence – the opportunity to shape how Common Purpose understands and uses one of its most important long-term assets
  • Variety – exposure to different sectors, generations, cultures, organisations and perspectives through your work
  • Growth – continual development of your community, impact and strategic practice, alongside access to internal learning and development opportunities
  • Responsibility – meaningful ownership of the development of our alumni communities and approach to impact

jobs.title: AI Native Senior Software Engineer
jobs.excerpt: The Company Versaterm is a PE-backed, high-growth SaaS company building a fully integrated platform across the entire public safety ecosystem — dispatch, law enforcement, forensics, courts, and beyond.
jobs.description:
The Company

Versaterm is a PE-backed, high-growth SaaS company building a fully integrated platform across the entire public safety ecosystem — dispatch, law enforcement, forensics, courts, and beyond. We've grown through strategic acquisitions and deep product investment. What connects all of it is a single purpose: give public safety agencies the tools and insights to make better decisions in high-stakes moments.

When a 911 call is answered, a detective investigates a case, or a forensic lab processes evidence, there's a good chance our software is working behind the scenes. That's been true for over four decades.

AI is central to where we're going. Not as a feature but as core infrastructure. We're embedding intelligence directly into the workflows our customers rely on every day, and we're doing it alongside them. Our customers tell us what the mission demands. We build what answers it.

This work attracts a specific kind of person — someone who wants to be pushed by great people, build things that outlast a sprint cycle, and go home knowing the work connected back to something real.

The Role

The AI Native Senior Software Engineer is a change agent and a driver of value within our public safety ecosystem. Public safety agencies, dispatchers, and first responders count on our software every day, so reliability and security come first. You will architect, own, and deliver innovation to customers and be accountable for the results it produces for our users and our business. You will work across the VersatermOS platform and our broader product portfolio, bringing deep technical and architecture knowledge together with AI native development practices to build solutions that are reliable, secure, scalable, and cost-efficient. You will also lead by example and help engineers on the team(s) adopt the same ways of working. You should be passionate about shaping the future of public safety and revel in the fact that no task is too small or too big to make a difference to the people we serve. You will own and shape product with your team, from idea through production, and set the direction and tone for generating value for our customers and business.

The Direction

This position will have the opportunity to contribute to several tech stacks across our public safety portfolio. Our direction is to build working solutions quickly using the full range of AI native tools and practices, including coding agents, spec-driven development, AI-assisted design and code review, automated test generation, and agent workflows built into our CI/CD pipelines. You will work closely with your team to do this without giving up the reliability, security, and quality our customers rely on. You will be a hands-on leader in this space, setting the example for how we use AI to deliver software and helping staff build the same skill set you have. The AI Native Senior Software Engineer should be passionate about agentic development, architecture, and driving innovation to help shape the future of our software products.

What You Do

  • Lead the design and architecture of complex, scalable software solutions, ensuring they are secure, highly available, fault tolerant, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
  • Take ownership of high-impact projects from understanding the user's problem through design, implementation, deployment, and support in production, and check that what you shipped delivered the value we expected.
  • Mentor and provide guidance to associate engineers, helping them grow in their careers and improve their coding practices, including how they work with AI tools. Provide constructive feedback and assistance.
  • Be a leader in how our teams use AI to deliver software. Try new tools and approaches, figure out what actually works for our products, and turn it into shared practices, agent configurations, and examples the rest of the team can pick up.
  • Work closely with product managers, designers, customers, and other teams to deliver software in small increments of business value, using customer feedback and data to decide what comes next.
  • Focus on optimizing application performance, ensuring that the software scales effectively under increased loads and performs reliably in production. Set service level objectives (SLOs) and put the monitoring and alerting in place to meet them.
  • Support what you build in production. This includes taking part in on-call, leading the response when critical issues come up, and following through on post-incident reviews so the same problem doesn't happen twice.
  • Lead efforts to resolve complex technical issues and make sure software meets business requirements. Catch defects before they reach customers through automated test suites that cover the depth and breadth of solutions, quality gates in the CI/CD pipeline, and safe release practices like feature flags, staged rollouts, and quick rollback.
  • Build security into your work from the beginning with secure coding practices, threat modeling, dependency scanning, and least-privilege access. Protect sensitive data such as Criminal Justice Information (CJI) and personally identifiable information (PII) in line with the CJIS Security Policy and our internal standards.
  • Review AI-generated code with the same care as code written by hand by utilizing modern methods and AI practices. You own every change you ship, and you will help set the review, testing, and data handling practices that let the team move quickly with AI while staying safe.
  • Stay up to date with the latest industry trends, tools, and technologies, especially in the fast-moving AI space. Drive innovation and suggest improvements to the development process, architecture, and product features.
  • Participate in daily collaboration with team members and retrospectives for work generated. Help the team break down complex tasks into quick achievable value increments.
  • Ensure that code, system designs, and technical processes are well-documented for knowledge sharing and future reference by people and AI agents.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned to support team objectives, departmental needs, and overall organizational priorities.

What You Bring

Required Qualifications:

  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience and training.
  • 6+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Advanced, hands-on experience delivering software with modern AI development tools and methods, including coding agents, spec-driven development, context engineering, and AI-assisted testing and code review, along with good judgment on how to verify what AI produces.
  • A genuine passion for AI native development and experience leading a team through the adoption of new tools and ways of working.
  • Advanced proficiency in one or more programming languages such as C#, Python, JavaScript, or similar.
  • Deep understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and principles for delivering Software as a Service (SaaS). Experience in designing scalable and distributed systems.
  • Experience building and running production systems with high availability requirements, including monitoring, incident response, and root cause analysis.
  • Experience with DevOps and CI/CD practices, including continuous integration, continuous deployment, and tools like Kubernetes, ArgoCD, and Terraform.
  • Experience with automated testing, test-driven development (TDD), and testing frameworks.
  • Good understanding of secure development practices (for example OWASP Top 10, threat modeling, and secrets management) and experience applying security controls in software and DevOps processes.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and collaboration skills. Ability to work cross-functionally with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to pass required background and security screening, including the fingerprint-based check required under the FBI CJIS Security Policy.

Asset Qualifications:

  • Working knowledge of Microservices, SOA, Monolith, REST, RPC, SQL, NoSQL, etc.
  • Experience building and evaluating AI harnesses, MCP servers, knowledge graphs, multi-agent workflows, and other agentic tooling.
  • Experience managing cost and token usage across multiple AI models and providers.
  • Experience setting up evaluations or other ways to measure the quality and impact of AI in the development process.
  • Experience with real-time media processing algorithms and machine learning for transcribing and translating information.
  • Expertise in optimizing and fine-tuning large-scale applications for performance, scalability, and high availability.
  • Previous experience in mentoring or coaching associate engineers and fostering a positive, collaborative team culture.
  • Experience in industries such as finance, healthcare, public safety or government.
  • Familiarity with public safety and compliance standards such as CJIS, SOC 2, StateRAMP/FedRAMP, or NG911.

Note: This position requires a security clearance from the Government of Canada. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Canada and must successfully obtain and maintain a Reliability security clearance. Please note that specific customer contracts may impose additional security verification requirements. Obtaining and maintaining all required security clearances is a condition of employment. For more information on the Government of Canada's security screening process, please visit Public Services and Procurement Canada.

Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Capital Markets & Treasury to support Oportun’s funding strategy, liquidity management, and capital planning. You’ll play a key role in managing warehouse facilities, securitizations, whole loan sales, lender reporting, covenant compliance, and corporate cash forecasting.

This role combines transaction execution, financial modeling, liquidity planning, and external partner management. You’ll work closely with Finance, Treasury, Legal, Accounting, Data, and external financing partners to strengthen funding capabilities, improve forecasting, and support informed capital decisions.

Success in this role means maintaining strong access to funding, improving visibility into liquidity and cash needs, strengthening reporting and controls, and helping the business make sound decisions across financing, capital, and growth priorities.

At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in.

· You’ll develop and maintain corporate cash forecasts, liquidity models, and short- and long-term funding plans.

· You’ll help evaluate and implement tools or processes that improve Treasury and Capital Markets efficiency, transparency, and scalability.

· You’ll bring ideas for how we can strengthen funding strategy, liquidity planning, and capital management across the organization.

· You’ll look for practical ways to use AI and automation to improve forecasting, analysis, reporting, documentation, and decision-making.

You’re an analytical and commercially minded finance professional who understands how funding, liquidity, capital, and portfolio performance connect to broader business strategy.

You communicate clearly with senior leaders and external partners, take ownership of outcomes, and know how to move work forward across multiple stakeholders.

You’re detail-oriented without losing sight of business impact, and you consistently look for ways to improve processes, controls, and decision-making.

What You Bring

jobs.excerpt: The Simulation Engineer III builds and validates discrete-event simulation and emulation models of automated material handling systems — conveyor and sortation, AS/RS and shuttle systems, goods-to-person, AMRs/AGVs, robotic picking and palletizing, and the labor and processes around them.
jobs.description:
The Simulation Engineer III builds and validates discrete-event simulation and emulation models of automated material handling systems — conveyor and sortation, AS/RS and shuttle systems, goods-to-person, AMRs/AGVs, robotic picking and palletizing, and the labor and processes around them. The models this role produces answer the questions that decide a project: Will the design hit peak throughput? Where does it bottleneck? How much buffer, how many stations, how many robots, how many people?

This is a hands-on modeling role with real customer exposure. You will support pursuits alongside sales and solution design, defend designs in front of customer engineering teams, de-risk systems before steel is ordered, and use emulation to shorten on-site commissioning. At Level III you own the simulation scope on multiple concurrent projects with minimal supervision, and you help less experienced engineers get better at the craft.

Key Responsibilities

Simulation Modeling & Analysis

•Build, verify, and validate discrete-event simulation models of proposed and existing material handling systems using [FlexSim / AutoMod / Emulate3D / Simio / AnyLogic / Plant Simulation].

•Translate concept drawings, equipment specifications, rate assumptions, and operating procedures into accurate model logic, including routing rules, recirculation, induction strategies, and exception handling.

•Analyze customer order and inventory data — order profiles, lines per order, units per line, SKU velocity, cube and weight, seasonality, hourly and peak-day profiles — and develop the design-day and peak-hour scenarios that models run against.

•Quantify system throughput, capacity, utilization, bottlenecks, accumulation and buffer sizing, staffing requirements, and order cycle time; run sensitivity and what-if analyses across growth, mix shift, and failure scenarios.

•Apply sound statistical practice: warm-up periods, replication counts, confidence intervals, and documented verification and validation steps so results hold up under customer scrutiny.

•Produce clear deliverables — result summaries, charts, animations, and written assumptions and limitations — that a non-simulation audience can act on.

Solution Development & Customer Support

•Work with solution design, sales engineering, and estimating during pursuits to compare alternative concepts, right-size equipment, and remove cost that analysis shows are unnecessary.

•Present findings and 3D animations in design reviews, proposal defenses, and customer workshops; explain the assumptions behind the numbers and where the risk sits.

•Support post-award design finalization and, after go-live, reconcile modeled performance against actual system data to improve future modeling accuracy.

Technical Leadership

•Own simulation scope, hour estimates, and schedule commitments across multiple concurrent projects.

•Peer-review models built by other engineers and mentor Simulation Engineers I and II on modeling technique, data analysis, and customer communication.

•Contribute to and maintain reusable component libraries, model templates, data-processing tools, and internal modeling standards.

•Stay current on MHE technologies, vendor equipment capabilities, and simulation software releases, and bring that knowledge back to the team.

Preferred Qualifications

•Master's degree in industrial engineering, Operations Research, or Supply Chain.

•Emulation and virtual commissioning experience with PLC-connected models.

•Familiarity with WMS, WCS, or WES platforms and how order release and wave strategy affect system performance.

•Exposure to AMR/AGV fleets, robotic each-picking, or automated storage vendors.

•Experience in e-commerce, retail, grocery, cold chain, 3PL, or parcel environments.

•Data visualization experience (Power BI, Tableau) and comfort working in CAD or coordination tools such as AutoCAD, Navisworks, or Revit.

•Lean, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement certification.

Requirements

•Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Operations Research, Supply Chain, or a related technical field.

•5+ years of professional discrete-event simulation experience, including at least 3 years modeling material handling, warehouse, distribution, manufacturing, or parcel operations.

•Demonstrated proficiency in at least one major simulation platform (FlexSim, AutoMod, Emulate3D, Simio, AnyLogic, Plant Simulation, or equivalent), with the ability to build complex custom logic rather than only assembling standard objects.

•Working knowledge of MHE subsystems and their operating characteristics: conveyor and accumulation, shoe/crossbelt/tilt-tray sortation, AS/RS and shuttles, goods-to-person, print-and-apply, palletizing, and mobile robotics.

•Strong data skills — able to profile and clean large order history files independently using SQL, Python, or equivalent, without waiting on someone else to prepare the data.

•Scripting or programming ability in at least one of Python, C#, VBA, FlexScript, or a comparable language.

•Proven ability to explain technical results to non-technical stakeholders, including customer operations and executive audiences.

•Ability to travel up to 25%, domestically and occasionally internationally.

About HexCoded

HexCoded is an AI video studio: you should be able to make anything you can imagine. We're a very small team, based in Gurugram and working remotely, building the tools that are reshaping how video, image and audio get made.

You'd work directly with me. Small team means nothing sits between you and the thing that ships.

What you'll actually work on

  • Live in the product. Your first week is spent making real videos in Creative Studio, across our video and image models, until you know where it breaks. Then you tell us — specifically, with the fix, not just the complaint.
  • Own a fix end to end. Find the thing that loses us users, argue for it, spec it tightly enough to build, and build the parts you can. You will ship to production in your first month.
  • Know the models cold. Sixteen video and image models sit in one place. Learn what each is good at, what it costs and where it falls over — and be the person who can say which one to reach for, and why.
  • Talk to users. On calls, on chat, in their own words. Bring back what they actually said, not a summary of what we hoped they said.
  • Know the market better than its own marketing pages. What every competing tool costs, what it does better than us, and where we win.
  • Whatever is on fire. Some weeks that is a vendor, a spreadsheet, a hiring pipeline or a launch. This is the honest part of the job.

What you'll bring

  • You have built something real with AI. Not a tutorial — a thing that exists, that someone other than you has used. Whether you hand-wrote the code or drove a model to write it matters far less than whether it works and whether you can walk us through how.
  • You check the machine's work. You can point at a time AI confidently handed you something wrong, and say how you caught it. "It didn't get anything wrong" is the wrong answer.
  • You read a product like an owner. You notice the thing that costs a user money or time, and you can say what you would do about it — precisely enough that someone could go build it.
  • High agency. You close loops without being chased. Given a half-formed problem and no instructions, you come back with it handled — or with the one question that was actually blocking you.
  • Clear, short writing. Most of your output is words other people act on. Long and vague is worse than short and wrong.
  • Speed over polish. You would rather ship ten rough things this week than one perfect thing next month.
  • Six months, full time, remote. Final-year student or a 2026 graduate. Any degree.

    • How to apply

  • Open Creative Studio and make something first. Sign up, generate one video, and find where it frustrates you. Then apply and tell us the single thing you'd fix — and how you'd build it.
  • That paragraph is what we read first. A CV is fine, but it is not what decides this. Applications that clearly have not opened the product do not get past the first pass.

jobs.description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

The Cobalt Services area is responsible for the entire lifecycle of essential shared services in the Command Central cloud-native software suite, offering capabilities such as the Events Pipeline, Rules Engine, Unit and Device management, Mapping, GIS, and Messaging services, which integrate and support multiple mission-critical products across the organization. The Cobalt Services DevOps team of experts operates as a Center of Excellence (CoE) by fostering a culture of operational excellence, managing the cloud infrastructure, deployments, and pipelines, and defining and enforcing a set of best practices and automation standards.


Job Description

We are seeking a proactive Mid-Level DevOps Engineer (Azure) to join our team as a hands-on force behind our cloud infrastructure and continuous delivery transformation. In this role, you will partner directly with development teams to optimize release processes, automate cloud provisioning, and maintain containerized environments on a daily basis.

We prioritize strong foundational skills in our core technologies over encyclopedic knowledge of every secondary tool. If you bring solid core competencies in Azure, Terraform, GitHub Actions, and Kubernetes, we provide the environment and resources to help you expand your tooling knowledge on the job. This role offers a people-first culture where you can pursue your potential, work with modern cloud technology, and contribute to software that helps keep people safe. Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience is welcome.


Basic Requirements

Cloud Infrastructure & Infrastructure as Code

  • Terraform to design, implement, and maintain scalable, high-availability cloud infrastructure within Microsoft Azure

  • Cloud Automation to help to provide reliable, repeatable environments and streamline provisioning across development and production

  • Operational Quality to observe operational metrics, analyze performance bottlenecks, and help to ensure continuous platform reliability

CI/CD Pipeline & Delivery Modernization

  • GitHub Actions to build, maintain, and optimize modern CI/CD release pipelines that empower developer teams

  • GitOps Methodologies to promote automated deployment patterns and maintain declarative infrastructure configurations

  • Workflow Efficiency to help to integrate continuous feedback loops and automated validation into release workflows

Container Orchestration & Reliability

  • Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) to contribute to hands-on deployment, maintenance, and scaling of containerized applications

  • Escalation Support to serve as a key technical contributor for escalated infrastructure issues and maintain platform stability

  • On-Call Support to participate in an after-hours on-call rotation to address critical system downtime and maintain platform availability

Basic Requirements

  • High School Diploma or Bachelor's Degree

  • 4+ years of DevOps experience supporting cloud infrastructure environments with Microsoft Azure

Job Requirements

Technical Expertise

  • Microsoft Azure & Terraform to build and manage automated cloud environments in production settings

  • GitHub Actions to construct and maintain scalable CI/CD pipelines

  • Kubernetes (AKS/EKS) to manage, maintain, and scale containerized application environments

  • Scripting to automate routine system tasks using PowerShell, Python, or Bash

  • English Proficiency to effectively communicate complex technical information in English, both verbally and in writing, with global teams

Professional Experience

  • Foundational DevOps to apply continuous integration and continuous deployment principles to daily release workflows

  • Pragmatic Problem-Solving to simplify complex technical architectures and help to streamline developer workflows

  • Collaborative Support to partner directly with engineering feature teams and foster continuous delivery improvements

Preferred Qualifications (Optional)

  • Exposure to GitOps delivery tools such as Argo CD or Flux CD

  • Basic conceptual understanding of security scanning tools such as SonarQube, OWASP ZAP, Mend, or Twistlock

  • Basic familiarity with monitoring and logging platforms such as Kibana, Grafana, Datadog, or Azure Monitor

  • Broad exposure to secondary cloud platforms such as Amazon Web Services (AWS)

  • Interest in leveraging AI-assisted workflows (such as Priority Intelligence™ and Assist capabilities) to assist with code generation and pipeline troubleshooting

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure DevOps Engineer Expert or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer - Professional certification

None


Relocation Provided

None

Experienced

Referral Payment Plan

Yes

jobs.description:
Menschen entwickeln, Servicequalität stärken

Als Teamleiter Kundenservice (m/w/d) übernimmst du die fachliche und organisatorische Verantwortung für ein standortübergreifendes 1st Level Support Team. Du entwickelst Mitarbeitende, Prozesse und Supportstrukturen weiter und trägst dazu bei, unseren Kundinnen und Kunden eine zuverlässige und serviceorientierte Unterstützung zu bieten.

Was du bewirkst

  • Du führst und entwickelst ein standortübergreifendes 1st Level Support Team und schaffst ein Umfeld, in dem Mitarbeitende ihr Potenzial entfalten können.
  • Du stellst sicher, dass Kundenanliegen zuverlässig, qualitativ hochwertig und serviceorientiert bearbeitet werden.
  • Du steuerst dein Team anhand relevanter Kennzahlen und leitest daraus Maßnahmen zur Verbesserung von Servicequalität und Kundenzufriedenheit ab.
  • Du etablierst einheitliche Arbeitsweisen, Prozesse und Qualitätsstandards und schaffst gleichzeitig Raum für individuelle Stärken und Entwicklung.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem 2nd Level Support und weiteren Fachbereichen zusammen, um nachhaltige Lösungen für unsere Kund:innen zu entwickeln.
  • Du optimierst Service-, Ticketing- und Eskalationsprozesse und treibst die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Supportorganisation voran.
  • Du begleitest Veränderungsprozesse und unterstützt dein Team dabei, neue Strukturen, Arbeitsweisen und Technologien erfolgreich umzusetzen.
  • Du förderst die Einführung innovativer Lösungen wie KI-gestützte Supportprozesse oder Chatbots und bewertest deren Mehrwert für Kund:innen und Mitarbeitende.

Was du mitbringst

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Kundenservice, idealerweise im Software- oder IT-Umfeld.
  • Erste fachliche oder disziplinarische Führungserfahrung.
  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung größerer Teams sowie in der Entwicklung einheitlicher Standards und Arbeitsweisen.
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung im Change Management und in der erfolgreichen Begleitung von Veränderungsprozessen.
  • Einen sicheren Umgang mit Kennzahlen und deren Nutzung zur Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung von Teams und Prozessen.
  • Erfahrung mit CRM-Systemen, Ticketing-Tools und digitalen Serviceprozessen.
  • Eine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie ein gutes Verständnis für operative Serviceorganisationen.
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.

Ein Plus, aber kein Muss

  • Erfahrung mit der Einführung neuer Technologien im Kundenservice
  • Kenntnisse im Einsatz von KI gestützten Supportlösungen oder Chatbots

Das zeichnet dich aus

  • Empathie Du schaffst Vertrauen und begegnest Kund:innen sowie Mitarbeitenden auf Augenhöhe
  • Kommunikationsstärke Du schaffst Orientierung, vermittelst auch komplexe Themen klar und bringst unterschiedliche Perspektiven zusammen
  • Ownership Du übernimmst Verantwortung, triffst Entscheidungen und treibst Themen konsequent voran
  • Führungskompetenz Du schaffst es, Teams auf gemeinsame Ziele auszurichten und gleichzeitig individuelle Stärken zu fördern
  • Veränderungsbereitschaft Du begleitest Menschen sicher durch Veränderungen und gewinnst sie für neue Wege

Unsere Benefits für dich

  • Du entscheidest: Hansefit, EGYM Wellpass, Kinderbetreuung oder JobRad – wir unterstützen Dich flexibel mit einem Zuschuss von bis zu 60 € monatlich. Zusätzlich profitierst Du von exklusiven Vergünstigungen mit Corporate Benefits
  • Du kannst auf uns zählen – TELUS Health stärkt Dich mit individuellen Angeboten für Deine mentale Gesundheit
  • Wir gestalten Deine Entwicklung – mit LinkedIn Learning hast Du Zugriff auf inspirierende Lerninhalte und praxisnahe Weiterbildung, die Dich wirklich voranbringen
  • Wir denken an Deine Zukunft – mit unserem Aktienkaufprogramm kannst Du direkt am Unternehmenserfolg teilhaben, und durch unsere betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV) sicherst Du Dir finanzielle Stabilität für die Zukunft
  • Du hast 30 Tage Urlaubsanspruch, um ausreichend Zeit für Erholung und persönliche Interessen zu haben

MEDIFOX DAN Gruppe mit Hauptsitz in Hildesheim gehört zur Resmed Corp. und beschäftigt über 900 Mitarbeitende an neun Standorten. Wir setzen auf Teamgeist, Kundenorientierung und Leidenschaft und arbeiten an zukunftsweisenden Softwarelösungen im Gesundheits- und Sozialwesen, um Innovationen voranzutreiben. Seit über 30 Jahren revolutionieren wir die Pflegebranche und suchen Menschen, die eine Leidenschaft für Technik in einer starken Unternehmenskultur teilen.

Über EVOLVE Digital

EVOLVE Digital ist eine spezialisierte E-Commerce- und Performance-Marketing-Agentur mit einem klaren Fokus auf skalierbare Wachstumssysteme, strukturierte Prozesse und messbare Ergebnisse.

Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in Ireland.

About Product Management:

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own your product’s roadmap, collateral, and market research, and you will collaborate with Grafana leadership on fine-tuning your product’s goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential.

Product Managers are the bridge that connect Engineering, Design, and UX to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers.

The opportunity:

As the Product Manager for Application Observability (App O11y), you’ll be responsible for helping application developers and SREs understand how their applications are performing, what’s affecting their users, and where to focus when something goes wrong. You’ll continue to build App O11y on top of the Knowledge Graph and fully integrate high-fidelity signals like traces and profiles, making all three first-class parts of the product experience. You’ll bring these capabilities together into our full-stack observability experience, alongside our Drilldown products, while building AI-first workflows that help customers investigate issues, understand root cause, and take action beyond static experiences.

Your primary responsibility will be to define the vision and roadmap that takes App O11y into its next wave of adoption and revenue growth. This will require heavy customer discovery, using product data to understand where users get stuck, and working with your engineering and design partners to turn those needs into clear priorities. You’ll balance new product opportunities with the depth, performance, and reliability customers need from tracing and profiling, while working across R&D to ensure App O11y is tightly woven into our broader Grafana Cloud suite.

You’ll also work closely with PMM and GTM to help customers understand the value of App O11y. This includes shaping pricing and packaging that make it easy to get started and grow with the product. You’ll regularly review customer feedback and usage data to understand what’s working and where people get stuck, and then be accountable for turning what you learn into stronger adoption and revenue growth.

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you will:

  • Transform ideas and feedback into a product vision and roadmap
  • Empathize with customer problems in order to collect user needs, requirements, and pain points
  • Curate and properly represent user feedback to Engineering, while providing evidence to support tradeoffs and priorities
  • Work closely with PMM to enable GTM on product differentiation, including creating and updating presentations, documentation, website content, datasheets, and whitepapers.

jobs.title: Practice Lead
jobs.excerpt: Our MissionAt Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life.
jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

As the Practice Lead (PL) within the Center of Excellence (COE), you will serve as the premier technical, operational, and delivery authority for our market-leading Cortex and Cloud portfolios within your designated theater. In this high-impact, matrix-leadership role, you are responsible for bridging global strategic engineering standards with regional field execution. Your mission is to drive predictable, world-class customer outcomes across the entire lifecycle from initial architecture, deployment & post-deployment phases.
You will act as the critical corporate nexus aligning Professional Services (PS), Customer Success (CS), Product Engineering, and Go-To-Market (GTM) leadership. By championing delivery excellence, AI-powered operational consistency, and regional performance, you will directly influence how Palo Alto Networks scales its most sophisticated cybersecurity and AI-driven automation solutions for the world’s largest enterprises.

Key Responsibilities

Theater Ownership & Execution Alignment

Drive Regional Excellence: Own the application, localized adoption, and quality governance of global COE methodologies, ensuring they are tailored effectively to regional market dynamics and compliance realities.
Cross-Functional Orchestration: Establish seamless alignment between Professional Services (PS) and Customer Success / Scale & Optimize (S&O) organizations to define unified delivery frameworks, joint handoffs, and customer success metrics.

Executive Escalation & Governance: Serve as the definitive regional authority and escalation point for complex methodology, scoping, and execution challenges, resolving high-stakes delivery roadblocks before they impact customer health.

Lifecycle Ownership & Delivery Scale
Unified Lifecycle Management: Enforce and champion a cohesive, end-to-end customer journey that bridges the gap between initial implementation and long-term account value optimization/expansion.
Operational Boundary Design: Define, refine, and optimize operational ownership boundaries between PS and CS, eliminating friction, clarifying roles, and ensuring frictionless transitions for customers.

AI-Driven Standardization at Scale: Eradicate bespoke, one-off delivery approaches by designing, introducing, and enforcing highly repeatable, asset-driven execution models that leverage machine learning insights and autonomous AI playbooks to maximize delivery margins.

Sales & GTM Integration
Strategic Commercial Partnership: Partner directly with regional Sales, Customer Success leadership, and GTM executives to ensure delivery readiness dynamically matches fast-paced deal motions and enterprise customer expectations.
Deal Architecture & Risk Mitigation: Advise on strategic, marquee, and complex enterprise deals by providing expert guidance on technical feasibility, scoping precision, risk mitigation, and delivery architecture.
Field-to-Product Feedback Loop: Systematically capture and synthesize theater-specific insights, product limitations, and regional constraints into structured, data-driven telemetry for Global COE and Product/Engineering teams to shape the future product roadmap

Performance, Capacity & Risk Management
Proactive Risk Management: Maintain deep, data-driven visibility into regional capacity, market demand, and delivery risks; preemptively resolve bottlenecks, skill shortages, and scalability challenges.
AI Readiness & Enablement: Spearhead the continuous enablement of field teams, ensuring PS, CS, and partner organizations are fully certified, equipped, and confident to execute new product features, service offerings, and advanced toolsets.
Operational KPIs: Establish and track metrics around delivery quality, methodology adherence, time-to-value, and customer satisfaction within the theater..

What You Will Influence
Global COE Evolution: The design, prioritizations, and strategic direction of the Global COE's foundational methodology.
Product Engineering Roadmap: Future product capabilities and GTM packaging based on strategic field telemetry and customer friction points.
Investment & Headcount Strategy: Long-term resource allocation, investment priorities, and headcount planning based on regional demand and scalability constraints.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Transformational Services Leadership: 10+ years of experience leading large-scale transformational initiatives within enterprise Professional Services, Management Consulting, or Customer Success organizations. A proven track record of modernizing global service delivery models is essential.

  • Strategic Operations & High-Growth Scale: 5+ years of experience steering enterprise-wide orchestration, strategic operations, business transformation, or executive advisory functions within a high-growth cybersecurity, cloud provider (AWS/Azure/GCP), or enterprise SaaS company.

  • Executive Stakeholder Management: Exceptional capability to influence, build consensus, and drive massive organizational change across disparate executive teams spanning Product, Engineering, Sales, and Services.

  • AI & Security Automation Proficiency: Solid understanding of how machine learning and Generative AI (GenAI) intersect with security operations. Candidates should possess a practical grasp of AI-driven SecOps (e.g., Cortex XSIAM), automated triage/incident orchestration, and the unique security governance/risks associated with safeguarding enterprise LLM deployments.

  • Framework Architecture: Proven success building, scaling, and optimizing delivery methodologies, operational governance models, maturity frameworks, and KPIs within complex, matrixed global organizations.

  • C-Suite Communication Skills: Stellar verbal, written, and presentation skills, with a demonstrated ability to translate highly complex technical, architectural strategies into clear, actionable operational plans for both technical engineers and C-suite audiences.

  • Domain & Platform Expertise: Deep technical literacy in modern cybersecurity architectures. Direct experience with Cortex (XDR/XSIAM/XPANSE), Cortex Cloud, and Prisma Cloud (or highly equivalent enterprise EDR/XDR, SIEM/SOAR, and CNAPP solutions) is strongly preferred.

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at .

We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
