jobs.excerpt: Job DescriptionThe U. S.  Oncology business within our company is a growing and dynamic organization committed to advancing innovative therapies for patients with cancer.
jobs.description:
Job Description

The U.S. Oncology business within our company is a growing and dynamic organization committed to advancing innovative therapies for patients with cancer. We have an exciting opportunity to join our dynamic commercial team as we prepare for the potential U.S. launch of an mRNA-based individualized neoantigen therapy for early-stage melanoma, being developed through an alliance partnership. This novel product has the potential to redefine personalized cancer treatment and requires a highly coordinated operating model to support seamless therapy delivery across a complex treatment ecosystem.

Reporting to the Director, Individualized Therapy Operations, the Associate Director, Treatment Site Operations Coordinator (TSOC) Lead is responsible for leading the centralized operational coordination capability that supports execution of the Intismeran treatment journey.

This leader will build, develop, and oversee a team of Treatment Site Operations Coordinators (TSOCs) responsible for coordinating patient cases, managing operational workflows, facilitating communication across stakeholders, and ensuring timely progression of patients through key treatment journey milestones. The role serves as the primary operational bridge between Treatment Site Leads (TSLs), treatment sites, alliance stakeholders, manufacturers, sequencing providers, pathology laboratories, distributors, patient support programs, and internal teams.

The TSOC team functions as the centralized coordination hub for the treatment journey, providing operational visibility, issue resolution, stakeholder communication, and case-level support to ensure patients successfully progress through each stage of the individualized therapy process. This role is accountable for establishing consistent operational standards, escalation pathways, and ways of working that enable seamless coordination across the treatment ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities 

  • Build, lead, and develop the Treatment Site Operations Coordinator (TSOC) organization, establishing team structure, performance expectations, ways of working, and capabilities required to support launch readiness and future scale.

  • Lead centralized operational coordination across the treatment journey, ensuring effective communication and alignment among treatment sites, Treatment Site Leads (TSLs), manufacturers, sequencing providers, pathology laboratories, distributors, alliance stakeholders, and internal teams.

  • Oversee the centralized case management capability, including active patient case coordination, operational escalations, cross-functional stakeholders, and ensuring timely communication and resolution of issues that may impact treatment completion.

  • Establish and manage operational escalation processes, proactively identifying, triaging, escalating, and resolving operational issues that may impact customer experience, treatment completion, or therapy delivery timelines.

  • Drive visibility and transparency across the treatment ecosystem, providing timely status updates, operational communications, and stakeholder coordination throughout the treatment journey.

  • Partner with the Individualized Therapy Operations team, Treatment Site Strategy team, TSL leadership, Patient Support, and IT to identify and resolve operational barriers, improve stakeholder experiences, and drive continuous improvement across the treatment journey.

  • Establish and monitor operational service standards, performance expectations, and response timelines for the TSOC organization to ensure consistent execution and a high-quality treatment site experience.

  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on operational efficiency, treatment site experience, execution consistency, and treatment completion, incorporating customer feedback and operational insights to improve future performance.

Education:

Bachelor's degree or equivalent (BA/BS)

MBA or equivalent preferred

Required Experience and Skills:

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or healthcare industry, including experience supporting treatment operations, patient operations, customer operations, treatment site operations, commercial operations, or other cross-functional operational functions.

  • Experience leading customer-facing operations, patient services, hub services, or customer support organizations, with a strong understanding of customer experience and operational issue resolution.

  • Demonstrated experience coordinating activities across multiple internal teams and external stakeholders in a highly matrixed environment.

  • Proven ability to manage operational escalations, resolve complex issues, and drive alignment across different stakeholder groups.

  • Strong operational execution, organizational, and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

  • Experience establishing operational processes, workflows, service standards, and performance expectations that support consistent execution and customer experience.

  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to effectively communicate across field teams, treatment sites, alliance stakeholders, vendors, and leadership teams.

  • Experience leading and developing high-performing teams while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer focus, and operational excellence.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience supporting the commercialization of complex therapies, including, cell therapy, gene therapy, radioligand therapy, or other highly coordinated treatment models.

  • Experience working directly with treatment sites, hospitals, academic medical centers, community oncology practices, or integrated delivery networks.

  • Experience with treatment journey orchestration platforms, workflow technologies, customer support systems, case management platforms, or operational control towers.

  • You will join a small team currently scaling up. We are passionate about it and we are not trying to hide it.

  • We expect you to bring your experience in implementing best practices to our team such as pair programming, continuous deployment, tech debt management.

  • A key part of our duties is to dedicate time to non-business requirements of the systems we are working on, such as cost, maintainability, scalability, and security.

  • You should have a cost-benefit analysis mindset and use logical reasoning to address the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions.

  • Special interest and high understanding of modern cloud-native software solutions, with special focus on observability, security and performance.

  • Experience building software applications with a combination of Go and C# or can easily adapt to using these languages.

  • Fully and asynchronous remote work within Spain, independence, ownership and flexibility is what you can expect from our mindset.

  • Fair wages for people with attitude above all (60k - 80k negotiable).

  • Evolve in a stimulating and challenging environment.

  • Share and learn with a passionate and diverse team.

  • Work from home budget, choose what you need to create your dream home office, including internet and electricity.

  • Annual learning budget, learn a new programming language or go to a tech conference, if it is important for your career, it is important for us.

  • Fully paid team building activities three or four times a year, somewhere around the world.

Clovr Labs is incorporated in Spain and the team meets regularly in Barcelona. We speak English and Spanish, most of the time at the same time, but we would appreciate it if you could send us the contents of your application in English.

Communications Specialist III (Change & Communication Lead)
Requisition ID: RQ00299
Department: SNB – Business Applications
Location: Fredericton, New Brunswick, Canada
Work Model: Remote (Candidate must reside in Canada)
Engagement Type: Contract
Overview
Service New Brunswick (SNB) is seeking an experienced Communications Specialist III / Change and Communication Lead to support the CAMA Renewal and Valuation Enhancements Solution (CRAVES) Deployment Project.
The successful candidate will play a critical role in planning and executing organizational change management, communications, and stakeholder engagement strategies to support the successful deployment of a modern SaaS-based property assessment system across the province. 00299 - SoW - Flextrack - CCM L…
This role involves working closely with project teams, stakeholders, and government departments to ensure smooth adoption of new systems and processes while minimizing organizational disruption.
Key Responsibilities
Change Management & Strategy
  • Develop and implement a comprehensive change management strategy and communication plan aligned with project objectives.
  • Lead change initiatives across the organization from planning through implementation.
  • Identify potential resistance to change and develop mitigation strategies.
  • Ensure all change management activities align with SNB’s Project and Change Management Framework.
Communications & Stakeholder Engagement
  • Develop and deliver clear and targeted communications to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Prepare materials such as presentations, newsletters, digital brochures, and project updates.
  • Facilitate workshops, consultations, focus groups, and stakeholder meetings.
  • Maintain a stakeholder register and conduct impact assessments for affected groups.
Training & Adoption
  • Design and execute training programs and workshops to support system adoption.
  • Develop training materials and deliver sessions in English and French.
  • Coach internal SNB staff on change management practices to build internal capabilities.
Project Support & Governance
  • Maintain project documentation and collaboration platforms (e.g., SharePoint).
  • Monitor project progress and communicate updates to stakeholders.
  • Track risks related to change management and maintain the risk register.
  • Evaluate adoption metrics and report on performance indicators.

Requirements

Required Qualifications
Education
  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Business Administration, Organizational Change Management, or a related field.
Experience
  • Minimum 6 years of change management experience in multi-year projects.
  • Demonstrated experience in enterprise-level change and communication management in the public sector.
  • Experience supporting large digital transformation initiatives.
  • Experience working with provincial or federal property assessment divisions in transformation projects.
Certifications
  • Prosci Change Management Certification or equivalent professional certification.
Technical Skills
  • Strong experience with Microsoft 365 tools including:
    • Word
    • Excel
    • PowerPoint
    • SharePoint
    • Forms
  • Familiarity with digital collaboration tools such as:
    • Microsoft Teams
    • Zoom
    • Miro
Language Requirement
  • Full professional proficiency in both English and French.
Preferred Experience
  • Experience leading organization-wide change initiatives across multiple large projects.
  • Experience with Tyler Technologies CAMA solutions in government environments.
  • Strong background in stakeholder engagement and communication strategies in large-scale IT transformation programs.
Contract Details
  • Duration: April 1, 2026 – March 31, 2029 (745 days)
  • Extension: Possible extension of up to 250 additional days
  • Work Schedule: Monday – Friday, 8:15 AM – 4:30 PM AST
  • Work Location: Remote (must reside in Canada)
  • Travel: Occasional travel to New Brunswick may be required.

jobs.title: Senior Director - Data Governance Platforms
jobs.excerpt: Are you looking for a role that motivates and challenges you?
jobs.description:
Are you looking for a role that motivates and challenges you? Are you ready for an opportunity for growth? Do you want to work on teams where people roll up their sleeves to take on tough problems together, and regularly blow the doors off our clients with their outstanding teamwork? If you answered yes to those questions, 3Cloud might just be for you!

At 3Cloud, we hire people who aren’t afraid to experiment or fail. We hire people who are willing to give direct and candid feedback to their managers, leaders, and team members. We hire people who jump at those opportunities because they care about our collective growth and success. We hire people who challenge and hold each other accountable for living 3Cloud’s core values because they know that it will result in amazing experiences and solutions for our clients and each other.

The Senior Director - Data Governance Platforms leads 3Cloud’s Data Governance Platforms practice, shaping strategy, growth, market positioning, and performance. This role defines how 3Cloud helps clients create trusted, secure, discoverable, high-quality, and business-ready data foundations for analytics, Microsoft Copilot, and AI agents.

The role is accountable for building a differentiated Microsoft-aligned practice, creating demand, shaping strategic pursuits, developing senior client relationships, and enabling delivery at scale. The successful candidate combines commercial judgment, executive presence, and technical credibility across Microsoft Purview, Fabric and OneLake, Microsoft IQ, Foundry, Microsoft 365, Azure, Copilot Studio, and the broader data and AI ecosystem. This is not a hands-on engineering role, but requires the ability to challenge designs, frame tradeoffs, guide technical leaders, and connect platform choices to business value and risk.

Responsibilities

Practice Leadership and Strategy

  • Own the practice vision, strategy, business plan, portfolio, operating model, investment roadmap, and performance metrics aligned to 3Cloud, Cognizant, Microsoft, and client priorities.
  • Define market positioning, priority buyers, offerings, commercial models, differentiated value proposition, and collaboration boundaries across related data, AI, security, and industry teams.
  • Translate Microsoft’s Frontier direction into a coherent portfolio for trusted data, governance modernization, Fabric and OneLake adoption, Copilot readiness, AI governance, agent control, and enterprise context.
  • Build the leadership bench, reusable IP, partner ecosystem, and delivery capability required to scale the practice profitably.

Go-to-Market and Growth

  • Own go-to-market planning and demand creation with account teams, Microsoft, Cognizant, alliances, marketing, and industry leaders.
  • Develop compelling plays, offers, campaigns, executive narratives, discovery methods, proof-of-value motions, and repeatable sales and solutioning assets.
  • Originate, qualify, and shape strategic opportunities with C-suite and senior data, AI, security, privacy, risk, compliance, and technology stakeholders.
  • Lead executive workshops and pursuit strategy, aligning outcomes, scope, solution direction, funding, commercial approach, delivery model, risks, and next steps.

Executive and Technical Advisory

  • Serve as a trusted advisor, connecting business strategy, regulatory obligations, risk appetite, operating model, architecture, platform choices, and transformation sequencing.
  • Advise on governance across Microsoft Purview, Fabric and OneLake, Microsoft IQ, Foundry, Microsoft 365 and Graph, Copilot Studio, Azure, and heterogeneous enterprise estates.
  • Guide unified governance control planes spanning identity, metadata, cataloging, policy, classification, protection, quality, lineage, observability, evaluation, audit, and runtime enforcement.
  • Advise on trusted business context through metadata, master/reference data, data quality, glossaries, semantic models, ontologies, knowledge graphs, authoritative metrics, and provenance.
  • Guide AI and agent governance across models, copilots, prompts, tools, actions, memory, knowledge sources, identity, permissions, oversight, evaluation, audit, and lifecycle controls.
  • Translate complex technical decisions into clear executive choices, including value, cost, risk, speed, dependencies, operating implications, and consequences of inaction.

Practice Enablement, Delivery, and Innovation

  • Develop leaders and employees, setting expectations for market contribution, advisory quality, technical credibility, delivery excellence, and reusable IP.
  • Own workforce strategy, succession, hiring profiles, certifications, communities of practice, and access to global and partner capabilities.
  • Establish practical solution and delivery governance for architecture assurance, commercial discipline, quality gates, escalation, risk visibility, and benefits realization.
  • Sponsor strategic engagements, coach leaders, resolve material client or solution risks, and convert lessons learned into improved offerings and methods.
  • Maintain a forward-looking view of Microsoft and industry developments, sponsoring incubations and ecosystem partnerships that become repeatable market offerings.

Requirements

  • 15+ years in data, analytics, cloud, security, AI, or enterprise transformation, including senior consulting, professional services, or technology practice leadership.
  • Proven ability to build and scale a consulting practice or major capability, with accountability for strategy, offerings, pipeline, revenue, margin, talent, partnerships, and client outcomes.
  • Demonstrated success originating, qualifying, shaping, and winning complex data and AI transformation opportunities with C-suite and senior executives.
  • Executive-level credibility across data governance, metadata, catalog, lineage, quality, MDM, privacy, security, compliance, data products, semantic context, ontologies, and responsible AI.
  • Ability to advise on Microsoft Purview, Fabric and OneLake, Microsoft IQ, Foundry, Microsoft 365 and Graph, Copilot Studio, Azure data and AI services, Entra, Defender, Sentinel, and relevant partner platforms.
  • Credibility advising on AI and agent governance, including grounding, lifecycle controls, identity, permissions, actions, memory, oversight, evaluation, observability, audit, and incident response.
  • Architecture depth to challenge designs, identify risks, frame platform tradeoffs, guide principal-level specialists, and explain technical choices to executive audiences.
  • Strong commercial judgment across qualification, value engineering, estimation, contracting, staffing, delivery risk, margin, investment decisions, and benefits realization.
  • Exceptional executive presence, facilitation, storytelling, written communication, structured problem solving, and ability to align business and technical stakeholders around action.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience required; advanced degree and relevant Microsoft, governance, security, privacy, cloud, or responsible AI certifications preferred.

Don’t meet every single requirement? At 3Cloud we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.

At this time, we cannot sponsor applicants for work visas.

jobs.description:
Our Client is one of the United States’ largest insurers, providing a wide range of insurance and financial services products with gross written premiums well over US$25 Billion (P&C). They proudly serve more than 10 million U.S. households with more than 19 million individual policies across all 50 states through the efforts of over 48,000 exclusive and independent agents and nearly 18,500 employees. Finally, our Client is part of one the largest Insurance Groups in the world.

About the Role

We are seeking an Operations Analyst to support Workforce Management (WFM) and real-time operations within our contact center environment. This role is responsible for monitoring call volume, agent adherence, and staffing levels to ensure the daily scheduling plan is executed effectively and service level objectives are achieved.

The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where operational decisions must be made quickly. You will work closely with leaders, supervisors, and employees to support day-to-day contact center operations while providing reporting, performance monitoring, and operational insights.

What You’ll Do

  • Monitor real-time contact center performance, including call volume, queue activity, service levels, and agent adherence
  • Manage execution of daily workforce schedules and identify staffing adjustments as business needs change
  • Communicate real-time operational updates and recommendations to leadership teams
  • Monitor performance metrics and notify leadership of operational risks, service level concerns, or staffing challenges
  • Support workforce management activities by tracking adherence, attendance, schedule compliance, and productivity metrics
  • Collect, maintain, and analyze operational data to support performance measurement and reporting
  • Assist in problem resolution and escalate operational issues when appropriate
  • Generate reports and provide business updates to support strategic and operational planning
  • Collaborate with supervisors, managers, and workforce management teams to optimize resource allocation
  • Support continuous improvement efforts by identifying trends and recommending operational enhancements
  • Utilize workforce management and telephony systems to monitor performance and support business objectives
  • Maintain accurate records and ensure data integrity across reporting and workforce management tools

Requirements

  • Experience in contact center operations, workforce management, scheduling, or operational analysis
  • Experience in business analysis, operations support, or performance reporting preferred
  • Experience monitoring service levels, call queues, and workforce adherence in a contact center environment
  • Familiarity with NICE IEX Workforce Management (WFM) systems preferred
  • Familiarity with Cisco ACD or similar contact center telephony platforms preferred
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Experience using Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, for reporting and data analysis
  • Ability to interpret operational metrics and provide actionable recommendations
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities

  4. Flexible work arrangements
  5. Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally renowned group

  8. Meals tickets
  9. Life Insurance

jobs.description:
Sales Partner – RealAdvisor (Mercado Español)

Buscamos vendedores con mentalidad de closer.

RealAdvisor es una de las principales plataformas digitales del ecosistema inmobiliario europeo. Fundada en Suiza, hoy apoyamos a más de 5.000 agencias inmobiliarias y llegamos a más de 10 millones de usuarios cada año en Europa.

Estamos acelerando nuestro crecimiento en el mercado español y buscamos Sales Partners freelance capaces de transformar oportunidades comerciales en clientes.

No es necesario conocer el sector inmobiliario: te formaremos en el producto y en el mercado. Lo que buscamos es una demostrada capacidad de venta y de cierre.

El resultado que buscamos

Nuestro objetivo es construir un equipo de vendedores capaces de alcanzar al menos 15 ventas al mes.

Para los profesionales que alcanzan un alto rendimiento, el plan de comisiones ofrece un potencial de ingresos superior a 20.000 € al mes, en función de los resultados obtenidos.

El principio es simple: cuanto más vendes, más ganas.

Tu rol

Tendrás la responsabilidad de todo el ciclo de venta, desde el primer contacto hasta la firma del contrato. No buscamos personas especializadas exclusivamente en prospecting o en demos. Buscamos full-cycle sales, capaces de gestionar de forma autónoma una negociación de principio a fin.

Tus responsabilidades incluirán:

  • Prospecting outbound y generación autónoma de oportunidades
  • Gestión de leads inbound
  • Gestión de reuniones cualificadas proporcionadas por nuestro equipo de SDR
  • Cualificación de prospects
  • Demos comerciales por videoconferencia
  • Análisis de necesidades del cliente
  • Presentación de la solución y propuesta de valor
  • Gestión de objeciones y negociación
  • Seguimiento estructurado
  • Envío y gestión del contrato
  • Cierre de la venta
  • Gestión completa del pipeline en el CRM

En resumen: del primer contacto a la firma.

Un rol de alta intensidad comercial

Es importante ser claros sobre el ritmo de trabajo requerido.

El rol prevé indicativamente 5 demos al día, generalmente a través de videollamadas de 20 a 40 minutos.

A estas actividades se suman el prospecting, el seguimiento, la negociación y la gestión del pipeline. Parte de las reuniones estará organizada por nuestro equipo de SDR, pero esperamos que el Sales Partner sea capaz de generar nuevas oportunidades por sí mismo.

Requirements

Requisitos (Quién buscamos)

No se requiere experiencia previa en el sector inmobiliario, pero es fundamental tener experiencia concreta en venta B2B/outbound.

Buscamos profesionales que:

  • Tengan experiencia previa en roles comerciales y venta outbound.
  • Sepan realizar demos comerciales efectivas por videollamada.
  • Dominen la gestión de objeciones, la negociación y el cierre de contratos.
  • Estén acostumbrados a trabajar por objetivos y KPIs.
  • Tengan mentalidad emprendedora, autonomía y disciplina.
  • Tengan experiencia en el uso de herramientas CRM.
  • Cuenten con español nativo o fluido (C1/C2).

No buscamos simplemente un comercial: buscamos un closer.

Benefits

Qué ofrecemos

  • Potencial de ingresos de 20.000 €+ al mes para perfiles de alto rendimiento (contamos con compañeros que superan de forma estable los 30.000 €/mes).
  • Plan de comisiones fuertemente orientado a resultados.
  • Reuniones cualificadas facilitadas por el equipo SDR.
  • Formación completa sobre el producto y el sector inmobiliario.
  • Colaboración freelance a largo plazo.
  • Apoyo continuo de un equipo internacional.
  • Mercado español en fuerte expansión.

Tipo de colaboración

  • Modalidad: Freelance / Autónomo (facturación mensual a nuestra sede en Suiza).
  • Dedicación: Al menos 35 horas semanales.
  • Remuneración: Basada en rendimiento y comisiones por venta.

At Oversee, we build practical AI solutions for the $1.6 trillion global travel industry.

For over a decade, we have helped travel agencies and global enterprises cut travel costs and work more efficiently. Our AI-based reshopping products, FareSaver for air and HotelSaver for hotels, track booked trips and automatically rebook them when a better rate becomes available.

AgentSee, our agentic AI platform, works alongside travel agents. It reads traveler requests, handles bookings and changes, and takes on routine servicing tasks, so agents can manage more trips while improving service quality.

We work with the largest travel agencies and fortune 500 companies, supporting over $15B in annual booking volume for more than 11,000 customers in over 60 countries.

If you want to solve real problems with a focused team in a fast-moving market, Oversee is the place to build, grow, and make an impact.

Why join us?

This is the role that owns product marketing at Oversee.

You'll start with products that already work for a defined set of buyers, and your job is to work out who else they are for. That means real market research, sharper ICP definition, and evidence on where we have product-market fit rather than where we assume we do. What you find shapes our GTM strategy, it doesn't just describe it after the fact.

From there you own the message and everything downstream of it: positioning, persona and segment messaging, competitive and win/loss insight, and the language that runs through the website, campaigns, outbound and product surfaces. You'll write the product content that makes a technical capability legible to a commercial buyer, and you'll run launches end to end.

You'll report to the Marketing Director, with direct access to product, sales and the executive team. This is a function to build and own, not a queue of requests to work through.

Come shape the future of travel with us!

What you'll do:

Messaging and positioning

  • Refine and build on our existing positioning and messaging framework;
  • Own ICP, persona and segment messaging per product across corporate, leisure and partnerships;
  • Own product messaging across all markets and verticals;
  • Own the language that feeds every digital activity: website, campaigns, paid and organic, outbound sequences, product surfaces. One source, applied consistently, maintained as products change.

Market and competitive insight

  • Run standing competitive tracking across reshop and agentic AI for travel operations, corporate and leisure;
  • Run win/loss as a standing programme rather than a one-off project;
  • Run buyer research to sharpen segment understanding;
  • Produce market research and evidence on segment fit, with a recommendation attached.

Product content and copy

  • Write product-specific content: product pages, one-pagers, launch material, product-led blog content, and technical explainers;
  • Write and edit campaign copy in partnership with Growth Marketing;
  • Maintain a content cadence and strategy.
  • Onboard new reps on positioning and keep the existing team current as we ship;
  • Sit in on sales calls regularly and close the loop on what is working.

Launches and GTM

  • Build and run a repeatable, tiered launch process end to end, so effort matches materiality;
  • Coordinate cross-functionally so a launch lands as one motion;
  • Run post-launch measurement and retrospectives.

About you:

  • A track record of owning positioning and messaging end to end, including the research behind it, not just executing a framework handed to you;

  • Self-directed. You can take a broad remit, sequence it yourself, and ship without being managed through it;

The business is a fast-growing importer and distributor within the luxury furniture, homewares, and interior design industry, holding exclusive New Zealand distribution rights from an international manufacturing partner. Driven by a decade of established industry relationships and a deep network of commercial and residential interior designers, the company imports premium stock via 40-foot shipping containers and is developing an automated B2B trade portal. Maintains contact with policyholders and injured worker and pursues return to work initiatives.   • Identify opportunities to use automation, artificial intelligence, and modern analytical tools to improve processes and convert filing information into scalable business insights for profitability reviews.

  • Establish strong peer-review and governance practices, resolve process gaps, and promote consistent actuarial standards across portfolios.

  • Translate complex actuarial analysis into clear recommendations for technical and non-technical senior leaders.

  • Represent Nationwide’s position with regulators, auditors, and external partners when needed.

What makes this opportunity distinctive

  • Enterprise impact: Your work will influence filing practices across multiple lines of business and help improve the work lives of dozens of actuarial, finance, and other business stakeholders.

  • Transformation ownership: You will have autonomy and visibility to turn a fragmented, manual process into a more streamlined and scalable capability.

  • Cross-functional influence: Success will depend on building partnerships across actuarial, business, legal, technology, and regulatory teams—not working in a silo.

  • Practical innovation: You do not need to be a hands-on programmer, but you should recognize how tools such as SQL, Excel, Python, R, automation, and AI can accelerate actuarial work and execute on that vision.

  • Leadership growth: This role offers a high-profile opportunity to expand your strategic leadership scope, develop others, and shape future-state operating models.

Who will thrive here

We are looking for a change-oriented, solutions-focused actuary who understands insurance filings and has been motivated to make the process better. The strongest candidates will bring:

  • Deep experience with P&C actuarial work, insurance rate filings, or related regulatory processes; commercial lines or personal lines experience may be relevant.

  • An actuarial credential required for filing signatory responsibilities, generally an FCAS or equivalent qualification.

  • The ability to connect actuarial judgment, regulatory requirements, data, technology, and business strategy.

  • A track record of leading through ambiguity, influencing without relying solely on authority, and moving complex work from concept to delivery.

  • A constructive sense of urgency and resilience to improve processes that have developed over time.

Work model and location

This position may be performed in a in office, hybrid or fully remote, consistent with Nationwide’s practices.

Job Description Summary

Our Property and Casualty (P&C) Actuarial team members have opportunities to use state-of-the-art tools, are encouraged to innovate and learn to master actuarial methodologies. If this sounds like a place you could thrive, then we want to know more about you!

As a Senior Actuary, you’ll be an expert and will provide leadership direction and oversight for the creation and performance of complex actuarial techniques and procedures and risk analysis. You’ll manage research and direct others to ensure efficient, consistent and integrated data and analysis. We’ll count on you to provide a strategic vision for the team and deliver business recommendations that are crucial to the success of Nationwide and the protection we provide our customers. You’ll work independently and may lead others (directly and/or indirectly).

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Acts as technical expert of actuarial methodologies allowing the ability to source and manipulate data within standard requirements. Identifies new ways to utilize data driving overall strategic vision.

  • Conducts complex analyses adhering to actuarial standards by selecting appropriate data sources, making assumptions, recognizing considerations, and developing recommendations. Accountable for resolving unreasonable results/non-optimal solutions using experience and professional judgment. Analysis conducted will be used to influence broad strategic vison of Nationwide.

  • Accurately documents assumptions, methods, sources and considerations in an organized fashion.

  • Creates cohesive presentations and recommendations of actuarial findings that are suitable for technical and non-technical audiences at the OCFO leadership level. May professionally represent company's position with regulators, auditors and external vendors. May negotiate within defined parameters.

  • Responsible for strategic development and oversite of multiple work plans ensuring accurate and timely delivery of product.

  • Strategic leader of peer review process. Responsible for driving collaboration cross functionally, identifies gaps in process, recommends and implements changes as needed to ensure quality work.

  • Builds strategic business relationships at all levels of the organization to drive solution delivery

  • Responsible for identifying skill gaps and developing training materials to develop associates skills for future business needs.

  • Advises on strategic data mining techniques used to identify new relationships in data. Makes recommendations on data and software packages that help drive strategic vision of P&C actuarial and business success. Has expert knowledge of modeling, predictive modeling, and software applications.

  • Consults and provides expert advice on new or enhanced product development opportunities, including discussions on data needed for analysis, coding implications and opinions of the viability and profitability of proposals.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

License/Certification/Designation: Actuarial designation required, generally as an FCAS. PLEASE REFER TO THE NATIONWIDE PROPERTY AND CASUALTY ACTUARIAL DEVELOPMENT PROGRAM FOR ADDITIONAL INFORMATION.

Knowledge, Abilities and Skills: Expert knowledge of actuarial business functions, statistical methods of analysis, actuarial models, actuarial software and databases; expert knowledge of company operations, products, systems and actuarial methodologies; expert knowledge of company, industry, and regulatory practices. Mastery of Microsoft Office products, analytical software, and programming languages. Proficient level of organizational agility and conflict management. Proficient level of command skills, strategic agility, delegation, motivating others, business perspective and accounting. Mastery level of perspective, problem solving, customer focus, dealing with ambiguity, drive for results, analysis, learning perspective, problem solving, customer focus, dealing with ambiguity, drive for results, analysis, learning.

26WD101063,Director, Product Management, Platform Trust

Position Overview

This role is accountable for defining what trusted capabilities Autodesk customers need and why they matter, partnering with product and platform organizations that determine how those capabilities are delivered. We are seeking an experienced Director of Product Management to lead the product strategy for Trusted experiences across Autodesk's platform ecosystem. Trust is foundational to every customer experience and every AI-powered workflow we deliver. This role will define the vision, strategy, and priorities for the trust capabilities customers expect and partner with product and platform teams to ensure these capabilities are delivered consistently across Autodesk products. Reporting to the Chief Trust Officer you will partner across Autodesk to influence platform investments and product strategy. You will translate evolving customer expectations, regulatory requirements, and competitive trends into platform investments that strengthen Autodesk's differentiation. This is a highly collaborative, cross-functional leadership role requiring exceptional influence, strategic thinking, and execution across a global organization.


We are open to remote candidates based in the United States and Canada.


Responsibilities

26WD101063,Directeur de la gestion des produits, Confiance dans la plateforme


Aperçu du poste

Le titulaire de ce poste est chargé de définir les fonctionnalités fiables dont les clients d'Autodesk ont besoin et d'expliquer leur importance, en collaboration avec les équipes chargées des produits et des plateformes qui déterminent la manière dont ces fonctionnalités sont mises en œuvre. Nous recherchons un directeur de la gestion des produits expérimenté pour diriger la stratégie produit relative aux expériences de confiance au sein de l’écosystème de plateformes d’Autodesk. La confiance est le fondement de chaque expérience client et de chaque flux de travail basé sur l’IA que nous proposons. Le titulaire de ce poste définira la vision, la stratégie et les priorités concernant les fonctionnalités de confiance attendues par les clients et travaillera en partenariat avec les équipes chargées des produits et des plateformes afin de garantir que ces fonctionnalités soient mises en œuvre de manière cohérente dans l’ensemble des produits Autodesk. Sous la responsabilité du directeur de la confiance (Chief Trust Officer), vous travaillerez en collaboration avec l’ensemble d’Autodesk pour orienter les investissements dans les plateformes et la stratégie produit. Vous traduirez l’évolution des attentes des clients, des exigences réglementaires et des tendances concurrentielles en investissements dans les plateformes qui renforceront la différenciation d’Autodesk. Il s’agit d’un poste de direction hautement collaboratif et transversal, exigeant une influence exceptionnelle, une réflexion stratégique et une capacité d’exécution au sein d’une organisation mondiale.


Nous sommes ouverts aux candidatures à distance provenant des États-Unis et du Canada.


Responsabilités

  • Définir la vision et la stratégie produit à long terme pour les fonctionnalités de confiance et d’IA de confiance au sein de l’écosystème de plateformes d’Autodesk
  • Collaborer avec les chefs de produit des plateformes et les responsables de l’ingénierie afin de hiérarchiser les fonctionnalités de confiance destinées aux clients, pouvant être exploitées de manière cohérente dans l’ensemble des produits Autodesk
  • Élaborer des analyses de rentabilité et des stratégies produit fondées sur les études clients, les tendances du marché, l’analyse de la concurrence, l’innovation technologique et l’évolution des exigences réglementaires
  • Assurer la coordination entre les équipes Produit, Ingénierie, Sécurité, Confidentialité, Juridique, Conformité, Réussite client et la direction générale concernant les priorités en matière de confiance et les investissements dans la feuille de route
  • Évaluer en permanence l’évolution du paysage de la sécurité, de la confidentialité, de la résilience et de l’IA afin d’identifier les opportunités stratégiques et les besoins émergents des clients
  • Représenter la stratégie de confiance d’Autodesk auprès des clients professionnels, des partenaires stratégiques et des forums sectoriels

Qualifications minimales

  • Plus de 10 ans d’expérience en gestion de produit ou en gestion de produit de plateforme, y compris la définition d’une stratégie de plateforme couvrant plusieurs produits
  • Expérience dans l’orientation de la stratégie produit au sein de grandes organisations matricielles sans responsabilité directe sur les équipes d’ingénierie
  • Solide compréhension des attentes des clients d’entreprise en matière de sécurité, de confidentialité, de résilience et de confiance dans l’IA
  • Capacité avérée à influencer les parties prenantes de la direction et à favoriser l’alignement entre les organisations techniques et commerciales
  • Grande capacité à concilier les besoins des clients, les priorités commerciales, la complexité technique et les considérations réglementaires
  • Expérience dans l’élaboration de stratégies produit fondées sur les insights clients, l’analyse concurrentielle et les données
  • Excellentes compétences en communication et en narration, avec la capacité de traduire des concepts techniques complexes en stratégies commerciales convaincantes
  • Solides compétences en analyse et en réflexion stratégique, avec une expérience dans la définition d’indicateurs de réussite et la mesure des résultats des produits
  • Expérience dans la présentation de stratégies à la direction et dans l’interaction directe avec les clients professionnels
  • Expérience de travail efficace au sein d’équipes réparties à l’échelle mondiale

Qualifications souhaitées

  • Expérience dans le développement de produits de plateforme pour des plateformes SaaS ou cloud d’entreprise
  • Connaissance des architectures de sécurité modernes, des infrastructures cloud, des systèmes d’identité, de l’ingénierie de la confidentialité ou des cadres de gouvernance de l’IA
  • Expérience de l’utilisation des fonctionnalités des plateformes d’IA/ML et des pratiques d’IA responsable
  • Connaissance des normes sectorielles en matière de sécurité et de confidentialité, telles que ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST CSF, RGPD, CCPA ou des cadres similaires

    • Familiarity with AI-assisted test case generation and coverage analysis
    • Understanding of how to test AI-driven features (prompt testing, hallucination detection, cost optimizations, response validation)

jobs.excerpt: Facet was founded in 2016 on the belief that objective, personalized financial advice is essential to living well.
jobs.description:
Facet was founded in 2016 on the belief that objective, personalized financial advice is essential to living well. Our mission is to empower people to live more enriched lives by delivering a new standard of advice. By removing asset minimums, we provide holistic planning that goes far beyond investments to address every way money impacts life. Our team of CFP® professionals are at the core of our service and are empowered by our best-in-class support teams and proprietary technology platform. This model allows Facet to integrate advice into our members’ entire financial picture—all for an affordable, flat membership fee.

Our commitment to innovation and member success has earned national recognition, including being ranked the #1 Best Financial Advisory Firm 2025 by USA TODAY and named to Newsweek’s list of America’s Top Financial Advisory Firms 2025. With an A+ BBB Rating and a Trustpilot “Excellent” score (as of Sept. 16, 2025)*, we are proud to be redefining the industry for our members and our team alike.

About The Role

As a Taxation Specialist, you will serve as a high-touch, member-facing tax strategist for Facet members. In this consultative role, you will be directly on the frontline: meeting one-on-one with members, promptly answering their day-to-day tax questions, demystifying complex tax rules, and translating tax planning into practical, tangible financial wins.

Partnering closely with our CFP® Lead Planners, you will apply Facet's established tax planning philosophy and methodologies to individual member scenarios, empowering members to make confident, tax-optimized life decisions. This is an advisory-only role focused on delivering strategic planning and member education in alignment with firm standards: no tax return preparation or compliance filing is required.

Your Day-To-Day Responsibilities

  • Direct Member Consultations: Lead 10-15 virtual member strategy sessions per week, presenting tailored tax recommendations, answering complex tax questions in real time, and guiding members through key financial decisions.
  • Everyday Member Tax Q&A: Act as the primary tax sounding board for members by promptly answering their inbound questions about personal taxes, withholdings, life-event tax impacts, and IRS notices via our messaging platform, translating technical concepts into clear, reassuring, plain-English guidance.
  • Proactive Tax Plan Reviews: Review member profiles to build current-year liability projections and diagnose tax optimization opportunities (such as Roth conversions, equity vesting events, and real estate transactions) in close alignment with their Planner.
  • Custom Projections & Modeling: Model and present customized scenarios (including multi-year bracket management, withholding adjustments, and estimated tax payment strategies) directly to members.
  • Tax Research & Technical Analysis: Research complex federal and multi-state tax scenarios to architect practical, compliant planning strategies tailored to diverse household situations.
  • Strategic Collaboration with Financial Planners: Coordinate closely with the Director of Specialized Advice and Lead Planners to integrate tax strategies seamlessly into the Facet Way of holistic financial planning.

Commonly Advised Strategies & Domains

  • Roth Conversion Planning: Evaluating complex returns and income streams to identify multi-year conversion opportunities; assessing downstream impacts on IRMAA brackets, ACA subsidies, and Social Security taxation.
  • Charitable Giving Optimization: Structuring high-impact giving strategies, including Donor-Advised Funds (DAFs), Qualified Charitable Distributions (QCDs), and appreciated asset gifting.
  • Real Estate & Rental Assets: Advising on cost recovery/depreciation, Passive Activity Loss (PAL) limitations, short-term rental rules, and Section 1031 exchanges.
  • Equity Compensation: Navigating the tax implications of incentive stock options (ISOs), non-qualified stock options (NSOs), restricted stock units (RSUs), and ESPPs, including Alternative Minimum Tax (AMT) planning.
  • Small Business & Entity Structure: Providing consultative guidance on entity tax classification (Sole Prop, S-Corp, LLC), pass-through deductions (QBI), and the tax implications of business transitions or liquidity events.

Requirements

  • Active Credential: Active Certified Public Accountant (CPA) license.
  • Experience: 5-7+ years of professional experience specializing in personal tax planning, private client advisory, or high-net-worth tax consulting.
  • Member-Facing Excellence: Proven track record of conducting direct client consultations (e.g., managing an active meeting cadence of 10-15 client meetings weekly) with strong empathy, active listening, and the ability to explain complex concepts in plain language.
  • Diagnostic & Modeling Skills: Exceptional ability to analyze Form 1040s and supporting schedules to rapidly identify planning levers, missed deductions, and tax risks.
  • Technical Breadth: Deep knowledge of federal and state individual tax codes, equity compensation, retirement distribution planning, and pass-through taxation.
  • Fiduciary Mindset: A strong commitment to putting members first, personal integrity, and delivering objective financial advice.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Certified Financial Planner (CFP®) designation or active pursuit of the credential is a strong plus.
  • Prior experience delivering tax advice within an RIA, fee-only financial planning practice, or wealth management firm partnering directly with CFP® practitioners.
  • Exceptional video presence and written communication skills, with comfort managing multiple client cases simultaneously in a modern, tech-enabled environment.
  • High proficiency with modern tech tools, tax modeling software (such as Holistiplan, BNA, or Corvee), and CRM/workflow systems.

Benefits

  • $110,000 – $150,000 base salary: Determined by experience, knowledge, and skills.
  • Equity (ISO): It is important to us that all employees are shareholders in our mission.
  • Flexible PTO
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with employer match, short/long-term disability (paid by Facet), life insurance, and paid parental leave.
  • Certification and wellness reimbursement programs
  • Work from anywhere in the US

*Facet was ranked #1 Best Financial Advisory Firm 2025 by USA TODAY in April 2025 who partnered with Statista to rank the top 500 RIAs. Recommendations were collected via an independent survey among over 30,000 individuals. Self-recommendations were prohibited, and no compensation was provided for the ranking. Facet has been Accredited with the Better Business Bureau® since June 2025, and as of February 2026 holds an A+ BBB Rating. This Accreditation does not imply BBB approval or endorsement. Plant-A Insights Group and Newsweek partnered to identify America's Top Financial Advisory Firms 2025. This analysis was performed with data as of September 2024 and reviewed over 15,000 financial advisories registered with the SEC. These rankings prepared by Plant-A reflect editorial content and no compensation was provided by Facet in connection with America's Top Financial Advisory Firms 2025. As of February 25, 2026; Facet has a 4.8 star rating with TrustPilot.com. TrustPilot uses a formula for calculation that considers three factors: time span, frequency, and Bayesian average. After the calculation, a TrustScore is then visualized into a star rating from 1 to 5 stars, including half stars. Facet’s star rating is calculated from reviews from January of 2022 to present day. Daily star rating may fluctuate. Companies on Trustpilot aren't allowed to offer incentives or pay to hide reviews and Facet has not made any payments in offer or receipt of any reviews.

jobs.description:
Fully remote | Working directly with the CEO | Monthly compensation in USD

About Us

We are a startup where priorities can change quickly, processes are still developing and several important initiatives often run in parallel. We are looking for someone who enjoys this environment and can bring structure, calm and reliable execution to a busy working day. Our work spans HR, finance, IT and marketing, with AI playing a practical role in how we organise information, coordinate work and improve processes.

Job Description

As Executive Assistant to the CEO, you will be a trusted right hand who turns priorities into clear actions and follows them through to completion. You will anticipate needs, organise competing demands, coordinate people and maintain a reliable overview of what requires attention across the business.

Inbox and calendar management form part of the role, alongside broader responsibility for organising projects, improving workflows, preparing decisions and keeping commitments on track.

You should bring practical experience using AI to accomplish meaningful work. This includes creating and using reusable AI skills: structured instructions, relevant context and tools that help an AI assistant perform recurring tasks consistently. You should be comfortable adapting these workflows, checking their outputs and recognising when human judgement or specialist input is needed.

You should be comfortable with the pace, uncertainty and pressure that can come with building a startup. This means adapting when plans change, handling competing requests and maintaining sound judgement under time pressure. You will help the CEO and team set realistic priorities, make trade-offs and identify when workload or deadlines need to be adjusted.

Key Responsibilities

  • Translate the CEO's priorities into actionable plans with clear owners, deadlines and follow-up.
  • Maintain an overview of ongoing initiatives, identify dependencies and flag delays or decisions early.
  • Coordinate work across the startup team, external partners and service providers.
  • Prepare concise research, meeting briefs, comparisons and recommendations that support decisions.
  • Organise meetings, correspondence and schedules, capturing decisions and ensuring agreed actions are completed.
  • Support HR operations through recruitment coordination, onboarding, documentation and follow-up.
  • Support finance operations by organising invoices, expenses, payment schedules and information needed by accounting specialists.
  • Support marketing initiatives by organising briefs, assets, deadlines and collaboration with internal and external contributors.
  • Coordinate IT requests, access requirements, software subscriptions and communication with technical colleagues.
  • Organise and improve how the CEO and startup team use Microsoft 365, keeping communication, documents, tasks and shared information structured and accessible.
  • Connect Microsoft tools with suitable AI skills and workflows, respecting permissions and confidentiality.
  • Create, adapt and maintain AI skills and repeatable workflows for research, reporting, documentation and operational coordination.
  • Check AI-generated work for accuracy, relevance and completeness before it is used.
  • Keep business information organised and handle confidential matters with discretion.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience in executive assistance, business operations, project coordination or a comparable role involving substantial ownership.
  • A working understanding of HR, finance, IT and marketing, sufficient to coordinate tasks, ask informed questions and recognise when specialist expertise is required.
  • Strong practical experience with Microsoft 365, particularly Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to organise collaboration across these tools, including shared documents, structured information, task tracking and access coordination.
  • Confidence using Excel to maintain operational overviews, reconcile information and prepare clear reports.
  • Practical experience creating or configuring reusable AI skills and applying them to real work.
  • Ability to explain a workflow you personally implemented, including how you checked its results and handled its limitations.
  • Strong prioritisation and follow-through, including the ability to manage several workstreams without constant reminders.
  • Clear written and verbal communication in English.
  • Confidence working with spreadsheets, documents, shared knowledge systems and task management tools.
  • Sound judgement about confidentiality, access permissions and the information shared with AI tools.
  • Willingness to take responsibility, resolve routine issues independently and escalate significant risks promptly.
  • Resilience and adaptability in a startup environment, including changing priorities, incomplete information and periods of high workload.
  • Ability to remain calm, communicate clearly and maintain quality under pressure.
  • A practical approach to solving problems and taking ownership when established processes or clear instructions are not yet available.
  • Confidence raising capacity constraints early, proposing realistic alternatives and clarifying which tasks take priority.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Working directly with a founder or supporting a small startup team.
  • Improving processes that span several business functions.
  • Using AI agents, tool integrations or automation platforms to reduce repetitive work.
  • Hands-on experience with Power Automate, Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio to build useful automations and AI assistants.
  • Building reusable procedures and shared knowledge that other team members can use.
  • Coordinating recruitment, financial administration, suppliers or marketing delivery.

What We Offer

  • Close collaboration with the CEO and visibility across the startup.
  • Meaningful ownership of operational work and process improvements.
  • A broad role combining executive support, team coordination and practical AI use.
  • A fully remote working arrangement.
  • Monthly compensation in USD.

Remote Working Arrangement

You will work remotely and maintain clear visibility of priorities, progress and blockers. Reliable communication, organised documentation and consistent follow-through are essential. Working hours and required availability will be agreed during the hiring process.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and describe relevant examples of work you have personally delivered. Include an AI skill or workflow you created or substantially adapted, the business task it supported, and how you ensured the result was useful and reliable. An example of coordinating work across different business functions would also be helpful.

jobs.description:
YOUR POSITION WITH TNC

The Director of Finance & Operations, Europe serves as the region’s senior finance leader and operations integrator—the regional equivalent of a CFO with broader operations integration responsibilities. The role is a trusted partner to the Regional Managing Director, Europe and operates within a global matrix, with accountability to Global Finance for financial stewardship, standards, and alignment, and to the Regional Managing Director for regional strategy execution and organizational effectiveness.

In this role, the Director partners closely with both the Senior Director of Finance & Operations, Global Regions and the Regional Managing Director, Europe to support regional leadership, drive key priorities, and ensure effective execution across the Europe region. The role has broad Finance & Operations responsibility across a region that operates in multiple countries, while combining strategic oversight with practical hands-on leadership appropriate to the size, structure, and complexity of the region.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Reporting to the Senior Director of Finance & Operations, Global Regions, with a dotted-line relationship to the Regional Managing Director, Europe, the Director serves on the Europe Leadership Team, leads the regional Finance & Operations team, and provides leadership and coordination across countries, programs, and enabling functions. The role also serves as Managing Director of the related entity through which TNC operates in Germany, with responsibility for its effective management and governance. The Director helps shape and execute regional priorities while contributing Europe perspectives and learning to TNC-wide Finance & Operations initiatives.

RESPONSIBILITIES & SCOPE

Strategic Finance Leadership

  • Leads regional financial stewardship across Europe, including strategy, planning, forecasting, performance management, and long-term financial sustainability.
  • Serves as a senior financial advisor to the Regional Managing Director, Europe and senior regional leaders, providing forward-looking, integrated financial insight to inform strategic and operational decisions.
  • Leads regional budgeting, forecasting, and multi-year planning processes, ensuring rigor, consistency, and alignment with regional priorities and enterprise standards.
  • Establishes and reinforces financial discipline, resource optimization, and stewardship across the region.
  • Maintains forward-looking visibility into financial risks, funding pressures, and sustainability concerns, ensuring timely mitigation and escalation.
  • Ensures compliance with global finance policies, controls, reporting requirements, and audit standards, partnering with global finance leaders as required.
  • Contributes actively to the Global Regions Finance & Operations leadership team by sharing learning, advancing common approaches, and clearly articulating where regional differences or exceptions are necessary.

Regional Operations and Organizational Effectiveness

  • Acts as the regional operations integrator, providing senior-level oversight and coordination across support functions operating within the Europe region.
  • Establishes and manages the regional operating cadence for planning, prioritization, decision-making, execution tracking, and performance review, supported by clear accountability and governance mechanisms.
  • Drives organizational effectiveness and execution discipline by translating regional priorities into coherent plans, proactively identifying gaps in ownership, process, capacity, capability, or decision-making, and coordinating action to address them.
  • Contributes to regional capacity planning and resource allocation discussions, helping ensure trade-offs are made transparently and aligned to strategy.
  • Champions continuous improvement and operational excellence, embedding scalable, repeatable ways of working appropriate to the region’s size and structure.

Executive Partnership and Strategic Execution

  • Acts as a trusted strategic and operational partner to the Regional Managing Director, Europe, helping translate strategic intent into integrated operational and financial execution.
  • Supports leadership alignment and decision-making by synthesizing complex information into clear analysis, options, trade-offs, recommendations, and decisions needed rather than only identifying issues.
  • Coordinates and tracks strategic initiatives, ensuring progress, risks, and dependencies are actively managed and escalated.
  • Leads or contributes to enterprise Finance & Operations initiatives within the region, supporting effective implementation of global priorities.

Cross-Functional Integration and Matrix Leadership

  • Leads regional alignment of enabling functions operating within a global matrix, ensuring cohesive delivery in support of Europe priorities.
  • Influences outcomes without direct authority by building strong relationships, clarifying expectations, resolving competing priorities, and enabling transparent trade-off decisions.
  • Partners with global and regional functional leaders to adapt enterprise standards and operating models to regional context while maintaining consistency and compliance.
  • Clarifies ownership, decision rights, dependencies, timing, and escalation paths across functions and ensures material regional issues move toward resolution, while respecting the authority of functional leaders.

Governance, Risk and Compliance

  • Oversees regional governance frameworks spanning financial, operational, compliance, legal, safety, and reputational risk.
  • Serves as Managing Director of the related entity through which TNC operates in Germany, fulfilling applicable governance, fiduciary, statutory, and organizational responsibilities in coordination with regional and global leadership.
  • Ensures effective controls, escalation mechanisms, and assurance processes are in place and operating as intended.
  • Ensures critical finance, operational, banking, compliance, and entity responsibilities have clear ownership, appropriate delegation, documented processes, and continuity coverage.
  • Oversees regional risk identification, mitigation, and reporting, ensuring material issues are elevated to appropriate leadership and governance bodies.
  • Promotes a culture of accountability, integrity, and stewardship, setting expectations for ethical and responsible management across the region.

Leadership and Stakeholder Management

  • Serves as a senior leader on key regional leadership and governance forums.
  • Builds and maintains trusted relationships with global, regional, and business unit leaders, enabling effective collaboration across a complex stakeholder landscape.
  • Leads and develops a multidisciplinary team by setting clear expectations, managing performance, delegating effectively, building leadership capability, and ensuring succession and backup coverage for critical responsibilities.
  • Represents the region and organization externally, including with donors, partners, and stakeholders, as required and in coordination with regional leadership.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree and 9 years related experience or equivalent combination, including 3 years managing operations functions and experience working at a senior level;
  • Experience managing the finances of a complex organization, business unit, region, or major program, including financial planning, forecasting, performance management, controls, and long-term financial sustainability;
  • Experience preparing, interpreting, and presenting financial and operational analyses, forecasts, and management reports to support senior leadership decisions;
  • Experience leading budgeting, forecasting, multi-year planning, resource allocation, and financial performance processes for a significant and complex portfolio;
  • Experience conceiving, developing, and managing multiple complex projects or strategic initiatives, including coordinating plans, tracking progress, and addressing risks and dependencies;
  • Management experience leading and developing multidisciplinary teams, including setting direction, managing performance, delegating significant responsibilities, building leadership capability, and establishing succession or backup coverage;
  • Experience working in a complex, matrixed, and geographically dispersed organization and influencing outcomes across functions and reporting lines;
  • Experience supporting financial and operational governance, risk management, compliance, internal controls, and escalation processes;
  • Experience supporting finance and operations across multiple countries, including working with differing statutory, tax, regulatory, audit, donor, and financial reporting requirements;
  • Experience managing or providing senior oversight of a related legal entity, including governance, fiduciary, statutory, compliance, and reporting responsibilities;
  • Professional proficiency in both German and English, with the ability to communicate effectively in business, governance, and stakeholder settings;
  • Experience building effective relationships with senior leaders and diverse internal and external stakeholders, communicating complex issues clearly, and providing practical counsel and recommendations;
  • Experience coordinating finance and operations across multiple functions or business areas and improving processes, systems, and ways of working;
  • Demonstrated experience exercising sound judgment and discretion in handling confidential and sensitive matters.

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Multi-lingual skills and multi-cultural or cross-cultural experiences are appreciated;
  • Advanced understanding of best practices in non-profit management;
  • Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex information and communicate it clearly through written materials, presentations, and senior-level discussions;
  • Expert knowledge of current and evolving trends in relevant discipline;
  • Proficiency in working independently as well as jointly with colleagues on a team;
  • Relevant accounting or finance degree and professional qualification, such as CPA, ACCA, CA, or equivalent; and/or
  • Knowledge of IFRS or other locally applicable accounting frameworks, nonprofit accounting, donor financial requirements, and statutory reporting;
  • Experience providing support in HR processes.

Who We Are:

The Nature Conservancy’s mission is to protect the lands and waters upon which all life depends. As a science-based organization, we create innovative, on-the-ground solutions to our world’s toughest challenges so that we can create a world in which people and nature thrive. We’re rooted in our mission and guided by our values, which include respect for all people, communities, and cultures. Whether it’s career development, flexible schedules, or a rewarding mission, there’s many reasons to love life inside TNC. Want a better insight to TNC? Check out our TNC Talent playlist on YouTube to hear stories from staff or visit Glassdoor.

One goal is to cultivate an inclusive work environment so that all our colleagues around the globe feel a sense of belonging and that their unique contributions to our mission are valued. In addition to the requirements in our job postings, we recognize that people come with talent and experiences outside of a job and consider each applicant’s unique experience. Please apply – we’d love to hear from you. To quote a popular saying at TNC, “you’ll join for the mission, and stay for the people.”

What We Bring:

Since 1951, TNC has been doing work you can believe in. Through grassroots action, we have grown from a small non-profit into one of the most effective and wide-reaching environmental organizations in the world. Thanks to more than 1 million members, over 400 scientists, and the dedicated efforts of our diverse staff and partners, we impact conservation around the world!

TNC offers competitive and comprehensive benefits packages tailored to the individual countries where we work. These may include health care benefits, retirement benefits, parental leave, paid time off, life insurance, and disability coverage as well as an employee assistance program and other life and well-being benefits. Learn more about our Benefits and Perks here.

We’re proud to offer a flexible work environment that supports the health and well-being of the people we employ.

Our recruiting process includes a rolling interview process to ensure we engage applicants in a timely manner. This means we may review applications in the order in which they are received. Once a strong candidate pool is identified, the role will be unposted. The timeline may vary depending on the expressed interest in the role, so we highly encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

Employees must submit their application by logging into Workday and applying via the Jobs Hub.

The Nature Conservancy is an Equal Opportunity Employer.Our commitment to equal employment opportunity includes the recognition that our conservation mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people of all backgrounds, beliefs, and culture. Recruiting and mentoring staff to create an inclusive organization is a priority, and we encourage applicants from all cultures, races, colors, religions, sexes, national or regional origins, ages, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, military, protected veteran status or other status protected by law.

The successful applicant must meet the requirements of The Nature Conservancy's background screening process.
