jobs.description:
Department:Cohort Implementation and Operations Manager

Location: Home based, UK (with occasional travel to our London office)

Reports to: Operations Performance Manager

Hours: 37.5 per week

Salary: (Depending on experience)

A quick note before you apply: This role is strictly UK-based and must be performed entirely within the United Kingdom; we do not employ remote staff overseas, nor do we offer relocation support. Candidates must have the legal right to work in the UK prior to commencing employment. While we hold a sponsor licence, visa sponsorship is only considered in exceptional circumstances and is not available as standard for this vacancy


Role Overview

As Cohort Implementation and Operations Manager, you will lead the team that turns every signed Funded Learning agreement into a cohort that launches on time and runs smoothly to completion.

Cambridge Spark delivers AI and data apprenticeships to large employers and public sector organisations, who expect the onboarding experience of an enterprise service: one clear plan, one point of coordination, and a launch that runs to schedule.

Your Cohort Implementation Leads manage each client's implementation from handover to kick off. Your Scheduling Lead maintains the calendar of cohort slots that Leads book into. Your Operations Coordinators provide support to live cohorts. You own how these fit together, and you are the senior point of contact for Sales and Delivery on onboarding and live cohort operations.


Key Responsibilities

1. Connect Sales and Operations

  • Make sure every agreed deal is handed from Sales to a Cohort Implementation Lead promptly, with the information they need, and own the handover standard with Sales.
  • Be Sales' senior point of contact for onboarding: timelines, readiness and changes.
  • Agree with Sales and other teams what information is needed for each new client, and when.
  • Lead the handover into delivery, so delivery teams start with a full picture of the client and their goals.
2. Oversee client implementation
  • Allocate new clients across the Cohort Implementation Leads and balance their workload.
  • Set the standard implementation plan that each Lead runs, from programme set-up and slot booking to kick off.
  • Scope requests to tailor programmes to a client's context or tools, and agree realistic timelines with Product and Curriculum.
  • Make sure tools discovery with our Senior Trainers is built into every implementation plan.
  • Confirm each cohort is ready to launch, and agree the way forward with Sales when plans change.
  • Lead complex or strategic client implementations yourself.

3. Plan scheduling and capacity
  • Oversee the cohort calendar: the Scheduling Lead publishes slots for open and client-specific cohorts, and Leads book each new client's cohorts into them.
  • Make sure the supply of cohort slots keeps pace with the sales forecast, opening more slots as the forecast and trainer headcount change.
  • Work with Training and Delivery leads to ensure there is clear visibility on trainer capacity vs sales forecast.
  • Give Sales a clear view of upcoming capacity to support their planning with clients.


4. Lead ongoing cohort management

  • Lead the Operations Coordinators in keeping all live sessions, trainer allocations and learner support on track from kick off to completion.
  • Make sure changes to live cohorts, such as trainer absence or rescheduled sessions, are handled quickly, with minimal disruption to learners and clear communication to clients, learners and Delivery.
  • Monitor recurring operational issues across live cohorts and fix the underlying process, not just the individual case.


5. Lead and develop the team

  • Line manage a team of six (the Scheduling Lead, three Cohort Implementation Leads and two Operations Coordinators), setting clear roles, priorities and objectives.
  • Balance work across many concurrent cohorts, including at peak times.
  • Build a team known across the business for being responsive, organised and easy to work with.​​​​​​​

6. Improve how we work
  • Track every new cohort through onboarding, and report progress and risks to Funded Learning leadership.
  • Keep onboarding processes clear, documented and current.
  • Use automation and AI tools to streamline scheduling and set-up.



Candidate Specification

Essential

  • Experience leading a team of project or implementation managers across a large portfolio of concurrent B2B client implementations.
  • A track record of building or improving an operational process, with the results to show for it.
  • Confidence working with commercial colleagues and clients: setting realistic expectations and finding a way forward when plans change.
  • Strong working knowledge of a CRM (HubSpot preferred) and of tracking work in tools such as Notion.
  • An appetite for automating manual work, including with AI tools.

Desirable
  • Implementation or client onboarding experience at an EdTech, online learning or executive education provider.
  • Knowledge of UK apprenticeship delivery and funding rules.
  • Experience scheduling shared delivery resources such as trainers or facilitators.

Company Benefits:

  • Pension with 4% matched contributions, opportunity to opt into salary sacrifice scheme
  • 25 days holiday + Flexi bank holidays + 1 day off on your birthday
  • A day for volunteering
  • Enhanced Maternity and Paternity Leave
  • Health & Wellbeing allowance of up to £30 per month
  • Annual Summer and Xmas events
  • Company socials including everything from Cambridge College formals, pub nights to team building events
  • CPD Allowance alongside quarterly reflections to ring fence time for development and growth
  • Private medical insurance and cash plan
  • Holiday buy back scheme (up to 10 days p/a)
  • Employee Assistance Programme with a dedicated company counsellor


Background to our Organisation

We are an education technology company that enables corporate and government organisations to achieve their business goals by educating their workforce with critical digital transformation skills to succeed in the AI era.

We deliver unique and innovative professional education that is accelerating the digital transformation of our clients, advancing the careers of their employees, helping people get into work and closing the digital skills gap. We are in a sector that is crucial to the economy and workforce, with a lot of opportunity for change and innovation. We are at the cutting edge of teaching applied data and digital skills, with our unique patented learning platform EDUKATE.AI offering our clients and learners a unique learning experience. EDUKATE.AI was developed with support from Innovate UK and provides all of our learners with 24/7 immediate feedback on their work, helping accelerate the learning process and providing a sandbox environment to experiment on real world datasets.

Since 2016, we have supported more than 15,000 learners across four continents with nearly 550,000 pieces of code submitted for feedback on EDUKATE.AI. We are trusted by some of the most recognisable brands in the world to educate their workforce, including Microsoft, the NHS, GSK, easyJet, the BBC and John Lewis. Our focus on applied learning to create business impact sets us apart - individual learners have reported applying their skills at work to generate recorded value of up to £40m.



Our Values

At the centre of the way we work together and inspire each other to achieve success are these core values:

Entrepreneurial

We take initiative and show entrepreneurial spirit which fuels innovation at Cambridge Spark. This includes identifying opportunities for improvement, taking ownership for implementing solutions effectively and driving improvement by using proof of concepts to demonstrate the feasibility and value of their work.

Team Spirit

Everyone is part of building an open and transparent culture, communicating effectively to raise issues, discuss improvements and share the evidence used to make decisions.

Customer-focused

Our customers are at the centre of everything we do, inspiring us to create great work. We strive to build friendly, professional and lasting relationships with them to better understand and anticipate their needs.

Gold Standard

We are experts in our field and are constantly developing our technology and offering. We set the benchmark in our industry: both in what we offer customers and in how we deliver it.

Cambridge Spark is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunities for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at Cambridge Spark are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, colour or ethnicity, ability or disability, gender or gender reassignment, sexual orientation, marital status, religion, age or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. Cambridge Spark will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. Cambridge Spark encourages applicants of all ages.

  6. Generate best-practice guidelines and quality assurance checks for legal data annotation workflows.
  7. Stay abreast of US corporate and M&A legal developments, integrating relevant insights into annotation guidance.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Active license to practice law in the United States, with a focus on corporate law and M&A transactions.
  2. 5+ years’ experience advising on or structuring M&A transactions, corporate due diligence, or commercial contracts.
  3. Deep knowledge of US securities law, compliance frameworks, and governance requirements.
  4. Demonstrated skill in drafting and reviewing a wide variety of corporate and transactional documents.
  5. Exceptional written and verbal communication abilities, including clear annotation and documentation skills.
  6. Prior involvement in legal technology, legal research, or data-driven legal projects is a plus.

jobs.excerpt: Amylyx has an audacious mission to usher in a new era for treating diseases with high unmet needs.
jobs.description:
Amylyx has an audacious mission to usher in a new era for treating diseases with high unmet needs. Where others see challenges, we see opportunities that we pursue with urgency, rigorous science, and unwavering commitment to the communities we serve. We are a clinical-stage company currently focused on post-bariatric hypoglycemia (PBH), Wolfram syndrome, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS).

Our mission is powered by our people. Our core values – be audacious, be curious, be authentic, be engaged, and be accountable – creating a culture of caring. Amylyx has assembled an experienced team ready to take action because the communities we serve have no time to wait. If you share our passion and are determined to tackle some of medicine’s toughest problems, we encourage you to read the opportunity below and apply.

The Opportunity

Amylyx is seeking an experienced and strategic Vice President, CMC Strategy to lead integrated Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (CMC) strategy, global execution, and lifecycle management across the company’s preclinical, clinical, and commercial portfolio. This leader will advance Amylyx’s pipeline by aligning CMC priorities with development plans, global regulatory requirements, commercialization readiness, and long-term product strategies. The Vice President will lead the CMC asset leadership and program management organization and partner closely with Technical Development, Manufacturing Sciences and Technology (MSAT), External Manufacturing, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Supply Chain, Clinical Development, Program Management, and Commercial teams. The ideal candidate combines deep global CMC expertise with organizational leadership, rigorous risk management, and hands-on problem solving in a dynamic biotechnology environment.

Responsibilities

CMC Strategy & Portfolio Leadership

  • Develop and lead integrated CMC strategies across Amylyx’s preclinical, clinical, and commercial portfolio, ensuring alignment with corporate objectives and asset development plans.
  • Provide strategic leadership and oversight of CMC activities from early development through late-stage clinical programs, regulatory approval, commercialization, and lifecycle management.
  • Establish portfolio-level priorities, resource allocation strategies, and risk mitigation plans to support successful execution across multiple programs.
  • Partner with cross-functional leadership to ensure CMC strategies support clinical development milestones, regulatory commitments, and commercial readiness.
  • Anticipate and proactively address CMC challenges, dependencies, and risks that could impact development timelines, regulatory approvals, or product supply.
  • Serve as a senior CMC representative in portfolio governance, asset leadership, and strategic planning discussions.
  • Drive alignment and decision-making across the CMC functions to ensure coordinated execution of portfolio priorities.

Global CMC Execution & Regulatory Strategy

  • Translate asset objectives into phase-appropriate, risk-based integrated CMC plans, securing functional alignment, resources, and budgets to ensure execution.
  • Partner with Regulatory Affairs, Quality, and technical functions to ensure CMC strategies meet evolving regulatory requirements across the United States, Europe, Japan, and other international markets.
  • Provide strategic oversight of CMC components of INDs, NDAs, MAAs, and other global regulatory submissions, including responses to health authority questions and post-approval commitments.
  • Drive global CMC readiness, ensuring appropriate planning, coordination, and execution of activities required to support clinical development, regulatory approvals, and commercial launches.
  • Oversee the strategic planning and coordination of CMC-related regulatory changes, commitments, and implementation activities across global markets.
  • Establish effective governance, risk management, and decision-making processes to ensure timely execution of global CMC priorities.
  • Collaborate with internal program teams and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure alignment of CMC deliverables with program timelines and business objectives.

Product Lifecycle Management

  • Develop and oversee comprehensive CMC lifecycle management strategies to support product sustainability, global expansion, and long-term commercial objectives.
  • Lead strategic planning for post-approval CMC activities, including manufacturing changes, site transfers, capacity expansion, and regulatory variations, in partnership with the responsible technical and manufacturing functions.
  • Partner with Program Teams, Commercial, Supply Chain, Regulatory Affairs to support geographic expansion and evolving market requirements.
  • Ensure lifecycle management plans anticipate changing regulatory requirements, supply needs, and business priorities.
  • Drive cross-functional alignment on lifecycle priorities, investment decisions, and execution timelines.
  • Provide strategic oversight of lifecycle initiatives to ensure effective implementation while maintaining regulatory compliance and continuity of supply.

CMC Organizational Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and develop the CMC organization, including CMC asset leaders and program management professionals, establishing clear priorities, accountability, and performance expectations.
  • Build organizational capabilities and ensure the team is appropriately structured and resourced to support an expanding global pipeline and commercial portfolio.
  • Provide leadership and oversight to CMC asset teams, promoting collaboration, operational excellence, and effective decision-making.
  • Foster a high-performing, collaborative culture focused on scientific rigor, strategic thinking, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Develop talent, strengthen succession planning, and support the professional growth of CMC team members.
  • Partner with senior leadership on organizational planning, workforce needs, and long-term capability development.
  • Promote strong cross-functional partnerships and ensure effective communication and coordination across CMC functions.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Operational Excellence

  • Serve as a strategic partner to Technical Development, MSAT, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Supply Chain, External Manufacturing, R&D, Clinical Development, Program Management, and Commercial teams.
  • Establish effective CMC governance, program oversight, and performance management processes to ensure consistent execution across the portfolio.
  • Oversee CMC program timelines, budget assumptions, and critical milestones, ensuring transparency, accountability, and timely escalation of risks.
  • Partner with technical and manufacturing leaders to align development, manufacturing, and supply strategies with broader asset and portfolio objectives.
  • Drive continuous improvement in CMC planning, execution, communication, and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Represent CMC in senior leadership discussions, providing clear recommendations on strategic priorities, risks, investments, and business decisions.
  • Ensure effective integration of CMC activities across functions to support timely and successful achievement of program milestones.

Requirements

  • Advanced degree in chemistry, chemical engineering, pharmaceutical sciences, or related scientific discipline.
  • At least 15 years of progressive experience in pharmaceutical or biotechnology CMC, including significant leadership experience overseeing complex development programs and global CMC activities across the full product lifecycle.
  • Demonstrated experience leading CMC organizations, developing organizational capabilities, and managing high-performing teams.
  • Extensive experience developing and executing global CMC strategies across preclinical, clinical, and commercial-stage programs including CMC asset leadership and program team representation.
  • Proven track record leading successful global regulatory submissions, product approvals, and commercial readiness activities.
  • Strong understanding of global CMC regulatory requirements, including FDA, EMA, PMDA, ICH, and applicable cGMP standards.
  • Demonstrated expertise in CMC lifecycle management, including post-approval changes, global market expansion, comparability strategy, and regulatory commitments.
  • Strong understanding of pharmaceutical development and manufacturing, with experience in both large and small molecules, preferred.
  • Experience leading complex cross-functional programs and partnering effectively with Technical Development, MSAT, External Manufacturing, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, and Supply Chain.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to translate scientific, regulatory, and operational considerations into strategic business decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to establish priorities, manage competing demands, anticipate risks, and drive execution across multiple programs.

jobs.excerpt: Cheesecake Labs é parceira de IA, dados e engenharia de produto para organizações consolidadas e em fase de escala que enfrentam sistemas legados, dados fragmentados, pressão por IA ou capacidade de engenharia limitada.
jobs.description:
Cheesecake Labs é parceira de IA, dados e engenharia de produto para organizações consolidadas e em fase de escala que enfrentam sistemas legados, dados fragmentados, pressão por IA ou capacidade de engenharia limitada.

Nossos serviços incluem Implementação de IA, Modernização de Aplicações, Data & Analytics, Product Engineering, Entrega Acelerada por IA e Times de Engenharia Integrados. Entregamos workflows agênticos em 8 a 12 semanas e modernizamos aplicações em 5 a 10 meses, em vez de 2 anos. Também construímos bases de dados confiáveis e produtos digitais feitos para escalar. Nosso ciclo de desenvolvimento de software agêntico acelera a execução, enquanto engenheiros experientes se integram aos times dos clientes para trazer profundidade técnica, segurança e clareza de ownership.

Membro do Claude Partner Network da Anthropic. Entre nossos parceiros de tecnologia estão Databricks, Snowflake, dbt e AWS.

Em mais de 13 anos, a Cheesecake Labs construiu mais de 300 produtos para clientes como Eurasia Group, MoneyGram, World Bank, Stellar, Wedgewood, PepsiCo, Merck, Sodexo e Mercado Libre.

Detalhes da contratação

  • Modelo de contractor, por projeto
  • Pagamento em USD por hora
  • 100% remoto
  • Alocação flexível, conforme a disponibilidade de projetos e o fit
  • As oportunidades podem variar em duração, escopo e dedicação semanal, de acordo com as necessidades dos clientes

Algumas oportunidades podem começar imediatamente.
Outras podem ser ativadas conforme novos projetos entrarem no nosso pipeline.

A história por trás desta vaga

O que define o trabalho na Cheesecake Labs é a forma como a gente trabalha.

Na maioria das vezes, não trabalhamos com produtos que têm sistemas maduros, pesquisa de usuário extensa ou requisitos totalmente definidos desde o primeiro dia. Os clientes nos chamam quando o produto ainda está tomando forma: as ideias estão surgindo, as prioridades mudam rápido e o time vai descobrindo as coisas junto.

Isso significa que nossos designers fazem mais do que deixar as coisas bonitas. Eles definem a experiência: os fluxos, a direção de UX e as telas que fazem cada produto ser diferente.

Estamos buscando uma pessoa Product Designer que trabalhe bem com briefs incompletos, atue lado a lado com PMs e com a engenharia e transforme o problema de um cliente em uma experiência clara para o usuário.

A IA mudou a forma como o design funciona por aqui. As LLMs cuidam de boa parte da pesquisa e as ferramentas de IA constroem protótipos utilizáveis, então o seu tempo vai para decidir como a experiência deve ser e para especificá-la bem.

Como é esta vaga na prática

Esta não é uma vaga em que o design acontece de forma isolada.

Em um projeto típico, você pode:

  • Definir a UX: fluxos de usuário, templates base e a direção que o produto inteiro segue.
  • Trabalhar com PMs, engenharia e clientes nas decisões de experiência. A responsabilidade por escopo, prioridades e pelo processo de spec é de quem atua como PM.
  • Direcionar a IA para conduzir o discovery: benchmarks de concorrentes e de UX, relatórios e apresentações. Depois, checar o resultado e decidir o que ele significa para o produto.
  • Especificar cada tela por escrito para que agentes de IA possam construir a partir dela. Aqui, a engenharia sempre constrói com agentes de IA, então a sua spec é o insumo com que eles trabalham. Quando uma spec de produto for delegada a você, escreva essa também. Quem responde por ela continua sendo a pessoa PM.
  • Desenhar à mão as telas centrais, de wireframes a UI refinada, para que o produto não acabe genérico.
  • Construir protótipos utilizáveis com ferramentas de IA como Figma Make, Claude Code ou Claude Cowork, para testar a experiência com stakeholders antes que a engenharia construa.
  • Equilibrar necessidades do usuário, objetivos de negócio, restrições técnicas e prazos.
  • Apresentar ideias, coletar feedback e iterar rápido com stakeholders e com o time.
  • Trabalhar dentro das regras de cada cliente sobre o uso de IA (veja Como usamos IA aqui).

Alguns projetos são altamente exploratórios. Outros são muito mais focados em execução. A maioria fica em algum ponto entre os dois.

O que costuma funcionar bem por aqui

Quem se destaca nesta vaga costuma:

  • Ter experiência desenhando produtos digitais para web e mobile.
  • Se sentir confortável tanto em discussões de UX quanto de UI, do enquadramento do problema até interfaces refinadas.
  • Trabalhar bem com a engenharia e entender como produtos digitais são, de fato, construídos.
  • Não precisar de tudo totalmente definido para começar.
  • Receber bem feedback, iterar rápido e questionar ideias com argumentos.
  • Já usar IA todos os dias para pesquisa, síntese e prototipação, e conseguir mostrar como.
  • Comunicar-se de forma proativa e saber se organizar bem em um formato 100% remoto.

Talvez esta vaga não seja para você se

Só para ser transparente:

  • Você prefere só a execução visual, com pouco envolvimento no pensamento de produto.
  • Você prefere desenhar cada tela à mão a direcionar ferramentas de IA e especificar o resultado.
  • Você não se sente à vontade apresentando ideias, facilitando discussões ou trabalhando de perto com stakeholders.
  • Você depende de ambientes muito estruturados e de requisitos perfeitamente definidos.
  • Você prefere não trabalhar diretamente com clientes.
  • Você quer uma vaga que termina na entrega de telas finalizadas para a engenharia.
  • Você não gosta de ambientes que mudam rápido, em que prioridades e escopo evoluem com frequência.
  • Você vê a IA como algo opcional na forma como trabalha.

Não há nada de errado em nenhuma dessas preferências. Só não é assim que a gente trabalha.

Uma última coisa

Para participar deste processo seletivo, você precisa:

  • Ter um registro empresarial válido no seu país (CNPJ, VAT, EIN ou equivalente).
  • Ter uma conta bancária apta a receber pagamentos em dólar (USD).
  • Poder emitir invoices (notas fiscais ou equivalente) conforme necessário.

Job Purpose:

The Manager, Sales Deployment & Compensation is responsible for the sales force deployment and incentive compensation programs that support Bracco’s Molecular Imaging Oncology and Cardiology franchises. This role owns the day-to-day design support, administration, and reporting of the Sales Incentive Compensation (SIC) plans, and supports the market opportunity, segmentation, territory, and quota work, owned by the Senior Director, Commercial Operations, that sets fair, defensible goals for the field. The Manager serves as the primary point of contact for the field sales organization on quotas, territory alignment, attainment reporting, and incentive compensation payouts.

The Manager works closely with the Senior Director, Commercial Operations, Finance, HR, Sales Leadership, Marketing, and Sales Enablement to connect the market opportunity model to quota, territory, and payout, and to ensure that compensation rewards the right behaviors and growth. The ideal candidate combines hands-on incentive compensation experience, strong analytical and Excel skills, Salesforce reporting capability, and the ability to communicate clearly with the field and with senior leaders. The Manager will also help move incentive compensation administration from Excel and ECT toward a single, auditable system, and calendar across both franchises.

Main Responsibilities, Activities, Duties and Tasks:

Sales Deployment Support: Market Opportunity, Segmentation & Territory

  • Support the TAM/SAM/SOM market opportunity models by gathering and validating data inputs, refreshing the models, and preparing outputs by franchise and geography for planning, quota setting, and resource decisions.
  • Support customer segmentation and targeting by applying the approved segmentation model, producing segment and target lists, and loading them into Salesforce for use by Sales, Marketing, and Enablement.
  • Support territory optimization and expansion analyses by building scenarios and impact assessments and implement approved alignment changes and account and customer alignments.
  • Support the annual Operating Plan and quota-setting process by calculating territory-level quotas from account potential in collaboration with Finance and Sales Leadership.
  • Load, maintain, and reconcile quotas and territory alignments in Salesforce and incentive compensation systems each cycle, and manage mid-cycle changes with appropriate documentation and approvals.

Incentive Compensation Design & Administration

  • Support the design and ongoing refinement of Oncology and Cardiology Sales Incentive Compensation (SIC) plans, including commission structures, payout tables, and SPIFFs, in partnership with the Senior Director, Commercial Operations.
  • Manage end-to-end incentive compensation administration, including data collection, payout calculation, validation, exception review, and timely, accurate payment processing in accordance with plan documents.
  • Build, maintain, and audit compensation calculators and payout, with strong documentation, version control, and controls.
  • Support the transition to a single compensation system and calendar across both franchises, with a clean audit trail, and help evaluate and implement compensation automation in 2H 2027.
  • Partner with Finance, HR, and Legal on plan approvals, accruals, and audit and SOX requirements related to incentive compensation.
  • Lead field rollout and communications for SIC plans, SPIFFs, and plan changes, including plan documents, FAQs, and training for sales leadership and the field.
  • Administer field recognition programs, including President's Club and Circle of Excellence, including eligibility calculations, tracking, and communications.

Reporting, Analytics & Plan Effectiveness

Professional Experience, Knowledge, & Technical Skills

jobs.description:
About Us

We are an early-stage startup preparing to launch a mobile dating app competing in the same market as Tinder, Bumble and Hinge.

Our working culture is fast-moving, hands-on and shaped by short decision cycles, evolving priorities and limited resources. We need someone who enjoys this environment, takes initiative and remains composed and effective when deadlines are tight or plans change.

You will help shape the product, build the brand and bring the app to market. Initially, you will personally deliver much of the work across marketing, content, partnerships and automation. As the business develops, the role may expand to include building and leading a team.

Job Description

You will play a central role in deciding how the app is positioned, how the brand looks and communicates, which audiences we serve and how the product develops to meet their needs.

Working closely with the founding and development teams, you will turn market research, user insights and performance data into recommendations for product priorities, features, onboarding and the overall user experience. Your involvement starts before launch and continues through ongoing product development and growth.

You will also own the marketing strategy and its practical execution. This includes creating the content and systems needed across websites, social media, YouTube long-form videos, Shorts, advertising, influencer campaigns and partnerships.

Exceptional practical expertise in AI is essential. You must be able to use AI to produce high-quality work independently and build reliable content pipelines and automations. n8n and similar tools should be part of your everyday workflow.

Key Responsibilities

  • Shape the product: Research user needs, competitors and market opportunities. Help define the product's value proposition, contribute to roadmap priorities and turn insights into clear feature proposals and briefs.
  • Improve the user experience: Work with the product and development teams on onboarding, activation, engagement, retention and monetization. Help define experiments and assess whether changes improve the experience.
  • Build the brand: Develop brand positioning, messaging, tone of voice, visual direction and storytelling. Translate these into a consistent identity across the app and all marketing channels.
  • Own go-to-market: Develop and execute the pre-launch, launch and growth strategy, including target audiences, market selection, channel priorities and campaign planning.
  • Create marketing content: Personally plan, produce, edit and publish the content the business needs, including websites, landing pages, social posts, advertising assets, graphics, email campaigns, YouTube long-form videos, Shorts and other short-form video.
  • Build content pipelines: Use AI and automation to support research, scripting, visual production, video editing, repurposing, publishing and performance analysis while maintaining creative quality.
  • Develop influencer marketing: Identify suitable creators, establish relationships, negotiate collaborations, develop campaign briefs and measure results.
  • Establish partnerships: Find and develop relevant brand, community, event and distribution partnerships that support awareness, trust and user acquisition.
  • Drive measurable growth: Run acquisition and lifecycle experiments across paid, organic, referral and community channels. Connect marketing activity to activation, retention and commercial outcomes.
  • Automate operations: Build and maintain n8n workflows and integrations that reduce repetitive work across marketing, content production, partnerships and reporting.
  • Support future team growth: As needs and resources develop, help identify hiring priorities, document effective workflows and onboard colleagues or external specialists.

Required Qualifications

  • Substantial hands-on experience launching and growing consumer mobile apps, with a demonstrable personal contribution to apps reaching six-, seven- or eight-figure download totals.
  • Evidence of your own impact: the decisions you owned, the work you delivered and the measurable results achieved.
  • Experience contributing directly to product development through user research, feature definition, prioritization, experimentation and collaboration with designers and developers.
  • Strong brand-building ability, including positioning, messaging, visual judgment and consistent execution across product and marketing.
  • Exceptional practical AI skills across research, writing, design, image generation, video production, editing and content workflows.
  • The ability to independently produce marketing content across multiple formats, including social media, YouTube long-form videos, Shorts, websites and advertising creatives.
  • Hands-on experience with influencer marketing, creator collaborations and partnership development.
  • Strong practical knowledge of n8n or comparable automation platforms, including APIs, webhooks, integrations and reliable workflow operation.
  • A solid understanding of mobile acquisition, attribution, activation, retention, customer acquisition cost and lifetime value.
  • The judgment to prioritize the channels and activities that matter most, balancing quality, speed and limited startup resources.
  • A willingness to take ownership across disciplines and personally execute the work required at an early-stage business.
  • Resilience under pressure, strong prioritization skills and the ability to maintain quality and sound judgment during demanding launch phases.
  • Comfort working with uncertainty, changing priorities and limited startup resources, with the confidence to communicate trade-offs, flag constraints early and propose practical solutions.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Experience with dating apps, social discovery products or consumer platforms that depend on network effects.
  • Growing mobile apps to millions or tens of millions of downloads.
  • Taking a product from pre-launch through launch and subsequent growth.
  • Building local user density, communities and market-by-market launch strategies.
  • Developing a brand from the beginning and carrying it consistently into the product experience.
  • Building a YouTube presence, repeatable video formats or creator-led acquisition channels.
  • Establishing partnerships that delivered measurable distribution, engagement or revenue.
  • Growing from an individual contributor into a team leadership role within a startup.

What We Offer

  • A central role in shaping the product, brand and market launch of a new mobile dating app.
  • Broad responsibility across creative work, product decisions, marketing and growth.
  • The opportunity to build practical systems and workflows from the beginning.
  • The potential to help build and lead a team as the business grows.

How to Apply

Please share your CV and selected examples demonstrating:

  • Mobile apps you helped launch or scale, their download totals and your personal contribution.
  • Product decisions or improvements you helped shape, including the user insight behind them and the outcome.
  • Branding and marketing content you personally created, ideally covering multiple formats.
  • AI-powered content workflows or automations you built.
  • Influencer campaigns or partnerships you developed and the results they produced.

Public links and anonymized examples are welcome. Please respect the confidentiality of previous employers and clients.

What We Do:

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 6M endpoints and 17M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

Reports to: Manager, Security Operations Center

Location: Remote Australia

Compensation Range: $180,000 to $215,000 AUD base plus bonus and equity.

What You’ll Do:

As our Principal SOC Analyst in Australia, you're the most senior technical voice on the APAC SOC floor, working Monday to Friday. You'll take ownership of the hardest intrusions, turn what the floor sees every day into durable detection and product improvements, and raise the bar for every analyst around you. You'll lead by example as a cultural driver for the team, and you'll help build our Human Led Agentic SOC, where agents handle volume and humans own quality. You'll work closely with Product, Product Research and Detection Engineering & Threat Hunting.   • Own complex, multi-host intrusions end to end, from triage through forensic timelining, root cause and remediation, across endpoint, identity (Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace) and SIEM telemetry
  • Act as the SOC's technical partner to Product, Product Research and DE&TH: turn recurring floor pain points into lasting detection, suppression and product fixes rather than workarounds
  • Perform advanced static and dynamic malware analysis, research emerging tradecraft, and publish findings through Huntress content
  • Find repeatable investigation patterns and toil, then design, build and maintain both automation and human-led agentic workflows with Workflow Engine owners, Product and Engineering, with inline QC/QA built in from the start
  • Own quality on the floor: grade AI agent and analyst output, trace misses to their root cause and fix them at the source, and act as final technical reviewer on detection tuning, suppression decisions and high-impact incident reports

What You Bring To The Team:

  • 6+ years in SOC, Incident Response, DFIR or MDR roles, including leading multi-host intrusion investigations
  • Deep knowledge of attacker tradecraft across MITRE ATT&CK (credential access, lateral movement, persistence, defense evasion, living-off-the-land) and how to detect it

  • Advanced static and dynamic malware analysis, including extracting IOCs and determining capability and intent

  • Proven technical leadership and mentoring: you've raised the standard of a team, not just your own work, and you explain complex findings clearly in writing and verbally

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Published research, blogs, conference talks or open-source security tooling
  • Detection engineering experience: writing and tuning detections and SIEM queries
  • Investigations in other cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS or GCP
  • Previous MSP/MSSP/MDR experience and familiarity with RMM tools

jobs.description:
Location: 100% Remote

Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve engineering workflows, and share practical knowledge.

We are looking for a senior engineer who can connect mobile development, backend services, databases, and infrastructure into a reliable development and delivery process.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior Mobile & Platform Engineer who can work across Android and iOS, contribute to our Kotlin Multiplatform architecture, and support our dedicated developers on both platforms.

Your main focus will be enabling the team to deliver effectively: resolving technical challenges, maintaining shared components, improving development workflows, and managing the backend and infrastructure that support the application.

You will also contribute directly to implementation where needed. Depending on your experience and suitability, the role may include technical team leadership for our Android and iOS developers.

Strong GitHub, GitHub Actions, and runner-management experience is essential. Practical experience with AI-assisted and agentic development is equally important.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support our Android and iOS developers with technical decisions, debugging, code reviews, and integration challenges.
  • Develop and maintain shared application logic using Kotlin Multiplatform.
  • Contribute to native Android and iOS development where platform-specific work is required.
  • Maintain a clear architecture across mobile applications, backend services, APIs, and databases.
  • Develop and maintain backend functionality and server-side integrations.
  • Manage database changes, investigate data-related issues, and maintain reliable migration, backup, and recovery processes.
  • Build and improve CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions.
  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot GitHub runners, including self-hosted runners.
  • Improve build reliability, automated testing, deployment processes, and development environments.
  • Manage server-side application deployments, configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
  • Establish effective AI-assisted and agentic coding workflows across the team.
  • Review AI-generated code and ensure that changes are tested, understandable, secure, and maintainable.
  • Help developers and junior team members use AI tools effectively through practical demonstrations and knowledge sharing.
  • Where appropriate, act as technical team lead: coordinate dependencies, guide implementation, review technical decisions, and help the team resolve blockers.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience in mobile software development.
  • Strong Kotlin and Android development experience, together with practical Swift and iOS development experience.
  • Solid hands-on experience with Kotlin Multiplatform and integrating shared code into both mobile platforms.
  • The ability to investigate problems across mobile clients, APIs, backend services, databases, and infrastructure.
  • Practical backend development experience and a sound understanding of API design, authentication, and application security.
  • Strong SQL and relational database experience, including schema changes, migrations, and performance troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on DevOps experience with Linux servers, application deployment, configuration, and operational troubleshooting.
  • Excellent Git and GitHub knowledge, including pull requests, code reviews, branch workflows, and repository configuration.
  • Strong experience with GitHub Actions and configuring and maintaining GitHub runners.
  • Substantial experience using AI coding assistants and coding agents to deliver working software.
  • The ability to establish development workflows that combine coding agents, automated checks, and human review.
  • Clear communication, practical documentation skills, and a willingness to share knowledge.
  • The ability to work independently while supporting other developers constructively.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Previous experience as a technical lead or senior engineer supporting a mobile development team.
  • GPS, BLE, UWB, NFC, or other location and proximity technologies.
  • Testing mobile applications on real devices and investigating platform-specific behavior.
  • Container-based application deployment and reproducible development environments.
  • Monitoring, incident diagnosis, and maintaining reliable backend services.
  • Coordinating changes that affect mobile applications, backend APIs, and database structures together.

Potential Technical Team Lead Responsibilities

For a suitable candidate, the role can include technical leadership of our Android and iOS developers.

This would involve helping the team make consistent technical decisions, breaking down implementation work, coordinating shared dependencies, and maintaining the quality of delivered changes. You should be comfortable mentoring developers and taking responsibility for the technical direction while remaining actively involved in engineering.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • A central role supporting our mobile development team.
  • The opportunity to shape our architecture, infrastructure, and agentic development workflows.
  • Potential technical teamlead responsibility, depending on suitability.
  • Close collaboration with a team that values practical knowledge sharing.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your experience developing for both Android and iOS, including Kotlin Multiplatform.
  • Your backend, database, and server infrastructure responsibilities.
  • Examples of GitHub Actions workflows and runner environments you have configured or maintained.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with examples of delivered results.
  • Your experience supporting developers, mentoring colleagues, or leading a technical team.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio links, GitHub repositories, and released application references are welcome where available.

Built on an API-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.

Position Summary

The Senior Business Operations Analyst, Professional Services is responsible for the operational processes that support the Professional Services business from commercial intake through project creation, financial forecasting, milestone management, and billing readiness. The role connects Professional Services, Sales, Finance, Business Operations, and Tools Engineering to ensure that engagements move cleanly from statement of work and commercial intake into Salesforce, Smartsheet, NetSuite, and downstream financial processes.

This position combines hands-on operational responsibility with business analysis and continuous improvement. The successful candidate will maintain business continuity while simplifying, standardizing, and automating manual processes. The long-term objective is to own process integrity, data quality, controls, exceptions, and improvement rather than merely processing transactions.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Commercial Operations

  • Coordinate the operational lifecycle of Professional Services statements of work, work orders, change requests, quotes, and related commercial requests.
  • Review incoming requests for completeness and route work to the appropriate business, technical, legal, or subject-matter experts.
  • Track requests through completion and proactively resolve stalled or incomplete work.
  • Maintain pricing worksheets, commercial assumptions, annual uplifts, support-window pricing, and standardized pricing models.
  • Preserve traceability between commercial documents, approvals, opportunities, and resulting projects.

Project Setup and Operational Readiness

  • Validate required project and financial information before project creation.
  • Create or coordinate project setup in NetSuite, including project records, tasks, milestones, charge rules, and required financial attributes.
  • Validate handoffs among Salesforce, Smartsheet, NetSuite, and related systems.
  • Coordinate exceptions when automated project creation or system integration fails.
  • Confirm each engagement is operationally ready before delivery work begins.

Project Financial and Milestone Operations

  • Monitor contractual, delivery, and billing milestones.
  • Work with Project Managers to validate milestone completion and estimated completion dates.
  • Ensure completed milestones are accurately reflected in NetSuite and downstream billing processes, including Zuora.
  • Identify overdue, at-risk, incomplete, or inconsistent milestones and coordinate corrective action.
  • Support reconciliation between project, financial, billing, and forecasting systems.

Revenue Forecasting and Reporting

  • Conduct recurring forecast reviews with Project Managers and validate projected milestone completion dates.
  • Identify changes that may affect revenue timing, billing readiness, or delivery commitments.
  • Maintain accurate forecast information in the designated system of record and provide Finance with timely visibility.
  • Develop and maintain reporting for overdue milestones, forecast movement, billing risk, data quality, and workflow exceptions.
  • Investigate and resolve unexplained differences among project forecasts, NetSuite milestones, and billing activity.

Professional Services Intake

  • Validate incoming opportunities, purchase orders, and commercial documentation before downstream processing.
  • Coordinate project manager assignment and operational handoffs where required.
  • Ensure appropriate Salesforce records exist and monitor project provisioning into Smartsheet and NetSuite.
  • Maintain clear ownership across Sales, Business Operations, Professional Services, Finance, and Tools Engineering.

Purchase Order and Vendor Administration

  • Coordinate purchase-order requests associated with Professional Services engagements.
  • Validate approved amounts against commercial documentation and provide required PO information to vendors.
  • Maintain visibility into vendor-related project costs and partner with Finance and Procurement to streamline recurring purchasing.

Process Governance and Automation

  • Maintain current standard operating procedures, process maps, controls, business rules, and exception-handling guidance.
  • Define and reinforce systems of record and data ownership for critical operational information.
  • Translate operational problems into business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized automation opportunities.
  • Partner with Tools Engineering on Salesforce, Smartsheet, NetSuite, Power BI, integration, and workflow improvements.
  • Participate in user acceptance testing, release validation, adoption, and post-implementation measurement.
  • Reduce duplicate entry, spreadsheets, manual reconciliation, and person-dependent knowledge.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Operations, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Five or more years of experience in Business Operations, Professional Services Operations, Finance Operations, Sales Operations, Business Analysis, or a related discipline.
  • Experience supporting Professional Services project lifecycles, including SOWs, project setup, milestones, revenue forecasting, pricing, and billing processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to reconcile data across enterprise systems and resolve operational inconsistencies.
  • Strong requirements gathering, process mapping, documentation, analytical, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple operational workstreams and communicate effectively with Project Managers, Sales, Finance, Engineering, and senior leaders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with NetSuite project management, project accounting, milestones, charge rules, or billing.
  • Experience with Salesforce, Smartsheet, Zuora, Power BI, SharePoint, and advanced Microsoft Excel.
  • Experience with Professional Services Automation platforms, workflow automation, system integrations, and user acceptance testing.
  • Experience creating operational controls, exception reporting, and process performance metrics.

Ensures that all ISO data acquisition (ISO metered entities) and control entities are thoroughly inspected, documented, certified and provide accurate data acquisition information and control capacity according to ISO approved certification procedures and standards. Supports, maintains, and modifies current tariff and Business Practice Manuals (BPM) language related to ISO revenue metering and telemetry policies and practices.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Participates in the design, development and maintenance of standards according to requirements associated with telemetry and revenue metering, including Programmable Logic Controllers (PLC), Remote Terminal Units (RTU), Digital Control Systems (DCS), Energy Management Systems (EMS), Supervisory Control And Data Acquisition (SCADA), ISO approved Remote Intelligent Gateways (RIG) and approved ISO meters.
  • Assists market participants and associated engineering companies in troubleshooting issues affecting proposed or existing designs, development or configuration of standards according to requirements outlined in the tariff and BPMs associated with telemetry and revenue metering. Researches, evaluates and develops technical solutions to meet current or proposed tariff or BPM requirements related to telemetry or revenue metering, including analysis and resolution of non-compliant issues for entities.
  • Supports Full Network Model (FNM) builds including deliverables affiliated with telemetry (database builds) and revenue metering (certificate of compliance) outlined within the New Resource Implementation (NRI) process to ensure commercial operation dates are met according to projected timelines. Coordinates and analyzes data for certification of resources desiring to participate in the ISO market and contractual resource reserves.
  • Provides guidance and training to various internal and external customers, such as ISO authorized inspectors and meter inspection companies, related to matters involving the collection and processing of telemetry and revenue metering. Creates and maintains internal and external documentation, including business processes and desktop procedures, to ensure consistent practices according to ISO standards captured within the tariff and BPMs.
  • Verifies the integrity of resources certified for ancillary services, including coordination of testing, analysis of test data, and managing the resource testing database.
  • Represents the business unit as a subject matter expert for audits, installation, and configuration verifications to ensure that ISO approved standards and requirements are maintained.
  • Provides support to the ISO’s control center by monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving issues related to telemetry that are experienced in real-time.

Level of Education and Discipline:

A Bachelor's degree (BA, BS) or equivalent education, training or experience in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Technology or related field.

Amount of Experience:

Equivalent years of education and training, plus two (2) or more years related experience.

Type of Experience:

Experience as a utility industry meter technician or engineer desired. Experience with the use of test equipment in high voltage substations and generating plants. Experience with the installation and/or programming of revenue grade meters used in the collection and calculation of meter data. Experience establishing metering solutions and applications associated with the collection of meter data. Experience working with regulations, standards, codes, methods, practices, and advanced engineering principles of electrical metering instrumentation for revenue metering.

Additional Skills and Abilities:

Strong verbal and written communication and documentation skills required, with a demonstrated attention to detail. Ability to use deductive reasoning and analytical thinking with sound judgment and decision-making skills. Strong interpersonal and conflict resolution skills are also essential. Must be self-starting and willing and able to work independently in a dynamic corporate organization under pressure of tight deadlines and aggressive expectations. Problem solving skills with the ability to influence others without direct authority. Must be able to work effectively in a team environment as facilitator and team member. Must be proficient with Microsoft Office Suite.

Basic understanding of telecommunication software, hardware and circuitry as applied to WAN. Ability to configure internal and external analog modems. Ability to review and apply engineering concepts as they relateto electrical drawings, calculations and specifications for conformance with published ISO standards and protocols. Knowledgeable of Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) software and Telemetry technology. Understanding of AC/DC electrical theory using algebra and trigonometry is required. Ability to install and test meters and metering-related equipment (e.g., utility meters, CT's, VT's and free-standing metering devices). Proficient in the use of various types of metering test equipment such as watt-hour test kits, burden testers, phase sequence indicators) to verify metering installations. Demonstrates an understanding of telecommunications software, hardware and circuitry. Must possess a strong background in the theory and application of current transformers, voltage transformers and capacitive couple voltage devices as used for revenue metering. Understanding of different types of generators, how they participate in the ISO market, and their system impact.

The pay range for the Energy Data Acquisition Specialist position is $41.25/hr - $57.75/hr

The California Independent System Operator (ISO) manages the flow of electricity across the high-voltage, long-distance power lines that make up 80 percent of California's power grid. We safeguard the economy and well-being of 30 million Californians by operating the grid reliably 24/7.

As the impartial grid operator, the California ISO opens access to the wholesale power market that is designed to diversify resources and lower prices. It also grants equal access to 25,865 circuit-miles of power lines and reduces barriers to diverse resources competing to bring power to customers.

The California ISO's function is often compared to that of air traffic controllers. It would be grossly unfair for air traffic controllers to represent one airline and profit from allowing that company's planes to go through before others. In the same way, the California ISO operates independently—managing the electron traffic on a power grid we do not own—making sure electricity is safely delivered to utilities and consumers on time and reliably.

The California ISO is committed to the health, safety, and work/life integration of its employees and is proud to offer flexible work arrangements. This position works in a hybrid or fully remote capacity.

Join the WeVote Movement!

WeVote is seeking a dynamic IT System Support Technician to join our passionate team of changemakers in a meaningful volunteer role (~5 hours per week). Please note, this is an unpaid volunteer position for national non-profit organization.

About WeVote

WeVote is a nonpartisan nonprofit startup on a mission to strengthen American democracy through innovative technology. As a celebrated Fast Forward nonprofit technology grantee, we're building something special – a movement of 250+ dedicated volunteers creating open-source mobile solutions that reach millions of voters nationwide.

Our challenge? Modern voters are busy, distracted, and pressed for time. Our solution? A streamlined voting experience that takes just 8 minutes, delivered through the downloading of our app. We're 100% volunteer-powered and fully remote, proving that passionate people can create extraordinary impact.

For more information, view

The Role of the IT System Support Technician

Within WeVote, we support all of our initiatives with custom software as well as ~15 other software systems to support our mission. We’re looking for volunteers to help manage these systems and our volunteer users. Our user base is approximately 250 volunteers. The IT system support technicians will aid with giving our volunteers new accounts, resetting passwords, changing permissions and updating , as well as answering questions and administering our technical solutions.

What You'll Accomplish

  • Technical support for volunteer user base, primarily using Slack and email
  • Oversee and manage the organization's technology systems and infrastructure, performing administrative tasks as necessary

Your Background

  • 5+ years IT technical support experience, preferably in the social impact space
  • Excellent communication and problem solving skills
  • Technical training experience, preferably with non-technical users
  • Google workspace experience
  • System implementation experience
  • Onboarding/offboarding employee experience

Essential Requirements

Availability: At least 5 hours each week during our core team hours M-F 9 a.m. - 6 p.m PST with the ability to work 1-2 hours during Pacific Time overlap. Must be available to attend the team meeting each week.

Why This Role Matters

This isn't just volunteer work – it's experience that makes a real difference. You'll develop advanced technical skills, work with cutting-edge civic technology, and help millions of Americans participate more effectively in democracy. Plus, you'll join a network of passionate professionals committed to positive change.

jobs.description:
About 8 West Consulting

8 West Consulting provides consultancy services and software solutions to clients across the US, Europe and the UK. We work in sectors including insurance, healthcare and retail, helping organisations tackle complex technology challenges and modernise critical platforms.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a senior, hands-on Quality Engineer to deliver dependable testing and practical automation improvements on enterprise client projects. You will own quality activities within your engagements, replace valuable manual regression checks with reliable automation, and apply AI-assisted methods to improve test design, data and delivery feedback.

This is an active engineering and delivery role, not a strategy-only position. You will write automation, create test data, investigate defects and support releases yourself. You will plan improvements within your project, work closely with developers and share techniques that other teams can reuse.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Own project quality. Plan and execute functional, integration, regression and exploratory testing on assigned client projects; investigate defects and support releases.
  • Automate within live projects. Prioritise high-value manual regression checks and implement stable, maintained automation without losing sight of current delivery obligations.
  • Build and maintain test solutions. Write, debug and maintain UI, API, integration and data tests; integrate checks into pipelines and resolve unreliable tests.
  • Engineer reliable test data. Create realistic, repeatable data for complex workflows and linked records; automate setup, isolation, reset and cleanup rather than depend on shared existing data.
  • Apply AI in testing. Use AI tools in live work to derive scenarios, generate and refine tests and data, inspect code changes and analyse failures; validate results and protect sensitive information.
  • Improve project feedback. Work with developers on testability, environments, regression coverage, reporting and traceability; retain exploratory testing where judgement matters.
  • Communicate clearly. Explain project-level quality risks, coverage, priorities, trade-offs and progress to developers, product owners, delivery managers and client stakeholders.
  • Introduce practical improvements. Assess current project practices, try focused changes, demonstrate results and share effective approaches with colleagues.
  • Apply enterprise controls. Maintain appropriate test evidence, access controls and safe handling of client information, including approved AI tools and processes.

Essential Skills & Experience

Enterprise automation delivery. Significant hands-on contribution to moving manual testing towards automation within an established enterprise application, project or team, with evidence of results.

  • Hands-on test engineering. Able to code, debug and maintain production test suites in C#, TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, Java or equivalent; no single language is mandatory.
  • Broad testing techniques and tooling. Experience across UI, API, integration, data and regression testing with Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, Postman or equivalent; selects tools pragmatically.
  • Microsoft enterprise environments. Experience testing .NET, SQL Server and/or Azure applications, with Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, Git and related engineering practices.
  • Test data creation and engineering. Builds deterministic, independent test data for complex relational and cross-system scenarios using APIs, SQL, builders or fixtures; understands integrity, masking, edge cases and reset.
  • Applied AI-assisted testing. Has used AI/LLM tools on real projects to generate and validate test cases and test data, and to support script development or failure analysis; can explain benefits and safeguards.
  • CI/CD and live delivery. Integrates checks into pipelines, improves suite stability and reporting, and takes responsibility for testing under project delivery pressure.
  • Project planning and execution. Assesses current coverage, prioritises by risk, plans manageable increments and delivers measurable improvements within an assigned project.
  • Communication and collaboration. Explains technical issues in plain English, works well with developers and delivery leads, and shares knowledge to help colleagues adopt better practices.

Desirable Experience

Enterprise automation delivery. Significant hands-on contribution to moving manual testing towards automation within an established enterprise application, project or team, with evidence of results.

  • Hands-on test engineering. Able to code, debug and maintain production test suites in C#, TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, Java or equivalent; no single language is mandatory.
  • Broad testing techniques and tooling. Experience across UI, API, integration, data and regression testing with Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, Postman or equivalent; selects tools pragmatically.
  • Microsoft enterprise environments. Experience testing .NET, SQL Server and/or Azure applications, with Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, Git and related engineering practices.
  • Test data creation and engineering. Builds deterministic, independent test data for complex relational and cross-system scenarios using APIs, SQL, builders or fixtures; understands integrity, masking, edge cases and reset.
  • Applied AI-assisted testing. Has used AI/LLM tools on real projects to generate and validate test cases and test data, and to support script development or failure analysis; can explain benefits and safeguards.
  • CI/CD and live delivery. Integrates checks into pipelines, improves suite stability and reporting, and takes responsibility for testing under project delivery pressure.
  • Project planning and execution. Assesses current coverage, prioritises by risk, plans manageable increments and delivers measurable improvements within an assigned project.
  • Communication and collaboration. Explains technical issues in plain English, works well with developers and delivery leads, and shares knowledge to help colleagues adopt better practices.

Personal Profile

You are practical, organised and comfortable owning testing work from start to finish. You enjoy writing tests and creating dependable data yourself, make sensible use of AI and validate its output. You build good relationships, communicate risks early and improve the way your project works without losing focus on client commitments.

What Success Looks Like

Your assigned client projects receive dependable testing and increasingly reliable automated regression coverage. Tests use reproducible, independent data rather than brittle shared records. AI supports verified quality engineering work, feedback improves and releases are more predictable. Your colleagues benefit from practical approaches you have demonstrated and shared.

jobs.excerpt: About Bask HealthBask Health provides a full-service SaaS platform that enables doctors, entrepreneurs, and healthcare businesses to build, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health provides a full-service SaaS platform that enables doctors, entrepreneurs, and healthcare businesses to build, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, speed, and exceptional execution. We work in small teams, tackle complex problems, and expect everyone to take an active role in building and improving our products.

About the Role

We're looking for a Patient Experience Product Intern to help improve the patient-facing experiences across Bask Health's telehealth platform.

You'll work alongside product managers, engineers, designers, and clinical operations teams to understand how patients interact with our software and identify opportunities to make those experiences easier, clearer, and more reliable.

This internship focuses on the patient portal, messaging, treatment status, refills, renewals, and other workflows patients use throughout their care journey.

You'll gain hands-on experience with product discovery, technical requirements, usability testing, quality assurance, and product improvements. You'll also learn how patient-facing features connect with clinical and pharmacy operations.

We're looking for someone who is technically curious, detail-oriented, and interested in building software that solves real problems for patients.

What You'll Do

  • Support product initiatives that improve the patient experience across Bask's telehealth platform.
  • Help research how patients navigate the patient portal and interact with treatment-related features.
  • Gather and organize patient feedback to identify recurring issues, confusing workflows, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Assist with improvements to patient messaging, treatment status, refill requests, and renewal experiences.
  • Help map patient journeys and identify friction between onboarding, treatment, and ongoing care.
  • Work with product managers to document user needs, product requirements, and acceptance criteria.
  • Collaborate with engineers and designers to understand technical requirements and evaluate potential improvements.
  • Investigate patient-facing issues, reproduce bugs, and document findings.
  • Support usability testing to evaluate whether patients can complete important tasks successfully.
  • Help test new features across different devices, browsers, and patient scenarios.
  • Assist with quality assurance and feature validation before product releases.
  • Research patient portal experiences, digital health applications, and consumer software to identify useful design and product patterns.
  • Review patient feedback and basic product analytics to understand feature usage and workflow completion.
  • Work with clinical and pharmacy operations teams to understand how patient-facing features connect with internal processes.
  • Help identify opportunities to improve clarity, accessibility, and reliability across patient communications and interfaces.
  • Maintain product documentation, research notes, testing results, and project updates.
  • Participate in product discovery sessions, planning meetings, and feature reviews.
  • Take ownership of smaller research, testing, or product improvement projects with guidance from the product team.

Requirements

Requirements

  • Strong interest in product management, software development, and building intuitive patient-facing applications.
  • Foundational understanding of how websites, applications, and software products work.
  • Hands-on technical experience through coursework, personal projects, internships, or independent learning.
  • Familiarity with JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, or another programming language.
  • Strong analytical thinking, curiosity, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to understand user problems and communicate clear, practical recommendations.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to investigate software issues systematically.
  • Ability to organize feedback, document findings, and communicate requirements clearly.
  • Interest in user experience, accessibility, and building software that is easy to navigate.
  • Ability to learn new technical concepts, tools, and workflows quickly.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate with product managers, engineers, designers, and cross-functional teams.
  • Initiative, adaptability, and willingness to take ownership of assigned responsibilities.

Nice to Have

  • Previous coursework, internship, or project experience in product management, software engineering, UX research, or a related field.
  • Experience with patient portals, healthcare applications, or consumer-facing software.
  • Familiarity with patient messaging, treatment tracking, refill requests, or subscription renewal workflows.
  • Experience building websites, applications, prototypes, or other technical projects.
  • Familiarity with React, Next.js, or modern frontend development tools.
  • Experience conducting user research, usability testing, or analyzing customer feedback.
  • Familiarity with Figma, product analytics tools, or user journey mapping.
  • Experience writing user stories, acceptance criteria, or product documentation.
  • Understanding of accessibility principles and responsive web design.
  • Familiarity with healthcare privacy, security, or HIPAA considerations.
  • Experience using AI tools for research, prototyping, or software development.
  • Interest in telehealth, digital health, or healthcare technology.
  • A portfolio, GitHub profile, or examples of projects demonstrating technical ability and product thinking.
