T5 Program Summary: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) awarded the Technical Support Services Contract 5 (T5) to Parsons as the prime contractor. This $1.8 billion+ contract has a 4-year base period with two 3-year options. The statement of work includes a variety of activities that support the FAA’s Capital Investment Plan (CIP) modernization efforts: Site selection and engineering, construction, environmental and fire/life safety, equipment installation and testing, CAD, and other technical services as required. Work is performed across the nation and in several U.S. territories. An average staff of 400-500 with a peak staff over 650 supports this contract, in addition to those subcontractors who perform construction work.


Parsons is now hiring a Senior Buyer to join our expanding team! Parsons extensive experience combined with your procurement skills will propel your career forward. We need our Buyers at this level to collaborate with technical teams to source materials, equipment, and construction related services nationwide. In this role you will participate in a variety of procurement functions to ensure quality, efficiency, and timeliness of services provided to clients and project personnel. The ideal candidate will have experience supporting construction crews and/or familiarity with construction equipment rentals.


POSITION OVERVIEW:

Participates in a wide variety of procurement functions to ensure quality, efficiency, and timeliness of services provided to clients and project personnel. A Senior Buyer understands the entire acquisition life cycle and can independently source requirements from the planning stages through closeout. Specific assignments will vary based on project requirements but will generally involve managing life-cycle acquisitions for material (including via Corporate Purchasing Card (P-card) purchasing), charters, equipment rentals, and professional services. All purchasing activities must be managed and documented in compliance with corporate and federal regulations.

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE:

Some college education is preferred. 3+ years of related work experience is required.

SKILLS/COMPETENCIES:

Procurement experience with a major engineering and construction firm or industrial supplier, excellent written and oral communication skills, a working knowledge of PC software packages typically associated with procurement, and proficiency in utilizing basic Microsoft Office products. In addition, a working knowledge of vendor data control, sourcing, expediting, negotiation, and other purchasing activities is required.

SPECIFIC RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Sources and establishes subcontractors / vendors. Performs due diligence to qualify and establish them for eligibility to provide material or services.
  • Utilizes Corporate Purchasing Card (P-card) to procure goods and services under the micro-purchase threshold in compliance with corporate policies. Records payments and performs timely reconciliations.
  • Collaborates with other Procurement representatives and Project Managers in the pre-award solicitation process. Prepares bidders lists, issues Request for Quotations or Request for Proposals, receives and analyzes bids, ensures completeness of bid packages, prepares bid analysis summaries, and makes recommendations for purchase order / subcontract awards.
  • Prepares documents and amendments, including identification and inclusion of flowdown requirements from the prime contract. Ensures that terms and conditions will be appropriate.
  • Ensures compliance with Parsons and FAA Acquisition Management System (AMS) requirements, and maintains documentation evidencing compliance.
  • Prepares and awards Purchase Orders or Subcontracts commensurate with delegated procurement authority.
  • Monitors bid requests, bid analyses, and the preparation of purchase orders to ensure timely action.
  • Serves as primary point of contact with vendors to ensure equipment and materials are delivered to job sites in support of project schedules, and follows up on assigned purchase orders to ensure adherence to terms and conditions.
  • Initiates action, as required, to resolve any supplier problems which might adversely affect project requirements and construction schedules.
  • Prepares reports and contractual correspondence. Maintains accurate tracking records tailored to the assigned subcontracts / purchase orders.
  • Maintains real-time file documentation, including history of follow-up contact with suppliers.
  • Oversees post-award activities such as obtaining final vendor data and invoices, ensuring data is recorded for vendor performance evaluations, and preparing for closeout and storage of all records.
  • Performs subcontract / purchase orders closeout actions, completes file documentation, and submits closeout files to storage.
  • Serves as primary contact for purchasing support to project management, engineering, and other non-procurement disciplines within assigned regions.
  • May analyze draft purchase requisitions, including reviewing for completeness and accuracy, suggesting possible revisions, and forwarding to project management for further processing.
  • Evaluates and coordinates arrangements for the safe, most economical delivery of materials / equipment / personnel by selecting the best available transportation modes, carriers, rates, and routing.
  • Oversees the administration and maintenance of large BPAs, coordinating with other Procurement Representatives nationwide.
  • Performs other responsibilities associated with this position as may be appropriate.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 3+ years of related work experience is required; related experience may include administrative work, purchasing, commercial sales in relevant industry, or other transferrable skills.
  • Some college education is preferred.
  • Good written and oral communication skills, and a proficiency in Microsoft Office and Adobe is preferred
  • Experience utilizing Microsoft Teams or similar application is preferred.
  • Must be able to meet customer security requirements. A background check by Federal Authorities will be performed.
  • Experience with federal procurement regulations and Corporate Purchasing Card (P-card) preferred.
  • This position is fully remote, with some travel required. Residency within either Mountain Standard Time (MST), Central Standard Time (CST), or Pacific Standard Time (PST) is strongly preferred.

jobs.title: Virtual Certified Ophthalmic Coder & Billing Coordinator (Retina)
jobs.excerpt: We are seeking a highly experienced, certified, and detail-oriented Virtual Certified Ophthalmic Coder & Billing Coordinator (Retina) to support a premier ophthalmology practice.
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly experienced, certified, and detail-oriented Virtual Certified Ophthalmic Coder & Billing Coordinator (Retina) to support a premier ophthalmology practice. In this critical clinical revenue cycle role, your primary focus will be live-coding complex ophthalmic and retinal patient visits, managing J-code injectable drug claims, posting payments, and acting as the main operational liaison between the clinic and our third-party billing company.

Because this role demands high-level clinical coding accuracy, a minimum of 5+ years of direct ophthalmology coding experience, specialized background in retina coding, active coding certification, and live-coding mastery are absolute, non-negotiable requirements. General medical billers without direct hands-on ophthalmology coding expertise will not be considered.

Working Environment & Core Schedule

  • Role Title: Virtual Certified Ophthalmic Coder / Billing Coordinator (Retina)
  • Specialty: Ophthalmology & Retina
  • Status: Full-Time (40 Hours / Week)
  • Schedule: Monday – Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM PST (Pacific Standard Time)
  • Core Technology Stack: Ophthalmology EHR platforms (e.g., ModMed / DrChrono), Clearinghouses, Payer Portals, Practice VoIP System
  • Primary Objective: Real-time visit live-coding, J-code processing, payment posting, and third-party billing agency liaison oversight

Top 3 Daily Tasks

  1. Live Clinical Visit & J-Code Coding: Review clinical documentation in real time to code complex retina visits, surgical procedures, and intravitreal injectable drug J-codes using precise ICD-10 and CPT coding guidelines.
  2. Payment Posting & Discrepancy Auditing: Post payments accurately from ERAs/EOBs, reconcile accounts, and audit payment postings to uncover fee schedule discrepancies or coding-related claim rejections.
  3. Third-Party Billing Company Liaison Support: Work directly with the practice manager and outsourced billing agency to track unbilled encounters, resolve coding denials, push claim corrections, and report on pending revenue items.

Core Responsibilities

  • Ophthalmic & Retina Live-Coding (Primary Focus): Execute real-time CPT and ICD-10 coding for clinical encounters, retinal procedures, intravitreal injections, and specialized diagnostic testing.
  • J-Code & Injectable Drug Management: Ensure precise coding and compliance for high-cost ophthalmic drugs and biologic injectables (J-codes), verifying unit quantities and modifier application.
  • Documentation & Discrepancy Auditing: Audit provider chart documentation against submitted codes to capture unbilled services, catch clinical discrepancies, and ensure billing integrity prior to claim submission.
  • Payment Posting & AR Audit: Post electronic and manual payments, identify line-item discrepancies, and address coding-related denials or payor bundling rejections.
  • Outsourced Billing Agency Coordination: Serve as the practice’s primary contact for the third-party billing company—tracking claim transmission cadences, resolving coding edits, and holding external billers accountable.
  • Administrative & Practice Manager Support: Own all coding workflows, deliver transparent weekly status reports on pending charts, and directly relieve administrative bottlenecks for clinic leadership.

Requirements

  • 5+ Years Ophthalmology Coding Experience: Extensive, proven background coding for an ophthalmology practice, with direct specialization in retina coding.
  • Active Medical Coding Certification: Hold an active credential such as CPC (Certified Professional Coder), COC, CCS, or COA/OCP (Ophthalmic Coding Specialist).
  • Live-Coding & J-Code Mastery: Demonstrated expertise in real-time live coding of provider notes and deep familiarity with J-codes / injectable drug coding.
  • CPT & ICD-10 Expertise: Advanced knowledge of ophthalmic CPT codes, modifiers, ICD-10 diagnostic codes, and payor LCD/NCD coverage policies.
  • Payment Posting & Billing Operations: Hands-on experience posting payments, analyzing EOBs/ERAs, and auditing claim denial patterns.
  • Schedule Availability: Full availability to work 40 hours per week during Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM PST.
  • Remote Workspace Setup: Dedicated, private home office with a lockable door, high-speed primary internet connection, backup power/internet solutions, a high-performance computer (PC/Mac), and a noise-canceling headset in full compliance with HIPAA rules.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct coding experience for intravitreal injections, retinal detachments, laser surgeries, and complex retinal imaging.
  • Hands-on proficiency with ModMed (Modernizing Medicine / EMA) or DrChrono EHR systems.
  • Prior experience coordinating workflows alongside an outsourced third-party billing agency.
  • Experience directly supporting an ophthalmology practice manager or clinic director.

Ideal Candidate Profile

You are a master-level certified ophthalmic coder who thinks like a clinician and audits like a financial officer. You navigate retina CPT codes and J-codes with complete confidence, catch documentation errors in real time, keep payment posting tight, and seamlessly manage outsourced billing teams to ensure maximum practice reimbursement during PST business hours.

jobs.excerpt: OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance.
jobs.description:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

Why This Role Matters

At OPSWAT, protecting the world’s critical infrastructure is real, urgent, and growing. MetaDefender Managed File Transfer (MFT) is a security-first MFT platform trusted by customers in finance, life sciences, government, and critical infrastructure to move sensitive files safely across IT and OT environments. We are now ready to take MFT to the next level and win against established MFT vendors. As a member of OPSWAT’s product leadership team, you will help set company-level product strategy, influence investment decisions across the portfolio, and be accountable for
the business performance of MFT. This Senior Director role is a rare opportunity to shape the future of MFT, including a next-generation MFT Gateway and a lightweight automation offering, while scaling commercial impact and deepening customer value. You will operate at the intersection of product strategy, engineering execution, and go-to-market success, with clear ownership and visible impact. It is also a chance to redefine what product management looks like in the AI era. We are not looking for someone who talks about AI. We want a leader who already uses it every day to work faster and smarter, and who can build a team of PMs that does the same. If you are energized by building, innovating, and owning outcomes, this role was designed for you.

What You Will Be Doing

As Senior Director of Product Management, MFT, you will be the executive owner of MFT’s product strategy,
business performance, and growth trajectory. You will:

  • Set and own the MFT product vision and roadmap, including the MFT Gateway, automation, and AI-driven capabilities.
  • Translate market signals, customer needs, and competitive insights into clear product direction and prioritized investments.
  • Drive MFT’s position in regulated and high-assurance markets (e.g., GxP, financial services, federal, OT), including compliance, audit, and integrity requirements.
  • Partner deeply with Engineering, ensuring fast, high-quality execution and scalable architecture.
  • Work closely with Sales, Sales Engineering, and Marketing to drive bookings, pipeline, competitive displacements, and customer adoption.
  • Serve as a strong, visible product leader across regions, with close partnership with our engineering team in Hungary and Romania.
  • Balance innovation with operational excellence, ensuring MFT delivers reliability, performance, and trust at scale.
  • Own MFT business results, including revenue, pricing, packaging, and investment priorities.
  • Shape company-level product strategy as part of the product leadership team, presenting to the CEO and executive team.
  • Represent MFT as its executive voice with strategic customers, partners, analysts, and at industry events.

Build an AI-Native Product Function

You will set the standard for how product management works at OPSWAT, using AI as a core part of how the

team operates:

  • Use AI to compress the path from customer signal to shipped feature: synthesizing customer calls, support tickets, win/loss data, and competitive intel into clear insights in hours, not weeks.
  • Use AI tools to draft PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and release notes, freeing PMs to spend
    more time with customers and engineers.
  • Prototype workflows and UI concepts with AI to validate ideas with customers before engineering commits.
  • Build AI-assisted competitive and market analysis so the team always knows where MFT wins and why.
  • Identify where AI belongs inside the product itself, from intelligent automation and anomaly detection to policy recommendations and natural-language administration.
  • Define practical guardrails for using AI safely in a security company, protecting customer data and IP.

Grow and Lead a Team of PMs

You will build and develop a high-performing product team as MFT grows:

  • Hire, coach, and grow product managers across regions, raising the bar on product judgment, customer empathy, and execution.
  • Create a clear career path and a culture of ownership, where PMs own outcomes, not just backlogs.
  • Establish lightweight, repeatable product processes for discovery, prioritization, and launch that scale with
    the business.
  • Make every PM on the team AI-fluent through hands-on enablement, shared playbooks, and leading by
    example.Develop future product leaders who can take on new product lines as OPSWAT grows.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 12–18 months, success will look like:

  • A clear, compelling MFT roadmap aligned to market demand and customer value.
  • Measurable growth in bookings and pipeline tied directly to product strategy.
  • Competitive wins displacing legacy MFT solutions in strategic accounts.
  • Strong, trust-based partnerships with Engineering and GTM teams.
  • Delivery of the MFT Gateway and automation offerings that position MFT for long-term growth.
  • An AI-native product team with measurably faster discovery, documentation, and release cycles.
  • A growing, engaged team of PMs with clear ownership and visible development.
  • AI-powered capabilities in the MFT roadmap that customers value and competitors lack.
  • A product organization that moves with urgency, clarity, and accountability.
  • Recognition as a trusted executive voice for MFT inside OPSWAT and across the market.

Who You Are

You are a product leader who blends strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You bring:

  • Proven experience owning enterprise or security products at scale, including business outcomes such as revenue, pricing, and packaging.
  • Deep, hands-on experience using AI in your daily product work, and a clear point of view on how AI changes the PM role. Be ready to show us how you use it.
  • Experience building AI-powered features into enterprise products.
  • A track record of hiring, coaching, and growing product managers into strong leaders.
  • Strong understanding of MFT, secure file transfer protocols (SFTP, FTPS, HTTPS), identity and access (SSO, OAuth, mTLS), or adjacent security domains.
  • Familiarity with the competitive MFT landscape and the compliance needs of regulated industries.
  • A track record of partnering effectively with Engineering to deliver complex products.
  • Commercial acumen and experience supporting bookings, pipeline, and customer conversations.
  • Comfort operating in a global, distributed environment, including close collaboration with teams in Europe.
  • Executive presence, with clear, confident communication and the ability to influence peers, executives, and customers at the C-level.
  • Experience operating as part of an executive or senior leadership team, making portfolio-level tradeoffs.
  • A mindset rooted in ownership, urgency, and continuous improvement.
  • 10+ years in product management, including 5+ years leading teams of PMs. Senior Director or Director-level experience is preferred, but we value demonstrated leadership altitude, judgment, and impact above title alone.

Why OPSWAT?

OPSWAT is a fast-growing cybersecurity company with a strong culture of ownership and innovation. We build products that matter, support leaders who take initiative, and invest in those who want to grow. In this role, you will:

  • Own a revenue-generating product with a large market and meaningful runway.
  • Shape the future of security-first MFT and MFT Gateway innovation.
  • Build and lead your own team, and define what an AI-native product organization looks like.
  • Work with smart, committed teams across the globe, at a company that rewards using AI to move faster.
  • Join the executive product leadership team, with a direct influence on company strategy.
  • If you are looking for a role where your decisions matter, your leadership is visible, and your work protects what matters most, we would love to meet you.

OPSWAT is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to providing an environment where equal employment opportunities are extended to all employees and applicants, free of discrimination and harassment of any type. All employment decisions are based on individual qualifications, job requirements, and business needs without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Recruiting Agencies: we do not accept unsolicited resumes from third party agencies for any of our open positions. jobs.description:
About Bitwarden

Bitwarden is the open source password and secrets management company trusted by more than 15 million users and over 80,000 businesses worldwide. Our products, including Password Manager, Secrets Manager and Passwordless.dev, help individuals, teams and enterprises secure the credentials that run their lives and their companies. We're a fully remote, growth-equity backed company in a scaling phase, and we're building the finance function to match.

About the role

This isn't a classic FP&A seat. Reporting directly to our CFO, you'll own revenue planning and reporting end to end, combining sales finance and strategic finance into one role. You'll be the person who knows our customer and revenue data cold, turns it into the plan, and puts it in front of the executive team and the board.

You'll partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Product and RevOps leaders on how we grow: where we invest in go-to-market, how we price and package a multi-product suite, and which drivers actually move revenue. This role is built for a finance leader who wants a real seat at the table today and sees a CFO role in their future.

What you'll do

Revenue planning and forecasting

  • Build and own the revenue plan, including the annual operating plan, quarterly reforecasts and long-range model, across new business, expansion, renewal and churn.
  • Model the drivers behind the number: pipeline coverage, win rates, sales cycle, ACV, quota capacity and ramp, NRR, GRR and logo churn.
  • Partner with Sales and RevOps on headcount and capacity planning, territory and quota setting, and sales compensation design and cost.

Reporting and board materials

  • Own revenue and customer reporting for the CFO, executive team and board, including ARR bridges, cohort and retention analysis, and KPI dashboards.
  • Build board and investor materials that tell a clear story with accurate numbers.
  • Run the monthly and quarterly business review cadence with GTM leaders, focused on what's working, what isn't and what we're changing.

Strategic finance and pricing

  • Lead pricing and packaging analysis across a multi-product suite: bundle and tier modeling, discounting guardrails, price change impact and new product monetization.
  • Evaluate GTM investments and new motions (channel, public sector, self-serve, enterprise) with clear ROI and payback analysis.
  • Support deal desk on non-standard deals, multi-year terms and pricing exceptions.

Data integrity and systems

  • Be the source of truth for revenue and customer data. Reconcile CRM, billing and ERP data so bookings, billings, ARR and revenue tie out.
  • Partner with Accounting on revenue recognition (ASC 606) inputs and with RevOps on CRM hygiene and definitions.
  • Own and improve our FP&A planning platform and customer revenue cube, and push for automation over spreadsheets.

Team and leadership

  • Build and lead a small, high-performing revenue finance team as the function scales.
  • Act as a trusted thought partner to executives, and challenge assumptions with data when the plan and reality don't match.

What you bring

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, sales finance, strategic finance or a mix, with at least 3 years leading revenue planning.
  • B2B SaaS experience is required, ideally in a PE or growth-equity backed company where you've lived through operating plans, value creation plans and board and lender reporting.
  • Experience helping a SaaS business scale through a major growth stage, such as from roughly $50M to $100M+ in ARR, including the systems and process growing pains that come with it.
  • Deep fluency in SaaS revenue metrics and classic sales motion KPIs: bookings, ARR, NRR and GRR, CAC payback, LTV, pipeline coverage, win rates, quota attainment and capacity.
  • Hands-on experience working with large customer and billing datasets. You're comfortable getting into the data yourself, and SQL or BI tool experience (Looker, Tableau, Power BI) is a strong plus.
  • A track record of pricing and packaging work across multiple products or tiers.
  • Experience building board-level materials and presenting directly to executives.
  • Working knowledge of the finance stack: CRM (Salesforce or HubSpot), ERP (NetSuite or similar), FP&A planning software (Adaptive, Pigment, Anaplan or similar) and customer revenue cube or subscription analytics tools.
  • High ownership and high standards. You set the pace, you sweat the accuracy of your numbers, and you don't wait to be told what to fix.
  • Ambition to grow into a CFO role, and the executive presence to earn that path.
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related field.

Nice to have

  • MBA or CPA.
  • Experience with hybrid revenue models: self-serve or product-led alongside enterprise sales.
  • Exposure to channel, partner or public sector revenue models.
  • Security, identity or developer tools industry experience.
  • Experience in a fully remote company or with globally distributed teams.
  • Background in investment banking, PE or consulting before moving into operating finance.

Why this role

  • Direct line to the CFO and real exposure to the executive team and board.
  • A scaling company where your models shape actual decisions on pricing, GTM investment and product strategy.
  • Room to build: the team, the tooling and the operating cadence are yours to shape.
  • A mission that matters. Our products protect millions of people and businesses every day.

jobs.description:
About Us

Red Cell Partners is an incubation firm building and investing in rapidly scalable technology-led companies that are bringing revolutionary advancements to market in three distinct practice areas: healthcare, cyber, and national security. United by a shared sense of duty and deep belief in the power of innovation, Red Cell is developing powerful tools and solutions to address our Nation’s most pressing problems.

ABOUT DEFCON AI

RESILIENCE IN THE FACE OF DISRUPTION. DEFCON AI is an insights company that leverages artificial intelligence, mathematical optimization, data analytics, and software engineering for resilient optimization of complex systems.
In today’s dynamically changing world, DEFCON AI’s technology aligns outcomes with operational goals, better decision making, and empowers customers to anticipate assess, and mitigate the impacts of disruptions.

About the Role

As QA Engineer you will own quality for an AI-enabled decision-support system: the test plan, the automated coverage, and the evidence that what was delivered is what was specified. Product defines the acceptance criteria. You build the executable version of it, and you hold engineering, platform, and everyone else delivering the work accountable to it.

This role sits on the product side of the organization, not the engineering side. You will report through the Product Lead and take direction from product, while working with engineering and platform every day. A tester embedded in engineering tends to verify what was built, because the implementation is what they see. This role verifies what was specified. A test suite written from the code will pass while still missing what the customer asked for.

That reporting line does not lower the engineering bar. You will write code and build real automation rather than managing test cases, and you will need enough fluency in the application code to test it well. As the first dedicated quality engineering hire you are establishing the approach rather than inheriting one, so we want someone with a clear point of view on how testing should work. We build with current tooling and expect the same, including AI assistance in our own engineering practice.

This is a fully remote role with occasional travel (up to 25%) to DEFCON AI HQ, customer sites, and vendor facilities as required.

Key Responsibilities

Test Strategy and Acceptance Criteria

  • Own the system test plan covering functional, integration, performance, and load testing, and maintain it as a formal deliverable
  • Translate the acceptance criteria set by product into executable tests
  • Review acceptance criteria with product before development begins, and identify requirements that are ambiguous or not verifiable as written
  • Hold engineering, platform, and partner teams accountable to the acceptance criteria, and define what evidence must exist before a change is considered complete
  • Work alongside the engineering team day to day, close enough to test their work well and independent enough to report what the testing shows
  • Plan and coordinate user acceptance testing with the customer, and track findings through to resolution

Test Automation and Coverage

  • Build and maintain automated test suites, and integrate them into the CI/CD pipeline as release gates
  • Establish and hold an automated coverage standard, and report against it
  • Build performance and load testing that validates the system under its expected user load
  • Maintain regression coverage across releases

Measurement and Evidence

  • Build and maintain labeled evaluation sets, working with subject-matter experts whose time is limited
  • Design and run sampled audits confirming that automated decisions were correct
  • Measure and report what the system misses alongside what it gets right
  • Measure how often users override the system, and report the trend
  • Document how each committed measure is computed, on what data, and what evidence accompanies a release
  • Produce this evidence independently of the people building the models

Release Governance

  • Maintain the version inventory across builds, models, configurations, and thresholds
  • Produce test reports, evaluation records, and rollback criteria for each release
  • Work with platform engineering to confirm that test environments match production closely enough for results to be meaningful
  • Hold the gate: no release ships without the evidence its acceptance requires

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years in software quality engineering, test automation, or software engineering with substantial dedicated test ownership
  • A clear point of view on how testing should be done, and the judgment to know which practices are worth holding to. You will be setting the standard here rather than following one
  • Strong coding ability in a language and framework used for test automation, for example Python with pytest, or JavaScript or TypeScript with Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium. Python is what most of this stack is written in. You should also be able to read and reason about the application code under test
  • Routine use of AI-assisted development, with informed judgment about where it adds value and where its output requires verification. We expect AI tooling to be part of how test coverage gets built here, not an occasional experiment
  • Demonstrated experience building automated test suites and integrating them into CI/CD as release gates
  • Experience owning a test plan through review and acceptance
  • Demonstrated habit of testing against the requirement rather than the implementation, including working directly with product owners or end users to establish what correct actually means
  • Experience with performance and load testing, including establishing what a result does and does not demonstrate
  • Working statistical literacy, including sampling design and the confidence a measurement can support
  • Experience measuring what a system misses, not only what it gets right
  • Willingness to report a result the team did not want, and to keep the measurement independent of the people whose work it evaluates
  • Ability to gate work owned by people who do not report to you, and to earn enough credibility with engineers that the gate holds
  • Clear, audit-ready written documentation, since much of the output of this role is evidence that others read
  • Willingness to hold a release, and explain the reason, to people who want it shipped
  • US Citizenship Required
  • Active US Secret clearance. The work is performed in a controlled government cloud environment and requires a favorable investigation and CAC eligibility from the start
  • Elevated security requirements apply to portions of this work and are discussed during the interview process
  • Willingness to travel up to 25% to customer sites, DEFCON AI HQ, and vendor facilities as required

Preferred Qualifications

  • Clearance: active Top Secret
  • Environment: government DevSecOps, RMF, or ATO environments, and experience producing test evidence for a formal accreditation or audit
  • Automation: contract and API testing, test data management, and building test infrastructure others can extend
  • AI-assisted testing: using language models to generate and maintain test coverage, and the practices that keep generated tests meaningful rather than merely passing
  • Performance: JMeter, k6, Locust, or comparable
  • Evaluation: validating machine learning or model output, including groundedness and citation checking, and analyzing where users disagreed with a system recommendation
  • Domain: systems where an incorrect result carries real cost, and where testing had to satisfy an outside reviewer rather than only an internal one
  • Governance: model cards, NIST AI RMF, or comparable responsible AI practice
  • Accessibility: Section 508 and WCAG verification

What Success Looks Like

  • A test plan the customer accepts, and that holds up as the system grows
  • Acceptance criteria that are verifiable before development starts
  • Automated coverage meeting its standard and running as a release gate
  • Sampled audits designed to catch an incorrect automated decision
  • Performance evidence that reflects realistic load
  • A release trail complete enough to reconstruct why any version shipped

What We Offer:

  • A fully remote, results-based environment
  • Competitive salary, bonus, and equity package
  • 100% employer paid, comprehensive health insurance including medical, dental, and vision for you and your family
  • Unlimited PTO, with your manager’s approval
  • Flexible work environment where you manage your work day
  • 14 weeks of fully-paid parental leave

Salary Range: $135,000-$170,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience, skills, and other factors.

Our Red Cell Partners Benefits (may differ for each incubation):

For full-time roles

  • Career track opportunity with potential for rapid advancement with strong performance as the firm grows
  • 100% employer paid, comprehensive health care including medical, dental, and vision for you and your family.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Nucleus Financial Platforms runs its data estate on Microsoft Fabric.
jobs.description:
Nucleus Financial Platforms runs its data estate on Microsoft Fabric. The Data Engineering team ingests data from the group's platform systems and enterprise tools, transforms it through a four layer architecture, and delivers it as a curated data warehouse and semantic model layer. That output supports management information, financial reporting, self service analytics, an emerging AI capability, and regulatory returns under FCA and PRA obligations.
As a Senior Data Engineer you will own the design and delivery of the more complex parts of that platform. You will decide how a new source is onboarded and modelled, what controls it needs before it can be relied on for regulatory and financial reporting, and whether a change is safe to promote. Alongside that you will set the standards the team builds to, lead delivery of significant pieces of work, and develop the engineers around you. It is a hands on engineering role with technical leadership attached, and depending on the shape of the team it may include line management.
How we work
We work in an Agile cycle alongside a Product Owner. Everything we build is version controlled in Azure DevOps and promoted through Fabric deployment pipelines across development, test and live. Development takes place in an isolated feature workspace, every change is peer reviewed before it reaches production, and anything touching regulatory reporting carries an additional test and approval gate. We cover daily platform health checks, and documentation is treated as part of the build rather than an afterthought. In this role you will be expected to shape that way of working, not simply operate within it.
Responsibilities:
  • Own platform and pipeline design: Lead the design of ingestion pipelines and warehouse models, from the first review of a source feed through to a live, reconciled and documented pipeline in production.
  • Set the engineering standards: Define and evolve the team's design standards, naming conventions, load patterns and re-runnability requirements, and make sure they are applied consistently across every source.
  • Own the cross platform model: Lead the design of the conformed layer of the warehouse, resolving differences in identifiers, hierarchies and status models between source platforms so that group level reporting is consistent and reconcilable back to source.
  • Act as technical approver: Provide in depth peer review, give clear and specific feedback, and make the call on whether a change is designed, tested and evidenced well enough to reach production, particularly for regulatory pipelines and semantic models.
  • Lead delivery: Work with our Product Owner to scope, break down, estimate and prioritise work, and lead delivery of data and BI projects against business objectives and timelines.
  • Strengthen the control environment: Design the validation, reconciliation and monitoring controls that sit around the data, own the judgements they depend on such as materiality thresholds, and provide evidence to risk, compliance and audit reviewers.
  • Lead incident resolution and recovery: Take the lead on complex failures, including code and data rollback, establish root cause, and feed the lesson back into standards, documentation and controls.
  • Govern the consumption layer: Own semantic model governance, keeping business logic in version controlled warehouse procedures and measures thin, so that a metric means the same thing wherever it is consumed.
  • Develop the engineers around you: Mentor colleagues through review, pairing and structured knowledge transfer, and make sure no critical pipeline depends on a single person.
  • Line management: Depending on the structure of the team, line manage one or more engineers, covering objectives, development plans, regular one to ones and performance.

  • Engage senior stakeholders: Work directly with finance, risk, compliance and business leads to turn requirements into deliverable solutions, and be straight with them about what the data can and cannot answer.
  • Lead Agile ceremonies: Lead planning, backlog refinement and retrospectives, and drive continuous improvement in how the team works.
Key Skills:
  • Advanced SQL: Advanced SQL development, optimisation and troubleshooting, including complex stored procedure logic over bi-temporal, large data volumes.
  • End to end design ownership: A proven record of designing and delivering pipelines or platforms end to end in a cloud data platform such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Synapse or Databricks, rather than building only to someone else's design.
  • Deep data warehousing knowledge: In depth understanding of dimensional modelling using the Kimball methodology, conformed dimensions, slowly changing dimensions, surrogate key strategies and incremental load patterns.
  • Advanced semantic modelling: Strong semantic model and DAX skills, and a clear view on where logic belongs between the warehouse and the model.
  • Python and automation: Confident with Python for parsing, automation and data handling, ideally in a notebook environment.
  • CI/CD and change control: Strong working knowledge of branching strategy, pull request policy, environment promotion and secret management, and experience operating change control in a governed environment.
  • Data quality by design: Experience designing reconciliation, validation and monitoring controls, and setting the thresholds that decide when a difference is investigated.
  • Incident leadership: Calm and methodical during a live data incident, able to lead diagnosis and recovery and to communicate clearly while it is happening.
  • Mentoring: A genuine interest in developing other engineers and raising the standard of the team's output, through review, pairing and day to day support.
  • Stakeholder management and delivery: Able to manage priorities, expectations and delivery with senior stakeholders, and to push back constructively where a request is not the right answer.
  • Judgement in ambiguity: Comfortable taking an unclear requirement or an undocumented source feed and turning it into a defined, deliverable piece of work.
Desirable Experience:
  • Microsoft Fabric: Hands on experience with the Fabric Lakehouse, Fabric Data Warehouse, Data Pipelines, Notebooks, Git integration and deployment pipelines. A certification such as DP-700 is welcome but not required.
  • Regulated financial services: Experience delivering data used for regulatory reporting, and working with audit, risk and compliance reviewers.
  • Platform and product domain: Wrap, SIPP, pensions or investment platform data.
  • Secure file based feeds: Experience with encrypted file transfers, key management and automated decryption within a controlled environment.
  • AI and data agents: An understanding of how curated data supports AI use cases, and the governance those outputs require.
A little about us
We are the Nucleus Group Services Limited and we help make retirement more rewarding. Here at Nucleus, people come first - whether it’s our colleagues, or the advisers and customers we support, we know that working in partnership and collaboration leads to the best outcomes. Together, we’ve shaped the platform to how it is today. We work hard, and we celebrate hard too.

Our ambition is to create a platform with a difference, putting the customer centre stage meant tearing up the rule book and starting from scratch. We’ve come a long way since then, but our mission remains just as focused. jobs.excerpt: Location: 100% Remote Employment: Full-time, long-term position Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility About UsWe are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies.
jobs.description:
Location: 100% Remote
Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve our engineering workflows, and build practical knowledge across the team.

We are looking for a senior developer who can take ownership of iOS development, deliver reliable software, and help our team become more effective at building applications with AI.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior iOS App Developer with an excellent background in native iOS development using Swift and SwiftUI, together with practical experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into iOS applications.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will develop and improve our iOS application, integrate shared application logic, solve complex technical problems, and establish effective workflows for AI-assisted and agentic development.

Experience with GPS, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Ultra-Wideband (UWB), or related location and proximity technologies would be particularly valuable.

You will also share your knowledge with our internal team, including mentoring a junior team member who is learning to build mobile applications through AI-assisted development, often referred to as “vibe coding.”

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and improve our native iOS application using Swift and SwiftUI.
  • Integrate Kotlin Multiplatform modules into the iOS application and collaborate on shared business logic.
  • Implement platform-specific functionality while maintaining consistent behavior across iOS and Android.
  • Implement and troubleshoot location and proximity features involving GPS, BLE, UWB, and related device capabilities.
  • Address practical iOS challenges such as permissions, application lifecycle, background execution, battery consumption, and device compatibility.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents extensively to implement features, investigate defects, refactor code, and support testing.
  • Set up and improve agentic development workflows, including task decomposition, project context, automated checks, and review processes.
  • Review and validate AI-generated code, taking responsibility for its correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.
  • Test relevant functionality on real devices and investigate issues that automated tests alone may not reveal.
  • Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and clear explanations.
  • Support application signing, release preparation, and distribution through TestFlight and the App Store.
  • Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production iOS applications.
  • Excellent practical knowledge of Swift, SwiftUI, and the iOS development ecosystem.
  • Practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform and its integration into native iOS applications.
  • Solid understanding of application architecture, asynchronous programming, lifecycle management, and state management.
  • Strong debugging skills across application code, shared modules, APIs, and device behavior.
  • Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software.
  • A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents.
  • The ability to assess AI-generated solutions critically and explain technical decisions.
  • Willingness and ability to teach less experienced team members patiently and clearly.
  • The ability to work independently, communicate progress clearly, and take ownership of results in a remote team.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • GPS positioning, location accuracy, geofencing, and sensor data.
  • BLE discovery, advertising, connections, and proximity detection.
  • UWB ranging, distance measurement, direction estimation, and hardware compatibility.
  • NFC and other device-to-device interactions.
  • Interoperability between Swift and Kotlin Multiplatform, including asynchronous operations and error handling.
  • Building automated development and testing workflows that combine human oversight with coding agents.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • Ownership of meaningful iOS development work.
  • The opportunity to shape how our team uses AI and coding agents.
  • Close collaboration with an internal team that wants to learn from your experience.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your role in developing and releasing iOS applications.
  • Your experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into native iOS projects.
  • Any practical experience with GPS, BLE, UWB, or similar technologies.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with an example of how they helped you deliver a working application or feature.
  • Your experience mentoring junior developers or colleagues learning AI-assisted development.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio links, App Store references, or GitHub links are welcome where available.

jobs.excerpt: Commercial Pricing & RFP AnalystAbout Securitas USASecuritas Security Services USA, Inc.
jobs.description:
Commercial Pricing & RFP Analyst

About Securitas USA

Securitas Security Services USA, Inc. is the global leader in protective services, delivering specialized guarding, advanced technology solutions, and comprehensive risk management to clients across a wide range of industries. Our mission is simple yet powerful: to help make your world a safer place. With a proud legacy of 90 years, built on trust, innovation, and international expertise, we take pride in offering security solutions that are tailored to each client’s unique needs. By combining cutting-edge technology with exceptional service, we continue to redefine what safety and security mean in today's world.

What You’ll Do

As a Commercial Pricing & RFP Analyst, you will play an important role in developing competitive, financially sound pricing strategies for new and existing business opportunities. Supporting Global Clients Americas (GCA) National Sales, you will work at the intersection of Sales, Finance, Operations, and Legal, translating RFP requirements, client pricing formats, labor costs, operating expenses, and contractual considerations into thoughtful commercial recommendations.

This is not a traditional Finance role. It is a highly visible, commercially focused position for someone who enjoys using financial analysis to solve business problems, influence decisions, and support growth. The ideal candidate combines strong Excel and financial modeling capabilities with sound commercial judgment, curiosity, and the ability to communicate financial insights to both financial and non-financial stakeholders.

  • Own pricing analysis for RFPs and commercial opportunities, translating client requirements and varying pricing templates into clear, accurate financial models and recommendations.
  • Evaluate the economics of potential business, including labor costs, operating expenses, margin, profitability, contractual requirements, and potential pricing risks while balancing competitiveness with sustainable returns.
  • Partner across Sales, Operations, Finance, and Legal to gather inputs, evaluate commercial considerations, and ensure pricing deliverables are accurate and completed within RFP deadlines.
  • Develop scenario and sensitivity analyses that help business leaders understand pricing alternatives, trade-offs, risks, and potential financial outcomes.
  • Present and summarize financial analysis for business leaders, providing clear insights that support commercial decisions and growth opportunities.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

Who you are

An ideal candidate brings:

  • A service-first mindset, clear communication skills, strong attention to detail, and sound judgment when approaching challenges. The ideal candidate is solutions-focused and thrives in both independent and team settings.
  • A bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field.
  • Experience in pricing, financial analysis, RFP/bid support, or a closely related commercial finance environment.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel and financial modeling skills, particularly related to cost, margin, profitability, and scenario analysis.
  • The ability to evaluate labor costs, operating expenses, contractual requirements, and pricing risk and translate that analysis into actionable business insights.
  • Strong organizational and communication skills, including the ability to manage multiple deliverables and deadlines and clearly summarize financial analysis for leadership.

Experience that sets you apart:

  • Experience supporting pricing requirements and deliverables for complex RFPs or bids.
  • Exposure to contracts and commercial terms and an understanding of how those considerations can affect pricing decisions.
  • Experience evaluating complex bids, pricing, or commercial proposals from the client/buyer side, including procurement, sourcing, or bid analysis. Experience in consulting or professional services supporting similar work is also highly valued.
  • Experience with Power BI.
  • Experience working with CRM or ERP platforms.
  • Experience operating in a cross-functional environment with Sales, Operations, Finance, and Legal stakeholders.

Why you would want to join the team

  • Make a direct impact on growth. Rather than focusing solely on traditional financial reporting, you’ll help shape the pricing and commercial decisions behind new and existing business opportunities.
  • Gain meaningful leadership exposure. The role provides the opportunity to interact with senior decision-makers, including C-suite leaders, AVPs, and Regional Presidents, as opportunities and pricing strategies are evaluated.
  • Broaden your commercial toolkit. You’ll gain experience beyond traditional financial analysis through exposure to pricing, RFPs, contracts, operations, sales, and commercial decision-making.
  • Get closer to the decisions that move the business. You’ll see how financial analysis, client requirements, operational realities, contractual considerations, and sales strategy come together when determining how to approach an opportunity.
  • Take on varied and challenging work. Every client and RFP can bring different information, requirements, and pricing formats, giving you the opportunity to solve new problems rather than work from a single standardized model.
  • Accelerate your development through exposure. This role is well suited to someone with a few years of experience who wants greater challenge, visibility, and the opportunity to build the skills needed to become a strong commercial business partner and decision-maker.
  • This is a U.S.-based remote role, with limited travel anticipated at less than 10%.

Treat PeteDME’s MSK Integrated Care patients from home. Our program pairs knee and lumbar bracing with physical therapy and remote therapeutic monitoring, delivered through a network of in-home therapists. Remote visits and monitoring are paid per visit and per call.

How you join
Every therapist on the remote caseload starts with six in-person brace fittings on patients from your own current caseload, so you know the devices you will be coaching patients on. Each fitting is a paid clinical visit — intake, fitting, and follow-up — at a flat fee agreed in writing before your first patient. We give you a one-page screening tool to identify candidates among the patients you already see, and we handle the prescription, benefit verification, and the paperwork.

This is not a sales role. We do not ask you to refer; you treat patients you already see.

After six fittings
Teletherapy patient referrals from PeteDME begin: our patients, work from home, on your schedule, paid per visit and per call.

What you get
• Free specialized training and certification in orthopedic bracing.
• AI-generated SOAP notes — no new EMR to learn.
• Keep your current job. This is additional, independent-contractor work alongside it.
• Flat fees fixed in advance; no part of your pay depends on volume or on referrals.

Requirements

    • Active physical therapist or physical therapist assistant license in the state where you practice.
    • Currently working in home health or another in-home setting.
    • You evaluate and provide treatment.

How to apply

    Complete the short questionnaire. It asks about your license, your setting, and your caseload, and it asks you to acknowledge that teletherapy referrals begin after six fittings. A clinical onboarding specialist will reach out within one business day.

Position Name: Machine Learning Engineer

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-time

Notes: Direct Hire. No third-party assistance is approved for this role.

About The Job:

At Jaxon, we’re focused on making AI trustworthy for mission-critical environments. Our core technology is built to enable the safe deployment of AI in high-stakes settings, particularly across the Department of Defense. While our company supports both commercial and government applications, this role is dedicated to the defense side. As a Machine Learning Engineer at Jaxon, you’ll be embedded on a sensitive project designed to help solidify the U.S. government's ability to use AI reliably. The work centers on advancing machine learning capabilities to meet the rigor and reliability required for national security operations.

Jaxon’s product, Domain-Specific AI Language (DSAIL), forms the basis of most of our deployments. This role will focus on increasing security and reliability for our customers through implementing and building on DSAIL’s capabilities. A particular emphasis is placed on addressing the fundamental limitations of LLMs – specifically around context and logical reasoning.

The basics of this role requires the ability to:

  • Collaborate Across Teams: Work with cross-functional, geographically distributed teams to integrate ML models into our existing systems and workflows, enhancing product capabilities.

  • Optimize Data Processing and Model Performance: Conduct comprehensive data management including preprocessing, feature engineering, and model evaluation to improve accuracy and efficiency.

  • Technical Proficiency with an NLP focus: Demonstrate solid machine learning engineering experience, particularly with NLP applications and unstructured data in a cloud environment. Fluency in Python is essential.

  • Understand Large Language Models: Intimately familiar with the model deployment process, optimization of LLM parameters for specific behaviors, and a general understanding of LLM functionality and use cases. Previous experience with AI/LLM governance and guardrail development is a big plus.

Soft Skills:

  • Ability to context switch as needed

  • Ability to communicate findings and recommendations clearly and constructively to peers, management, partners, and customers

  • Ability to effectively explain highly technical details to less technically focused decision makers

  • Ability to compartmentalize different projects with different goals

  • Able to communicate clearly and precisely - not just abstractions and "lines-and-boxes"

Specific Technologies:

  • Python

  • Python Data Science Stack - NumPy, Pandas, Scikit Learn, various deep learning and NLP libraries including demonstrable experience with libraries relevant to data manipulation.

  • Langraph, LlamaIndex, and/or other agentic libraries

  • Docker, Docker Compose, K8s, and related container orchestration technologies

  • Hands-on experience running local LLMs using technologies such as Ollama and Transformers

  • Have a comfort level building and training and/or fine-tuning models, not just calling cloud APIs, but you’re resourceful enough to recognize when you can get away with using cloud APIs.

  • Aren’t afraid of digesting academic papers, but you understand that it’s building things that matters.

  • Have an understanding of both the fundamentals and applications of different NLP approaches.

Nice-To-Haves:

  • Some familiarity with knowledge representation

  • Previous experience with consulting on Defense projects involving software development, data science support, especially at service labs or joint commands.

About Jaxon: Jaxon is on a mission to make AI trustworthy. Developed through R&D with the U.S. Department of Defense, Jaxon converts complex rule sets—whether from policy manuals, onboarding playbooks, compliance protocols, or SME conversations—into executable logic. It extracts the key ‘questions’ hidden in unstructured docs, builds rule-driven evaluators, and tracks what’s being asked and why. The result: consistent, auditable, and provable reasoning—bringing structure, oversight, and trust to LLM-driven workflows.

What Makes Jaxon Different?

  • Human First: Our leaders get it — life happens. Whether it’s flexible working hours or understanding the need for a mental health day, we prioritize your well-being. Our CEO recognizes that happy people do the best work and he backs that up with an empathetically led culture – and I’m not just saying that because he’s going to read this post.

  • Laid-Back Culture: We know that the best work comes from a place of comfort and authenticity. At Jaxon, you’re encouraged to be yourself, dress casually, and embrace your quirky side. It’s just one of the benefits of being an early-stage, high-growth startup.

  • Tech Lover's Dream: From hackathons to tech talks with industry leaders, we fuel our passion for innovation with constant learning and development opportunities.

  • Grunt Work to Grand Projects: Every task you tackle, big or small, matters. You think I’m writing job descriptions for fun? Sometimes things need to get done and it’s an all hands on deck situation to get them to the finish line. We're looking for team players who understand that achieving groundbreaking AI innovations sometimes involves rolling up your sleeves to tackle the essential, yet less glamorous tasks.

Added Perks:

  • Unlimited PTO: (seriously!)

  • Comprehensive benefits: Health, dental, and vision insurance + 401k matching

  • Competitive Salary: We provide competitive compensation packages commensurate with experience

  • Stock Options: All compensation plans include stock options - join now and benefit from future acquisitions

  • Holidays Off: ALL federal holidays are paid time off.

About You: You're the type of person who's naturally driven—not necessarily because you built a rocket in your backyard as a kid, but because you have a genuine curiosity about the world of technology. In your spare time, you might find yourself deep-diving into technology subreddits, following the latest industry trends, or exploring which companies are innovating and how. Your passion isn't just about staying informed; it's about thinking how you can take these emerging concepts and scale them up, make them faster, or more impactful. At Jaxon, we're looking for someone who sees a baseline and instinctively wants to build beyond it. If you’re ready to take what exists and make it extraordinary, you’ll fit right in.

We are looking for somebody who thrives in an environment where day-to-day priorities and tasks may rapidly change. The role is not a fit if you value "business as usual".

We value team members who are bold enough to pitch creative ideas, even if they're still rough around the edges or might not make the final cut.

Education and Length of Experience

Applicants should have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science or similar. An MS or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Physics, Mathematics or any related Engineering field preferred. Candidates should have a minimum 5 years of experience in similar roles.

Jaxon is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or Veteran status.

Location: 100% Remote

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve engineering workflows, and share practical knowledge.

We are looking for a senior engineer who can connect mobile development, backend services, databases, and infrastructure into a reliable development and delivery process.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior Mobile & Platform Engineer who can work across Android and iOS, contribute to our Kotlin Multiplatform architecture, and support our dedicated developers on both platforms.

Your main focus will be enabling the team to deliver effectively: resolving technical challenges, maintaining shared components, improving development workflows, and managing the backend and infrastructure that support the application.

You will also contribute directly to implementation where needed. Depending on your experience and suitability, the role may include technical team leadership for our Android and iOS developers.

Strong GitHub, GitHub Actions, and runner-management experience is essential. Practical experience with AI-assisted and agentic development is equally important.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support our Android and iOS developers with technical decisions, debugging, code reviews, and integration challenges.
  • Develop and maintain shared application logic using Kotlin Multiplatform.
  • Contribute to native Android and iOS development where platform-specific work is required.
  • Maintain a clear architecture across mobile applications, backend services, APIs, and databases.
  • Develop and maintain backend functionality and server-side integrations.
  • Manage database changes, investigate data-related issues, and maintain reliable migration, backup, and recovery processes.
  • Build and improve CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions.
  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot GitHub runners, including self-hosted runners.
  • Improve build reliability, automated testing, deployment processes, and development environments.
  • Manage server-side application deployments, configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
  • Establish effective AI-assisted and agentic coding workflows across the team.
  • Review AI-generated code and ensure that changes are tested, understandable, secure, and maintainable.
  • Help developers and junior team members use AI tools effectively through practical demonstrations and knowledge sharing.
  • Where appropriate, act as technical team lead: coordinate dependencies, guide implementation, review technical decisions, and help the team resolve blockers.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience in mobile software development.
  • Strong Kotlin and Android development experience, together with practical Swift and iOS development experience.
  • Solid hands-on experience with Kotlin Multiplatform and integrating shared code into both mobile platforms.
  • The ability to investigate problems across mobile clients, APIs, backend services, databases, and infrastructure.
  • Practical backend development experience and a sound understanding of API design, authentication, and application security.
  • Strong SQL and relational database experience, including schema changes, migrations, and performance troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on DevOps experience with Linux servers, application deployment, configuration, and operational troubleshooting.
  • Excellent Git and GitHub knowledge, including pull requests, code reviews, branch workflows, and repository configuration.
  • Strong experience with GitHub Actions and configuring and maintaining GitHub runners.
  • Substantial experience using AI coding assistants and coding agents to deliver working software.
  • The ability to establish development workflows that combine coding agents, automated checks, and human review.
  • Clear communication, practical documentation skills, and a willingness to share knowledge.
  • The ability to work independently while supporting other developers constructively.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Previous experience as a technical lead or senior engineer supporting a mobile development team.
  • GPS, BLE, UWB, NFC, or other location and proximity technologies.
  • Testing mobile applications on real devices and investigating platform-specific behavior.
  • Container-based application deployment and reproducible development environments.
  • Monitoring, incident diagnosis, and maintaining reliable backend services.
  • Coordinating changes that affect mobile applications, backend APIs, and database structures together.

Potential Technical Team Lead Responsibilities

For a suitable candidate, the role can include technical leadership of our Android and iOS developers.

This would involve helping the team make consistent technical decisions, breaking down implementation work, coordinating shared dependencies, and maintaining the quality of delivered changes. You should be comfortable mentoring developers and taking responsibility for the technical direction while remaining actively involved in engineering.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • A central role supporting our mobile development team.
  • The opportunity to shape our architecture, infrastructure, and agentic development workflows.
  • Potential technical teamlead responsibility, depending on suitability.
  • Close collaboration with a team that values practical knowledge sharing.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your experience developing for both Android and iOS, including Kotlin Multiplatform.
  • Your backend, database, and server infrastructure responsibilities.
  • Examples of GitHub Actions workflows and runner environments you have configured or maintained.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with examples of delivered results.
  • Your experience supporting developers, mentoring colleagues, or leading a technical team.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio links, GitHub repositories, and released application references are welcome where available.

About the Team

College Board’s Operations division is a best-in-class digital assessment delivery and customer engagement function that supports millions of students and thousands of test centers, annually. The Operations team is also leading exciting work to advance customer experience using innovative solutions, products, and technology to enhance the end-to-end delivery of digital assessments and all aspects of customer support. Within Operations, the Assessment Delivery Operations (ADO) team is responsible for the successful execution of digital assessments like the SAT and Advanced Placement examinations, working closely with partners across College Board, the education sector, and beyond to improve testing technologies, customer experience, and outcomes. The Resolve team serves as trusted experts in post-administration issue resolution for SAT and AP assessments, ensuring issues reported by educators and students are resolved efficiently, protecting the integrity of our assessments and the validity of student scores.


About the Opportunity

As Senior Director, Assessment Exceptions & Integrity, you will lead the team that resolves testing irregularities, incidents, and complaints for College Board assessments, protecting the integrity of our assessments and ensuring every student tests on a level playing field. You will set the strategy and operating model for how issues are identified, investigated, and resolved at scale, leading the shift from manual case handling to automated, insight-driven operations. You will directly manage a team of ~10 that owns Resolve’s day-to-day execution, building the habits and infrastructure to turn case trends, operational metrics, and root-cause findings into action. Partnering closely with Deliver, Technology, and Product leaders, you will drive the improvements that prevent issues before test day.

Set Resolve Strategy and Performance (40%)

  • Design and evolve an operating model that scales with case volume and complexity

jobs.description:
The Company

At Springboard, we’re on a mission to bridge the world’s skills gap, offering transformative online education in data science, UI/UX design, machine learning, and coding. Our courses may be tech-enabled, but we're ultimately human-centric: each student taps into a vast community throughout their time with us, engaging with fellow students, industry-expert mentors, student advisors, and career coaches, the goal of which is to successfully transition students into their dream job. Through this hybrid approach, we’ve helped thousands of learners revamp their careers and, by extension, their lives, with hundreds of top-notch job offers received every year and a near-perfect placement rate for our program graduates.

Overview:

Location: Remote (U.S.) | Contract, Part-Time (6-10 hrs/week)

Pay rate: Up to $35 an hour, pending location and experience

Overview:

Springboard is launching an online Surgical Technician Career Training program designed to prepare aspiring Surgical Technicians with no prior healthcare experience for entry-level operating room careers and the Tech in Surgery – Certified (TS-C) certification exam through the National Center for Competency Testing (NCCT).

Springboard is seeking experienced, certified Surgical Technicians to serve as student mentors throughout the program. Mentors support learners through weekly 1:1 coaching, applied concept reinforcement, surgical skills guidance, and certification readiness as students progress through a structured 18-week didactic curriculum.

Because this is a first-time program launch, mentors will also serve as instructional partners, helping identify where students struggle, how classroom concepts translate into operating room practice, and how learner support can continuously improve throughout the program.

This role is distinct from the Live Instructor role and does not include large-group lecture delivery responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities

Student Mentorship & Support

  • Meet weekly with assigned students in scheduled 1:1 mentorship sessions (approximately 30 minutes each)
  • Reinforce key surgical technology concepts aligned to the TS-C certification exam
  • Help students connect weekly coursework to real-world operating room workflows
  • Build student confidence navigating unfamiliar healthcare terminology, surgical procedures, and operating room expectations
  • Provide encouragement, accountability, individualized study strategies, and structured progress coaching
  • Reinforce professional behaviors expected of Surgical Technicians working within the surgical team

Certification & Clinical Readiness Support

Help students prepare for both certification and clinical practice by reinforcing topics including:

  • Surgical anatomy, physiology, microbiology, and pharmacology
  • Infection prevention, aseptic technique, and sterile field maintenance
  • Surgical instrumentation and equipment preparation
  • Operating room setup and patient preparation
  • Intraoperative assisting techniques
  • Surgical counts, specimen management, and documentation
  • Surgical specialties and procedure-specific workflows
  • Postoperative procedures and OR turnover

Additional Responsibilities Include:

  • Share practical strategies for TS-C exam preparation and knowledge retention
  • Help students identify concepts requiring additional review
  • Reinforce the seven core surgical lab skills learners will demonstrate through graded video submissions and later validate during the onsite Clinical Skills Lab
  • Prepare students for success transitioning into the Clinical Skills Lab and subsequent externship involving completion of 125 required surgical scrub cases.

Applied Industry Context

  • Help students understand expectations of hospital and ambulatory surgery center operating rooms
  • Share examples from real surgical workflows and case experiences
  • Help learners understand the role of the Surgical Technician within the interdisciplinary surgical team
  • Reinforce patient safety, professionalism, communication, and teamwork expectations
  • Help learners understand how classroom concepts directly translate into surgical practice

Asynchronous Student Support

  • Respond to student questions related to course concepts between mentorship sessions
  • Maintain visibility into student engagement and academic progress
  • Identify learners at risk and escalate concerns to the Springboard learner support team
  • Document mentorship sessions and learner progress according to program expectations

Program Collaboration

  • Partner with Live Instructors, Advisors, Clinical Skills Lab trainers, and the Learning Experience team to surface student learning trends
  • Share recurring student misconceptions and opportunities to strengthen curriculum or support resources
  • Provide feedback on learner preparedness for clinical skills demonstrations and certification readiness
  • Contribute insights that strengthen future cohorts and overall learner outcomes

Qualifications

Required

  • Active Tech in Surgery – Certified (TS-C) credential through the National Center for Competency Testing (NCCT)
  • Minimum 3–5 years of experience working as a Surgical Technician
  • Experience working in a hospital operating room strongly preferred
