jobs.title: Principal Agentic Engineer, AI Ecosystem
jobs.excerpt: About Life360Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love.
jobs.description:
About Life360

Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 107.7 million monthly active users (MAU), as of September 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit .

Life360 is a Remote-First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US) regardless of any specified location above.

We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

Life360's AI ecosystem is being built by three teams working from a shared 2027 vision, each owning a distinct layer:

  • AI Platforms — the foundational infrastructure and company-wide AI governance: gateways and MCP connector infra, cost and spend controls, observability and safety guardrails, the agent deployment/orchestration platform, and knowledge graphs.
  • AI Dev Tooling (AI DevX) — AI-powered developer tools that remove friction across the software development lifecycle: coding assistance and productivity tooling, automated and agentic testing, and the codified primitives (CLAUDE.md, evals) that make shared and monolithic repos legible to AI.
  • Agentic PDLC — agents that remove humans from common, repetitive product-development work: on-call investigation, bug triage, code review, and release, consolidated under a single owner instead of being built ad hoc team-by-team.

These teams deliberately don't own everything. A set of foundational questions — non-human identity and agent authZ, model regression eval frameworks, workflow/agent eval infrastructure, atomic agent-unit definitions, agent standards for what an agent can never do — sit in the shared space between them, ready to be addressed.

About the Job

We're hiring a Principal-level Agentic Engineer to hold the system view across AI Platforms, AI DevX, and Agentic PDLC — and to give the unowned middle ground between them an owner. This is not a coordination role. You'll have clear, end-to-end ownership of a defined set of cross-cutting problems, not an open-ended advisory brief. It's an architecture-and-build role for someone who can define what an "agent" is as a reusable unit at Life360, set the standards that make agents safe and evaluable, build an ecosystem that supports our agents, and then help each team build to that architecture. In addition, this role will craft the vision for how our broad agent ecosystem will evolve into the future.

The role operates at two altitudes, and needs to be genuinely strong at both:

  • Strategic: set the technical vision for Life360's AI-Native developer ecosystem — the architecture that lets AI Platforms, AI DevX, and Agentic PDLC build against shared primitives instead of re-solving the same problems three times.
  • Tactical: get into the core components yourself — agent execution frameworks, context and retrieval systems, eval harnesses, identity and authZ for unattended agents — and ship the parts that are too foundational to leave to any one team, or that no team currently owns.

You'll partner closely with the AI Platforms, AI Dev Tooling, Agentic PDLC, and our Product leadership (as their technical counterpart), but you won't report through any single one of them — your mandate is the seams between all of them.

The US-based salary range for this position is $247,000 to $363,000. We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers.

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.

What You'll Do

Architect across the ecosystem

  • Hold the system view across AI Platforms, AI DevX, and Agentic PDLC, so investments compose instead of collide.
  • Drive build-vs-buy decisions for PDLC-critical agents, and for ecosystem-wide capabilities where an outside vendor may out-deliver an internal build.
  • Build the ecosystem that supports agents as we define them today and shapes how they evolve: execution frameworks, context and retrieval systems, and telemetry that treat token spend as a first-class design constraint.

Define & own the unowned middle

  • Define what an agent is at Life360 — a reusable unit, the interface it exposes, and the standards it must meet (human-in-the-loop and blast-radius policy, eval standards, promotion gates) — in partnership with AI Platforms, who will operate the resulting infrastructure long-term.
  • Design the non-human identity and agent authZ model that unblocks scheduled and unattended agents across every team.
  • Stand up eval and regression infrastructure (framework, CI hooks, result storage) as a shared capability rather than three parallel bets.

Build, hands-on

  • Avoid “ivory tower” syndrome by shipping production code against the highest-leverage components yourself — you're a builder first, not an advisor who hands off specs.
  • Get close to live bets, such as the on-call investigation agent, to validate the architecture under real usage and economics, and prototype and de-risk the hardest pieces before asking any team to commit engineering time.

Lead without owning the org chart

  • Mentor Agentic Engineers and Staff engineers across all three teams on agent architecture, context engineering, and evaluation rigor, and help grow the senior technical bench.
  • Write the architecture decision records, standards docs, and playbooks that AI Platforms, AI DevX, and Agentic PDLC can each build against independently, and represent a coherent technical point of view in build-vs-buy and roadmap discussions, even without formal authority over the teams involved.

What We're Looking For

  • 12+ years of engineering experience, including deep platform or systems architecture work at consumer scale (50M+ MAU or equivalent preferred).
  • Demonstrated experience architecting agentic systems in production — not just using AI coding tools, but designing the frameworks, identity models, and eval infrastructure that other agents run on.
  • Direct experience with non-human identity, service-account, or agent authZ models — or a clear, well-reasoned point of view on how to build one.
  • Experience designing and consuming structured interfaces for AI systems (MCP-style tool definitions, JSON Schema, OpenAPI) and building for tool-calling and contract-first agent development.
  • A track record of building eval and regression frameworks for AI systems — promotion gates, scoring, and CI integration — not just running evals ad hoc.
  • Strong architectural instincts across multiple services and teams, with the judgment to know which problems deserve a shared platform investment and which don't.
  • Fluency in AI economics — token cost as a design constraint, progressive retrieval, and the tradeoffs between centralizing and forking model usage.
  • A track record of driving technical direction across teams you don't manage — through documentation, prototypes, and demonstrated results rather than mandates.
  • Excellent written communication: architecture decision records, standards, and playbooks precise enough for other engineers (and their agents) to build against directly.

Bonus Points

  • Experience building or operating an agent orchestration or deployment platform, or an MCP-style connector gateway.
  • Background in ML infrastructure, model observability, or production AI systems at a company that has been through a comparable AI-native transformation.
  • Experience with mobile engineering (iOS/Android) or high-throughput cloud systems, and how agent architecture needs to flex across both.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for employees)
  • Paid parental leave
  • 401(k) plan with company matching program
  • Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being
  • Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns
  • Learning & Development programs
  • Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment
  • Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers

AI Usage: We use AI to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Life360 hiring teams

Life360 Values

Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference

  • Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.
  • Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard.
  • Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families.
  • High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done.

Our Commitment to Belonging

Life360 is an equal opportunity employer. We don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected status. We believe diverse perspectives make us better, and we’re building a workplace that reflects the communities we serve. Don’t meet every qualification? Apply anyway.

Description

The eCOA and RTSM Application Specialist is responsible for supporting the design, deployment, configuration, and oversight of electronic Clinical Outcome Assessment (eCOA) solutions—including ePRO, eConsent, and other patient-centric electronic data capture tools— and of Randomization and Trial Supply Management (RTSM) across global clinical studies.

This role collaborates with cross-functional teams, Sponsors, and external vendors to ensure that eCOA and RTSM systems are implemented in alignment with study protocols, regulatory expectations, and industry standards. The eCOA and RTSM Specialist acts as a subject matter expert throughout the study lifecycle to ensure reliable data collection, optimal user experience, and data integrity.

RESPONSIBILITIES

More specifically, the eCOA and RTSM Application Specialist must:

  • Act as cCOA and RTSM subject matter expert during study start-up, maintenance, and close-out.
  • Define functional requirements and participate in the design and configuration of eCOA and RTSM solutions.
  • Draft and maintain system specifications, user requirements, edit checks, notifications, and reporting requirements.
  • Assist with the design of eCOA-related Case Report Forms (CRFs).
  • Create User Acceptance Testing (UAT) test scripts and coordinate or perform system validation testing.
  • Validate eCOA logic, rules, and study calculations against protocol requirements.
  • Support CDISC-compliant data mapping and collaborate with Clinical Data Standards teams.
  • Contribute to the development of data cleaning strategies and review relevant plans (e.g., DMP, edit check specifications).
  • Prepare study-specific training materials (site guides, participant instructions, etc.) and support training delivery as needed.
  • Lead or participate in internal and sponsor meetings related to system setup, changes, and issue management.
  • Document system configuration and file eCOA and RTSM deliverables into the Trial Master File (TMF).
  • Manage updates, amendments, and change requests throughout the study lifecycle.
  • Troubleshoot issues, escalate risks, and ensure timely resolution with vendors and project teams
  • Ensure eCOA and RTSM activities comply with ICH-GCP, FDA, EMA, and other relevant regulatory standards.
  • Contribute to SOPs, work instructions, process improvement initiatives, templates, and eCOA and RTSM standards.
  • Support continuous improvement, training, and knowledge sharing within Clinical Data Management.
  • Stay current on emerging eCOA and RTSM technologies, regulatory trends, and best practices.
  • Support vendor evaluation, standardization, and relationship management when applicable.
  • Act as a resource for cross-functional teams regarding cCOA and RTSM processes, timelines, and risks.

Employee may be assigned to other responsibilities that do not pertain to their former description, if they have the required experience, are qualified and/or have received adequate training

Requirements

PROFILE

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Computer Science, Health Sciences, or related field.
  • 3–5 years of experience in eCOA, EDC, IRT, or eClinical solutions within a CRO, pharma, or health-technology environment.
  • Strong knowledge of eCOA systems and patient-reported outcomes (ePRO).
  • Solid understanding of clinical trial processes and data management principles (CDISC knowledge is an asset).
  • Experience with system configuration, UAT, edit checks, and validation activities.
  • Ability to collaborate in cross-functional settings and manage multiple priorities.
  • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Global trial experience and knowledge of regulatory expectations (FDA, EMA, GDPR, HIPAA).
  • Attention to quality and data integrity
  • Technical curiosity and digital mindset
  • Problem solving and escalation awareness
  • Stakeholder communication and collaboration
  • Organization, accountability, and autonomy

Good knowledge of good clinical practices, and applicable Health Canada and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations/guidelines.

Our company

﻿The work environment

At Indero, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.

In this position, you will be eligible for the following perks:

  • Flexible work schedule
  • Permanent full-time position
  • Ongoing learning and development

jobs.description:
Senior Legal Contracts Manager

What you will be doing:


At Premier, we take pride in the business of serving patients by serving the healthcare providers who meet the needs of those patients, in every area of their care. As a group purchasing organization (GPO), we negotiate contracts for the goods and services our members use every day, and those contracts are where our commitments to members and suppliers become real. This role exists because that paper has to be accurate, readable and defensible — often on a short clock.


Reporting to the [Associate General Counsel or Senior Corporate Counsel], the Senior Contract Specialist is a senior, hands-on contracting professional who works alongside Premier’s attorneys to support the day-to-day contracting needs of Premier’s supply chain service lines. In this role you will draft and revise straightforward commercial agreements, amendments, statements of work, confidentiality agreements, legal correspondence and internal policy documents; review and disposition contract redlines returned from negotiations across all Premier supply chain service lines; and lead or participate in negotiations directly with business counterparts and counterparties. You will also help maintain the templates, fallback language and playbooks that make the team faster over time.


The person in this role works independently on routine and moderately complex contracting matters with limited direction, escalating novel, high-risk or ambiguous issues to counsel with a clear summary and a recommended path. This position requires work in a fast-paced and business-competitive GPO environment and interacts with business unit leaders and their management, sourcing and field teams, Premier members, and suppliers of goods and services to Premier’s members. Success in this role depends as much on business fluency as on drafting skill: you will be expected to learn Premier’s supply chain service lines well enough to articulate the business case behind each contractual engagement and to discuss legal risk with business leaders in their own language.


In this role, you may choose to work from our Charlotte, NC office according to your preferred schedule, or remotely. We will consider candidates whose experience may not align perfectly with every qualification listed below as a combination of relevant skills, experience, and potential for success may be equally valuable. If this role interests you and you believe you can make a meaningful contribution, we encourage you to apply. Current Premier employees with sourcing, contracting or field operations experience are also encouraged to apply. This position does not practice law or provide legal advice; all work is performed under the supervision of licensed Premier attorneys.

Responsibility #1– 40%


Contract Development and Management

  • Draft and revise straightforward commercial contracts, amendments, order forms, statements of work, confidentiality agreements, legal letters and internal policy documents, working from approved templates and from scratch, for Premier’s supply chain service lines and our member-facing contracting.
  • Read, interpret and explain contracts and other legal documents independently, including identifying obligations, termination and renewal mechanics, pricing and fee terms, and inconsistencies across a document set.
  • Prepare clear written summaries and recommendations for counsel and business owners; escalate novel, high-risk or ambiguous issues with a proposed resolution.

Responsibility #2 – 40%

  • Review contract redlines returned from negotiations across all Premier supply chain service lines; identify substantive changes, departures from Premier’s approved positions and unacceptable risk shifts; and recommend or apply responsive language.
  • Lead negotiations directly with business counterparts and counterparty representatives on assigned agreements, and participate in more complex negotiations alongside attorneys and business owners.
  • Track open issues, deal status and turnaround commitments so that matters move to closure and nothing stalls; communicate status proactively to business owners and counsel.

Responsibility #3 – 20%

  • Serve as a responsive point of contact for internal clients in sourcing, operations and member field teams, translating business objectives into workable contract language and legal risk into business terms.
  • Develop, maintain and improve contract templates, clause libraries, fallback positions and negotiation playbooks; contribute to improvement of contracting processes and intake.
  • Maintain accurate contract records in Premier’s contract lifecycle management system; respond to inquiries from Premier members and suppliers; support special projects as needed.

jobs.description:
The Integration Architect is responsible for designing, developing and governing integrations between Affidea’s clinical and business applications, with a primary focus on healthcare interoperability and the Group’s central integration platform.

A key responsibility of the role is the technical ownership, development and continuous improvement of Affidea’s Central Mirth integration platform, which provides standardized integration capabilities between country-level and Group-level clinical systems.

The Integration Architect combines solution architecture with hands-on integration development. The role is expected not only to define integration designs and standards, but also to develop, configure, test, troubleshoot and optimize interfaces and integration components.

The role works closely with Group and Country IT teams, application owners, clinical IT teams, project teams and external vendors to ensure reliable, secure and scalable exchange of healthcare information between systems such as HIS, RIS, PACS, LIS and other clinical and operational platforms.

The Integration Architect also drives the standardization of healthcare integrations across Affidea, reducing unnecessary point-to-point integrations and establishing reusable integration services and patterns.

Healthcare Integration Architecture

  • Design end-to-end integrations between healthcare applications including HIS, RIS, PACS, LIS and other clinical systems.
  • Define integration architecture and data flows between local country systems and central Group platforms.
  • Design and maintain integration solutions using healthcare interoperability standards including HL7 v2, FHIR and DICOM.
  • Define standardized integration patterns for patient, appointment, order, result and other clinical information exchange.
  • Analyze existing healthcare workflows and interfaces and propose improved or standardized integration solutions.
  • Support the transition from country-specific and point-to-point interfaces towards reusable Group integration services.
  • Produce and maintain integration architecture diagrams, interface specifications, message flows and technical documentation.
  • Ensure appropriate consideration of patient safety, data integrity, availability and traceability when designing healthcare integrations.

Central Mirth Platform

  • Take technical ownership of Affidea’s Central Mirth integration platform and its integration architecture.
  • Design and develop Mirth channels supporting communication between Group and country-level systems.
  • Configure and maintain Mirth source and destination connectors, transformers, filters and routing logic.
  • Develop message transformations and routing rules for healthcare and application integrations.
  • Implement and maintain HL7 and other message-processing workflows within Mirth.
  • Develop custom scripts and components where required to support complex integration requirements.
  • Design reliable message processing including acknowledgement handling, retries, queues, error handling and message recovery.
  • Monitor and optimize integration performance and message processing.
  • Troubleshoot complex integration problems including connectivity, message format, transformation, routing and application-level issues.
  • Analyze failed, delayed or duplicate messages and perform root-cause analysis.
  • Define monitoring, alerting and logging requirements for the central integration platform.
  • Support high availability, scalability and business continuity requirements of the Central Mirth environment.
  • Establish development, testing and deployment standards for Mirth channels and integration components.
  • Maintain appropriate version control and release management for integration developments.

Integration Development

  • Perform hands-on development of integration solutions as a core part of the role.
  • Develop and maintain interfaces, APIs, integration services, scripts and message transformations.
  • Develop integration logic using technologies such as JavaScript, Java, C#, SQL or other relevant technologies.
  • Build and consume REST APIs and web services.
  • Develop data transformation and mapping logic between different source and target data structures.
  • Work with XML, JSON, HL7 and other structured message formats.
  • Develop database integration components and queries where required.
  • Implement appropriate validation, error handling, logging and reconciliation mechanisms.
  • Create reusable integration components and libraries to accelerate future integration development.
  • Perform unit and integration testing of developed interfaces.
  • Support UAT and production deployments.
  • Investigate and resolve production integration incidents where development-level expertise is required.

Healthcare Interoperability

  • Define and maintain Affidea standards for healthcare interoperability.
  • Work extensively with HL7 v2 messages, including common ADT, ORM, ORU and SIU workflows.
  • Design and support FHIR-based integrations where appropriate.
  • Understand and support DICOM-related workflows and integration with medical imaging environments.
  • Work with clinical and technical stakeholders to understand healthcare workflows and translate them into integration requirements.
  • Ensure correct patient identification and appropriate handling of patient and clinical data across integrated systems.
  • Support integration between scheduling, patient administration, clinical reporting and medical imaging systems.
  • Work with vendors to understand and validate their healthcare integration capabilities and interface specifications.

API and Application Integration

  • Design and develop integrations using REST APIs, web services, messaging and other integration technologies.
  • Define standards for API-based communication and reusable integration services.
  • Design synchronous and asynchronous integration patterns according to business and technical requirements.
  • Support integration with cloud-based and on-premise applications.
  • Define common approaches for authentication, authorization, error handling, retry mechanisms and API versioning.
  • Work with external vendors to design and implement interfaces between vendor solutions and the Affidea environment.

Integration Monitoring & Operations

  • Ensure integrations can be effectively monitored and supported in production.
  • Define end-to-end monitoring and alerting for critical healthcare interfaces.
  • Implement appropriate logging and technical traceability.
  • Establish processes for identifying failed, delayed or duplicate messages.
  • Support root-cause analysis of integration incidents.
  • Work with support teams to establish appropriate operational procedures and escalation paths.
  • Identify recurring incidents and implement permanent technical improvements rather than relying on manual operational workarounds.
  • Continuously improve integration reliability, performance and maintainability.

Architecture & Technical Governance

  • Act as the technical authority for healthcare integration solutions.
  • Define and maintain Affidea integration architecture standards and development guidelines.
  • Review integration designs proposed by internal teams and external vendors.
  • Ensure new integrations follow agreed architecture and interoperability standards.
  • Promote reusable integration components and standardized interfaces across Affidea countries.
  • Reduce unnecessary direct system-to-system integrations where centralized or reusable integration services provide a more sustainable solution.
  • Evaluate new integration technologies and healthcare interoperability approaches where relevant.

Projects & Stakeholder Management

Provide technical guidance and mentoring to developers and other technical team members.

jobs.description:
👉 About the job

At Enertis Applus+, we are looking for a Renewable Energy Consultant to join our Consulting team in Poland. In this role, you will support the technical assessment of renewable energy projects across Poland and Eastern Europe, delivering feasibility studies and technical due diligence for solar PV, wind and Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS). You will work closely with developers, investors and financial institutions, providing technical expertise throughout the project development and investment process.

🛠️ What will you do?

Your main responsibilities will include: Conduct feasibility studies and technical due diligence for renewable energy projects. Assess project sites, identifying technical, environmental and permitting constraints. Review permits, licenses, authorizations and regulatory documentation. Evaluate grid connection agreements and coordinate technical discussions with TSOs and DSOs. Review engineering documentation at conceptual, basic and detailed design stages. Identify technical risks and recommend mitigation measures. Prepare high-quality technical reports and client deliverables in English. Support commercial proposals, tenders and client presentations. Contribute to business development activities across the Polish and Eastern European markets.

🎯 What are we looking for?

We are looking for talent, not perfection. If you believe you can contribute to the team, even if your profile does not fit 100%, we want to hear from you.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering or another STEM discipline. 5+ years of experience in renewable energy development, engineering or consultancy. Experience with Solar PV, Wind and/or BESS projects. Strong knowledge of the Polish renewable energy market, permitting processes, grid connection and applicable regulations. Experience preparing technical due diligence or feasibility studies. Strong analytical, reporting and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and client management abilities. Fluent Polish and good command of English. Spanish is considered a plus.

🌍 What do we offer?

Opportunity to work on renewable energy projects across Poland and Eastern Europe. The opportunity to join a consolidated technical team that is a benchmark in the sector. Professional growth opportunities with a well-defined career plan. Be part of a company in constant expansion. Flexible work arrangement with remote working from Poland. Full-time or part-time collaboration under an Employment Contract or B2B agreement. International and multidisciplinary working environment.

🤝 Diversidad e inclusión

En Barlovento Applus+, promovemos un entorno de trabajo diverso, equitativo e inclusivo. Valoramos a todas las personas independientemente de su género, edad, origen, orientación sexual, capacidades o creencias. Apostamos por el talento sin etiquetas.

jobs.description:
About the Company

Global University Systems (GUS) is one of the world’s most dynamic, inclusive, and diverse education organisations. GUS is an international network of higher education institutions, brought together by a shared passion for accessible and industry-relevant qualifications. We deliver a wide variety of programmes, including bachelor’s degree programmes, master’s degree programmes, professional training, English Language training, and corporate & executive education. When someone chooses to study at one of our institutions, whether on campus in Europe, North America, Asia or even in their own home, they are joining a network of over 100,000 students worldwide. When you decide to work with GUS, you will be joining an industry leading, global organisation that has a reach in over 150 different countries.

Role Summary

Are you a gifted wordsmith with a knack for transforming ideas into compelling stories that engage audiences and drive action? As a Creative Copywriter at GUS, you will leverage innovative writing techniques and digital tools to captivate our prospective students and meet our organizational goals. We're looking for creative individuals with a passion for excellence and a drive for results.

As a Creative Copywriter, you will contribute to GUS' worldwide content initiatives, harnessing the power of technology and digital platforms to create unique and engaging campaigns that resonate with our brand's ethos. Your work will span across various channels, including organic and paid social media, PPC, SEO and local marketing efforts, harmonizing these elements to build a best-in-class content portfolio.

To excel in this role, you should be an exceptional communicator with a proven ability to conceptualize and implement creative ideas. You should know when to apply technology to accelerate the writing process and when human creativity is essential to the process.

To be an ideal candidate, you will have had extensive experience producing powerful written content for multinational companies. You should be a natural team player who wants to contribute to a creative environment where everyone can produce their best work.

If you're a passionate communicator who is excited by the prospect of shaping the future narratives of our brands and making an impact on a global scale, we invite you to apply for this exhilarating opportunity.

Key Activities and Responsibilities

As a Creative Copywriter at GUS, you will be responsible for:

  • Developing compelling and creative copy for various organic and paid mediums, including social media, PPC, SEO, print and digital campaigns, and email journeys, while ensuring consistency in tone, style, and voice across all platforms and institutions.
  • Utilizing technology and AI tools to enhance the copywriting process, while understanding when a human touch is necessary for the crafting of content.
  • Working in alignment with the overall company's goals and marketing strategies, ensuring that your written content supports these objectives and helps to deliver the desired message to the targeted audience.
  • Staying up to date on the latest trends in content and copywriting, implementing best practices in daily tasks and continuously seeking innovative ways to improve the quality and impact of written content.
  • Working in coordination with the marketing teams to maintain a content calendar that aligns with the company's broader marketing and business goals.
  • Ensuring all content and communication efforts take diversity, equity and inclusion (DEI) into consideration.
  • Contributing to content audits on a regular basis to assess the effectiveness of our copywriting efforts, providing useful recommendations for improvements based on key metrics and analysis.
  • Assisting in managing relationships with GUS’ internal brand partners, ensuring clear, persuasive and effective copy is provided for all collaborative efforts.
  • Maintaining a high level of quality control to ensure all produced copy aligns with brand guidelines and is free of errors.

Qualifications and Education

Essential

  • Undergraduate level or equivalent work experience

Desirable

· Digital marketing qualification

· Writing qualification

Experience

  • Significant (5+ years) experience in creative copywriting for multiple channels, including social media, PPC, SEO, content marketing and PR.
  • Demonstrated experience (2+ years) in a team-oriented environment, with the ability to collaborate and contribute to team projects.
  • Strong research and analytical skills, including the ability to understand audience sentiment, analyse content performance and optimize copy based on performance data.
  • An understanding of, and demonstrated interest in, emerging technologies that may impact copywriting including generative AI, automation tools, and data analytics.
  • Strong project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, while ensuring timely execution.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to effectively present ideas to internal stakeholders and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
  • Proven experience working collaboratively with an international team.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to think strategically and creatively to continually improve the company's content and copywriting strategy.
  • Expertise in Microsoft Office, particularly Word and PowerPoint.
  • Fluency in English with excellent writing and editing skills, with a strong grasp of grammar and style.
  • Knowledge of AP Style or other major style guides is a plus.
  • A portfolio of work that demonstrates your writing abilities and creative skills.
  • A demonstrated passion for the educational space
  • Experience with content-related tools and services including SEO tools (such as SEMRush, Ahrefs), social media management tools (such as Buffer, Hootsuite) and content management systems (such as WordPress).
  • Experience in digital marketing including SEO, social media advertising and content marketing.

The post holder may be asked to undertake different or additional duties in line with business requirements at the request of their line manager. There is an expectation that all employees will maintain the values of the Group and will comply with the code of conduct as well as equality and diversity, health and safety and safeguarding policies.

Other information

Please note this position is only available on our Consultancy agreement.

We acknowledge receipt of your resume for a position at Global University Systems and sincerely appreciate your interest in our company.

We will screen all applicant CVs and select the candidates whose qualifications and experience meet our requirements. Please note due to the high volume of applications we will only contact you if you are selected to continue for the next stage of the recruitment process. We wish you every success.

GUS is an equal opportunities employer and positively encourages applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, or religion or belief.

jobs.description:
PVcase is seeking a Product Marketing Manager with hands-on solar engineering expertise to drive the market strategy for PVcase Ground Mount, PVcase Roof Mount, and PVcase Yield. Rather than a traditional marketer, we need someone with direct experience as a solar design engineer, PV engineer, or technical consultant at an EPC, developer, or solar tech firm. You understand utility-scale workflows, are comfortable in CAD environments, and speak the language of technical buyers.

In this role, you will bridge Product, Sales, and Go-To-Market by translating complex technical capabilities into clear customer value, shaping product roadmaps based on real engineering workflows, and proving PVcase's unique advantage to the market. Deep solar industry and technical expertise are required, while formal product marketing experience is secondary.

  • Own positioning, messaging, go-to-market strategy, and adoption initiatives for PVcase Ground Mount, Roof Mount, and Yield.

  • Develop a deep understanding of utility-scale solar engineering workflows, customer needs, and technical pain points.

  • Partner closely with Product Management to bring customer, market, engineering, and competitive insights into roadmap decisions.

  • Translate complex technical capabilities into clear customer value and differentiated product narratives.

  • Lead technical go-to-market planning for new products, features, and workflows.

  • Own demo strategy and help create credible, real-world solar engineering use cases.

  • Support Sales and Solutions teams on strategic opportunities requiring deeper product or industry expertise.

  • Monitor competitors, market trends, and developments across solar design, engineering, yield, and adjacent software.

  • Develop technical sales enablement, training, presentations, webinars, and educational content.

  • Serve as a bridge between Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and technical customers.

  • Engage directly with customers to understand workflows, validate product direction, and strengthen the Voice of Customer.

  • Help commercial teams understand not only what PVcase does, but how and why solar professionals use it.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional experience in the solar industry, ideally within utility-scale solar.

  • Strong understanding of solar project development, design, engineering, or construction workflows.

  • Hands-on experience with AutoCAD or other CAD-based design and engineering software.

  • Experience in solar engineering, PV design, applications engineering, solutions engineering, project engineering, EPC, development, or a similar technical role.

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Renewable Energy, or another relevant technical discipline preferred, or equivalent industry experience.

  • Strong understanding of how developers, EPCs, engineering firms, and technical teams work and make decisions.

  • Ability to quickly learn and confidently demonstrate technical software and workflows.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex engineering concepts.

  • Comfortable presenting to technical customers, commercial teams, and senior stakeholders.

  • Strong analytical skills and ability to translate customer, market, and competitive insights into recommendations.

  • Commercial mindset with the ability to connect technical capabilities to customer and business value.

  • Proactive, self-directed, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment.

  • Fluent or bilingual-level English.

About us

PVcase is moving solar forward with an alternative to the traditional labor-intensive, time-consuming, error-prone solar project development process. With our sophisticated site selection, PV design, and yield estimation software, you can achieve maximum results in a fraction of the time — to succeed faster, build better, and accelerate the global transition to clean energy. PVcase ends clunky processes and corrupted data to clear the path to a net-zero economy.

Whether you use a single product or plug into the entire platform, our end-to-end site selection, design, and yield assessment software makes you faster, precise, and highly productive at every stage of project development. PVcase is a leading choice for solar energy professionals — our platform serves over 1,800 customers in 75+ countries, powering the development of more than 4 TW of projects a year.

Get ready to enjoy

  • Flex benefit package, customizing perks to match your unique style.

  • Enjoy unlimited remote work or join the vibrant offices in Vilnius, Kaunas, or Barcelona.

  • Flexible working hours, harmonizing your personal and professional life.

  • Half-day Summer Fridays.

  • Full training and onboarding program for a seamless start.

  • Exclusive work only with international markets.

  • Considerable & steadily increasing salary, recognizing and rewarding your dedication.

  • Frequent in-office and after-hours activities with team members.

  • Participation in international training programs.

  • Internal transparency with company results and salary system, promoting a culture of trust and collaboration.

  • Additional paid vacation days, including birthdays, volunteering, and other occasions.

Salary Range:

  • Lithuania: 41,300 - 70,200 EUR gross/yearly.

  • Spain: 41,700 - 70,700 EUR gross/yearly.

jobs.description:

We partner with healthcare organizations to problem solve and deliver revenue cycle improvement services that enable their success, support their patients, and nurture their communities, all while living our values of Commitment, Authenticity, Respect and Excellence (CARE).

Job Description

The Accounts Receivable Specialist II is responsible for ensuring the timely collection of outstanding government or commercial healthcare insurance receivables.

Responsibilities:

  • Verifies or obtains patient eligibility and/or authorization for healthcare services performed by searching payer web sites or client eligibility systems, or by conducting phone conversations with the insurance carrier or healthcare providers.

  • Updates patient demographics and/or insurance information in appropriate systems.

  • Conducts research and appropriately statuses unpaid or denied claims.

  • Monitors claims for missing information, authorization and control numbers (ICN//DCN).

  • Researches EOBs for payments or adjustments to resolve claims.

  • Contacts payers by phone or through written correspondence to secure payment of claims.

  • Acces client systems for information regarding received payments, open claims and other data necessary to resolve claims.

  • Follows guidelines for prioritization, timely filing deadlines, and notation protocols within appropriate systems.

  • Secures medical documentation as required or requested by third party insurance carriers.

  • Obtains billing guidelines and requirements by researching provider billing manuals.

  • Writes appeal letters for technical appeals.

  • Verifies accuracy of underpayments by researching contracts and claims data.

  • In the event of an authorization, coding, level of care and/or length of stay denial, prepares claims for clinical audit processing.

  • Support' s Compliance Program by adhering to policies and procedures pertaining to HIPAA, FDCPA, FCRA, and other laws applicable to Savista's business practices. This includes: becoming familiar with Savista's Code of Ethics, attending training as required, notifying management or Savista's Helpline when there is a compliance concern or incident, HIPAA-compliant handling of patient information, and demonstrable awareness of confidentiality obligations.

Requirements:

  • High school diploma or GED.

  • At least two years of experience in healthcare insurance accounts receivable follow up, working with or for a hospital/hospital system, working directly with government or commercial insurance payers.

  • Experience identifying billing errors and resubmitting claims as well as following up on payment errors, low reimbursement and denials.

  • Experience reviewing EOB and UB-04 forms to conduct A/R activities.

  • Knowledge of accounts receivable practices, medical business office procedures, coordination of benefit rules and denial overturns and third-party payer billing and reimbursement procedures and practices. 

  • At least two years of experience with accounts receivable software.

  • Experience navigating payer sites for appeals/reconsiderations, benefits verification and online claims follow up.

  • Demonstrated ability to navigate Internet Explorer and Microsoft Office, including the ability to input and sort data in Microsoft Excel and use company email and calendar tools.

  • Demonstrated success working both individually and in a team environment.

  • Demonstrated experience communicating effectively with payers, understanding complex information and accurately documenting the encounter.

  • Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams to achieve goals.

  • Demonstrated ability to meet performance objectives.

  • This role is remote for candidates based in the following states: Alabama, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Kansas, Maine, Virginia, Vermont, Michigan, North Carolina, and South Carolina.

jobs.excerpt: ¡Hola!  Somos Cashea y nuestra misión es devolverle a los venezolanos la oportunidad de acceder al crédito a través de un modelo de negocios BNPL.
jobs.description:
¡Hola! Somos Cashea y nuestra misión es devolverle a los venezolanos la oportunidad de acceder al crédito a través de un modelo de negocios BNPL. Desde nuestro lanzamiento en 2022, nos hemos dedicado a promover la inclusión financiera. Hoy día tenemos más de 11 millones de usuarios activos, tanto para consumidores como para comercios, y nos convertimos en una marca de confianza en Venezuela.

Resumen del rol

Buscamos un Lead Analytics Engineer para ser el referente técnico del equipo de Analytics Engineering. Tu misión principal será diseñar y mantener la Single Source of Truth (SSoT) del negocio, estructurando modelos de datos escalables, gestionando el catálogo de datos y construyendo la capa semántica que habilitará el autoservicio de los Business Analysts (BAs). Trabajarás en la intersección entre tecnología y negocio, definiendo estándares de desarrollo y optimizando el contexto de nuestros datos para herramientas de IA.

Responsablidades

  • Modelado y SSoT: Diseñar, construir y mantener modelos de datos limpios, testeados y transformados dentro del Data Warehouse (usando dbt/Dataform) como la única fuente de verdad para el negocio.

  • Capa Semántica y Autoservicio: Crear la capa semántica y mantener actualizado el Catálogo de Datos para garantizar que los BAs puedan construir dashboards y análisis operativos sin fricción ni ambigüedad.

  • Contexto para IA: Enriquecer esquemas, metadatos y documentación en el repositorio para alimentar modelos de código/IA (como Claude Code o Copilots) y maximizar el autoservicio técnico del equipo.

  • Calidad y Calidad de Datos: Definir e implementar frameworks de pruebas (dbt tests), monitoreo de alertas y observabilidad para asegurar la consistencia del dato en toda la organización.

  • Liderazgo Técnico: Establecer buenas prácticas de desarrollo (DataOps, revisión de PRs, control de versiones) y mentorear a otros Analytics Engineers del equipo.

  • Colaboración Cruzada: Coordinar con Data Platform e Ingeniería la integración de pipelines y definición de contratos de datos (Data Contracts).

Requisitos

  • Experiencia 6+ años trabajando en entornos de datos, con al menos 3 años especializados en Analytics Engineering.

  • Experiencia 2+ liderando equipos especializados en Analytics engineering .

  • Stack Core: Dominio avanzado de SQL y experiencia sólida con dbt (o Dataform) en entornos cloud (GCP BigQuery, Snowflake o Redshift).

  • Modelado de Datos: Experiencia práctica en metodologías de modelado analítico (Kimball, Star Schema, Data Vault).

  • Ingeniería de Software: Control de versiones con Git, flujos de CI/CD para datos (DataOps) y conocimientos intermedios de Python.

  • Gobernanza: Experiencia implementando y manteniendo Catálogos de Datos (Datahub, Atlan, dbt Docs, etc.) y capas semánticas.

  • Habilidades Blandas: Capacidad comprobada para traducir requerimientos de negocio complejos en modelos técnicos escalables y guiar a otros ingenieros.

Porque te encantará trabajar en Cashea

En Cashea tenemos una cultura de trabajo basada en la confianza y el propósito. Si necesitas una pista de por qué somos una buena opción, estos son nuestros valores fundamentales:

  • No trabajamos en piloto automático. Todo lo que hacemos es intencional. Nos encanta elaborar ideas plenamente conscientes del impacto que pueden tener en nuestros usuarios.

  • Tu creatividad y curiosidad son el activo más Importante.

  • Tu voz importa. Escuchamos y damos espacio a las ideas y al feedback. Todos pertenecen y lo que es importante para ti, también lo es para nosotros.

  • Valoramos la transparencia. La claridad nos mantiene conectados y con los pies en la tierra.

  • Por último, pero no menos importante, nos enfocamos en el impacto real.

Si quieres trabajar con nosotros, llena la aplicación. ¡Nos encantaría conocerte!

jobs.description:
Sr. Strategic Sourcing Manager


We are Lennar

Lennar is one of the nation's leading homebuilders, dedicated to making an impact and creating an extraordinary experience for their Homeowners, Communities, and Associates by building quality homes and providing exceptional customer service, giving back to the communities in which we work and live in, and fostering a culture of opportunity and growth for our Associates throughout their career. Lennar has been recognized as a Fortune 500® company and consistently ranked among the top homebuilders in the United States.


A Career that Empowers You to Build Your Future

The IT Senior Strategic Sourcing Manager reports to the Head of IT Strategic Sourcing and Vendor Management Office (SVMO) and is responsible for developing and executing strategic sourcing initiatives across a broad portfolio of IT categories. These include application development, e-commerce, enterprise software, technical consulting, networking and data center hardware, PCs, tablets and peripherals, hosting services, mobile service providers, and telecommunications.


This role partners with business and technology leaders to understand requirements, evaluate solutions, and develop sourcing strategies that optimize costs, maximize value, and support the company's technology objectives. Key responsibilities include analyzing historical spend to identify savings opportunities, leading complex contract negotiations, developing strategic supplier partnerships, and overseeing supplier performance and contract management.


The Senior Strategic Sourcing Manager will build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including executive leadership, and lead cross-functional teams to define business requirements, establish sourcing strategies, and negotiate complex agreements and service-level commitments. The ideal candidate brings deep IT category expertise, strong commercial and negotiation skills, and the ability to influence strategic decisions as a trusted subject matter expert and thought leader across the IT portfolio.


Your Responsibilities on the Team

  • Reviews documentation and legal drafts of contracts/agreements, ensuring contractual/agreement requirements are met, and works directly with Strategic Sourcing Managers and key stakeholders to ensure contract/agreement language and requirements are appropriate and comply with Lennar Corporation policies and procedures.
  • Coordinates work with various departments and serves as a liaison between Lennar Corporation and vendors to oversee the intake, review and finalization of all IT and HR contracts that bind the corporation.
  • Innovative thought leader with demonstrated good business acumen and can quickly understand complex business programs related to Information Technologies.
  • Lead, mentor, and coach managers and specialists.
  • Promote career development and manage the performance of the team.
  • Review, draft, redline, and negotiate a variety of technology-related agreements, including SOW's, POC's, order forms, amendments, etc. while maintaining coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Supplier relationship management, engagement, and continuous improvement of supplier performance.
  • Responsible for creating and facilitating the issuance and evaluation of RFP’s, RFI’s, etc.
  • Ability to prepare and/or diagnose/interpret financial and other relevant analysis related to the product being sourced.
  • Negotiate and prepare contracts with appropriate terms and conditions.
  • Resolve conflicts or service level issues regarding supplier performance.
  • Excellent understanding of IT protocols and guidelines; ensure that IT minimum standards are applied and properly documented.
  • Effectively communicates program needs status with internal team members and external stakeholders, ability to build stakeholder trust and influence change.
  • Proficient understanding of procurement systems and functionality and procure-to-pay processes.
  • Effectively deal with conflict inherent in procurement and sourcing operations between suppliers and stakeholders.

Your Toolbox

  • 7+ years of IT Purchasing experience
  • 7+ years of IT Sourcing experience
  • Must have experience working with large technology partners such as AT&T, CDW, Cisco, IBM, Insight, Oracle, Microsoft, Salesforce, Verizon and VMWare.
  • ITIL experience preferred
  • Excellent customer service skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and follow-up skills.
  • Ability to work in challenging and ambiguous environments.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with executives, clients, and team members regularly.
  • Ability to work across functional areas to drive continuous improvement.
  • Advanced experience with MS Office.
  • Experience in a team-oriented environment is essential.
  • Connects the dots between strategy and contracting.
  • Can conform to shifting priorities, demands and timelines through analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Flexible during times of change.
  • Ability to read communication styles of team members and contractors who come from a broad spectrum of disciplines.
  • Ability to elicit cooperation from many sources, including executives, clients, and other departments.
  • Ability to defuse tension among project team, should it arise.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal and operational skill sets.
  • Must be able to learn, understand, and apply new technologies.
  • Strong Customer service skills and focus required.
  • Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment is crucial.
  • Tenacious, driven, energetic and has a high degree of professional integrity.
  • Follow directions from a supervisor.
  • Interact well with co-workers, supervisors and management.
  • Understand and follow posted work rules and procedures.
  • Accept constructive criticism.
  • Maintain Professional appearance and demeanor at all times

Physical & Office/Site Presence Requirements

This is primarily a sedentary office position which requires the incumbent to have the ability to operate computer equipment, speak, hear, bend, stoop, reach, lift, and move and carry up to 25 lbs. Finger dexterity is necessary.


This description outlines the basic responsibilities and requirements for the position noted. This is not a comprehensive listing of all job duties of the Associates. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Life at Lennar

At Lennar, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching environment for our Associates, offering a comprehensive array of benefits designed to enhance their well-being and professional growth. Our Associates have access to robust health insurance plans, including Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage, ensuring their health needs are well taken care of. Our 401(k) Retirement Plan, complete with a $1 for $1 Company Match up to 5%, helps secure their financial future, while Paid Parental Leave and an Associate Assistance Plan provide essential support during life's critical moments. To further support our Associates, we provide an Education Assistance Program and up to $30,000 in Adoption Assistance, underscoring our commitment to their diverse needs and aspirations. From the moment of hire, they can enjoy up to three weeks of vacation annually, alongside generous Holiday, Sick Leave, and Personal Day policies. Additionally, we offer a New Hire Referral Bonus Program, significant Home Purchase Discounts, and unique opportunities such as the Everyone’s Included Day. At Lennar, we believe in investing in our Associates, empowering them to thrive both personally and professionally. Lennar Associates will have access to these benefits as outlined by Lennar’s policies and applicable plan terms. Visit Lennartotalrewards.com to view our suite of benefits.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives focused on process effectiveness, risk reduction, and operational quality.

• Solid understanding of Insider Risk Management concepts, including risk indicators, policy configuration, alert triage, case management, escalation workflows, and audit-ready documentation.

• Good knowledge of Microsoft 365 workloads and signals relevant to Insider Risk scenarios, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Entra ID, Microsoft Defender, and endpoint activity.

• Strong understanding of privacy-by-design principles, proportionality, responsible investigation practices, and confidentiality controls.

• Experience working with security and compliance processes involving sensitive or confidential information.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a high level of attention to documentation accuracy and process discipline.

• Ability to coordinate across global teams and manage multiple stakeholders in time-critical situations.

• Strong ownership of assigned topics, combined with a proactive and self-directed working style.

• Experience with eDiscovery processes.

• Experience working in international and multicultural environments.

• Knowledge of Microsoft security, compliance, and data protection solutions beyond Insider Risk Management.

• Experience participating in change management, testing, and validation activities for security or compliance solutions.

• Strong stakeholder management skills across Legal, Compliance, HR, IT Security, and business teams.

• Experience working in highly regulated or enterprise environments.

• Proactive mindset with a strong focus on confidentiality, quality, and continuous improvement.

jobs.excerpt: Marcus Evans is a global leader in business intelligence, helping our clients grow by making connections, sharing knowledge, inspiring people, building relationships and creating new opportunities.
jobs.description:
Marcus Evans is a global leader in business intelligence, helping our clients grow by making connections, sharing knowledge, inspiring people, building relationships and creating new opportunities. With over four decades of experience and teams of highly experienced professionals across 50+ office locations, we deliver impactful strategic insight and business development guidance across all sectors through high-level summits, conferences, online platforms, performance coaching, and curated corporate event programmes. Based in 30+ countries, we create services that connect decision-makers, spark innovation, and drive real business growth.

ME Perform is the performance improvement consultancy of the Marcus Evans Group. We work differently from most of the training market: we diagnose what is actually holding an organisation's people back, design a programme specifically for them, deliver it over months rather than days, and measure whether behaviour genuinely changed, then hand the client written evidence of what improved. Because the design work is done in-house by our Programme Scientists, our trainers get something rare: a fully built, properly researched session, briefed to them in advance, delivered to a cohort who have already been diagnosed and who are expecting to work rather than watch.

Job Summary

You will deliver live sessions, typically 90 to 150 minutes, mostly online, working from a session design and a written brief prepared for you by the Programme Scientist.

This is a delivery role, and deliberately so. You are not asked to write content, find clients, or sell anything. You are asked to be outstanding in the room. Based on the seniority and ability of the applicant there will also be an opportunity extend this role to a follow-up coach with the same group.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver live sessions to our designed structure, to a consistently high standard.

  • Prepare from the written brief you receive at least five working days before each session — preparation time is paid within the session fee.

  • Run structured practice: our sessions are built around participants doing the thing, not listening to it explained. Expect to spend much of each session facilitating small-group work, giving feedback, and coaching in the moment.

  • Manage the room — including the sceptical senior participant, the quiet group, and the one who wants to debate rather than practise.

  • Submit brief written session notes within 48 hours of every session, so the Programme Scientist can adjust what comes next.

  • Take part in accreditation before your first client session, and stay open to observation and feedback afterwards.

Qualifications

Essential

  • 5-10 years of substantial experience in facilitating live learning or development sessions for professional or managerial audiences in a corporate setting.

  • Genuinely strong online delivery — confident running breakout groups, keeping cameras on and energy up, and handling the mechanics without it disrupting the session.

  • Comfortable delivering material you did not write, to a structure you are asked to keep to. This is the single most important requirement of the role.

  • Skilled at running practice and giving direct, useful feedback to adults — rather than presenting.

  • Reliable on the administrative side: punctual, responsive, and consistent with session notes.

  • Fluent, credible professional English, and comfortable with senior audiences.

Desirable

  • Experience in one or more of: leadership and management development, communication and influence, collaboration, resilience and change, or working across cultures.

  • A coaching qualification, or experience delivering one-to-one as well as group work.

  • Additional languages, or experience delivering to international cohorts working in a second language.

  • Familiarity with evidence-based learning design — you do not need to be a researcher, but you should be interested in why a session is built the way it is.

How the engagement works

  • Paid accreditation first: a methodology induction, then you deliver a full session for our Programme Scientist to observe, paid at half the standard session fee. Accreditation is completed before any client-facing work.

  • You are then briefed and booked per session. Fees are paid per session with preparation included, invoiced on delivery, on 30-day terms.

  • Standard contract terms apply, including confidentiality, intellectual property assignment for anything created in connection with the work, and non-solicitation of our clients. These are shared in full before accreditation.

  • If a client cancels at short notice, you are protected: cancellations inside five working days are paid in full.

Marcus Evans is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the Finance team
The Finance team ensures Affirm remains financially sound and strategically positioned for growth. Our team manages financial planning, accounting, pricing, vendor management, tax, investor relations, and corporate development. We deliver timely insights, accurate reporting, and careful analysis to support decision-making. From day-to-day financial operations to major investments, we enable sustainable, informed growth by maintaining strong fiscal discipline.

About the role
Affirm is looking for an experienced Accounting Manager to support and manage our international accounting operations, with a focus on statutory accounting, statutory audits, financial statement preparation, local compliance requirements, transfer pricing, and monthly close activities.

In this role, you will help ensure Affirm’s international entities are supported by accurate books and records, timely close execution, audit-ready documentation, and compliant local reporting. You will coordinate closely with internal Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Legal, Payroll, People, Finance, Technical Accounting and Financial Reporting teams, as well as external auditors, accounting firms, tax advisors, and statutory service providers.

You will bring strong US GAAP and local statutory accounting awareness, excellent project management skills, and the ability to manage multiple workstreams across jurisdictions. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, highly organized, proactive, and comfortable driving work through cross-functional partners and external providers.

You will be expected to deliver reliable, high-quality results, communicate clearly, and improve processes that make statutory accounting, audit support, and transfer pricing activities more scalable over time. You are a strong problem solver and communicator who is excited to support Affirm’s continued growth and mission to deliver honest financial products that improve lives.

What you’ll do

  • Manage statutory accounting and monthly close activities for international entities, including journal entries, accruals, reconciliations, variance analysis, and close checklist completion.
  • Coordinate with external accounting, payroll, tax, statutory, and audit providers to ensure accurate local books, timely deliverables, and compliance with local requirements.
  • Lead statutory audit planning and execution, including auditor onboarding, timelines, status tracking, request management, issue resolution, and stakeholder coordination.
  • Prepare and review statutory financial statements, disclosures, footnotes, supporting schedules, and tie-outs to trial balances, reconciliations, and audit evidence.
  • Own PBC coordination and audit testing support by gathering, validating, reviewing, and submitting accurate and complete audit documentation.
  • Partner with Technical Accounting, Financial Reporting, Tax, Legal, Treasury, Payroll, People, Finance, and external advisors on local accounting requirements, statutory adjustments, and reporting matters.
  • Manage audit completion and filing activities, including open item resolution, final approvals, signed documents, filing coordination, and completed audit file retention.
  • Own or support transfer pricing calculations, intercompany invoicing, related journal entries, reconciliations, settlements, and cross-functional alignment.
  • Review trial balances, general ledger activity, reconciliations, and financial statement variances to identify risks, unusual items, required adjustments, and recurring issues.
  • Strengthen process improvements and controls across statutory accounting and audit workflows by standardizing templates, improving review checklists, clarifying ownership, documenting key judgments, enhancing audit trails, and building repeatable processes that reduce manual effort, improve accuracy, and support audit readiness.
  • Identify control gaps, process inefficiencies, and documentation weaknesses; partner with stakeholders to implement scalable solutions, improve close governance, and ensure processes remain effective as entities, requirements, and reporting complexity evolve.
  • Use systems and tools such as NetSuite, Blackline, Excel, Workday, and AI-enabled workflows to improve efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.

What we look for

  • CPA professional accounting designation; or 6+ years of relevant professional accounting experience with a bachelor’s degree in business or finance.
  • Public accounting experience preferred, especially audit experience with multinational or public company clients.
  • Strong knowledge of US GAAP, statutory accounting, financial statement preparation, account reconciliations, journal entries, and month-end close.
  • Experience supporting or managing statutory audits, including PBC coordination, audit testing, financial statement review, audit completion, and filing.
  • Experience working with international entities, local accounting requirements, statutory reporting, and external service providers.
  • Experience with transfer pricing calculations, intercompany invoicing, intercompany reconciliations, and cross-border accounting activity.
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple audits, deadlines, entities, and stakeholders at once.
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to produce accurate, complete, audit-ready work under tight timelines.
  • Ability to partner effectively with Technical Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Legal, Payroll, People, Finance, external auditors, and local accounting providers.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain audit status, accounting issues, risks, and recommendations clearly.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including lookups, conditional formulas, pivot tables, large dataset analysis, and financial statement support.
  • Experience with accounting systems and close management tools; NetSuite and Blackline experience preferred.
  • Strong ownership mindset and desire to improve processes, reduce manual work, and make accounting workflows more scalable over time.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment with competing priorities.
