jobs.description:
EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform, providing vertically-tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 745,000 global service-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention. Its modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals. With its EverPro, EverHealth, and EverWell brands specializing in Home, Health, and Wellness service industries, EverCommerce provides end-to-end business management software, embedded payment acceptance, marketing technology, and customer experience applications. Learn more at EverCommerce.com.


We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here:


EverPro, a business within EverCommerce, provides software and solutions designed to help home and field service businesses run and grow their companies with greater efficiency and confidence. EverPro brings together purpose-built tools across key trades—including field service, remodeling and roofing, landscaping, and pest and lawn—so service professionals can manage operations, engage customers, and drive long-term growth.

Our solutions support the full lifecycle of running a service business, from scheduling and dispatching work, to estimating, invoicing, and payments, to customer communication, reputation management, and business insights. Together, these connected solutions help service pros win more jobs, save time, and build stronger, more resilient businesses.


The Senior Marketing Automation Manager owns the marketing automation platform, data, and campaign operations that power demand generation, lifecycle, and cross-sell programs across EverPro's Horizontal Solutions portfolio, which includes pulseM, Customer Lobby, ZyraTalk, GuildQuality, and Listen360. These products serve home services businesses across trades and brands, and this role is the technical backbone that allows Growth, Product Marketing, and Customer Marketing to reach the right customer with the right message at the right moment, at scale and with measurable results.


You will lead marketing automation platform (MAP) strategy and operations with a primary focus on Marketo and its integration with Salesforce. With the Horizontal Solutions Salesforce and Marketo migration now complete, you will lead post-migration optimization and standardization across the portfolio, turning a newly consolidated instance into a scalable, well-governed foundation. A core mandate of this role is enabling the EverPro ecosystem: building the audiences, signals, triggers, journeys, personalization, lead routing, and measurement that make cross-sell and multi-product adoption across CES possible, beyond supporting individual solution campaigns.


This role blends technical depth and systems thinking, with clear accountability for prioritizing work based on business impact rather than stakeholder demand alone. Messaging is owned by partner teams, and this role helps shape the strategy behind it: bringing a data-driven, systems-level point of view to what is possible, then turning that strategy into reliable, measurable automation.


Responsibilities:

Marketing Automation Platform Ownership

  • Serve as the Marketo owner and subject matter expert for the Horizontal Solutions portfolio, including architecture, governance, user management, and best practices.
  • Lead post-migration optimization of the consolidated Salesforce and Marketo environment, partnering with Marketing Ops, RevOps and data teams to standardize fields, scoring models, program templates, and naming conventions across products.
  • Design and maintain scalable data architecture for segmentation, lead scoring, attribution, and reporting across multiple products and customer bases.
  • Own data hygiene, consent and compliance (CAN-SPAM, TCPA, GDPR), and email deliverability standards across all programs.

Campaign Execution and Optimization

  • Manage and oversee day-to-day marketing automation operations, including campaign setup, segmentation, scheduling, QA testing, tagging, and deployment of one-time, recurring, triggered, and dynamic campaigns.
  • Build and maintain reusable program templates and modular email and landing page assets so teams can launch faster with fewer errors.
  • Continuously optimize existing automated programs based on behavioral data and performance trends, and surface insights on CTAs, landing pages, and funnel performance back to the teams that own messaging.
  • Proactively troubleshoot technical issues related to data integrations, lead scoring, CRM sync, and campaign execution prior to launch.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with Growth and Product Marketing to operationalize demand generation programs, lead quality and scoring strategy, and funnel reporting.
  • Serve as the automation partner to Customer Marketing, building the onboarding, retention, expansion, and advocacy journeys they design and instrumenting them for measurement.
  • Collaborate with Sales, RevOps and Marketing Ops on lead management, routing, SLAs, and closed-loop reporting between Marketo and Salesforce.
  • Work with Product and data teams to bring product usage and account signals into the marketing data model.
  • Support Partner and Field Marketing with campaign infrastructure for webinars, events, and ABM programs.

Ecosystem and Multi-Product Automation

  • Build behavioral triggers and multi-step journeys that move customers from a single solution to multiple products, with personalization by trade, product mix, and lifecycle stage.
  • Design and maintain complex lead routing for multi-product campaigns, ensuring leads generated by ecosystem and cross-sell programs reach the right product sales team or account owner with the right context and SLAs.
  • Build the measurement framework for ecosystem programs, including multi-product attribution, cross-sell pipeline and attach-rate reporting, and incremental lift from journey and personalization tests.

Prioritization and Operational Excellence

  • Own marketing automation prioritization and roadmap planning, making clear trade-offs based on business impact, resource constraints, and performance data, not just inbound stakeholder requests.
  • Manage intake and capacity for marketing automation requests through the team's shared project management process, with clear SLAs and documentation.
  • Balance short-term execution needs with long-term platform scalability and strategic investments.
  • Build a culture of experimentation and operational rigor, continuously improving how automation work is planned, executed, QA'd, and measured.

Skills and Experience needed for success in this role:

  • 7+ years of experience in marketing automation, marketing operations, or marketing technology; B2B SaaS experience strongly preferred.
  • 3+ years of people leadership experience, including leading teams through platform migrations, consolidations, or complex cross-functional initiatives.
  • Deep Marketo expertise required; Marketo Certified Expert strongly preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with multiple MAPs (e.g., HubSpot, Pardot, Eloqua, Acoustic) and demonstrated success optimizing and standardizing a platform following a migration or instance consolidation.
  • Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, including the Marketo-to-Salesforce sync, campaign and lead objects, and closed-loop reporting.
  • Experience designing scalable data architecture for segmentation, scoring, attribution, and reporting.
  • Experience designing complex lead routing and assignment logic for multi-product campaigns, including routing across multiple sales teams and account ownership models.
  • Experience building the automation behind cross-sell, multi-product, or ecosystem programs across a multi-product or multi-brand portfolio is strongly preferred.
  • Working knowledge of email compliance and data governance standards (CAN-SPAM, TCPA, GDPR) and deliverability best practices.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate performance data into actionable recommendations and prioritization decisions.
  • Advanced familiarity with HTML/CSS; experience with Velocity scripting, webhooks, or APIs is a plus.
  • Excellent project management skills, including intake management, prioritization, and cross-functional stakeholder leadership.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth, and evolving environment.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and operational discipline.
  • Salesforce Administrator certification is a strong plus.

Where: Remote, US
The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. This role can be based anywhere in the United States – if you’re close to one of our offices, we can set you up in-office or you can work 100% remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America.


Benefits and Perks:

  • Flexibility to work where/how you want within your country of employment – in-office, remote, or hybrid
  • Continued investment in your professional development
  • Day 1 access to a robust health and wellness benefits package, including an annual wellness stipend.
  • 401k with up to a 4% match and immediate vesting
  • Flexible and generous (FTO) time-off
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program

Compensation: The target base compensation for this position is $130,000 to $145,000 USD per year in most US locations. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, and candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.


EverCommerce is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We look forward to reviewing your credentials and getting to know more about your experience!

FireMon gives security teams one place to see, govern, and prove that their policy is doing what they intend, across on-prem, cloud, and hybrid environments.

Your main responsibilities will include proactively identifying and researching potential threats, analyzing emerging trends, and assessing risks that could impact the client’s personnel, operations, reputation, and strategic objectives.

In this role, you will apply your intelligence analysis expertise to provide actionable insights, advise decision-makers, and help develop strategies to mitigate risks. You’ll monitor various sources of information, synthesize complex data, and communicate your findings clearly to support the client’s safety and success.

The ideal Protective Intelligence Analyst is passionate about intelligence work, enjoys problem-solving, and is committed to delivering impactful analysis that protects and informs the client’s organization.

This role supports a 24/7 function, and although the core hours are standard business hours, you will be required to support evening, weekend, and holidays as needed.

Essential Functions / Responsibilities

  • Monitor all-source information to proactively identify and assess threats and highlight emerging trends that may impact business, productions, and talent.
  • Conduct detailed assessments on threat actors and maintain databases.
  • Support talent and executive protection details with accurate and timely information and alerting
  • Provide security/threat assessments for events.
  • Respond to critical incidents, rapidly research, and deliver information in a clear, concise format.
  • Conduct investigations into threat actors.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Advanced knowledge of open-source, social media, and public records search techniques.
  • Experience with threat assessment tools and structured professional judgment guides for targeted violence risk.
  • Strong interpersonal skills.
  • Clearly communicate risk to stakeholders in a concise format.
  • Approach cases with empathy and discretion.
  • Be aware of and work through cognitive bias that may impact assessment.
  • Proven ability to work with highly confidential information.
  • Demonstrated ability to complete multiple tasks simultaneously and function in a fast-paced environment with minimal supervision.
  • Strong analytic, oral, and written presentation skills to include the ability to deliver communications centered on the target audience.
  • Advanced proficiency in Web-based social media platforms, search tools, productivity applications, and communication technology.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Security Studies, International Relations, Criminal Justice, Business Management, or a relevant field from an accredited college or university; or equivalent professional experience. Master’s degree, preferred.
  • 4+ years of relevant work experience in the protective intelligence field in a corporate setting.
  • Foreign language proficiency a plus.

Work Environment/Physical Requirements

This position is moderately self-directed and requires understanding and compliance with company policies, procedures, and values. The position works in an on-site office environment utilizing a computer and standard office equipment. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to interact collaboratively with the team and stakeholders, and communicate via phone, video phone, or text messaging. The employee may be required to occasionally lift and/or move up to 20 pounds. The position may require travel up to 5%.

Benefits

Sibylline is committed to the recruitment and selection of candidates without regard for sexual orientation, gender, ethnicity, age, political beliefs, culture, and lifestyle. We are committed to fostering a business culture that reflects these values and promotes equal opportunity.

POS-P2935

Lead Solutions Engineer

AI is changing how businesses buy. Buyers arrive informed, often having researched with AI, and they no longer buy on promises: they want to see their own business running in HubSpot, and proof that it will deliver measurable results, before they commit. HubSpot's agentic customer platform is leading this shift, connecting customer context, Breeze AI agents and a unified CRM so scaling companies realize business outcomes, not just adopt software. As buying moves from large contracts signed up front to proving value one use case at a time, we are building a new technical go-to-market team to lead customers through that change.

Come join the team defining what technical go-to-market looks like in the AI era. As a Solutions Engineer, you bring a customer-facing background in solutions engineering, solutions architecture or technical consulting, along with hands-on building experience. You won't just show customers what's possible; you'll build it with them, prove it delivers their outcomes, and set them on the path to realizing them. This is a pre-sales role, not a software engineering role, for technologists who build fast with AI tools. Few companies have figured out how to sell this way at scale, and here you will help lead the industry in defining and building a new technical go-to-market model that others will follow. If you love building, thrive at the intersection of business and technology, and want to help write the playbook for how software is bought next, this role is for you.

In this role, you will need to:

  • Tell compelling, outcome-led stories (via demos and product led experiences) that show customers how their business can be reimagined on HubSpot's agentic customer platform.
  • Lead discovery that uncovers the pain, outcomes and requirements by engaging customers and then earning the right to go deeper
  • Partner with Account Executives to map the technical buying committee, competitive landscape and path to a decision.
  • Redesign customers' legacy complexity into a simplified HubSpot architecture that integrates with their wider tech stack.
  • Design and build working proofs quickly with AI coding tools, Breeze AI agents and the HubSpot developer framework, scoped to clear use cases, success criteria and timelines.
  • Run hands-on proofs with customers, iterating on their feedback and clearing security and integration risks to secure the technical win.
  • Turn proof into a business case, ROI and use-case roadmap with a consumption plan that sizes the first commitment.
  • Present results to executives and generate confidence to move forward with HubSpot

  • Experience using modern AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar tools as part of the engineering workflow.

Preferred Qualifications

You will own your product’s roadmap, collateral, and market research, and you will collaborate with Grafana leadership on fine-tuning your product’s goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. Serving the People Who Serve the People

Granicus is driven by the excitement of building, implementing, and maintaining technology that is transforming the Govtech industry by bringing governments and its constituents together. With comprehensive cloud-based solutions for communications, government website design, meeting and agenda management software, records management, and digital services, Granicus empowers stronger relationships between government and residents across the U.S., U.K., Australia, New Zealand, and Canada. By simplifying interactions with residents, while disseminating critical information, Granicus brings governments closer to the people they serve—driving meaningful change for communities around the globe.

Want to know more? See more of what we do here.

Job Summary

The Director, Federal Sales owns account strategy, business development, and sales execution for Federal accounts, spanning military services, combatant commands, defense agencies, and installations. The Director will build a team of quota-carrying Account Executives, prioritizing pipeline development, new-customer acquisition, and enterprise expansion.

The Director combines strategic account leadership with hands-on sales execution: building senior civilian and military customer relationships, identifying funded priorities, coaching sellers through complex defense opportunities, and activating partners to advance pursuits from discovery through contract award and customer adoption.

Success requires deep understanding of defense organizations, mission needs, funding cycles, acquisition pathways, and technology buying decisions. The Director connects digital communications, engagement, and experience solutions to measurable improvements in installation communications, newcomer onboarding, family readiness, workforce outreach, access to services, and program participation.

The role is directly accountable for federal account bookings and revenue attainment, qualified pipeline, strategic account penetration, new-customer acquisition, expansion, forecast accuracy, account retention, and sales-team development. Account plans connect installation- and program-level opportunities to broader command, service, and department-level growth.

Success in this role is measured by bookings and revenue attainment, qualified pipeline growth, strategic account penetration, expansion of existing deployments, partner-generated opportunities, forecast accuracy, contract awards, customer adoption, and achievement of agreed customer outcomes.

What Your Impact Will Look Like

  • Own the Federal account management: Develop and execute an integrated department-level account strategy with service-, command-, agency-, and installation-level plans. Identify priority programs, budget owners, decision-makers, competitive alternatives, acquisition pathways, and near- and long-term opportunities.
  • Deliver predictable growth: Own quarterly and annual bookings and revenue targets for federal accounts. Balance near-term awards with long-term pipeline development, maintaining accurate forecasts and disciplined CRM, pipeline review, and account-planning practices.
  • Build senior customer relationships: Engage senior civilian and military leaders, technology executives, program owners, public affairs teams, personnel organizations, installation leadership, and acquisition stakeholders. Serve as an executive sponsor for strategic federal account pursuits.
  • Generate qualified demand: Lead executive briefings and discovery workshops that translate federal account customer challenges into actionable opportunities with identified sponsors, funding, outcomes, acquisition paths, timelines, and next steps.
  • Develop mission-aligned solutions: Build repeatable sales approaches for installation communications, newcomer onboarding, family readiness, workforce outreach, access to services, and program participation. Position solutions around measurable customer value rather than product features alone.
  • Advance enterprise expansion: Connect local deployments to broader program, command, service, and department-level opportunities. Develop consolidation and expansion business cases, map stakeholders across organizational levels, and establish repeatable approaches to entering previously unserved federal accounts.
  • Lead capture and contracting: Establish pursuit plans covering stakeholder alignment, funding, procurement strategy, competitive differentiation, pricing, security requirements, risks, and milestones to award. Coordinate with Legal, Finance, Security, and Sales Operations to validate suitable acquisition pathways and commitments.
  • Activate defense-market partners: Build joint federal account plans with systems integrators, resellers, and technology partners. Define responsibilities for customer access, solution development, co-selling, and contract execution.
  • Lead and develop the sales team: Recruit, coach, develop, and retain approximately 6–10 quota-carrying Account Executives. Align territory coverage, quota allocation, individual goals, account reviews, and deal coaching to the federal account strategy.
  • Orchestrate customer success: Align Sales Engineering, Product, implementation specialists, and Customer Success around achievable customer roadmaps, smooth sales-to-delivery transitions, adoption, and customer-agreed measures of value.
  • Shape the account growth strategy: Bring federal account customer needs, competitive insights, and validated security requirements into product planning, marketing, messaging, and investment decisions. Represent the company at relevant customer briefings, defense-industry events, and partner engagements.
  • Drive strategic business leadership: Influence organizational priorities through market intelligence, customer insights, acquisition trends, and defense modernization initiatives. Provide executive recommendations regarding account investment, territory priorities, partnership strategy, and growth opportunities.

You Will Love This Job If You Have

  • 8+ years of enterprise SaaS, government technology, defense technology, or B2G sales experience, with demonstrated success developing and closing complex opportunities within the Department of Defense and broader Federal market.
  • 3+ years of people leadership experience managing quota-carrying sales professionals and delivering measurable sales performance.
  • Proven success building and scaling new-logo acquisition strategies while expanding strategic accounts and driving revenue growth.
  • Deep understanding of defense funding, acquisition, and procurement processes, including experience working with Federal contract vehicles (e.g., GSA Schedules, GWACs, IDIQs, BPAs, SEWP, OTAs).
  • Strong strategic account planning, territory management, pipeline development, forecasting, and financial management capabilities.
  • Experience leading complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles involving senior military, civilian, technology, acquisition, and contracting leaders.
  • Demonstrated success recruiting, coaching, developing, and retaining high-performing sales talent.
  • Experience building and managing relationships with systems integrators, channel partners, resellers, and technology partners.
  • Strong executive presence, business acumen, communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce or comparable CRM and sales analytics platforms.
  • Ability to travel domestically approximately 50% of the time.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior military, defense civilian, or defense-industry leadership experience relevant to the account; specific military rank or Senior Executive Service status is not required.
  • Established relationships with defense program, technology, public affairs, personnel, installation, or acquisition organizations.
  • Experience building or significantly scaling a defense technology account or territory, including expanding installation- or program-level deployments into service- or department-level opportunities.
  • Experience working with major Federal systems integrators and channel partners.
  • Experience with government digital communications, customer experience, engagement, or comparable technology platforms.
  • Ability to distinguish current product authorizations from customer-specific defense security requirements and coordinate validation before making commitments.

jobs.description:
The Opportunity


We are looking for an experienced claims leader to lead the strategy, governance, and performance of our third-party administrator (TPA) claim programs across multiple products, business segments, and jurisdictions.

This is a highly visible leadership role with responsibility for ensuring our TPA partners deliver fair, timely, accurate, and compliant claim outcomes while meeting our expectations for customer experience, financial performance, and operational quality.


You will serve as the senior business owner for key TPA relationships, lead a team of claims and vendor oversight professionals, partner closely with senior leaders across the organization, and influence how we manage outsourced claims operations at an enterprise level.


This role is ideal for a strategic P&C claims leader who knows how to balance technical claims expertise, vendor accountability, financial discipline, and strong relationships to drive results.

What You'll Do


Lead TPA strategy and governance

  • Set the strategy, operating model, and governance framework for TPA claim programs across products, programs, jurisdictions, and business segments.
  • Establish and continuously improve service-level agreements, performance scorecards, claim-handling guidelines, authority levels, escalation protocols, and reporting standards.
  • Lead TPA selection, onboarding, implementation, renewal, transition, and termination activities while protecting claim continuity and customer service.

Own TPA performance and relationships

  • Serve as the senior relationship owner with TPA leadership, leading business reviews, performance discussions, escalations, and negotiations.
  • Hold partners accountable for claim inventories, cycle time, customer experience, claim quality, reserve adequacy, settlement accuracy, leakage, litigation activity, regulatory compliance, and contractual commitments.
  • Assess TPA capacity, staffing, training, licensing, business continuity, data security, and catastrophe readiness, and drive action plans when risks emerge.

Provide senior claims leadership

  • Provide strategic direction on complex, high-exposure, litigated, escalated, or disputed claims, including coverage, reserves, litigation strategy, and settlement approach within delegated authority.
  • Lead the audit, calibration, and quality assurance framework for TPA claim handling.
  • Identify performance trends and root causes and ensure corrective actions deliver sustainable improvement.

Lead and develop a high-performing team

  • Lead, coach, and develop managers, claim consultants, relationship managers, and vendor oversight professionals.
  • Build leadership capability and bench strength while creating a culture of accountability, sound judgment, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Set clear goals and expectations and ensure the team has the tools, resources, and direction needed to deliver results.

Drive enterprise partnership and improvement

  • Partner with Legal, Compliance, Finance, Actuarial, Underwriting, Procurement, Operations, Technology, and business leaders on contracts, controls, data, reporting, systems, and service delivery.
  • Develop and present performance dashboards, trend analysis, risk assessments, and strategic recommendations to senior and executive leadership.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives across TPA processes, controls, technology, training, and operating models.

Manage financial performance

  • Oversee department expenses as well as TPA fees, loss adjustment expenses, claim payments, reserves, vendor charges, and audit-related costs within delegated authority.
  • Identify leakage and adverse financial trends, validate contractual billing and service outcomes, and drive corrective action.
  • Establish financial performance targets and communicate results, trends, and risks to senior leadership.

What You'll Bring


Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • 10+ years of claims or related P&C insurance experience, including experience with TPA, vendor, program, or outsourced claims oversight.
  • 5+ years of progressive leadership experience, including leading managers or multiple teams.
  • Adjuster licenses for applicable states, with the ability to obtain and maintain additional licenses as needed.
  • Deep knowledge of claim investigation, policy interpretation, coverage analysis, reserving, litigation management, settlement practices, fraud indicators, regulatory requirements, and claims financial controls.
  • Demonstrated experience establishing governance models, service levels, vendor performance standards, claims audit programs, and corrective action plans.
  • Experience interpreting and negotiating contracts, statements of work, authority levels, fee structures, reporting obligations, and governance requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior internal stakeholders and external business partners and drive accountability without direct authority.
  • Experience managing budgets and using operational and financial data to identify trends, determine root causes, and drive measurable action plans.
  • Strong executive communication, presentation, negotiation, relationship management, and change leadership skills.

We'd Especially Like to See

  • Bachelor's degree in business, insurance, risk management, finance, or a related field.
  • Experience leading multiple TPAs, outsourced claim programs, complex vendor relationships, or multi-state claims operations.
  • Experience with procurement, contract negotiation, vendor risk management, implementations, conversions, or TPA transitions.
  • Professional insurance designation such as AIC, CPCU, or SCLA.
  • Experience with claims analytics, dashboards, quality assurance programs, process improvement, or enterprise change initiatives.
  • Experience presenting to senior and executive leadership and contributing to broader claims strategy.

What Success Looks Like


In this role, success means building a TPA operating model that delivers:

  • Consistent, high-quality claim outcomes
  • Strong regulatory and contractual compliance
  • Improved cycle time and customer experience
  • Appropriate reserves and settlement outcomes
  • Reduced leakage and unnecessary expense
  • Clear accountability across TPA partners
  • Strong visibility into performance, risk, and financial results
  • Continuous improvement in claims controls, technology, and operational effectiveness

Work Environment & Travel


This role operates in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment and involves managing multiple external partners, competing priorities, confidential claim information, and significant financial and operational accountability.

Travel may be required for TPA site visits, business reviews, audits, implementation meetings, and leadership sessions. Occasional schedule flexibility may also be necessary to support urgent claims issues, catastrophe events, regulatory deadlines, or other critical operational needs.

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Who is Boulevard?  Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses.
jobs.description:
Who is Boulevard?

Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most.

Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen.

We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most.

Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too.

Come do the best work of your life at Boulevard.

As our Senior Solutions Engineer, you'll own the technical story in our enterprise and strategic sales cycles. You'll take how a multi-location salon, spa, medspa, or franchise actually operates and turn it into a credible, tailored demonstration of Boulevard. This is a senior individual contributor role with real autonomy, no prescribed playbook, and the chance to build assets that raise the technical quality of our whole go-to-market team.

You'll work closely with our Enterprise and Mid-Market Account Executives, Product, Engineering, and Implementation. We're building the operating system for beauty and wellness, and here the line between your work and its impact is never abstract. This role is remote within the U.S.

What you’ll do here

  • Lead technical discovery, technical qualification, integration solution design, and executive-facing readouts on enterprise and strategic opportunities.
  • Partner with Account Executives to connect Boulevard to each prospect's business case, showing value, ROI, and how our APIs extend across their existing technology stack.
  • Build working proofs of concept and interactive prototypes that show prospects their own workflows running on Boulevard.
  • Write RFP and security questionnaire responses that give prospects usable insight into their own operations.
  • Advise prospects and internal teams on security configuration and on HIPAA, PHI, and PII handling, and serve as the technical contact for security review during procurement.
  • Scope integration requirements and sort each one into fits today, partner solution, or genuine product gap, then document them for Sales, Implementation, and Support. Turn recurring gaps and feature requests from live deals into clear signal for Product and Engineering.
  • Advise on demo environment strategy, create sandboxes (most often post-sale migration sandboxes), and prepare prospect briefings so what we promise in the sales cycle is what we deliver.
  • Use AI tools to speed up pre-sales deliverables, and coach new upmarket sales teammates.

What you’ll need to thrive

  • 5+ years in solutions engineering, sales engineering, technical account management, or a comparable customer-facing technical role in B2B SaaS.
  • Direct SaaS experience: how subscription software is built, sold, implemented, and renewed, including release and roadmap cycles, APIs and integrations, and data migration. Vertical SaaS backgrounds such as booking, payments, communications, or client experience platforms transfer most directly.
  • Demonstrated ownership of enterprise or strategic sales cycles, including multi-location or franchise buying structures.
  • Technical fluency in APIs, integrations, data flows, and permissions models, and credibility with both operators and technical stakeholders without engineering support for routine questions.
  • Strong written communication and the ability to produce precise documentation that stands on its own.
  • Proven ability to operate independently in ambiguity, define the approach, and own the outcome.
  • A plus: experience in beauty, wellness, health, or another appointment-based services vertical; working familiarity with HIPAA, PHI, and PII requirements in a software context; hands-on experience building or prototyping with AI tooling, including prompt design and evaluation; or experience selling to or supporting private equity backed groups, franchise organizations, or multi-site operators.
  • A degree is not required.

How we'll take care of you

At Boulevard, we work hard to structure compensation in a way that balances internal equity with local market competitiveness, and we're happy to share a good-faith estimate of the base salary range for this role. For candidates in NYC, the SF Bay Area, and Seattle, the anticipated base salary range is $136,000-160,000 per year. For all other U.S. locations, the anticipated base salary range is $133,00-157,000 per year. In addition to this base compensation, this role may be eligible to participate in a variable compensation program. Final compensation will vary based on a variety of factors which include but are not limited to applicable experience, location, and final leveling.

How we take care of our team

Our business is deeply immersed in an industry that’s centered around helping people feel their best, so we know that taking care of yourself isn’t selfish; it’s essential. That’s why our culture pairs high standards with genuine care. We don't glorify burnout or wear ‘always on’ as a badge of honor. Instead, we’ve created benefits designed to support you inside and outside of work, so you can bring your best self to both.

Here’s how we support you:

  • Competitive base pay and performance bonus eligibility because you deserve to be rewarded for your impact.
  • Equity participation for all full-time employees because we believe the people helping build Boulevard should share in our long-term success.
  • Comprehensive medical coverage with up to 100% employee premium coverage and 75% dependent coverage to help take care of you and your loved ones.
  • An annual $1,200 HSA employer contribution for eligible plans to help support healthcare costs and future planning.
  • 100% covered dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, ensuring you stay healthy, protected, and ready for whatever life brings.
  • 12 weeks of fully paid U.S. parental leave supporting all new parents equally as they take the time to bond, adjust, and be present when welcoming a new family member.
  • Flexible paid time off, plus 10 U.S. company holidays, where you are encouraged to rest, recharge, and take the time you need, guilt-free.
  • Fully remote with support, including a $200 home office setup allowance and a $50 monthly WFH reimbursement so your workspace is set up for success.
  • $200 quarterly Boulevard Bucks to prioritize your well-being and stay connected to the industry we serve.
  • And other perks like One Medical membership and Employee Assistant Program.

To learn how Boulevard collects, uses, and protects personal information related to candidates and employees, please review our Boulevard Employee & Personnel Privacy Notice.

Boulevard Labs, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to hiring a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive culture. All employment decisions at Boulevard Labs, Inc. are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

Outside Employment Disclosure
Boulevard serves the beauty, wellness, and self-care industry, and many of our employees have access to our customers' business and client data. Because of that, we ask all candidates to disclose any concurrent employment, self-employment, ownership interest, or advisory role during the hiring process, including the company name and industry. Disclosure is a normal part of our process and is not by itself a barrier to being hired. Employees in Tier 1 Restricted Roles may not hold concurrent employment, ownership, or an advisory role with a beauty, wellness, self-care, or med-spa business, or with a company that competes with Boulevard. If you currently hold such a role, you are still welcome to apply — please raise it early with your recruiter so we can talk it through.

jobs.description:
Actian is the company behind the Data Intelligence Platform — an enterprise solution that helps organisations discover, govern, and trust their data at scale. Our platform connects metadata, data lineage, data quality, and business context into a single knowledge graph, enabling enterprises to turn raw data into reliable decisions. We operate globally, move fast, and build for the long term.

Software engineering is being redefined. The engineers who will shape the next decade of product development are not the ones who write the most code — they are the ones who know how to think clearly, ship confidently, and use every tool available to them, including AI, to multiply their impact.

The Actian Data Intelligence Platform helps teams find, understand, and use AI-ready data under clear governance. It connects metadata, data lineage, data quality, and business context into a single knowledge graph, so enterprises can turn raw data into reliable decisions — the trusted foundation that AI agents increasingly depend on to work. We operate globally, move fast, and build for the long term.

The Data Intelligence Platform has to deploy, operate, and pass audits in every one of the environments our customers run — public cloud, private cloud, and on-premises. We are standing up a dedicated platform team to make that possible, and we are hiring the leader who will build it.

This is a hands-on director role. You will stand up and lead a newly formed platform team, hire and grow it, and build alongside it from day one: you will design the platform services, write infrastructure code, and set the engineering standards the rest of engineering relies on.

We are an AI-first engineering organization, and in this role AI is how the work gets done. AI agents run operational tasks, AI accelerates the team's own engineering, and AI replaces tools we pay for today but no longer need. You will also build the infrastructure that runs the AI and ML workloads inside our product.

What You Will Own:

  • Platform services for the Data Intelligence Platform, including the infrastructure behind the data catalog, the knowledge graph, and the APIs that power customer integrations.

  • Cloud-agnostic deployment of the Platform across AWS, a second public cloud (Azure or Google Cloud), and customer on-premises and private-cloud environments — including packaging, installation, upgrades, and supportability.

  • The internal developer platform and CI/CD, including GitOps delivery, so engineering teams ship safely and quickly.

  • Security operations and compliance evidence for SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR — including EU data residency — in partnership with the security team.

  • Cloud cost management and FinOps, with clear cost visibility and accountability across every environment.

  • Infrastructure for the AI and ML workloads used by the Platform.

  • Observability, reliability, and incident response for the services the team runs, including the team's on-call rotation.

  • High-functioning platform team: an operating model in place, and clear ownership boundaries with the product engineering teams you serve.

  • Portable, cloud-agnostic deployments: one deployment model that runs the Platform on AWS, on at least one other cloud, and on customer infrastructure — defined as code and delivered through GitOps.

  • AI agents running operations: agents that handle routine operational work — triage, remediation, change validation, and reporting — with measurable reductions in manual effort and a smaller tool footprint.

  • Platform foundations for the data catalog, the knowledge graph, and integration APIs: scalable, observable infrastructure that product teams build on.

  • Compliance automation and audit readiness: evidence for SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR collected automatically from the platform rather than assembled by hand before each audit.

We expect this leader to treat AI as part of the platform. That means you will:

  • Design and run AI agents that operate infrastructure under clear guardrails — human approval for high-risk changes, and full audit trails.

  • Review our current tooling and retire tools that AI agents or simpler automation can replace, with a cost and risk case for each change.

  • Use AI coding and operations assistants in your own daily work, and set the standard for how the team uses them.

  • Build the compute, data, and access patterns that let AI and ML workloads run reliably in every environment we support.

What You Bring:

  • 10+ years in platform engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, or SRE, including 3+ years managing engineers — with experience building or scaling a team, not only running an established one.

  • AI-first mindset, making extensive use of this technology for accelerating developments.

  • A track record of shipping on-premises or self-hosted software that customers install and run in their own environments.

  • Deep, hands-on experience with Kubernetes in production, infrastructure as code (Terraform/Terragrunt), and GitOps delivery with Argo CD or similar tooling.

  • Strong AWS experience, and the judgment to design for portability rather than lock-in to a single cloud.

  • Hands-on experience operating systems under SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR controls, including data-residency requirements.

  • Experience managing cloud costs and making cost trade-offs explicit to engineering and business leaders.

  • Clear written communication, suited to a fully remote team across US and EU time zones.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience running infrastructure for data platforms, data catalogs, or graph databases.

  • Production experience on Azure or Google Cloud in addition to AWS.

  • Experience with air-gapped or restricted-network customer deployments.

  • Experience building infrastructure for AI and ML workloads, including model serving and vector or graph data stores.

  • Observability with OpenTelemetry or comparable tooling, from instrumentation through alerting.

  • Privileged access management with StrongDM or a comparable tool.

What We Value:

    We value autonomy over process, outcomes over activity, and builders over theorists. This role suits someone who thrives when handed a hard problem, a team to build, and the space to figure it out — and who uses every tool available, including AI, to multiply the team's impact.

How You Will Work:

    You will report to the SVP of Engineering and work closely with product engineering, security, customer success, and support. The role is fully remote from the US, UK, Spain, France or Germany, with at least four hours a day of overlap with both US Eastern Time and Central European Time. Expect occasional travel for team offsites and company-wide meetings.

What We Offer:

  • The chance to be part of an innovative, fast-growing company making a significant impact in the data management space.
  • Collaboration with a passionate and diverse team.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Flexible work arrangements (remote or hybrid).
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
Why Join Us? At Actian, we are passionate about innovation and teamwork. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, loves creating an efficient and welcoming workspace, and enjoys working closely with a talented team.
Interested? We’d love to hear from you! Let’s discuss how you can contribute to our success while growing your career with us.

The Opportunity:

Product Marketing at Grafana Labs lives in the Product org, not the Marketing org, and we think differently about the job. As Grafana's offering shifts from dashboards to observability agents, our team closes the gap between what our products can do and how customers understand that value. We build clear, consistent positioning, run marketing campaigns that attract new customers, and create content that helps engineering teams see why Grafana Cloud is the right choice for them.

Rather than only executing launches and campaigns, we teach Grafana’s product managers and engineers how to think about growth and demand. We also codify product marketing knowledge into AI-forward tools and processes that anyone at Grafana can use. For example, we all contribute product information to a shared knowledge base, which we use to generate enablement materials and decks.

The Operations Manager keeps the Product Marketing system running and makes it better. You'll track how our work performs and report on it to the team every week, experiment with new AI workflows, and maintain the collateral and tools the team and the field depend on, so the sales team is fully supported in positioning our products. You'll work closely with the team's software engineers: you test ideas like sales deck generators or tools for competitive analysis, script prototypes, and define what good output looks like, and they turn the best ideas into production tools. You'll also coordinate with the field, Enablement, and Marketing so we understand each other's goals and make progress on shared initiatives.

For this role you don't need to be a product marketer but you should have experience working inside a Product or Marketing organization for a software company. Since we don’t have an operations manager yet, you’ll also help to shape your own role. You should arrive with a desire to find and solve imperfectly-defined problems.

  • Projects and Cross-Functional Initiatives: Drive cross-functional initiatives that align with product marketing strategies across GTM, Product, and Marketing teams. Own follow-ups, task tracking, and on-time completion.

  • AI Experimentation and Prototyping: Try out new AI workflows and tools, using AI to write scripts and checking that they work. Decide what good output looks like and codify that judgment in evaluations, working alongside the software engineers on our team as they refine and deploy tools. Hand the most promising prototypes to engineers to make production-ready. For example, you might test a deck generator with sellers, write evals for it, and communicate about it internally.
  • Collateral Management: Maintain the team's most important collateral, including core decks, positioning content, and enablement sessions. Keep it accurate and current, share it widely, and make sure sellers know where to find it and how to use it.
  • Knowledge Base Stewardship: Help keep our shared product knowledge base complete and current. Spot missing or stale information, chase down the owners, and improve the processes that keep it up to date.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • 2+ years in an operations, analytics, enablement, or technical support role within a Product or Marketing organization for a software company.
  • Strong analytical judgment: you use AI and other tools to pull data, check the results instead of taking them at face value, and turn the numbers into clear recommendations
  • Proficiency with AI agents, including building skills and automated workflows that more than one person uses
  • Good judgment about what makes AI output good, and the ability to codify that judgment in evaluations

Bonus Points For:

  • High emotional intelligence and strong interpersonal skills

  • More people outside the team use our AI tools and collateral
  • Collaboration with the field, Enablement, Marketing, and other partner teams runs more smoothly, leading to better working relationships and more impact across the org

Compensation & Rewards:

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.

jobs.excerpt: About ThatchFor most people, health insurance is something that happens to them: a plan chosen by someone else, with little room to fit their life.
jobs.description:
About Thatch

For most people, health insurance is something that happens to them: a plan chosen by someone else, with little room to fit their life. Thatch is changing that. We help companies give every employee a real healthcare budget instead of a one-size-fits-all plan, so people can choose the coverage and care that works for them, and employers get predictable costs they can control.

It’s a simple idea, but making it real means solving hard problems across healthcare, payments, and technology, and we’re just getting started. We look for people who like solving complex problems, use good judgment, and are comfortable working through ambiguity. People here care deeply about our customers, take real responsibility for what gets built, and are driven by doing work that matters.

About the role

We're looking for an exceptional Enterprise Account Executive, National Accounts to help establish and scale Thatch's enterprise business nationally.

This is a strategic, hands-on sales role for someone who understands employer-sponsored healthcare, knows how to navigate complex enterprise purchasing decisions, and has experience working with leading national benefits consulting firms, including Mercer, Aon, WTW, Lockton, and Gallagher.

Success requires more than traditional enterprise sales experience. You must understand how large employers evaluate healthcare strategies, how consultants influence those decisions, and how to effectively engage both audiences. You know when to sell directly, when to engage consulting partners, and how to maintain ownership of the sales process.

You'll report to our VP of Revenue and regularly engage with Thatch's founders and executive leadership team on strategic opportunities, partnerships, and enterprise growth.

This is the first of several planned enterprise sales hires. We're looking for a proven individual contributor who is equally excited about helping build the strategy, playbook, and team we'll develop over the next two years. For the right person, this role offers meaningful opportunities for future leadership.

What you'll do

Drive National Enterprise Growth

  • Build and own a national pipeline of large employer opportunities.
  • Lead complex sales cycles from prospecting through contracting.
  • Develop relationships with CHROs, CFOs, benefits leaders, and executive decision-makers.
  • Build compelling financial and strategic business cases for Thatch.
  • Navigate enterprise procurement, RFPs, legal reviews, and multistakeholder decisions.
  • Deliver consistent sales performance, pipeline discipline, and accurate forecasts.

Develop Strategic Consulting Relationships

  • Build relationships with Mercer, Aon, WTW, Lockton, Gallagher, and other leading consulting firms.
  • Understand consultant influence, RFP processes, and employer decision-making.
  • Generate opportunities through both direct employer engagement and consulting partnerships.
  • Maintain direct employer relationships while working collaboratively with consultants.
  • Position Thatch as a credible alternative to traditional employer-sponsored healthcare.

Bring Deep Healthcare Expertise

  • Translate complex healthcare financing and benefits strategies into executive-level conversations.
  • Understand fully insured, self-funded, and alternative employer healthcare models.
  • Engage employers on healthcare costs, financial risk, plan design, and employee experience.
  • Partner with internal finance, product, carrier, and operations teams to develop solutions.
  • Guide employers and consultants through the evaluation of ICHRA and emerging healthcare models.

Help Build Our Enterprise Business

  • Partner with the VP of Revenue to shape enterprise sales strategy and execution.
  • Help establish target account strategies, sales processes, and consulting engagement models.
  • Provide market feedback to inform product development and enterprise positioning.
  • Contribute to hiring, mentoring, and developing future enterprise sellers.
  • Remain accountable for individual sales performance while helping scale the organization.

Background we're looking for

Required Experience

  • 5–7+ years of enterprise sales experience in employer-sponsored healthcare, insurance, or benefits solutions.
  • Proven success originating and closing complex, high-value enterprise opportunities.
  • Experience in one or more of the following:
    • Health insurance carriers, particularly national accounts or large group.
    • Third-party administrators (TPAs) or self-funded benefits administration.
    • Employer benefits consulting or healthcare advisory services.
    • Healthcare benefits technology and solutions, including navigation, cost management, and care delivery.
  • Experience working with national consulting firms and understanding their role in employer purchasing decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to sell directly to employers and alongside consulting partners.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise procurement, RFPs, contracting, and executive decision processes.
  • Established credibility with senior HR, finance, and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong financial acumen, executive communication, and negotiation skills.
  • Willingness to travel nationally.

Experience We'd Be Especially Excited About

  • Deep self-funded healthcare expertise, including ASO, stop-loss, claims experience, network strategies, and renewal economics.
  • Established relationships with national benefits consultants and large employer decision-makers.
  • Experience selling innovative healthcare solutions that challenge traditional insurance models.
  • Familiarity with ICHRA, defined contribution benefits, or alternative healthcare financing.
  • Success creating direct employer demand rather than relying exclusively on consultant referrals.
  • Experience building a new market, enterprise sales motion, or go-to-market strategy.
  • Interest in mentoring sellers and potentially leading an enterprise team as Thatch grows.

Who Thrives in This Role

You're a builder. You want to create an enterprise business, not simply inherit a territory and established playbook.

You understand healthcare. You know how employers, consultants, carriers, and administrators interact, and you're comfortable discussing the economics of self-funded healthcare.

You can sell directly and through partners. You value consulting relationships but know how to create demand and develop executive relationships independently.

You can sell change. You're comfortable challenging conventional thinking and guiding sophisticated employers through consequential healthcare decisions.

You operate at the executive level. You can engage a CFO on healthcare economics, a CHRO on workforce strategy, and a consultant on benefits design.

You have an ownership mentality. You're resourceful, accountable, and energized by building something new.

You want to grow. You're motivated by individual success today and the opportunity to help build and potentially lead a national enterprise sales team tomorrow.

Why Thatch

Enterprise healthcare is at an inflection point. Employers are looking for alternatives to traditional approaches that have delivered rising costs, limited flexibility, and increasingly complex benefits experiences.

Thatch is positioned to help lead that transformation.

You'll have the opportunity to work directly with our founders and executive team, shape our national enterprise strategy, influence product development, and help build a business with significant growth potential.

We're looking for someone who wants to win meaningful enterprise business today and help build the organization that will define our growth tomorrow.

What to expect

We interview rigorously based on integrity, talent, and drive; the trust we display in our teammates from day 1 is a reflection of the confidence we have in this process. We aim to evaluate the things you’ll be doing every day as best we can, and we move quickly. Here's what to expect:

  • 30 minute video meeting to talk through your background and interest in Thatch
  • 30-45 minute video meeting with the hiring manager to get a high level understanding of your experience and deep into your sales experience
  • 30 minute video meeting to meet 3 members of the team
  • 30 minute video meeting to go over a case study assignment
  • 30 minute video meeting with our founders to discuss your approach to culture and our operating principles

Please note: The posted compensation range reflects On-Target Earnings (OTE), not base salary.

Estimated Compensation Range
$250,000—$300,000 USD

Every therapist on the remote caseload starts with six in-person brace fittings on patients from your own current caseload, so you know the devices you will be coaching patients on. Requirements

    • Active physical therapist or physical therapist assistant license in the state where you practice.
    • Currently working in home health or another in-home setting.
    • You evaluate and provide treatment.

jobs.description:
As a data entry keyer for our growing company, you’re part of a functional team that focuses on getting things right the first time around. You get to work independently, with minimal supervision, to read our work orders, shipping orders and other customer service documents, and enter data from them into our computer systems. Your job is integral to the smooth operating of our company, as you verify the information before you enter it, and you key it in so it is consistent in format. We do understand that data entry for hours on end becomes repetitive, so we have built-in filing and copying time to vary your days and to keep your eyes sharp.

Pay: $20.00 - $30.00 per hour.

Job Responsibilities

  • Read customer and shipping orders submitted in person, via the print catalog and online; decipher handwriting that can be hard to read
  • Key data into specific Microsoft Excel fields (much of the work for the online orders should already be done for you); 10 percent of orders tend to be in person, 15 percent via catalog and the rest online
  • Read and key in data from other source documents
  • Verify that the data is accurate before you enter it
  • Ensure that data is consistent throughout the system (example: if a customer has moved to a new address, you would check that the new address is in other pertinent places in the system)
  • Report any data errors or anomalies to your supervisor
  • Keep accurate and updated logs of ongoing work
  • Perform filing, copying and other administrative duties for about three hours per day; expect to spend about five hours daily on data entry keying

Job Skills & Qualifications

Required:

  • Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook)
  • Reading comprehension
  • Critical thinking
  • Organization
  • Good communication skills
  • Patience for repetitive work

Preferred:

  • Reading knowledge of English (about 5 to 10 percent of our orders are also in Spanish)
  • One to two years of experience with data entry and/or filing
  • Social perceptiveness
  • Service orientation

Wonder Works employees have a winning attitude and champion innovation, teamwork and accountability through a results-oriented, customer-centric, and fun culture. We offer various health and financial benefits, learning and growth opportunities, competitive salary compensation, rewarding bonus programs, and a wide range of work-life benefits designed to make your life easier.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Wonder Works is one of the most respected Development and Construction firms in the Tri-State area that have earned its reputation by building with integrity and quality since 1987.

The construction process is broken up into three distinct phases: Pre-construction/Pre-development, Construction, and Post Construction/Close Out. At Wonder Works, we pride ourselves on the quality of services we provide within each phase. Unlike other builders, we offer flexibility in Delivery Methods for all phases of the work. Each situation and phase is unique and in order to be successful one cannot always follow established paradigms. We can act as General Contractor, Design-Builder, Construction Manager and even Developer.

jobs.description:
Established in 2022, Guardz rapidly emerged as a noteworthy player in the cybersecurity sphere, securing $85M in funding and rallying a dedicated team of 120 industry professionals. Our vision is to foster a safer digital landscape for small and medium businesses across the globe. To this end, we introduced our comprehensive all-in-one platform, and continue to grow and expand our team, our partnerships and our revenue.

We are looking for an experienced, highly resourceful Senior Threat Researcher to join Guardz's Security Research team.

In this role, you will operate at the intersection of advanced threat research, detection engineering, and incident response, serving as a key technical escalation point for our security research teams and also for the global Managed Detection and Response (MDR) team.
You will investigate complex security incidents, uncover emerging threats, develop effective detection mechanisms, and conduct security market research to help shape our product capabilities and security strategy.
This is a highly hands-on, high-impact position for someone who thrives on solving complex problems, takes ownership, and is comfortable navigating uncharted technical territory.

Responsibilities:

  • Research emerging attack techniques, vulnerabilities, and adversarial behaviors, translating findings into effective detection rules, security controls, and response capabilities.
  • Research emerging cybersecurity technologies, competitor capabilities, market trends, and evolving attack surfaces to identify opportunities for product innovation and differentiation.
  • Continuously evaluate detection effectiveness, identify coverage gaps, reduce false positives, and improve detection accuracy.
  • Serve as a senior technical escalation point for Guardz's global MDR team, leading complex investigations, threat hunting, root cause analysis, and incident response guidance.
  • Partner with Security Research, Product, Engineering, and MDR teams to turn technical findings and field insights into scalable security capabilities.
  • Partner with Customer Success and other go-to-market teams to provide expert security guidance and technical context for customer-facing discussions involving complex incidents, findings, and response actions.
  • Develop investigation methodologies, detection strategies, and response playbooks, while mentoring and supporting analysts across our global security operations.
  • Independently explore new technologies, tools, and research methodologies to anticipate emerging threats and strengthen Guardz's security offering.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in threat research, detection engineering, incident response, or advanced security operations.
  • Strong background in Tier 3 security operations, including complex incident investigations, threat hunting, and threat mitigation.
  • Deep understanding of modern attack techniques, adversary behavior, and frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Hands-on expertise in cloud, identity, email, and endpoint security, particularly Microsoft 365, Entra ID, and/or Google Workspace.
  • Experience developing, testing, and optimizing detection logic within SIEM, EDR, XDR, or similar security platforms.
  • Strong scripting and analytical capabilities, including Python and SQL.
  • Experience researching AI-driven threats, agentic AI security, or AI-powered detection and response.
  • Broad knowledge of cybersecurity technologies, attacker methodologies, and the modern security vendor landscape.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain sophisticated technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Assistant Controller, Client Onboarding

Topo is hiring key team members for its accounting team. If you’ve ever been interested in working at a startup as a member of the initial team, this is it!

Topo provides fractional embedded accounting and finance support to venture-backed companies. Topo’s customers look to us as early-stage company experts focused on helping their companies succeed.

We are looking for a strong Assistant Controller to join our Client Onboarding team and help new Topo clients start on a clean, well-built foundation. You’ll work hands-on with CEOs and leadership team members at dynamic software and services companies during their first 30–60 days with Topo, getting their books, systems, and processes into shape so they’re ready for long-term success.

This position can be remote based in the US. The company is headquartered and based in Indianapolis, Indiana.

About this role: Every new Topo client starts with onboarding. In this role, you’ll help take clients from signed agreement to fully operational in roughly 30–60 days: assessing their current systems and books, setting them up in Topo’s systems, cleaning up historical accounting, and putting sound processes in place before handing them off to the Topo team that will support their accounting on an ongoing basis. We’re looking for a high agency person with a strong understanding of and an interest in startups, who enjoys bringing order to messy books and thrives working across several new clients at once. This role will become increasingly strategic as the individual grows within Topo.

What You’ll Do:

  • As the Onboarding Assistant Controller you will kick off new client engagements, gathering system access, documents, and background on the client’s business and accounting history.
  • Assess each client’s current accounting systems, chart of accounts, tech stack, and historical books to identify cleanup needs, gaps, and risks.
  • Set up new clients in Topo’s systems and tools, including chart of accounts design or restructuring, bank and credit card feeds, and integrations with payroll, billing, and expense platforms.
  • Perform historical cleanup, including account reconciliations, catch-up bookkeeping, reclassifications, and adjusting entries, so balances are accurate and supportable.
  • Run the client’s first month-end closes with Topo, establishing close checklists, reconciliation schedules, and reporting packages, and support initial budget and cash flow setup where in scope.
  • Document and implement accounting processes and workflows (e.g., AP, AR, payroll, revenue, and expense management), recommending improvements where needed.
  • Coordinate with tax advisors, and prior accountants to obtain records and resolve open items, ensuring timely and accurate completion of deliverables.
  • Support and guide Topo team members assisting on onboarding engagements.
  • Research technical accounting questions that arise during cleanup and setup, and provide guidance internally and to clients.
  • Prepare complete handoff documentation and support a smooth transition to the ongoing Topo accounting team.

What You’ll Need:

  • You’re organized and demonstrate a high attention to detail and accuracy.
  • You’re a self-starter who can put ideas into action.
  • You love working with numbers and helping people.
  • You enjoy diagnosing and cleaning up messy books, and you take pride in leaving things better than you found them.
  • You’re comfortable working directly with clients, asking good questions, and setting clear expectations during a period of change.
  • You can manage several onboarding engagements at different stages, keep each on track against tight timelines, and write clear documentation others can pick up and run with.
  • You have the ability to quickly shift from high-level strategic thinking to tactical execution.

Marketing strategy and campaigns

Social media and brand awareness

Team leadership

  • Manage and develop our Digital Marketing Manager and our Marketing Designer, setting clear priorities and giving regular feedback.

  • Work closely with our Content and Tech teams, who own our teaching resources, SEO, and site infrastructure.

Your first 90 days

  • Know our teachers: Learn who they are, what motivates them, and how they find us today.

  • Product marketing: Build and present a product marketing strategy for our AI localization tool, with the launch campaign to follow within your first six months.

  • Campaigns and channels: Refresh our campaign calendar and channel strategy against our teacher reach targets, including Earth Month, our biggest campaign of the year.

What we're looking for

Must have

  • A genuine connection to our mission, whether that comes from climate, education, or working with kids.

  • Experience running influencer or creator partnerships.

  • Knowledge of marketing tools and channels beyond the usual playbook.

  • A background in education, edtech, or product.

Classroom teaching experience is not required. Our Content team brings the teacher voice; we need your marketing expertise.

Details

  • Location: Remote

  • Hours: Fractional, about 20 hours per week. This is an ongoing role, not a fixed-term contract. Many of our leadership roles are fractional, including our Chief Technology Officer, Finance Manager, and HR Manager.

  • Reports to: Chief Operating Officer

  • Manages: Digital Marketing Manager and Marketing Designer

  • Employment type: Contract (fractional). This role is not eligible for benefits.

SubjectToClimate is a free online platform for all K-12 educators to integrate climate action into what they already teach. Our 3,000+ teacher-reviewed, scientist-approved resources span every grade and subject, and our AI-powered localization tool adapts any resource to a teacher's own community.

We sit where three worlds meet. We are a philanthropy-funded nonprofit, so our materials stay free for every teacher, always.
