jobs.description:
Job Description

About the Organization


Join the team building GM's next generation of autonomous driving, starting with eyes-off driving on the highway and growing toward point-to-point autonomy. The goal is autonomous capability that is safe, reliable, comfortable, and scalable across GM's vehicle portfolio. Autonomy Evaluation helps the AV program figure out where the driver still falls short. Every mile our vehicles drive, on the road or in simulation, carries that signal. We turn it into answers: what is limiting the system, how big each problem is, and what fixing it is worth. Those answers steer what GM's autonomy teams build next and inform software release decisions. We partner closely with Autonomy, Simulation, Systems, Safety, and Software Validation.


The Role


As a Principal Engineer in Autonomy Evaluation, you will own how we evaluate the autonomous driver, from overall driving behavior down to individual subsystems. You'll take on questions like: How do we measure whether the car drives well, not just safely? When a behavior goes wrong, which subsystem caused it, and how much does that error matter on the road? How do we find the failures we don't know to look for? You'll turn the answers into methods other teams adopt, priorities other organizations commit to, and evidence that release decisions rely on. You'll prototype and land code yourself, and you'll grow the Staff and Senior engineers who carry the work forward. You are a senior individual contributor with no direct reports.


What You'll Do


  • Set the multi-year technical direction for evaluation. Decide which questions matter most, which methods to invest in, and which to retire.
  • Invent new ways to judge overall driving behavior, such as learned or VLM-based judges of driving quality, comparison with how expert humans drive, counterfactual and closed-loop analysis, and discovery of unknown failure modes in the long tail.
  • Define how we evaluate subsystems such as perception, prediction, planning, and localization, including learned components, with metrics that reflect each subsystem's real effect on driving rather than accuracy alone.
  • Trace bad driving back to the subsystem or interaction that caused it, and measure how subsystem errors add up to driving outcomes.
  • Define how we tell whether a software or model change actually improves driving, including regression detection and version-to-version comparison, so engineering teams and release reviews get trustworthy answers quickly.
  • Turn observed behavior into measured, ranked problems. Size issues with metrics and scene classifiers, build a Pareto of the problem space, and drive fixes with the teams that own them.
  • Own the scientific rigor of evaluation: sampling, statistical confidence, metric validity, and agreement between simulation and road results. Make every result's assumptions and limits explicit, and resolve the hardest disagreements between signals, such as simulation versus road or a subsystem metric versus a driving metric.
  • Turn results into clear recommendations for engineering and leadership: what changed, how confident we are, and what to do next.
  • Mentor Staff and Senior engineers through research and design reviews and written technical direction.

Your Skills & Abilities


  • 10+ years of experience in autonomous systems, robotics, ML evaluation, or applied data science, with a track record of turning analysis into decisions and shipped improvements.
  • A track record of creating new evaluation or measurement methods that were adopted beyond your own team.
  • Deep experience designing statistically sound evaluations of dynamic systems, including sampling, confidence intervals, experimental design, hypothesis testing, and the precision and recall of classifiers on time-series data.
  • Strong production Python and SQL skills, including testing and code review.
  • A record of starting from raw observations, defining and sizing the problem, and driving it to resolution with data that others trust.
  • Proven ability to influence without authority: aligning peers, partner teams, and leadership on technical direction, and getting commitments from organizations you don't manage.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement. You build trusted relationships with partners such as Autonomy, Simulation, Safety, and Software Validation, understand what they need from evaluation, and keep them engaged through ambiguity and disagreement.
  • Experience growing senior engineers through mentorship, design reviews, and written technical direction.
  • Strong ability to turn ambiguous questions and uncertain results into clear recommendations for executive, engineering, and cross-functional audiences.
  • Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering, Machine Learning, Statistics, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge


  • Experience in autonomous driving or field robotics, including large-scale analysis of driving logs and AV sensor data (camera, lidar, radar) from both simulation and on-road testing.
  • Experience producing evaluation evidence for validation and release decisions, ideally for driver-assistance or automated-driving products.
  • Experience applying VLMs or LLMs to event classification, triage, or scenario discovery.
  • Experience with ML model interpretability, such as attribution, ablations, or embedding analysis.
  • Strong data-visualization instincts, with the ability to turn high-dimensional metrics into clear, trustworthy views.
  • Familiarity with C++, especially for reading or contributing to autonomy stack code.

Compensation

Commercial Pricing & RFP Analyst

About Securitas USA

Securitas Security Services USA, Inc. is the global leader in protective services, delivering specialized guarding, advanced technology solutions, and comprehensive risk management to clients across a wide range of industries. Our mission is simple yet powerful: to help make your world a safer place. With a proud legacy of 90 years, built on trust, innovation, and international expertise, we take pride in offering security solutions that are tailored to each client’s unique needs. By combining cutting-edge technology with exceptional service, we continue to redefine what safety and security mean in today's world.

What You’ll Do

As a Commercial Pricing & RFP Analyst, you will play an important role in developing competitive, financially sound pricing strategies for new and existing business opportunities. Supporting Global Clients Americas (GCA) National Sales, you will work at the intersection of Sales, Finance, Operations, and Legal, translating RFP requirements, client pricing formats, labor costs, operating expenses, and contractual considerations into thoughtful commercial recommendations.

This is not a traditional Finance role. It is a highly visible, commercially focused position for someone who enjoys using financial analysis to solve business problems, influence decisions, and support growth. The ideal candidate combines strong Excel and financial modeling capabilities with sound commercial judgment, curiosity, and the ability to communicate financial insights to both financial and non-financial stakeholders.

  • Own pricing analysis for RFPs and commercial opportunities, translating client requirements and varying pricing templates into clear, accurate financial models and recommendations.
  • Evaluate the economics of potential business, including labor costs, operating expenses, margin, profitability, contractual requirements, and potential pricing risks while balancing competitiveness with sustainable returns.
  • Partner across Sales, Operations, Finance, and Legal to gather inputs, evaluate commercial considerations, and ensure pricing deliverables are accurate and completed within RFP deadlines.
  • Develop scenario and sensitivity analyses that help business leaders understand pricing alternatives, trade-offs, risks, and potential financial outcomes.
  • Present and summarize financial analysis for business leaders, providing clear insights that support commercial decisions and growth opportunities.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

Who you are

An ideal candidate brings:

  • A service-first mindset, clear communication skills, strong attention to detail, and sound judgment when approaching challenges. The ideal candidate is solutions-focused and thrives in both independent and team settings.
  • A bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field.
  • Experience in pricing, financial analysis, RFP/bid support, or a closely related commercial finance environment.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel and financial modeling skills, particularly related to cost, margin, profitability, and scenario analysis.
  • The ability to evaluate labor costs, operating expenses, contractual requirements, and pricing risk and translate that analysis into actionable business insights.
  • Strong organizational and communication skills, including the ability to manage multiple deliverables and deadlines and clearly summarize financial analysis for leadership.

Experience that sets you apart:

  • Experience supporting pricing requirements and deliverables for complex RFPs or bids.
  • Exposure to contracts and commercial terms and an understanding of how those considerations can affect pricing decisions.
  • Experience evaluating complex bids, pricing, or commercial proposals from the client/buyer side, including procurement, sourcing, or bid analysis. Experience in consulting or professional services supporting similar work is also highly valued.
  • Experience with Power BI.
  • Experience working with CRM or ERP platforms.
  • Experience operating in a cross-functional environment with Sales, Operations, Finance, and Legal stakeholders.

Why you would want to join the team

  • Make a direct impact on growth. Rather than focusing solely on traditional financial reporting, you’ll help shape the pricing and commercial decisions behind new and existing business opportunities.
  • Gain meaningful leadership exposure. The role provides the opportunity to interact with senior decision-makers, including C-suite leaders, AVPs, and Regional Presidents, as opportunities and pricing strategies are evaluated.
  • Broaden your commercial toolkit. You’ll gain experience beyond traditional financial analysis through exposure to pricing, RFPs, contracts, operations, sales, and commercial decision-making.
  • Get closer to the decisions that move the business. You’ll see how financial analysis, client requirements, operational realities, contractual considerations, and sales strategy come together when determining how to approach an opportunity.
  • Take on varied and challenging work. Every client and RFP can bring different information, requirements, and pricing formats, giving you the opportunity to solve new problems rather than work from a single standardized model.
  • Accelerate your development through exposure. This role is well suited to someone with a few years of experience who wants greater challenge, visibility, and the opportunity to build the skills needed to become a strong commercial business partner and decision-maker.
  • This is a U.S.-based remote role, with limited travel anticipated at less than 10%.

jobs.excerpt: Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential.
jobs.description:
Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

As Oura grows, more of our reporting work falls outside the routine close: capital markets activity, complex commercial deals, acquisitions, and the systems that support a larger company. We're looking for a Senior Manager, Financial Reporting to own these complex and non-recurring reporting areas end to end and to bring deeper SEC reporting expertise to our filings.You'll lead the financial reporting work for debt offerings, review non-standard deals for reporting and disclosure impacts, own segment reporting and goodwill, and drive the disclosure side of M&A. You'll support our S-1 and recurring SEC filings, act as a SEC reporting expert when needed, and lead financial reporting support for the proxy statement. You'll also represent financial reporting in ERP and finance transformation efforts. You'll partner closely with Technical Accounting, External Reporting, Treasury, Legal, Tax, FP&A, and our external auditors.Note: the scope of this role will evolve as Oura grows, and the responsibilities below reflect what it can include.

What You Will Do:

Capital markets and debt offerings

  • Lead financial reporting for debt offerings as needed, including preparing and reviewing financial information in offering documents and related filings.
  • Own the circle-up and tie-out process with Legal, Treasury, outside counsel, and auditors, including support for comfort letter procedures.
  • Coordinate timelines and deliverables across internal and external working groups.

External filings

  • Support the S-1 and recurring SEC filings (10-Q, 10-K, and 8-K), including drafting and reviewing financial statements, footnotes, and MD&A sections, and helping the team through quarterly and year-end peak periods.
  • Lead financial reporting support for the annual proxy statement, partnering with Legal and Total Rewards.
  • Serve as an in-house SEC reporting expert: monitor new and changing SEC rules and disclosure requirements, assess what they mean for Oura, and recommend how we apply them, in partnership with SEC counsel.
  • Provide a senior layer of review across the team's filings, with a focus on complex, judgmental, or first-time disclosures.

Non-standard deal reviews

  • Review non-standard commercial agreements (customer, partner, and supplier contracts) for financial reporting and disclosure implications.
  • Partner with Technical Accounting on accounting conclusions and with Legal, Sales, and Operations to flag reporting impacts early in the deal process.

Segment reporting

  • Own segment reporting under ASC 280, including operating segment and CODM assessments, segment disclosures, and enhanced segment expense disclosures as applicable.
  • Partner with FP&A to keep internal management reporting and external segment disclosures aligned.

Goodwill

  • Own the annual and interim goodwill impairment assessment process under ASC 350, including reporting unit determinations, coordination with FP&A and valuation specialists, and related disclosures.
  • M&A (disclosure side) + Strategic Investment Management
  • Lead disclosure requirements for acquisitions, including ASC 805 disclosures and, where required, pro forma financial information.
  • Partner with Technical Accounting, which owns purchase price allocation and diligence, so accounting and disclosures stay consistent.
  • Partner with Technical Accounting on a target’s financial statement audit.
  • Ensure proper disclosure requirements of strategic investment portfolio, like VIEs, including ensuring proper capture into consolidated financials.
  • ERP and finance transformation
  • Represent financial reporting requirements in ERP and finance transformation initiatives, including chart of accounts design, reporting structures, and testing.
  • Identify opportunities to automate and standardize reporting processes.

Controls and audit

  • Design and maintain effective internal controls over your areas, in partnership with the SOX team.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for external auditors on your areas and drive timely resolution of audit requests.
  • Maintain clear documentation and process narratives.
  • Back up External Reporting on SEC-style reporting and financial statement preparation as needed.

What you'll bring

  • 8+ years of progressive accounting and financial reporting experience, including Big 4 or national firm experience.
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance; active CPA required.
  • Strong working knowledge of US GAAP and SEC reporting, with hands-on experience in ASC 280, ASC 350, and ASC 805.
  • Experience supporting debt or capital markets transactions, including offering documents, circle-ups, and comfort letter processes.
  • Ability to read complex commercial contracts and translate them into reporting and disclosure impacts.
  • Exposure to ERP implementations or finance transformation projects.
  • Strong project management skills and the ability to run multiple workstreams with external parties.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining complex topics to non-accounting partners.

jobs.excerpt: We are looking for a Director of Cloud Platform & Operations to lead our Cloud Operations and DevOps teams and evolve the way we build, operate, secure, and scale our cloud platforms.
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Director of Cloud Platform & Operations to lead our Cloud Operations and DevOps teams and evolve the way we build, operate, secure, and scale our cloud platforms.

This is a senior technical leadership role combining people leadership, cloud architecture, DevOps, security, reliability, and automation. You will be responsible for assessing our current practices, identifying opportunities for improvement, and establishing standards that enable our engineering teams to deliver software securely and efficiently.

You will lead and develop the members of our Cloud Operations and DevOps teams while working closely with Engineering and Product leadership to ensure our platforms support the needs of our products and customers.

We operate primarily in the Microsoft Azure ecosystem, and we are actively embracing AI and automation throughout our organization. We are looking for someone who will challenge manual processes, improve developer self-service, strengthen our security posture, and explore how AI and automation can make cloud operations more proactive and efficient.

This is a hands-on leadership role. We want someone who can set strategy and develop people, but who is also technical enough to dive into our architecture, pipelines, infrastructure, security controls, monitoring, and operational practices when needed.

What You'll Do

  • Lead and manage our Cloud Operations and DevOps teams, providing direction, coaching, mentorship, and professional development.
  • Assess our existing cloud architecture, DevOps, and operational practices and develop a strategy for continuously improving them.
  • Establish standards and best practices for Microsoft Azure, cloud infrastructure, networking, identity, access management, and platform services.
  • Strengthen our cloud security posture, including identity and access, secrets management, vulnerability management, infrastructure hardening, and secure development and deployment practices.
  • Drive improvements to CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, deployment automation, environment management, and developer self-service.
  • Establish strong practices around observability, monitoring, reliability, incident management, disaster recovery, and operational readiness.
  • Partner with Engineering teams to improve the developer experience, reducing friction between writing software and safely running it in production.
  • Help evolve traditional DevOps practices towards a more scalable platform engineering and self-service model where appropriate.
  • Establish clear standards and metrics around availability, reliability, performance, security, cloud consumption, and operational efficiency.
  • Manage and optimize cloud infrastructure costs while ensuring performance, scalability, reliability, and security requirements are met.
  • Champion the use of AI and automation to reduce repetitive operational work, improve troubleshooting and incident response, identify risks earlier, and increase team productivity.
  • Work closely with Engineering leadership to ensure platform capabilities and operational practices support the needs of our products and customers.
  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement and operational ownership, including learning from incidents and addressing root causes rather than repeatedly treating symptoms.

Nice to Have

  • Experience operating multi-tenant enterprise SaaS platforms.
  • Strong Microsoft Azure experience.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps and GitHub.
  • Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or Bicep.
  • Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC and cloud identity/security.
  • Experience with cloud security tooling such as Microsoft Defender for Cloud.
  • Experience with Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics and KQL.
  • Experience establishing or evolving SRE and Platform Engineering practices.
  • Experience with FinOps and cloud cost optimization.
  • Familiarity with security frameworks and practices such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, OWASP and NIST.
  • Experience operating cloud platforms across multiple products, regions, or environments.
  • Experience supporting distributed engineering organizations.
  • Experience using AI and automation within DevOps, SRE, security, or cloud operations.

Find Your Passion at Experlogix

Volunteer: Communications Manager, VoteUSA

Remote (U.S.‑based) • Volunteer • Communications Leadership • Civic Engagement

Fraud and phishing warning If you are reading this away from the WeVote site, please apply directly via our volunteering portal/ATS at . Do not apply via any other job portals, aggregators, or sites, as your information may not be secure, or the role may no longer be accepting applications. Thank you.

Join the Movement

WeVote’s partner VoteUSA has an open volunteering position for a Communications Manager (~5 hours per week) who wants to use their existing skills, grow new ones, and help strengthen American democracy.

About VoteUSA

Vote-USA.org informs and educates voters by producing comprehensive, nonpartisan election information for national, state, and many local elections. Founded in 2003 by Ron Kahlow, VoteUSA has researched 20,000+ candidates and 500+ issues, helping voters understand who and what they are voting for. The organization continues to close the voter‑information gap through accessible, factual election data.

About WeVote

A longtime partner of VoteUSA, WeVote is a nonpartisan, volunteer-powered civic‑tech nonprofit and a Fast Forward nonprofit technology grantee. With 150+ active volunteers, WeVote builds open‑source mobile tools that help voters make informed decisions in about eight minutes — including downloading the WeVote Ballot Guide app. Learn more at or @WeVote. We are a 100% remote organization.

What You’ll Do

As Communications Manager, you will lead VoteUSA’s communications operations, manage a small team, and oversee nationwide outreach campaigns.

  • Team Leadership — Manage VoteUSA’s Communications Team and coordinate with WeVote leadership.

  • Email Campaign Oversight — Oversee regular email campaigns to candidates, election officials, and voters (candidate outreach, election official verification, voter education/GOTV, volunteer communications).

  • Communications Calendar — Develop a communications calendar and metrics to assess campaign effectiveness (engagement, response rates, etc.).

  • Workflow Improvement — Build communication processes, improve workflows, and document best practices for consistency and efficiency.

  • Agile Team Management — Run weekly agile meetings, mentor volunteers, and onboard new team members.

  • Cross‑Team Collaboration — Work with Political Data and Business Development teams to ensure outreach is based on accurate election information.

  • Task Assignment — Match volunteers with tasks suited to their skill levels; review work products and propose efficiency improvements.

  • OKR Management — Support and track team OKRs, train volunteers unfamiliar with OKRs, follow up on deadlines, adjust schedules, and communicate changes.

  • Reporting — Provide brief reports in meetings, via email, and in team newsletters on project status.

  • Documentation — Keep communication documentation accurate and current.

Who You Are: Must‑Haves

  • Weekly Availability — Able to volunteer at least 3–4 hours per week during WeVote’s core hours (M–F, 9 a.m.–6 p.m. PT).

  • Commitment to Democracy — You want to work with an established, successful team and are committed to strengthening American democracy.

  • Personal Excellence — You strive for high‑quality work and continuous improvement.

  • Collaboration — Willingness to work with and support other volunteers.

  • U.S. Location — Must be located in the U.S. with 1–2 hours per week overlapping with Pacific Time.

Nice to Have (Not Required)

  • Additional Volunteering — If you have more than 5 hours per week, opportunities exist to contribute more broadly within WeVote.

  • Communications Background — Experience in communications, PR, nonprofit outreach, marketing, journalism, or strong written communication skills.

What You’ll Gain

You will help shape nationwide voter‑information outreach and contribute to a movement that will receive national attention. You’ll gain experience leading a remote communications team, managing large‑scale outreach campaigns, and developing nonprofit communications strategies. You’ll also expand your professional network, grow leadership skills, and contribute to tools that empower millions of voters across the United States.

jobs.title: Direct Response Copywriter (Natural Health Sales & Marketing)
jobs.excerpt: Salesman With A Keyboard: You write to make people act.
jobs.description:
Salesman With A Keyboard: You write to make people act. You know how to find the big idea, enter the conversation already happening in the customer’s head, and build a persuasive case from headline to call to action. You can turn a clinical study, customer frustration, product USP, or half-formed brief into a promise people want, proof they believe, and an offer that feels too good to ignore. You understand leads, mechanisms, objections, risk reversal, urgency, and the difference between copy that sounds good and copy that sells. Because the work isn’t finished when the sentence is polished. It’s finished when the customer responds.

If that sounds like you, here’s your next big opportunity:

We want a Direct Response Copywriter to help us write high-performing, conversion-focused copy across ads, emails, sales pages, social, video scripts, blogs, and more.

Small print here ⇒ We’re looking for a direct response copywriter. So if you can’t show us examples of direct response copywriting this isn’t the role for you.

Still here? Okay then…

This job will give you ALL the feels:

We create clinically supported, natural solutions for some of the biggest health challenges women over 40 face today. And your words will help more women discover those solutions.

Your copy will help a menopausal woman understand her body better. Feel more confident in her choices. Take action. And maybe even change the way she thinks about her health, her future, and what’s possible for her.

If that excites you, you’ll find no better place to continue your copywriting career than here.

This job might be for you if you’ve got…

Solid direct response experience. When we look at your portfolio we’ll see a full-spectrum of ads, emails, and sales pages that converted like a Kentucky Tent Revival. There’s no doubt about it… your copy SELLS!

A Makepeace-like ability to turn product features into customer benefits. You don’t stop at “contains calcium, magnesium, boron, and vitamin D3.” You ask: Why does that matter? What does the customer already believe? What are they afraid of? What have they tried? What do they need to understand before this feels worth buying?

A brain that can find the story in the science. You dig through a database of clinical studies, spot the strongest marketing nuggets, and turn them into a compelling product story. You don’t just summarize research. You connect the ingredients, doses, mechanisms, and results in a way that is clear, accurate, persuasive, and easy for a real human to understand. Bonus points if you’ve done this in health, wellness, supplements, or women’s health.

A performance-driven approach to writing. You don’t treat copy like precious art carved into marble. You want to know what worked, what didn’t, and what to test next. CTR, CVR, CPA, open rate, click rate, rankings, traffic, revenue — these numbers don’t bruise your ego. They sharpen your instincts.

The ability to write both short and long. You can write a 12-word ad hook, a 90-character description, a PWAT-style email, a 6,000-word sales page, or a VSL-style script without losing the thread. You know when to be punchy, when to explain, when to agitate, and when to get out of the reader’s way.

A healthy respect for compliance, claims, and accuracy. We work in the health space, which means “sounds convincing” is not good enough. Your copy needs to be truthful, sourced, compliant, and trustworthy. You know how to make a strong point without wandering into forbidden-claim territory wearing a blindfold.

The ability to use AI without letting AI use you. You’re comfortable using AI tools for research, ideation, outlining, variation, and speed. But you still bring the strategy, taste, judgment, empathy, and final polish.

A collaborative, receptive attitude. You’ll work with marketers, designers, video editors, stakeholders, and other writers. You’ll get feedback. Sometimes a lot of it. You don’t need to defend every sentence like it’s a beloved family heirloom. You listen, revise, improve, and make the work better.

A genuine curiosity about the customer. You want to know what she’s worried about. What she’s tried. What she believes. What she secretly fears. What would make her feel relieved. What would make her trust us. That curiosity is what makes your copy feel like it was written for a person, not an avatar on someone’s Canva slide.

Now, time to be honest: is this really you?

If you’re nodding your head and feeling that flutter of excitement, then we can’t wait to

Other Qualities You’ll Need

At AlgaeCal, we’re going to insist that you have these 3 qualities:

  • You’re humble — you put the team and others’ needs ahead of your own.
  • You’re hungry — you want to learn more, improve your craft, and keep getting sharper.
  • You’re people smart — in the sense that you’re a thoughtful, communicative, generous teammate.

The truth is, if you don’t have these qualities, you won’t last long at AlgaeCal.

So if you’re missing one of them, be honest. Save yourself a lot of headaches and skip to a job posting that is a better fit for you.

What Will You Earn?

We believe in rewarding top talent.

So let’s talk about salary once we’ve had the chance to get to know you better.

Rest assured, we’re generous and offer above-market pay for the right person. If you bring the skill, curiosity, work ethic, and copywriting talent, we’ll make sure the compensation reflects that.

You’ll also enjoy the following benefits:

  • Monthly team events and activities
  • Flexible Stat Holidays with the option to bank days for later use
  • Weekly team lunches if you work from our Vancouver office
  • Incredible dog-friendly Yaletown office one block from SkyTrain
  • Remote working is okay with us too

And above all, you’ll join a team that you’ll never want to leave

Culture is everything to us.

Yes, we work extremely hard to change as many people’s lives as possible.

But we know how to have fun, support each other, and reward ourselves too.

How To Apply

So, do you have what it takes to become the next member of Team AlgaeCal?

Job opportunities like this don’t come along often, and we’ve got a lot to offer our successful applicant.

So, to make sure our future Direct Response Copywriter is the real deal, will be a great fit, and will thrive at AlgaeCal, we ask a little more than your run-of-the-mill job application.

If this sounds like a position for you, please respond to this advertisement with your resume, cover letter, and writing sample.

Please read carefully:

Write a cover letter addressing:

  1. Why are you the best Direct Response Copywriter for this role? Give quantifiable examples of related achievements.
  2. Describe why you fit perfectly with our values. Read them here:
  3. What's the toughest challenge you’ve ever overcome in your life? How did you overcome it?
  4. Tell us about your direct response copywriting training. How did you learn the craft, what courses did you do, who mentored you, and how do you stay current?
  5. What are the last three books you’ve read?
  6. What do you do for fun?
  7. Explain what you’re doing now for a job:
    1. If you don’t have one, explain why.
    2. If you have one, explain why you’re looking elsewhere.

Upload your cover letter and resume together as one file.

  • Must attach a piece of copy you’ve written.

We want to see a direct response sales page that you’ve written that clearly demonstrates your understanding of direct response marketing.

Please include the results it produced, if available. We love seeing real-world performance.

Yes, our hiring process is challenging, but it’s our way of selecting the best — and your way of ensuring your AlgaeCal teammates are tops.

Click the “Apply Now” button on this page and upload your cover letter, resume, and writing sample.

Note: Please include your cover letter WITH your resume in one document. Applications without a cover letter will not be read!

We are looking to hire as soon as we find the right person, so act quickly and you can expect a prompt response.

About Life360

Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit .

Life360 is a Remote-First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US) regardless of any specified location above.

We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

Life360’s Corporate Engineering team exists to enable our workforce to be equipped, productive, and secure, wherever they’re working from. That means owning the identity, endpoint, and collaboration experience end to end, and treating the services it owns as a product. This team reports to our CISO and sits right next to Information Security, and the two work as true partners with decisions made together, not thrown over a wall. As Life360 leans further into an AI Native way of working, we're working towards automation & AI based solutions so that routine requests resolve themselves and our people can focus on the problems that need human judgment.

About the Job

We’re hiring an End User Services Engineer to own the experience every Life360 employee has with Corporate Engineering. You’ll be the senior escalation point for our operational identity, access, and device problems, but the job isn’t clearing the queue. It’s making the queue smaller by moving how employees get help from filing tickets to self-service, and by using AI agents, automation, and well-kept knowledge to resolve routine work before a person has to touch it.

This is a role for someone who sees support as a product. You’ll set the standards, measure what matters, coach the front line, and work alongside IT Engineering and Information Security with a real voice in how our operating model evolves. You’ll have the agency and runway to build, and the backing of a company that wants to see what great internal support looks like when AI is part of the team.

A year in, employees describe us as fast and easy. Most routine requests resolve in minutes without a ticket, onboarding is smooth from day one, and the knowledge behind it all is accurate enough that both people and AI agents trust it. Ticket volume per employee is falling while satisfaction climbs, and the front-line team is growing into more engineering-oriented work.

The US-based salary range for this position is $91,000 to $169,000.We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers.

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the end-user experience: define what “delightful” means for our employees, measure it (satisfaction, time to resolution, effort), and hold the team to it

  • Build and expand AI agents and automation (using scripting and APIs) that resolve common requests end to end, with safe defaults such as dry runs, verification after every change, and human approval where it matters
  • Serve as the escalation point for the hardest identity, access, and device issues, and fix root causes so the same problem doesn’t come back
  • Create and maintain service level agreements (SLAs), keep queues healthy (accurate categorization, fast triage, no stale tickets), and use ticket data to spot patterns and remove recurring causes
  • Keep the knowledge base and runbooks accurate and structured so that both people and AI models can rely on them
  • Coach and mentor front line Support Analysts through ticket reviews, shadowing, and onboarding of new End User Services staff
  • Manage the joiner, mover, and leaver lifecycle, automate as much of it as possible, and stress test it continually so we find the gaps before employees do
  • Manage hardware inventory and forecast device needs from hiring plans, refresh cycles, and failure rates; co-own access administration and run quarterly access reviews with Information Security
  • Be the direct link for Corporate Engineering to teams across Life360 and refine how requests route so they reach the right owner the first time

What We’re Looking For

Required Experience

  • Experience in a senior or lead support, end-user services, or end-user computing role, ideally at a remote-first or distributed company
  • Hands-on grounding in identity and access management (single sign-on, multi-factor authentication, provisioning) and in managing macOS and Windows devices through modern device management
  • Experience building or rolling out self-service, such as request catalogs, guided workflows, or automation that measurably reduced ticket volume
  • Proficiency with scripting (e.g., Python, Bash, or PowerShell) and working with APIs to automate IT workflows
  • Experience building or managing AI agents or AI-assisted support tooling, including keeping the knowledge they draw on accurate
  • Experience coaching or mentoring support teammates and improving queue health through metrics and process changes
  • Security-first judgment and comfort partnering with Security and Compliance teams
  • A genuine drive to make the employee experience great, plus clear written communication and documentation that others can follow without you in the room
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

Preferred Experience

  • Experience designing or improving an employee-facing Corporate Engineering or IT service experience using data (satisfaction surveys, effort scores, deflection rates)
  • Experience with IT asset management and hardware forecasting
  • Familiarity with automated user provisioning, SaaS license management, and access review or audit support
  • IT service management certification (e.g., ITIL)

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for employees)
  • Paid parental leave
  • 401(k) plan with company matching program
  • Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being
  • Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns
  • Learning & Development programs
  • Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment
  • Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers

AI Usage: We use AI to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Life360 hiring teams

Life360 Values

Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference

  • Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.
  • Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard.

Our Commitment to Belonging

We believe diverse perspectives make us better, and we’re building a workplace that reflects the communities we serve. Don’t meet every qualification? Apply anyway.

jobs.excerpt: Location: Fully Remote Compensation: $25 to $30 USD/hour Benefits: 15 days PTO.
jobs.description:
Location: Fully Remote
Compensation: $25 to $30 USD/hour
Benefits: 15 days PTO. Christmas Day and New Year's Day paid off.

Fair warning: the pace is intense and the ambiguity is real. But you'll feel yourself growing every single week, even the rough ones, and you'll be doing it next to people who actually celebrate your wins and have your back.

We're the all-in-one agentic marketing platform. AI-native from day one. We're not joining a category, we're defining it.

We're looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to own features end-to-end, from database schema to shipped UI, across the products our customers rely on every day. If you want real ownership, move fast, and raise the bar every week, keep reading. If your best work happens when tickets are fully scoped before they reach you, this will be a tough adjustment.

What you'll own

  • Ship backend and frontend features end-to-end across Atlas Brain, OTTO, Content Genius, Site Explorer, Rank Tracker, and GBP Galactic

  • Design and maintain Django APIs and React/Next.js UIs that hold up under real production load

  • Instrument your own work, observability, error tracking, performance baselines, before anything hits production

  • Push back on specs that don't hold up and propose stronger approaches before a line of code is written

  • Diagnose production incidents end-to-end and own them through to resolution

  • Operate at high throughput alongside agentic tooling, using Claude Code and parallel Git worktrees as a primary development interface

You'll thrive here if...

  • You're equally comfortable in the database, the API layer, and the React component tree

  • You treat a product spec as a hypothesis to pressure-test, not an instruction to execute

  • You don't wait to be told what to do. You see the gap and you move.

  • Deadlines don't rattle you. Ambiguity doesn't either.

  • You're an AI power user, not someone who's "open to learning it someday."

  • You communicate clearly, especially when things are unclear.

  • You have opinions and you're not afraid to bring them.

  • You can laugh at a chaotic week on Friday and mean it.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years shipping production web applications across the full stack

  • Strong Python 3, Django REST Framework, and Celery

  • Strong React, Next.js, and TypeScript

  • PostgreSQL in production, no MySQL

  • Daily fluency with Claude Code, Cursor, or similar agentic development tools. Not "open to it." Actually using it.

  • Experience with Sentry and the Grafana Stack, Loki, Grafana, Tempo, Mimir, for observability and monitoring

  • Docker Compose for local development, GitLab or equivalent for CI/CD

  • Available in UTC or EST

What working here actually looks like

High expectations. Real ownership. Things change fast and we don't apologize for it. You'll work with smart people who push you, a product that keeps getting better, and a team that's genuinely building something new.

You'll sit in a pod: one PM, one designer, two or three engineers. One senior engineer with Claude Code and parallel Git worktrees is expected to deliver what used to take a whole team. That's not a figure of speech.

We'll probably give you more to own than you expected. That's on purpose.

We use AI every day, across every function. That's just how we work.

What we stand for

  • We are obsessed with our customers, and making them obsessed with us

  • We figure it the f**k out

  • We go to war on our problems quickly

  • We are strategic. We work smart, not just hard.

  • We're fun AF

About Search Atlas

Search Atlas helps marketing teams move faster, make smarter decisions, and do more with less. We're a $30M+ ARR company, 215 people, bootstrapped, and building the infrastructure for the next era of marketing. No outside funding. No fluff. Just product.

jobs.description:
Growth Strategist | DTC E-commerce | Remote (UK) | £40,500 – £60,000

Most agency roles manage accounts. This one consults on businesses.

At Soar Group, every client has a Growth Strategist at the centre. You’ll be the trusted external growth leader for a small portfolio of founder-led DTC brands, mostly in health and supplements, with beauty and apparel alongside, across the UK, US and beyond. You’ll diagnose the business, set the growth agenda with founders and leadership teams, and lead our media buying, paid search and creative teams to deliver it.

Who we are

Soar Group is one of the UK’s fastest-growing performance marketing agencies, driving new customer revenue for 8–9 figure DTC brands through Meta, Google, TikTok and Performance Creative. Growth strategy, paid media and creative sit under one roof, so we work as an extension of our clients’ teams, not another agency to manage.

What you’ll do

  • Find the one thing holding a brand back. Diagnose each business from first principles across Offer, Conversion, Creative and Distribution using the Growth Compass, our proprietary framework, and fix the binding constraint first.
  • Own the commercial plan. Build growth roadmaps and forecasts tied to revenue, new customer acquisition and profit targets, and plan peak periods like BFCM well ahead.
  • Lead the room. Run strategic conversations with founders and CMOs, including the difficult ones. You make the final call on budget and strategy, and you’re confident telling a client what needs fixing in their business.
  • Lead through others. Align Media Buyers, Paid Search and Creative Strategists behind one plan. You own the testing framework and approve the key decisions, and the Media Buyer runs the account day to day.
  • Turn data into decisions. Read Shopify, Triple Whale, GA4 and platform data together, and measure what matters: new customer CAC, contribution margin and LTV, alongside MER, ROAS and AOV.
  • Use AI as leverage, every day, for research, analysis, forecasting and reporting.

Requirements

You’ll thrive here if you:

  • Have 3+ years growing DTC e-commerce brands hands-on, with Meta at the core, ideally with fast-growing challenger brands rather than large enterprise names.
  • Think beyond the channel. You know that landing pages, the offer, the product and creative often move results more than campaign structure, and you can tell us about a time you found a brand’s real constraint and fixed it.
  • Are as comfortable in a P&L as in Ads Manager, and fluent in CAC, contribution margin, LTV and MER.
  • Communicate with conviction. You can explain complex problems to a founder in plain English and get buy-in.
  • Understand creative strategy and performance creative.

You might currently be a Senior Paid Social Manager, Head of Performance, Performance Lead, Head of Growth or Head of E-commerce at a scaling brand, or a Creative Strategist with deep commercial chops. Brand-side and agency-side experience is a strong plus.

How we work

Extreme Ownership. Kind Candour. Radical Curiosity. Outcome Obsessed. Every recommendation you make should carry a commercial impact.

Benefits

What you’ll get

  • Fully remote, with hybrid options
  • 28 days’ annual leave (including your birthday, Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve)
  • Private health insurance (after 6 months), life insurance, 24/7 virtual GP and a healthcare cash plan
  • A Professional Development Fund for courses and certifications
  • A Work Abroad Scheme (up to 30 days at a time)
  • Company pension, regular events and team socials

If you think like a founder and act like an operator, we’d love to hear from you.

Soar Group is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace and welcomes applications from all backgrounds.

ABOUT STORD


Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission.


By combining comprehensive commerce-enablement technology with high-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator-built software suite including OMS, Pre- and Post-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale.


With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord’s end-to-end commerce solutions combine best-in-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.


Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like True Classic, Native, Seed Health, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.

About the Role

The Creative Director is the visual and conceptual voice of Stord. Reporting directly to the VP of Marketing, you will set the creative vision for how Stord looks, sounds, and feels across every channel, and lead the studio that brings it to life.

This role is for a hands-on creative leader who moves comfortably between big ideas and finished work. You have strong opinions about what great creative looks like, a portfolio that proves it, and the leadership skills to inspire a studio team and manage agency and freelance partners. You know that creative and performance work together, and you build campaigns that prove it for DTC founders, ecommerce leaders, and the broader commerce ecosystem.

You will partner closely with Product Marketing, Demand Generation, Content, and Sales to make sure Stord's creative is consistent, differentiated, and commercially effective at every touchpoint.

What You'll Do

Creative Vision & Brand Identity

  • Own Stord's creative vision, visual identity, and brand expression, keeping them consistent and distinctive across all channels and audiences
  • Turn Stord's positioning into a clear visual language, voice, and point of view that resonates with mid-market DTC founders and ecommerce operators
  • Act as the creative steward of the brand: set standards, educate the organization, and push for quality at every touchpoint
  • Partner with Product Marketing so creative ladders up to GTM messaging and positioning

Creative Studio Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop the in-house studio of designers, creatives, and content producers
  • Set creative direction and review work across campaigns, sales collateral, web, events, and product marketing assets
  • Build efficient creative processes (briefing, intake, review, and approvals) so the studio delivers high-quality work at the pace of a high-growth company
  • Manage agency and freelance relationships to scale output when needed

Campaigns & Content Creative

  • Develop big ideas and integrated campaign concepts that bring the brand to life across digital, video, social, events, and owned media
  • Direct the creative for thought leadership, video, and editorial content that earns attention and builds brand affinity with DTC founders and ecommerce leaders
  • Partner with Demand Generation and Sales to create work that drives pipeline, and use performance data to sharpen it
  • Make sure all creative reinforces Stord's position as the default operating system for modern commerce

Brand Experience & Visibility

  • Guide creative for major company moments, including product launches, partnerships, and executive announcements
  • Support executive visibility and PR efforts with strong creative storytelling and polished visual assets
  • Collaborate with Communications and Content on a consistent narrative across press, social, and owned channels

What You'll Need

  • 10+ years of progressive creative or marketing experience, with at least 4 years in a Creative Director or equivalent creative leadership role, ideally in VC-backed, high-growth B2B SaaS or tech-enabled services
  • A strong portfolio showing concept-to-execution work across brand, digital, video, campaigns, and sales or product marketing assets
  • Proven experience building or scaling a creative function from an early or underdeveloped state
  • Deep fluency across creative direction, brand identity, design, and storytelling, with the judgment to operate at the strategic level without losing touch with craft
  • Experience leading and developing in-house creative or studio teams, and the ability to attract, retain, and inspire A-players
  • Experience managing agencies, freelancers, and production partners
  • Comfort working as a player-coach: you set direction and hold a high bar, and you roll up your sleeves when the moment calls for it
  • Superior storytelling, presentation skills, and executive presence, with the ability to defend creative decisions and represent the brand with conviction

Leadership Competencies

  • Creative Vision: Turns complex positioning into simple, memorable ideas and visual systems that connect to commercial outcomes
  • Builder's DNA: Thrives in ambiguity; builds the processes, standards, and teams where none existed
  • Creative Rigor: Holds a high bar for quality while moving at the speed of a high-growth business; knows when to ship and when to push
  • Cross-Functional Influence: Earns trust with Marketing, Sales, Product, and executive stakeholders; drives alignment without relying on authority
  • Coaching & Talent Development: Gives clear, constructive feedback and grows creative talent at every level
  • Customer Obsession: Uses voice-of-customer insight to inform creative decisions and keeps the DTC founder and ecommerce operator at the center of the work
  • UX Ownership: Brings deep understanding and empathy for the user experience and owns translating it into exceptional, engaging design

Education & Experience

  • 10+ years of creative or marketing experience, including 4+ years leading creative direction in a high-growth B2B environment
  • Experience managing and scaling an in-house creative or brand studio
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver integrated campaigns that drive measurable business results
  • Bachelor's degree in design, communications, marketing, or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • Bonus: prior experience in ecommerce SaaS, logistics, or commerce-adjacent technology

jobs.excerpt: Ascensus is the leading independent technology and service platform powering savings plans across America, providing products and expertise that help nearly 16 million people save for a better today and tomorrow.
jobs.description:
Ascensus is the leading independent technology and service platform powering savings plans across America, providing products and expertise that help nearly 16 million people save for a better today and tomorrow.

Section 1: Position Summary

The Senior Fraud Investigator is a senior individual contributor responsible for leading complex or high-impact investigations, identifying emerging fraud patterns, and serving as a subject matter expert within the fraud function. This role is expected to operate with a high degree of independence and sound judgment while managing complex casework and contributing to broader fraud risk strategies. In addition to conducting investigations, the Senior Fraud Investigator helps strengthen the fraud program by identifying root causes, recommending control or process improvements, and partnering across the organization to improve fraud prevention and response.

Section 2: Job Functions, Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead complex fraud investigations involving multiple accounts, transactions, channels, and/or subjects
  • Identify and analyze emerging fraud trends, typologies, and risk indicators
  • Conduct root cause analysis of fraud events and identify opportunities to strengthen fraud controls
  • Use internal systems, reporting, and available data sources to investigate linked activity and suspicious patterns
  • Prepare clear, concise, and comprehensive case documentation, investigative summaries, and escalation materials
  • Support high-priority escalations and complex fraud events requiring timely containment and coordination
  • Partner with operations, compliance, legal, technology, and other stakeholders to support investigative outcomes
  • Help improve investigative procedures, documentation standards, and case management practices
  • Provide subject matter expertise and guidance to business partners and team members as needed
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and stronger fraud mitigation practices
  • Responsible for protecting, securing, and proper handling of all confidential data held by Ascensus to ensure against unauthorized access, improper transmission, and/or unapproved disclosure of information that could result in harm to Ascensus or our clients.
  • At Ascensus we are guided by our Core Values of People Matter, Quality First and Integrity Always®. They inspire us every day to prioritize an environment of respect for those we serve and one another and should be visible in your actions on a day-to-day.

Supervision

  • N/A

Section 3: Experience, Skills, Knowledge Requirements

  • Minimum of 3–7 years of progressive experience in fraud investigations, financial crimes, or financial services risk management
  • Strong experience conducting complex investigations involving multiple data points, linked accounts, and suspicious activity patterns
  • Strong knowledge of fraud typologies, investigative techniques, and fraud risk management practices
  • Proven ability to identify emerging fraud patterns and translate findings into actionable recommendations
  • Ability to operate independently and exercise sound judgment in high-risk or ambiguous matters
  • Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate with senior stakeholders and cross-functional partners
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality
  • Proficiency with case management, monitoring, and reporting tools
  • Experience in banking, financial services, retirement services, wealth services, fintech, or law enforcement
  • Experience supporting fraud control improvements or investigative process enhancements
  • Certifications such as CFE, CAMS, or CFCS are a plus
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience preferred

For all virtual remote positions, in order to ensure associates can effectively perform their job duties with no distractions, we require an uninterrupted virtual workspace and there is also an expectation of family care being in place during business hours. Additionally, there is an internet work speed requirement of 25 Mbps or better for individual use. If more than one person is utilizing the same internet connection in the same household or building, then a stronger connection is required. If you are unsure of your internet speed, please check with your service provider. Note: For call center roles specifically, it is a requirement to either hardwire your equipment directly to the internet router or ensure your workstation is in close proximity to the router. Please ensure that you are able to meet these expectations before applying.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer

Be aware of employment fraud. All email communications from Ascensus or its hiring managers originate from @ascensus.com or @futureplan.comemail addresses. We will never ask you for payment or require you to purchase any equipment. If you are suspicious or unsure about validity of a job posting, we strongly encourage you to apply directly through our website.

jobs.description:
Job Title: STEM Expert – Biology & Bioinformatics (PhD)

Job Type: Contract

Location: Remote(Worldwide)

Required Skills:

  • Scientific software configuration

  • Ai/ml-assisted chemistry workflows

  • Quantitative analysis

  • Analytical reasoning

  • Scientific programming

  • Written communication

  • Verbal communication

  • Documentation

  • Problem-solving

Job Summary: In this role, you’ll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, evaluate, and critique biology, bioinformatics, and computational biology workflows to support AI benchmarking initiatives.

  • Provide expert-level insights on genomic, transcriptomic, proteomic, and other biological data analysis pipelines.

  • Assess and optimize pipeline parameters, tool configurations, and statistical methods for accuracy and reproducibility.

  • Analyze biological datasets (e.g., NGS, RNA-seq, single-cell, variant calling, protein structure) and provide actionable recommendations.

  • Leverage domain knowledge to guide the development and validation of biology-related AI models and tools.

  • Communicate complex scientific concepts clearly, both in writing and verbally, to technical and non-technical collaborators.

  • Document findings, methodologies, and best practices to ensure knowledge transfer across the customer’s team.

Areas of Expertise (we welcome applicants from any of the following):

  • Genomics & NGS analysis

  • Transcriptomics & single-cell analysis

  • Proteomics & structural biology

  • Molecular & cell biology

  • Systems biology & biological network analysis

  • Drug discovery & computational pharmacology

  • Biostatistics & machine learning applied to biology

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • PhD in biology, bioinformatics, computational biology, genomics, or a closely related STEM field, or equivalent industry/research experience.

  • Professional written and spoken English (C1 or higher).

  • Deep expertise in at least one of the areas listed above, with hands-on experience analyzing real biological data.

  • Proficiency in Python and/or R for scientific analysis, plus experience with standard tools in your subfield (e.g., BLAST, samtools, GATK, Bioconductor, Biopython).

  • Strong statistical, quantitative, and analytical reasoning skills.

  • Outstanding written and verbal communication abilities, with the ability to clearly document and explain technical concepts.

  • Track record of rigorous scientific problem-solving in complex biological domains.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience building reproducible workflows (Nextflow, Snakemake) and working in Linux/command-line environments.

  • Experience with AI/ML-assisted biology workflows or benchmarking.

  • Peer-reviewed publications, patents, or contributions to open-source bioinformatics software.

Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

Hiring for future needs


POSITION SUMMARY:


Reporting to the Program Manager, the Caseworker is responsible for undertaking the management of specific projects or cases assigned to him/her, within the Specialty Services Department. The Caseworker is responsible for overall management of their patient cases.

PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Telephone support: Implementing call-centre programs including the provision of patient, healthcare professional and

Every therapist on the remote caseload starts with six in-person brace fittings on patients from your own current caseload, so you know the devices you will be coaching patients on. The Channel Manager owns a book of partners end-to-end and drives sourced and influenced pipeline through them. You’ll run the day-to-day partner relationship, own enablement and joint go-to-market, and keep deal registration and partner pipeline accurate and productive. You’ll work directly with the VP of Channel & Alliances and act as a second seat at the table with our top partners.

This is a builder’s role. Our partner program has a defined structure (Managed and Unmanaged tiers, with Professional Services and Distributor categories) and a January formal launch on the horizon. You’ll help turn program design into program reality and carry a real number against the partners you own.

What you’ll do

Own a book of named partners

  • Serve as the primary relationship owner for a book of assigned partners, including select national partner regions (specific GuidePoint regional offices, Trace3 or WWT sub-territories) and Unmanaged-tier partners moving toward Managed status

  • Build real relationships with the reps who sell for you. Know their book, know their quota, know what they need from Quilr to close

Program operations

Required

jobs.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit .

About the Team

Reddit's developer ecosystem is one of the biggest opportunities to make Reddit more useful, expressive, extensible, and valuable. Today, most people who build on Reddit are developers: they write code, use Devvit, work with APIs, and ship apps or games through a relatively technical workflow. That ecosystem is growing quickly and remains critical.

But the future is bigger than developers alone. AI-assisted building is changing who can create software. The next generation of Reddit apps, games, tools, community agents, content formats, and workflows should be buildable by many more people: developers, technically curious creators, moderators, community builders, game designers, data partners, and eventually people who can describe what they want without needing to code it by hand.

The Developer Ecosystem team owns the product systems that help this broader set of builders discover opportunities, create successfully, launch high-quality apps and games, reach the right users and communities, adopt new platform capabilities, and keep improving after launch. This includes surfaces and systems like developers.reddit.com, AI-assisted creation, app review, developer and creator onboarding, app marketplace experiences, platform capabilities, best practices, and support for emerging creator categories.

About the Role

We are looking for a Staff Product Manager to lead Reddit's Builder Ecosystem product strategy. This person will define the roadmap for how Reddit moves from a developer-only ecosystem to a broader builder ecosystem where AI-assisted and no-code creation become first-class parts of the platform.

The role spans developer growth, creator onboarding, AI-assisted building, app quality, ecosystem incentives, platform capabilities, app marketplace strategy, operational tooling, feature adoption, and new builder categories.

This is a high-ambiguity platform role with direct business, product, and community impact. The right PM will be able to bridge two worlds: they should understand the needs of serious developers and platform engineers, while also having strong conviction that Reddit can unlock a much larger wave of builders by making creation more accessible, guided, AI-native, and outcome-oriented.

What You'll Do

The Senior Applications Architect is a senior technical leader responsible for designing, developing, and implementing secure, scalable technology solutions that support research, evaluation, and mission-driven programs. This role combines hands-on software engineering and solution architecture with strategic leadership to translate complex business and data requirements into integrated applications, analytics, and decision-support tools.

Working across multidisciplinary teams, the Senior Applications Architect leads the design of data architectures, system integrations, application frameworks, and cloud-based technology solutions that enable clients to leverage data more effectively. The role requires deep technical expertise, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across systems, data pipelines, and applications.

The ideal candidate has experience delivering end-to-end technology solutions in data-intensive environments and can balance architectural vision with direct technical execution. Experience with Palantir Foundry is highly preferred, including the ability to develop solutions across Foundry's data integration, ontology, analytics, and application layers to support operational decision-making and workflow automation.

This position has the flexibility to work remotely within the United States (U.S.) or from one of our U.S. office locations. This does not include U.S. territories. Occasional travel required for meetings, training sessions, and conferences.

About AIR:

Founded in 1946 and headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, the American Institutes for Research (AIR) is a nonpartisan, not-for-profit organization that conducts behavioral and social science research and delivers technical assistance to address some of the most pressing challenges in the United States and globally. We generate evidence and apply data-driven solutions that expand opportunities and improve lives for all.

Primary Responsibilities:

Education, Knowledge, and Experience

  • Experience working across multidisciplinary teams to deliver technology solutions that support business, operational, research, or analytical objectives.

  • Experience with modern software engineering technologies and frameworks, including application development, database technologies, and enterprise platforms.

Skills

  • Strong understanding of cloud technologies, APIs, enterprise data platforms, and modern application development frameworks.

Our values
We always have the big picture in mind. By working hand-in-hand we reach common goals as a team. We tackle them head-on and always finish what we start.
Our misson
Our mission is to help our clients reach their goals. We do that by providing them with custom software tailor-made to suit their needs and solve their problems. From SMB to enterprise we get an in-depth understanding of the industry to efficiently automate its business processes.

Job Title: Quality Assurance Engineer

Job Overview: We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Quality Assurance Engineer to join our software development team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in software testing methodologies, excellent analytical skills, and a passion for ensuring the delivery of high-quality software products. As a Quality Assurance Engineer, you will play a crucial role in the software development life cycle by designing and executing comprehensive test plans, identifying and documenting defects, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure the overall quality of our software solutions.

Responsibilities:

  1. Test Planning and Design:

    • Collaborate with development teams to understand project requirements and functional specifications.
    • Design, develop, and execute detailed test plans, test cases, and test scripts.
    • Create and maintain comprehensive documentation related to testing activities.

  2. Manual and Automated Testing:

    • Perform manual testing of software applications to identify and document defects.
    • Develop and maintain automated test scripts to enhance testing efficiency and coverage.
    • Execute automated test suites and analyze results to ensure software meets quality standards.

  3. Defect Identification and Documentation:

    • Identify, document, and track software defects using established defect tracking tools.
    • Work closely with developers to isolate, reproduce, and resolve defects in a timely manner.

  4. Regression Testing:

    • Conduct regression testing to ensure that previously identified defects have been addressed and new features have not introduced new issues.

  5. Performance and Load Testing:

    • Plan and execute performance testing to evaluate the scalability, reliability, and responsiveness of software applications.
    • Analyze and report performance test results, identifying areas for improvement.

  6. Collaboration and Communication:

    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including developers, product managers, and business analysts, to ensure a comprehensive understanding of project requirements.
    • Clearly communicate test progress, test results, and any testing-related issues to relevant stakeholders.

  7. Continuous Improvement:

    • Stay current with industry trends and advancements in testing methodologies.
    • Propose and implement process improvements to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of the QA process.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Proven experience in software quality assurance, including both manual and automated testing.
  • Familiarity with testing tools and frameworks (e.g., Selenium, JUnit, TestNG).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
  • Knowledge of Agile development methodologies.

Education and Experience:

  • Minimum of [X] years of experience in software quality assurance.
  • Relevant certifications in software testing (e.g., ISTQB) are a plus.

If you are a dedicated Quality Assurance Engineer with a commitment to delivering high-quality software, we invite you to join our dynamic team and contribute to the success of our software development projects.
