About Tilda Research, Inc.

About Tilda

Tilda Research is reimagining how clinical trials are run by bringing AI-native tools and AI teammates into clinical research operations. Our technology works alongside sponsor, CRO, and research teams to simplify study management, improve data quality, support real-time oversight, and help accelerate trial timelines.

We are building the future of clinical trial execution: one where research teams can spend less time on administrative bottlenecks and more time focused on patients, sites, and the work that moves new treatments forward. Tilda’s mission is rooted in the belief that clinical research should be faster, more efficient, more scalable, and more accessible — without losing the human judgment and care that patients and research teams deserve.

At Tilda, we are a team of builders, operators, researchers, and problem-solvers working at the intersection of healthcare, technology, and AI. We move quickly, think deeply, and care about building products and systems that create meaningful impact in the clinical research industry.

TMF Lead

We’re looking for a detail-obsessed TMF professional to own eTMF completeness, accuracy, and inspection readiness across assigned studies. You’ll run periodic/milestone reviews in Veeva Vault, identify and resolve gaps (including co-dependencies), and partner closely with Study Teams and the TMF Lead to keep the file audit-ready at all times. If ALCOA+ and metadata checks are second nature to you and you enjoy coaching others on best practices, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities

  • eTMF Reviews & Readiness
  • Perform comprehensive completeness checks (periodic & milestone) in Veeva Vault, with cross-check and co-dependency verification.
  • Maintain inspection readiness for allocated studies; proactively identify and close missing/errant documents.
  • Update and maintain the Expected Document List (EDL) as requirements change.
  • Quality, Compliance & Metadata
  • Execute ALCOA+ and metadata checks to ensure accuracy, integrity, and compliance with GCP and internal SOPs.
  • Validate document types, properties, indexing, and scanning quality against TMF readiness criteria and reference standards.
  • Collaboration & Issue Resolution
  • Partner with Study Teams, TMF Leads, Document Owners, and TMF Study Owners to gather requirements and resolve discrepancies.
  • Follow up with stakeholders to close action items within agreed SLAs; escalate risks/issues to the TMF Document Specialist Lead/TMF Operations as needed.
  • Communicate document inquiries with responsible users and provide clear guidance on corrective actions.
  • Operations, Training & Continuous Improvement
  • Process TMF documents per good documentation practices and study priority/criticality within timelines.
  • Deliver training/office hours for internal teams; respond to TMF process and system queries.
  • Contribute to process improvements and special projects; serve as an SME for TMF processes, systems, and tools where applicable.

Required Qualifications

  • 4 + years in TMF/eTMF operations within clinical research (CRO, sponsor, or TMF service provider).
  • Hands-on experience with Veeva Vault eTMF (or similar eTMF), including document ingestion, indexing, QC, and reporting.
  • Strong working knowledge of ICH-GCP, ALCOA+, and TMF Reference Model concepts.
  • Proven ability to run completeness reviews, manage EDL updates, and maintain inspection readiness.
  • Excellent attention to detail, organization, and stakeholder communication; comfortable escalating appropriately.
  • Ability to work to SLAs, juggle multiple studies, and deliver in a deadline-driven environment.

Preferred/“Nice to Have”

  • Ultilized AI in your day to day / Drive to want to build their AI Skillset
  • Experience across Phase I–IV and multiple therapeutic areas.
  • Prior role as TMF SME/Trainer; experience building SOPs/work instructions.
  • Familiarity with TMF metrics and dashboards (e.g., completeness, timeliness, quality).
  • Exposure to audit/inspection support (regulatory and sponsor).

Tools & Systems

  • Veeva Vault eTMF (primary), plus standard productivity tools (e.g., Excel/Sheets for trackers & metrics).
  • Optional exposure: eCTD concepts, QMS, ETMF reporting/BI tools.

Success Metrics (KPIs)

  • eTMF completeness % and quality error rate
  • On-time document processing against SLA
  • Aging of open queries/action items
  • Number of findings during internal QC/audits and regulatory inspections
  • Training adoption and stakeholder satisfaction

Description

Director II, Data Science – AI Information and Intelligence

Position Overview

We are seeking a Director of Data Science to lead the AI Information and Intelligence team within the Global AI Products and Transformation organization in GRS Data Science Solutions. This team owns the reusable AI capabilities that let underwriting and claims systems find, extract, and connect the information those systems need — including intelligent data and document extraction, external research and enrichment, knowledge/guidelines/policy intelligence, evidence intelligence, and “like-me” comparison capabilities.

This leader will build and manage a team of data science managers, data scientists, and AI/ML engineers, and will be accountable for establishing a durable, reusable capability layer that multiple segments and geographies can extend rather than rebuild. They will set technical direction, develop the roadmap for their capability domain, and partner closely with the peer leaders of AI Products and Decisioning and AI Product Strategy and Scale, with segment data science teams, and with Technology to ensure capabilities are built once, proven in a lead segment, and scaled across the enterprise.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of data science managers, data scientists, and AI/ML engineers responsible for the Information and Intelligence capability domain.
  • Own the roadmap for reusable “find / extract / connect” capabilities — data extraction, external research and enrichment, knowledge/guidelines/forms intelligence, evidence intelligence, and comparable (“like-me”) intelligence — and prioritize investment for maximum reuse and value.
  • Direct the design, development, deployment, and ongoing improvement of production-grade AI/ML solutions that prove out in a lead segment and are engineered from the start to extend to other segments and geographies.
  • Partner with the leaders of AI Products and Decisioning and AI Product Strategy and Scale to sequence shared/dependent capabilities (e.g., hazard/concern flagging, rules and guideline intelligence, information sufficiency detection) and to hand off mature capabilities for adoption.
  • Partner with segment data science teams and Technology leadership to translate lighthouse solutions into enterprise-scale platforms, defining the architecture that gives AI systems governed access to relevant data and context.
  • Establish common evaluation, quality, and feedback standards for the capabilities the team owns, and ensure outputs are traceable to source and auditable.
  • Set engineering standards across the team’s AI development lifecycle — testing, version control, CI/CD, observability, documentation, and MLOps/AIOps.
  • Manage team structure, staffing, and workload across onshore, near-shore, and partner resources, including hiring and performance management for direct reports who themselves manage teams.
  • Communicate roadmap, trade-offs, progress, and recommendations clearly to technical teams, business stakeholders, and senior leadership.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience leading data science or AI/ML teams, including direct people-management of managers and/or senior individual contributors.
  • Hands-on background developing and deploying production-grade AI or ML solutions, with advanced knowledge of AI/ML methods, engineering practices, and tools.
  • Experience owning a product or capability roadmap and making prioritization trade-offs across multiple stakeholder groups.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills, including experience partnering with peer leaders, engineering/architecture teams, and business sponsors.
  • Relevant insurance or regulated-industry experience is preferred.
  • Competencies typically acquired through a Ph.D. degree (in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Actuarial Science, or other scientific field of study) and a minimum of 6 years of relevant experience — including people leadership — a Master’s degree (scientific field of study) and a minimum of 9 years of relevant experience, or a Bachelor’s degree (scientific field of study) and a minimum of 11 years of relevant experience.

Preferred Skills and Experiences

  • Prior formal management of managers, or experience leading a team of team leads, within data science, AI/ML, or engineering.
  • Experience leading AI products in a product-oriented delivery model, from opportunity identification through scaled adoption.
  • Experience with GenAI, LLM-based applications, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows, or AI-assisted document/data extraction at production scale.
  • Experience building reusable AI platforms, shared services, or enterprise-scale capabilities that were successfully extended across multiple business lines or geographies.
  • Success driving AI transformation and adoption in large, complex, or global organizations.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means the AI Information and Intelligence team becomes the trusted, reusable source of extracted data, external intelligence, and grounded knowledge that both underwriting and claims AI products depend on — built once, proven in a lead segment, and adopted broadly rather than rebuilt by each team. This leader will grow a high-performing organization of managers and engineers, maintain a roadmap that balances near-term segment needs with the long-term reusable capability vision, and be recognized as a peer partner to the other Global AI Products and Transformation leaders in scaling AI cost-effectively across the enterprise.

Qualifications

• Deep knowledge of predictive analytic techniques and statistical diagnostics of models.
• Expert knowledge of predictive toolset, to include highly technical tools.
• Proven ability to lead and drive projects and assignments to completion through others, to include prior experience effectively managing talent.
• Demonstrated ability to exchange ideas and convey complex information clearly and concisely, verbally, visually (presentations and exhibits), and in writing, consistent with the audiences and stakeholders with which s/he interacts.
• Ability to establish and build relationships within and outside the aligned functional area or SBU. Ability to give effective training and presentations to management and other groups.
• Presents to senior or functional department leaders or executives.
• Broad knowledge of business drivers and market context.
• Has a value driven perspective with regard to understanding of work context and impact.
• Competencies typically acquired through an advanced degree (in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science or other relevant field of study) and 5 to 7 years of relevant experience or may be acquired through a Bachelor`s degree (scientific field of study) with 10 years of relevant experience.

We are entering the next chapter of our growth, and we are looking for a Group CFO to lead it on the finance side.

As Group CFO, you will lead the entire finance function and own how the company manages its capital, financing and growth. You will work closely with the CEO and Founder on strategic and capital decisions, and you will build a finance organisation that matches the scale and ambition of the group.

Why join:

  • A senior role with real impact: you will shape the finance function and the financial strategy of a global music technology group.
  • A unique business at the intersection of digital products, music publishing and rights.
  • Direct partnership with the Founder on the group’s next stage of growth.

The position is open to candidates based in Europe or Cyprus.

Key responsibilities

You will:

  • Lead the group finance function, including financial operations, treasury and FP&A, and develop the team as the group grows.
  • Own capital and financing: manage relationships with lenders and investors, structure financing and keep the group’s capital position strong.
  • Drive M&A together with the Founder: source opportunities, build valuations and models, secure financing, lead due diligence and integrate acquired businesses.
  • Set treasury and cash policy across the group’s legal entities.
  • Lead the group audit and keep reporting and controls at a level that investors and lenders trust.
  • Own the group tax structure across multiple jurisdictions, including transfer pricing.
  • Be a trusted partner to the Founder, bringing recommendations with the price and the impact, not just reports on the problem.

Requirements

What you bring

Must have:

  • Experience as CFO of an international group with multiple countries and legal entities, consolidation and multi-jurisdiction tax.
  • Personal experience leading debt financing and lender relationships at a meaningful scale, including leveraged facilities.
  • A track record of M&A, refinancing or transactions with investors that you personally sourced, modelled, financed and closed.
  • Experience leading a Big Four group audit.
  • Experience in a company with revenue of $200M to $1B+.
  • Hands-on experience leading and building a finance function, as well as financing.

Nice to have:

  • CFO experience in a private equity-backed company.
  • Background in media, music, publishing, rights and royalties, or subscription digital products.
  • Experience with businesses that combine digital and physical products.
  • Experience in the transition from a founder-led to a management-led company.

Role TItle: Senior ML Engineer (MSc. or PhD)

Location: Global, fully remote

Job Type: Contract(~15 hours per week)

Schedule: Flexible—you choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired

We are looking for highly skilled Machine Learning Experts to contribute to an AI training project involving model development, training and inference systems, numerical computing, performance optimization, and Python.

The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating challenging machine-learning engineering tasks. A representative task may require implementing or modifying a model, constructing a reproducible training or inference workflow, optimizing memory or throughput, debugging numerical or system-level failures, and verifying that the resulting implementation satisfies objective correctness and performance requirements.

This is a very coding heavy role. Candidates but have experience using coding agents with python in their workflow.

What You’ll Work On:

  • Develop and validate machine-learning models, training pipelines, inference systems, and supporting infrastructure.

  • Implement model components, data pipelines, evaluation systems, and numerical methods.

  • Build reproducible programmatic workflows using Python and command-line tools.

Required Qualifications:

  • A master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a closely related quantitative discipline.

  • Strong professional or research experience in machine learning.

  • Practical proficiency with Python and coding agents.

  • Equivalent tools may also be considered when the candidate demonstrates directly relevant depth.

Experience at a well-established technology company, AI laboratory, research organization, or other recognized engineering environment is strongly preferred. Exceptional open-source or academic experience may also qualify.

Process:

  • Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.

  • Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.

  • Complete the hiring manager review.

Compensation Structure:

Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply.

Start Timeline & Availability:

We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first task within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

IT Service Operations Analyst — Federal Health IT

Location: Remote — United States
Security Requirement: Eligibility for a Tier 3 federal investigation; active U.S. Government Secret clearance required for designated assignments.

Keep Support Moving. Strengthen Service Reliability.

At Rackner, reliable technology support helps federal healthcare organizations maintain the systems and services their teams depend on. We're seeking an IT Service Operations Analyst to support efficient service request handling, strengthen operational accountability, and help ensure technology issues are accurately documented, prioritized, and directed to the appropriate specialists.

In this role, you'll work across ServiceNow ITSM operations, service-level performance tracking, operational reporting, and application support activities. You'll collaborate with specialized teams, monitor service commitments, identify recurring issues, and help improve the consistency, visibility, and reliability of healthcare technology support.

What You'll Do

  • Triage, categorize, and route incoming incidents and service requests across designated ServiceNow ITSM queues, applying established operational procedures to ensure accurate case assignment.
  • Coordinate handoffs to clinical workflow, training, account provisioning, application, and technical specialists, maintaining visibility into ticket progress, outstanding dependencies, and appropriate follow-up.
  • Monitor established response and resolution windows, track service-level agreement (SLA) clocks, and document approved pause reasons and service delays in accordance with defined procedures.
  • Maintain accurate ticket histories, status updates, supporting documentation, and audit-ready closure evidence to strengthen accountability and operational traceability.
  • Analyze ticket activity, recurring issues, and service trends to prepare weekly operational reviews and provide accurate inputs to monthly performance reporting.
  • Administer and validate assigned non-production and sandbox environments following upgrades, perform authorized operational checks, and document findings requiring additional technical attention.
  • Track inherited application defects through documented disposition, maintaining assigned owners, severity classifications, progress updates, and supporting evidence.

Required Qualifications

  • ITIL 4 Foundation certification.
  • Minimum of two years of professional experience in ServiceNow IT Service Management (ITSM) queue operations, including demonstrated capability in ticket triage, routing, service-level monitoring, and maintaining accurate operational records.
  • Eligibility to undergo the applicable Tier 3 federal investigation. Certain assignments require an active U.S. Government Secret security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Supporting service desk operations or IT service management within federal healthcare or similarly complex, regulated technology environments.
  • Experience using ServiceNow reporting capabilities to analyze service trends, monitor ticket activity, or support operational performance reporting.
  • Familiarity with enterprise healthcare applications, clinical technology support environments, or specialized operational systems.

Why Rackner?

At Rackner, we develop and support technology solutions that help federal organizations address complex operational challenges. Our teams bring together expertise across cloud engineering, DevSecOps, software development, AI/ML, and mission-focused technology services.

You'll have the opportunity to contribute to meaningful healthcare technology initiatives, work alongside multidisciplinary teams, and help strengthen the coordination processes that support reliable technology operations and positive user experiences.

Benefits & Perks

Rackner offers a competitive benefits package designed to support employees professionally and personally, including:

  • Professional development and company-supported certification opportunities.
  • 401(k) retirement plan with a 100% company match on contributions up to 6%.
  • Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance.
  • Paid time off and company holidays.
  • Home-office equipment and remote-work support.
  • Fitness and wellness reimbursement.
  • Weekly pay and company team events.
  • Benefits are subject to applicable eligibility requirements and plan terms.

Work Arrangement

This is a remote position based in the United States. The role involves collaboration with cross-functional teams supporting federal healthcare technology operations.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Rackner is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to any status protected by applicable law.

Career Category

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do. Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline and portfolio of medicines to treat heart disease, obesity and obesity-related conditions, rare diseases, inflammatory conditions, and cancer. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives. Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.


What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will lead Amgen’s Type 2 Diabetes (T2D) marketing strategy. Through deep understanding of customers and treatment paradigms, alongside a diverse cross-functional team, you will build a brand strategy and craft experiences to maximize impact at launch. The ED Global Marketing Lead (GML) for Type 2 Diabetes (T2D) will report to the T2D Indication Team Lead and will be responsible for developing successful global brands as well as developing and implementing global launch strategies and optimizing the impact of marketing budgets.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead the execution of launch and commercialization activities, focusing on global and priority markets
  • Build a comprehensive global brand strategy, ensuring strong alignment across cross-functional teams
  • Establish the target patient profile, utilizing deep market insights to bring the patient journey to life and inform brand positioning
  • Drive the development of the global launch campaign, ensuring it is culturally relevant, distinctive, and enduring
  • Lead the insight-driven development of branding, messaging, and market activation strategies to maximize launch impact and sustain commercial success
  • Represent commercial interests in the Indication Team, working closely with R&D, medical, and regulatory functions to ensure alignment
  • Partner with Market Access & Pricing teams to optimize pricing and reimbursement strategies to support global market entry.
  • Foster ongoing insights development by collaborating internally and externally, ensuring data-driven decision-making for the brand.
  • Monitor and analyze market trends, competitive landscape, and industry developments to inform brand strategy adjustments.
  • Represent the company at industry conferences and build relationships with key opinion leaders and stakeholders.
  • Manage the global marketing budget, ensuring optimal resource allocation to maximize brand impact.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The candidatewe seek is an experienced leader with the following qualifications. They will also embody the Amgen leadership attributes which are:


  • Inspire: Create a connected, inclusive, and inspiring work environment that empowers talent to thrive
  • Accelerate: Enable speed that matches the urgency of patient needs by encouraging progress over perfection
  • Integrate: Connect the dots to amplify the collective power of Amgen to drive results for patients, staff, and shareholders
  • Adapt: Lead through change by adapting to an ever-changing environment and defining a clear course of action to deliver results

Basic Qualifications:

  • Doctorate degree & 6 years of marketing experience OR
  • Master’s degree & 10 years of marketing experience OR
  • Bachelor’s degree & 12 years of marketing experience AND
  • 6 years of managerial experience directly managing people and/or leadership experience leading teams, projects, programs or directing the allocation of resources

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Global brand launch experience
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams in a matrix environment, managing global projects involving multiple functions and shared accountabilities
  • Experience in strategic marketing roles up to Head of Marketing / Portfolio leadership level in Global or US roles
  • Understanding of broad, global market dynamics and cultural awareness and sensitivity to form relationships and collaborate effectively with colleagues around the world
  • Experience in a tactical, “line” commercial role, implementing marketing strategies in local markets
  • Understanding of global market access, pricing, and reimbursement issues
  • Ability to leverage customer knowledge to enable decision-making and prioritization of investment
  • Experience within Type 2 Diabetes, obesity and/or cardiometabolic disease

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.The expected annual salary range for this role in the U.S. (excluding Puerto Rico) is $288,619 to $390,485. Flexcompute is leading the transformation of engineering simulation with our revolutionary ultra-fast simulation technology. Our flagship products, including the industry-leading Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) software Flow360 and electromagnetic simulation software Tidy3D, are reshaping how simulations are conducted across diverse sectors. Founded by visionaries from Stanford and MIT and supported by top-tier venture capital firms, we are a rapidly growing team dedicated to breaking boundaries and challenging the norms of the multi-billion-dollar engineering simulation market.

We are looking for a Senior Backend Software Engineer to help us design and implement scalable solutions that meet the growing demands of our advanced EM simulation platform.

Additionally, the candidate will help us enhance our data management, frontend-backend API unification, and cloud integration.

Key Responsibilities

  • Contribute to general software development efforts, such as API unification, simulation data management (e.g., caching, syncing, storage), and scripting improvements.

This is a senior seat. We keep the team small and senior on purpose, so you will own real pieces of the platform end to end, with little direction and direct access to the founders.

  • Strong backend engineering in at least one of Java, Python or C++. Deep in one is enough.

  • Distributed systems you have operated in production, not only studied.
  • Direct ownership of a production backend service, from design through deployment and operation.
  • Fluent professional English, spoken and written.
  • Based in Greece, or willing to relocate to Greece, with the right to work there without visa sponsorship, and available for four to six hours of overlap with our Boston team (afternoon and early evening in Athens).

We hire for depth, not checklists. You do not need all of the following on day one: Kubernetes and Docker, Terraform or Ansible, monitoring and observability tooling, Linux troubleshooting, networking and security practices, our simulation stack, and HPC (preferred, not mandatory). We look for people who have entered a new domain before, learned it fast and reached ownership.

Bonus

  • Load balancing, autoscaling, and queues or streaming systems such as SQS, SNS or Kafka.

  • Experience supporting scientific computing or simulation platforms.

  • Experience building developer platforms or internal infrastructure tooling.

Innovative Mindset: Ability to learn quickly, adapt to new challenges, and innovate in a fast-paced startup environment.

Example Projects

  • Architect and deploy infrastructure that runs distributed simulation workloads across cloud and on-premise compute
  • Design and implement scalable web APIs for simulation job orchestration and data access
  • Build CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code systems for reproducible deployments
  • Develop hybrid cloud solutions connecting on-prem HPC clusters with AWS compute and storage

At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

The Strategic Account Manager is responsible for the ongoing strategic business relationship between Cencora and various numbers of customers of varying size; responsible for increased revenues and profits with existing and proposed customers.


This role will support accounts in the Plains Region: CO, KS, UT, OK, WY, NM, MT

Primary Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Consults with customers to create profitable business strategies considering such factors as customer's vision and goals, current results by category/program and compliance with Cencora programs and services.
  • Organizes timely RFP process for effective contract renewals.
  • Creates potential customer interest using solution selling process and establishes trust through the creation and communication of value propositions.
  • Resolves customer issues, identifies root cause, and takes steps to prevent similar issues from arising in the future.
  • Partners with segment sales directors and their account managers in developing the regional chains managed by the Strategic Accounts Team.
  • Develops and implements strategic sales and marketing plans to accommodate national and regional business goals.
  • Reviews market analysis to determine customer needs and pricing schedules.
  • Gathers information, analyzes and develops strategies concerning dynamics that may affect the business relationship, such as changes in customer ownership or new affiliations, current market share and targets of opportunities for new growth, customers' changing requirements, competitor strengths and weaknesses, and continually communicates these strategies internally using verbal discussion and written business plans.
  • Represents Cencora at trade association meetings.
  • Responsible for delivering sales presentations to key customers.
  • Provides feedback, industry knowledge and specific recommendations to Corporate on programs, policies, products and prices.
  • Maintains strong customer relationships; seeks new and increased business opportunities.
  • Monitors and analyzes reports and data which are used consistently throughout Cencora for measuring profitability growth of regional chain sales; develops and implements strategies to insure continued success of that growth.
  • Must be willing to work extended hours, as needed, in order to meet sales objectives; must be willing to travel extensively.
  • Performs related duties as assigned.

Experience and Educational Requirements:

  • Requires broad training in fields such as business administration, accountancy, sales, marketing, computer sciences or similar vocations generally obtained through completion of a four year bachelor's degree program.
  • Normally requires 3 - 5 (three to five) years directly related and progressively responsible experience preferably in the healthcare industry.

Minimum Skills, Knowledge and Ability Requirements:

  • Working knowledge of pharmaceutical distribution with emphasis in specific segment sales
  • Thorough knowledge of Cencora products, programs, and services
  • Working knowledge of sales management, sales planning and goal setting, successful strategic and consultative selling techniques, and related information
  • Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing, for the purpose of preparing reports and disseminating information
  • Strong interpersonal skills; ability to develop and maintain cooperative working and business relationships
  • Strong presentation skills; ability to train others
  • Ability to interpret financial data of chain sales and develop successful strategies to deal with financial issues that are identified
  • Ability to interpret industry trends and competitive information and develop strategies and tactics to respond to changes in the marketplace
  • Strong analytical and mathematical skills
  • Strong creativity skills; focused and disciplined
  • Good understanding of Customer Value Chain
  • Working knowledge of computers necessary to operate effectively with company systems and programs

What Cencora offers

We provide compensation, benefits, and resources that enable a highly inclusive culture and support our team members’ ability to live with purpose every day. In addition to traditional offerings like medical, dental, and vision care, we also provide a comprehensive suite of benefits that focus on the physical, emotional, financial, and social aspects of wellness. This encompasses support for working families, which may include backup dependent care, adoption assistance, infertility coverage, family building support, behavioral health solutions, paid parental leave, and paid caregiver leave. To encourage your personal growth, we also offer a variety of training programs, professional development resources, and opportunities to participate in mentorship programs, employee resource groups, volunteer activities, and much more. jobs.title: VP, Accounting
jobs.excerpt: In today's dynamic worksites, seamless collaboration between people and machines is essential.
jobs.description:
In today's dynamic worksites, seamless collaboration between people and machines is essential. FORT's platform ensures safe, secure, and dynamic control that surpasses legacy systems and next-generation AI capabilities.

While autonomous machines offer significant advantages, they also introduce new safety challenges. FORT addresses these concerns by providing solutions such as the Wireless E-Stop, which allows operators to instantly stop any machine from a safe distance, enhancing safety during emergencies.

Additionally, FORT's Safe Remote Control enables operators to manage heavy machinery remotely, reducing the risk of accidents and improving visibility.

By ensuring communications integrity across any network, FORT empowers customers to protect their most valuable assets—people, data, and machines—ensuring they remain safe and secure.

We're looking for a Vice President, Accounting to lead FORT's accounting and external reporting functions as we move from a privately held robotics company to a public company through a SPAC business combination. You'll report to our CFO, where you will build a scalable, public-company-ready accounting organization, protect the integrity of our financial statements, and lead SEC reporting and technical accounting through the transaction and after it. You'll also advise the CFO and executive team on complex accounting matters. This role suits an accounting executive who has done this before and still gets hands-on with the critical work.

What you'll own

  • Accounting leadership. Lead, mentor, and develop the Head of SEC Reporting and Accounting Manager, establishing clear accountability, performance expectations, and professional development opportunities. Build a team that scales with the company. Set accounting policies and practices that follow U.S. GAAP and SEC requirements. Advise the CFO and leadership team on significant transactions.
  • SEC reporting and public-company readiness. Lead accounting and reporting readiness for the SPAC business combination, including historical financial statements, pro forma information, and transaction analyses, in partnership with Legal, external auditors, bankers, and advisors. Oversee the 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, registration statements, and related disclosures on public-company timelines.
  • Close and consolidation. Oversee an accurate, on-time monthly, quarterly, and annual close and consolidation. Improve close speed, reconciliation quality, and reporting processes.
  • Technical accounting. Own policy and documented, audit-ready conclusions for complex and judgmental areas, including de-SPAC accounting (equity classification, warrants, earnouts), revenue recognition under ASC 606 (hardware-plus-software and multi-element contracts), inventory, standard costing, and reserves, capitalized software and R&D, stock-based compensation, and business combinations, leases, and impairments.
  • Audit management. Serve as the primary accounting contact for external auditors through PCAOB-standard quarterly reviews and the annual audit. Resolve inquiries and proposed adjustments on time.
  • Controls partnership. Partner with the Internal Controls and Internal Audit functions. Make sure the accounting team carries out and documents its controls, and lead remediation of findings within accounting.
  • M&A and corporate development. Lead purchase accounting and bring acquired entities into FORT's close and reporting. Support financing transactions.
  • Systems and scale. Lead upgrades to FORT's ERP, close, and reporting systems. Use automation and AI where they cut manual work.
  • Board and cross-functional partnership. Prepare accounting materials for the Audit Committee and Board. Work with FP&A so actual results line up with budgets and forecasts, and with Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Engineering, Legal, and Tax on accounting for our robotics business.

What you bring

Required

  • 12+ years of progressive accounting and financial reporting experience, including significant leadership responsibility.
  • Experience at a U.S. public company, or leading a company through an IPO, de-SPAC, or similar public-company transition.
  • Hands-on ownership of SEC filings and public-company external reporting.
  • Deep U.S. GAAP and technical accounting expertise, including revenue recognition and stock-based compensation.
  • Track record leading close, consolidation, and external reporting.
  • Experience leading accounting managers and directors.
  • Proven experience working with external auditors and senior finance leadership.
  • Experience building scalable accounting processes in a high-growth or fast-changing organization.
  • Strong executive communication skills, and the ability to balance strategic leadership with hands-on work.
  • CPA (active).
  • Bachelor's degree in accounting or finance.

Nice to have

  • SPAC business combination experience, including transaction accounting and post-merger reporting.
  • Big 4 public accounting background combined with corporate accounting leadership.
  • Robotics, industrial automation, manufacturing, or hardware technology experience, including inventory costing and hardware-plus-software revenue.
  • Purchase accounting and integration experience from acquisitions.
  • International entity consolidation and multi-currency reporting.
  • NetSuite or similar ERP implementation experience.
  • Experience supporting Audit Committee and Board-level reporting.
  • Experience in a venture-backed or private equity-backed company.

Base salary range: $170,000-$240,000

Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision insurance; unlimited PTO; stock options; 3% 401(k) match, paid holidays, and parental leave.

Application window: Applications accepted through the end of December 2026. This date will be updated if the window is extended.

Shatterproof
Shatterproof is a national nonprofit dedicated to ending addiction by transforming prevention, treatment, policy, and public understanding. The organization is undergoing a deliberate transformation to align its work around integrated, measurable impact and sustainable growth.
Organizational Context

As part of this evolution, Shatterproof operates under an executive structure reporting to the Chief Executive Officer through three enterprise leaders: the Chief Impact Officer (CIO), Chief Development Officer (CDO), and Chief Financial & Administrative Officer (CFAO).

All programmatic and impact-related senior leadership roles sit within the Impact organization under the CIO, reinforcing a unified approach to systems change.

Who Succeeds at Shatterproof

Shatterproof is in a period of disciplined transformation and national growth. Leaders who thrive in this environment:
  • Bring a builder’s mindset, establishing durable systems, structures, and operating models.
  • Prioritize cross-functional integration over functional silos.
  • Influence through collaborative authority, emotional intelligence, and coalition-building.
  • Navigate ambiguity and dynamic policy landscapes with strategic poise.
  • Remain relentlessly committed to evidence-based, systems-level impact.
Position Summary
The Senior Vice President (SVP) of Program & Impact advises the CIO on strategy while directing the delivery and measurement of Shatterproof's national programmatic portfolio. Reporting directly to the Chief Impact Officer, the SVP leads the day-to-day operations, growth, and integration of core national programs across treatment quality, stigma reduction, training and education, and workplace engagement to advance Shatterproof’s strategic pillars.
  • Prevent Addiction & Overdose: Stopping the cycle before it starts, reducing fatal overdoses, and removing the shame and stigma that prevent people from reaching out for help.
  • Close the Treatment Gap: Making addiction treatment a standard part of routine healthcare so anyone who needs care can easily access it, while dismantling systemic barriers ranging from public and self-stigma to workplace policies that discourage seeking help.
  • Better Outcomes Through Better Care: Improve access to evidence-based addiction care by strengthening treatment standards, equipping clinicians with clinical tools and training, and scaling resources that help individuals and families identify verified, high-quality providers.
Responsibilities
  1. Program Strategy & Portfolio Execution
  • Lead nationwide prevention, stigma-reduction, and education programs across public, community, and employer domains to normalize help-seeking and promote early intervention.
  • Direct health care professional (HCP) training and health systems change to make evidence-based addiction medicine a standard component of routine care, establishing accessible treatment and referral pathways nationwide.
  • Oversee the national expansion and adoption of treatment quality standards, partnering with healthcare leaders, state agencies, and commercial payers to drive facility accountability and consumer transparency.
  • Operational Management & Governance
  • Maintain executive accountability for all program operations, team performance and key performance indicators. Set annual priorities, address strategic challenges, and align resources for maximum impact.
  • Recruit, mentor, and lead a high-performing, multidisciplinary team, promoting career growth, accountability, and a collaborative team culture.
  • Develop and manage the program budget in alignment with organizational goals and strategic priorities.
  • Lead regular operational and program reviews to improve processes, manage risk, and optimize resources.
  • Drive adoption of AI tools to increase team productivity and impact.
  • Impact Measurement & Reporting
  • Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) to track program performance and quantify clinical and social impact.
  • Integrate program outcomes and lessons learned across the team to inform and strengthen national policy and advocacy efforts.
  • Deliver regular progress reports and program updates to executive leadership to guide strategic priorities.
  • External Engagement & Growth
  • Support executive leadership in advancing Shatterproof’s national influence across addiction care standards, provider training, and anti-stigma initiatives.
  • Develop and scale earned-revenue strategies to drive program expansion and extend organizational reach.
  • Partner with Development and Communications teams to articulate programmatic impact to major foundations, corporate partners, and government funders.
  • Represent Shatterproof nationally across conferences, legislative hearings, and media publications.
Qualifications
• 15+ years of progressive leadership across healthcare, behavioral health, or non-profits, with at least 10 years in senior team and program management.
• Experience with substance use disorder (SUD) systems, care standards, clinician education, and anti-stigma science, or comparable leadership in healthcare or public health.
• Exceptional written advocacy and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to influence policymakers, executives, and grassroots partners.
• Proven success leading multi-state or national health initiatives.
• Demonstrated success leading complex, distributed teams in high-growth, mission-oriented environments.
• Experience managing multimillion-dollar program budgets, government contracts, and foundation grants.
• Demonstrated success reporting to C-suite leadership and collaborating with board committees, funders, and external partners.
• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Master’s or doctoral degree in public health,
healthcare administration, public policy, medicine, nursing, or a related field strongly preferred.
• Deep alignment with Shatterproof’s mission and values.
May Be a Good Fit If…
• You are skilled at bringing diverse partners together—across healthcare, community groups, and workplaces—to build and sustain initiatives that genuinely improve people’s lives.
• You build high-performing teams rooted in trust, empathy, and a genuine commitment to supporting each
person’s growth and success.
• You are a compelling storyteller and listener who translates complex clinical, program, and policy issues into clear, human narratives that connect with boards, donors, communities, and the public.
• You lead with empathy and purpose, driven to break down stigma, make asking for help feel safe and normal, and ensure everyone has access to compassionate, evidence-based care.
• You are comfortable using AI and emerging tools to enhance strategic thinking and operational efficiency.

Additional Information
• Ability and authorization to work in the United States required.
• Ability to work Eastern Time Zone hours required.
• Remote with approximately 15% to 30% travel required, including business development, partner and board meetings, national conferences, and visits to organizational offices.
• Shatterproof is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace.
• Individuals with lived experience of substance use, addiction, or recovery, including family members and loved ones, are encouraged to apply. Sharing your experience is always your choice and is never required to be considered

jobs.excerpt: Insurance Reservations & Account Manager – Canada Company: Insurance Stays | InsuranceStays.
jobs.description:
Insurance Reservations & Account Manager – Canada

Company: Insurance Stays | InsuranceStays.com
Industry: Insurance Housing | Temporary Accommodation | Furnished Rentals

Market: Canada – Nationwide

Employment Type: Full-Time

Work Arrangement: Remote

Reports To: Corporate Stays Management

About Insurance Stays

Insurance Stays is a specialized temporary housing platform designed to help insurance companies, claims adjusters, insurance brokers, and displaced policyholders find suitable fully furnished accommodations across Canada.

When individuals or families are temporarily displaced from their homes due to fire, flooding, water damage, renovations, or other insured events, Insurance Stays helps them secure comfortable and convenient temporary housing.

The platform connects insurance professionals and policyholders with apartments operated by Corporate Stays, as well as accommodations offered by independent property owners and other housing providers.

Position Overview

We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and customer-focused Insurance Reservations & Account Manager to manage accommodation requests, coordinate reservations, and develop strong relationships with insurance clients and property partners.

This position combines reservations management, customer service, account management, and booking coordination.

The successful candidate will be responsible for managing the entire accommodation booking process, from receiving an inquiry to confirming a reservation and coordinating the guest's arrival.

The primary objective is to maximize booking conversions, prioritize Corporate Stays inventory whenever suitable, and deliver an exceptional accommodation experience to insurance clients.

This position does not require previous experience in the insurance industry. Training will be provided on insurance accommodation procedures, claims-related terminology, and the specific requirements of insurance-funded housing.

Key Responsibilities

1. Insurance Accommodation Reservations (40%)

  • Manage all incoming accommodation requests received through InsuranceStays.com, email, phone, and other communication channels.
  • Respond promptly to inquiries from claims adjusters, insurance companies, brokers, and policyholders.
  • Gather all necessary information to identify the most suitable accommodation, including:
    • Destination city and preferred location.
    • Number of guests and family composition.
    • Required number of bedrooms and bathrooms.
    • Move-in date and estimated length of stay.
    • Accommodation budget and insurance approval requirements.
    • Parking, pets, accessibility, and additional requirements.
    • Insurance company, claims adjuster, and claim reference when applicable.
  • Identify suitable accommodation options based on availability, pricing, location, and client requirements.
  • Prioritize apartments managed by Corporate Stays whenever inventory is available and meets the client's needs.
  • Coordinate with Corporate Stays' reservations and revenue management teams to confirm availability and pricing.
  • Prepare and send professional accommodation proposals and quotations.
  • Follow up with clients and claims adjusters to obtain booking approvals.
  • Convert qualified accommodation requests into confirmed reservations.
  • Coordinate booking confirmations, payments, documentation, and move-in instructions.
  • Ensure accurate reservation records and seamless handovers to the relevant operations teams.

2. Third-Party Property Owner Coordination (20%)

When Corporate Stays does not have suitable inventory available, the Account Manager will work with external property owners listed on InsuranceStays.com.

Responsibilities include:

  • Search the Insurance Stays property network for suitable alternatives.
  • Contact property owners and accommodation providers to verify availability.
  • Request pricing and negotiate appropriate accommodation rates when necessary.
  • Confirm booking conditions, minimum stays, deposits, cancellation policies, and extension terms.
  • Coordinate communication between property owners, insurance professionals, and guests.
  • Facilitate reservations through InsuranceStays.com according to the platform's booking procedures.
  • Ensure all external bookings comply with agreed commercial terms and service standards.
  • Maintain accurate records of property owner communications and booking arrangements.
  • Identify properties and providers that consistently deliver excellent service.
  • Report inventory shortages and opportunities to expand the property network.

3. Insurance Client Account Management (20%)

  • Act as the primary point of contact for insurance professionals submitting accommodation requests.
  • Build professional relationships with claims adjusters, insurance companies, brokers, and existing insurance partners.
  • Maintain regular communication with clients regarding active reservations, accommodation availability, and upcoming housing requirements.
  • Ensure each insurance partner receives responsive, reliable, and personalized service.
  • Manage requests for booking extensions, accommodation changes, and relocations.
  • Coordinate with internal teams and external providers to resolve accommodation-related issues.
  • Follow up after completed reservations to collect feedback and encourage repeat business.
  • Maintain accurate contact information and account activity in HubSpot CRM.
  • Identify opportunities to generate additional reservations from existing insurance clients.
  • Share potential new partnership opportunities with the Insurance Business Development Manager once this role is established.

Important: This position focuses on managing existing accounts, incoming accommodation inquiries, and confirmed reservations. Large-scale outbound prospecting and new insurance partnership acquisition will be handled separately by the Insurance Business Development Manager.

4. Booking Follow-Up & Guest Experience (10%)

  • Monitor upcoming arrivals and ensure all reservation details are confirmed.
  • Coordinate with Corporate Stays' operations and guest services teams.
  • Ensure third-party property owners provide accurate check-in instructions and contact information.
  • Maintain communication with insurance professionals regarding accommodation confirmations and important updates.
  • Monitor upcoming check-out dates and proactively identify possible extension opportunities.
  • Assist with accommodation changes when a guest's requirements evolve.
  • Escalate unresolved operational issues to the appropriate team.
  • Support a professional and consistent customer experience throughout each reservation.

5. CRM Management & Reporting (10%)

  • Maintain accurate records of all accommodation inquiries and reservations in HubSpot.
  • Update each inquiry's status throughout the booking process.
  • Track pending quotations, approvals, confirmations, cancellations, and lost opportunities.
  • Ensure all active leads receive appropriate follow-up.
  • Maintain visibility into reservations generated through Corporate Stays and external property owners.
  • Provide weekly performance reports covering:
    • Total accommodation requests received.
    • Average inquiry response time.
    • Quotes and accommodation proposals submitted.
    • Confirmed reservations.
    • Booking conversion rate.
    • Total booking value and gross profit.
    • Corporate Stays versus third-party booking volume.
    • Pending booking extensions.
    • Lost bookings and reasons for non-conversion.
  • Recommend improvements to reservation processes and customer communication.

Qualifications & Experience

Required

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in reservations, hospitality, corporate housing, property management, or customer service.
  • Experience managing accommodation inquiries and coordinating guest reservations.
  • Strong written and spoken English communication skills.
  • Excellent customer service and relationship management skills.
  • Strong organizational abilities and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple booking requests simultaneously.
  • Experience using a property management system (PMS), reservations platform, or CRM.
  • Comfortable communicating with clients by phone, email, and messaging platforms.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with reservations, operations, and revenue management teams.

Preferred

  • Previous experience with Corporate Stays or another furnished accommodation operator.
  • Familiarity with Guesty, Hostaway, HubSpot, or similar systems.
  • Knowledge of Canadian cities and accommodation markets.
  • Experience handling medium- and long-term furnished accommodation bookings.
  • Experience working with property owners and accommodation partners.
  • French language skills, particularly for supporting clients in Québec.

Previous insurance industry experience is not required.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The Insurance Reservations & Account Manager will be evaluated against the following performance indicators:

KPIInitial Target

First response time – business hours Within 20 minutes Qualified inquiry follow-up 100% Accommodation proposal turnaround Within 2 business hours, when inventory information is available Inquiry-to-booking conversion Target 30%+, subject to lead quality CRM data accuracy 100% Booking confirmation accuracy 98%+ Follow-up on pending quotations Daily Booking extension follow-up Before scheduled check-out Client satisfaction 90%+ positive feedback

Targets will be reviewed and adjusted according to actual inquiry volume and operating conditions.

Key Priorities

The Account Manager must follow these priorities when handling accommodation requests:

Priority 1 – Customer Satisfaction

Provide responsive, professional, and reliable assistance to insurance companies, claims adjusters, and displaced policyholders.

Priority 2 – Corporate Stays Inventory

Whenever suitable apartments are available within Corporate Stays' portfolio, prioritize these accommodations to maximize internal occupancy and revenue.

Priority 3 – External Accommodation Partners

When Corporate Stays cannot fulfill a request, identify suitable alternatives through property owners and accommodation providers registered on InsuranceStays.com.

Priority 4 – Booking Conversion

Ensure every qualified accommodation inquiry receives a timely proposal, consistent follow-up, and the best possible opportunity to become a confirmed booking.

Priority 5 – Account Retention

Develop strong relationships with insurance clients to encourage repeat reservations and long-term account loyalty.

Internal Collaboration

The Insurance Reservations & Account Manager will collaborate closely with:

  • Corporate Stays Reservations Team: Availability, quotations, and booking confirmations.
  • Revenue Management Team: Pricing strategy and commercial optimization.
  • Operations & Guest Services: Guest arrivals, service issues, and accommodation coordination.
  • Property Owners & External Partners: Alternative accommodation sourcing and reservations.
  • Insurance Business Development Manager (Future Role): New insurance partnerships, account onboarding, and business development opportunities.
  • Management: Performance reporting, operational improvements, and commercial strategy.

First 90 Days – Expected Outcomes

Days 1–30: Training & Platform Setup

  • Become familiar with InsuranceStays.com and its reservation workflow.
  • Complete training on insurance-related accommodation requests.
  • Understand Corporate Stays' inventory and reservation procedures.
  • Learn how to search for and coordinate bookings with external property owners.
  • Organize the Insurance Stays reservations pipeline in HubSpot.
  • Establish standardized inquiry response templates and quotation procedures.
  • Begin managing incoming accommodation requests independently.

Days 31–60: Reservation Management & Account Development

  • Take ownership of the full accommodation inquiry pipeline.
  • Manage booking requests from initial contact through confirmation.
  • Build relationships with insurance professionals submitting accommodation requests.
  • Improve quotation response times and follow-up procedures.
  • Identify and address obstacles affecting booking conversion.
  • Establish reporting on booking volume, revenue, and accommodation sourcing.

Days 61–90: Performance Optimization

  • Independently manage the Insurance Stays reservations process.
  • Improve inquiry-to-booking conversion rates.
  • Increase bookings through Corporate Stays inventory where commercially appropriate.
  • Strengthen coordination with external property owners.
  • Develop repeat business from existing insurance clients.
  • Establish a reliable weekly performance reporting process.
  • Recommend improvements to reservation workflows, client communications, and platform operations.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a proactive reservations professional who enjoys helping clients, coordinating accommodation solutions, and building lasting business relationships.

They should be comfortable handling multiple reservations, communicating with insurance professionals, negotiating with property owners, and following up consistently to secure bookings.

This person should be commercially minded, detail-oriented, and committed to providing excellent service.

Success in this position means ensuring that every insurance accommodation request is handled professionally, every booking opportunity is maximized, and every client sees Insurance Stays as a reliable accommodation partner.

Career Growth

As Insurance Stays expands throughout Canada, this position may evolve into a senior account management or reservations leadership role, with opportunities to oversee additional reservations coordinators and manage larger insurance accounts.

The Insurance Reservations & Account Manager will play a central role in building Insurance Stays into a leading temporary accommodation platform for Canada's insurance industry.

jobs.description:
JoinphData, a remote-first data and AI consultancy company with employees across the United States, Latin America, and India. We partner with industry leaders, including Snowflake, AWS, Anthropic, Glean, and dbt, to solve the complex data and AI challenges that slow large enterprises.

We're growing fast, and we give our people real ownership over their work. We hire top performers and trust them to deliver results.

Why phData?

  • Snowflake Implementation Partner of the Year — 7 consecutive years, and 2026 Snowflake AI Partner of the Year
  • AWS Premier Tier Services Partner — the highest tier of recognition in the AWS Partner Network
  • 2025 Fivetran Partner of the Year (4th consecutive year)
  • 2025 dbt Labs Partner of the Year (3x winner) with Visionary partner status
  • 2026 KNIME Customer Excellence Partner of the Year
  • Preferred Partner in the Anthropic Claude Partner Network
  • #1 Partner in Snowflake Advanced Certifications
  • 600+ Expert Cloud Certifications (Sigma, AWS, Azure, Dataiku, and more)
  • Recognized as an award-winning workplace in the US, India and LATAM

About the Role

Most companies in data and AI sound the same. The same launch recaps, the same borrowed talking points, the same claims no one checked. This role exists so phData doesn't. You turn what our R&D experts and executives know into original, fact-checked journalism that reporters quote, analysts cite, and buyers trust. You are one person working with roughly 10 subject-matter experts and executives, and you don't have a team to hide behind. If you do this poorly, phData publishes content that is forgettable at best and wrong at worst, in a market where credibility is the whole game.

About You

Read this section like a mirror, not a checklist. Some of it is meant to make you nod. Some of it is meant to make you uncomfortable. Both reactions are useful, to you and to us.

  • You've killed a story you loved because one source wouldn't confirm it. You didn't publish and hope.
  • You've told a senior executive their idea wasn't original enough to run, and kept the relationship.
  • Journalist first. You report, interview, verify, and edit like someone whose name is on the byline. You consider "good enough to publish" a failure of standards, not a deadline.
  • Quiet ownership. Your best work goes out under an SME's or executive's name. You are fine with that, and you still defend its quality as if it were yours.
  • Judgment over volume. You pick one flagship idea a quarter and say no to the rest. You don't measure yourself by how much you shipped.

Role Overview

Enterprises cannot make confident use of AI when essential content is scattered across repositories, poorly classified, or difficult to govern. DryvIQ, part of Nasuni, helps organizations discover, classify, govern, and manage enterprise information across more than 40 cloud and on-premises repositories and 550+ file formats.

We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer who combines strong C#/.NET engineering with practical customer consulting. You will translate complex business challenges into deployed, supportable solutions that improve content intelligence, information governance, and AI readiness.

This is a hands-on engineering and customer-delivery role, not a pre-sales-only or purely advisory position.

Own the technical delivery of assigned complex enterprise customer engagements, from requirements discovery through production validation and handoff. Make customer-specific design decisions within supported platform capabilities and established engineering standards.

What You'll Do

jobs.title: Master Thesis -Development of a Virtual Validation Framework for Fuel Cell Elect
jobs.excerpt: Transport is at the core of modern society.  Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future.
jobs.description:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.

Background

The transition towards sustainable transportation requires efficient development and validation methods for next-generation propulsion technologies. Fuel Cell Electric Vehicles (FCEVs) offer a promising solution for demanding transport applications, but their development relies heavily on extensive physical testing campaigns covering areas such as fuel cell control, thermal management, energy management, safety systems, vehicle performance, and durability.

To support faster development cycles and reduce dependence on prototype vehicles, Volvo Group is increasing the use of simulation-driven development and virtual validation. Recent analysis of FCEV commissioning and validation activities has shown that a significant portion of existing physical test cases could potentially be assessed through simulation-based methods. By transferring suitable validation activities into virtual environments, development teams can identify issues earlier, improve simulation maturity, and support the company's left-shift validation strategy by moving verification activities from physical prototypes to virtual simulation earlier in the development cycle.

This thesis will investigate how physical validation activities can be systematically transformed into virtual validation scenarios and implemented within Volvo's Global Simulation Platform (GSP). The work will contribute to the development of a methodology that enables simulation-driven verification of FCEV functions and systems.

Thesis Tasks

The students will:

  • Review and classify existing FCEV validation activities and test cases.
  • Develop a methodology for converting physical validation tests into virtual validation scenarios and automated simulation-based test cases.
  • Implement representative virtual validation scenarios in Volvo's Global Simulation Platform (GSP).
  • Develop an automated regression test framework to execute and assess virtual validation test cases following model updates.
  • Compare simulation results with available vehicle test data and assess the accuracy and applicability of the virtual validation framework.
  • Investigate simulation confidence, limitations, and requirements for virtual validation.
  • As a secondary objective, provide recommendations for expanding the Virtual Validation Framework to additional FCEV systems, increasing simulation coverage, and supporting future Digital Twin capabilities within GSP.

The project aims to establish a framework for virtual validation of FCEVs and clarify the opportunities and limitations of replacing physical testing with simulation-based methods.

Candidate Profile

  • The thesis will be conducted in collaboration with the Software Solutions team at Volvo Group Trucks Technology and is intended for two Master's students.
  • A background in vehicle engineering, mechanical engineering, mechatronics, systems engineering, automatic control, or a related discipline.
  • Experience in dynamic system modeling and simulation.
  • Knowledge of vehicle systems and control strategies.
  • Proficiency in MATLAB/Simulink.
  • An interest in virtual validation, Digital Twin technologies, and simulation-driven development.
  • Experience with model development, scripting, simulation automation, and MIL/SIL environments. Familiarity with AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, or similar technologies is considered an advantage.

Project start: January 2027

Contact: Hong Yang, Industrial Supervisor, Volvo TTI, Performance Management, H2 & FC Value Chain, Göteborg, Sweden

We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.

Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. ​We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. ​We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.

Trucks Technology & Industrial Division hire team players who are ready to create real customer impact. Our decentralized teams work close to our customers, with speed and autonomy, to build what they truly need.
Join us to collaborate on innovative, sustainable technologies that redefine how we design, build, and deliver value. Bring your curiosity, your expertise, and your collaborative energy, and together, we’ll turn bold ideas into tangible solutions for our customers and contribute to a more sustainable tomorrow.

Resourcing Lead (D365)

Remote | Unlimited Holiday | Turn changing demand into clear resourcing decisions that
protect delivery
Infinity Group are a innovative Microsoft Cloud Solution Partner based in the UK. We excel in providing award-winning IT Support, Digital Transformation, and Microsoft Dynamics 365 Consultancy services.
With a robust team of over 170 professionals, we operate from offices in Tunbridge Wells and London Paddington. Our exceptional work has earned us the prestigious title of Finalist for Microsoft Partner of the Year for Dynamics Business Central.

Guided by core values of empathy, creativity, ambition, authenticity, and confidence, we celebrate diversity and strive to create a supportive and innovative work environment.
We are committed to the well-being and growth of our employees, and we prioritize continuous learning and development through fully funded training programs.
Our focus on people, expertise, and commitment to excellence underscores our mission to make a positive impact in the tech industry.

The Role:

The Resourcing Lead ensures the right people are deployed to the right work at the right time across Professional Services and Managed Services.

You will own the day-to-day resourcing process, challenge requests that do not make operational or commercial sense, and maintain a clear view of demand, capacity and utilisation. Rather than simply escalating issues, you will work through the options, recommend the best route forward and resolve problems before they affect customers, delivery or growth.

Working across Project Management, Service Delivery, Sales and practice teams, you will give the business the information and confidence to make faster, better resourcing decisions. This includes supporting Managed Services escalations, hypercare demand an d competing requirements across Dynamics CE and Business Central delivery

What you'll be doing

    Resource planning and allocation

  • Own the day-to-day resourcing process across Professional Services and Managed Services. Match demand against available capacity and make operational decisions within agreed parameters.

    • Challenge and problem-solving

  • Test resource requests against the actual delivery need, including capability, timing, duration and allocation. Work through competing priorities and recommend a practical way forward rather than simply processing or escalating requests.

    • Capacity and commercial visibility

  • Maintain a clear forward view of demand, availability, utilisation and chargeability. Highlight emerging gaps, under-utilisation and capacity pressure early enough for the business to act.

    • Booking quality and operational control

  • Own resource bookings within Dynamics 365 Project Operations, ensuring the schedule board provides an accurate view of commitments. Resolve conflicts, incorrect profiles, duplicate bookings and hard-versus-soft booking issues.

    • Delivery and service support

  • Work closely with Project Managers, Service Delivery Managers and practice leads to resolve day to-day resource issues. Support Managed Services escalations and 90 -day hyper care requirements while balancing the impact on wider delivery.

    • Planning and continuous improvement

  • Bring clear information, options and recommendations into resource and capacity planning discussions. Improve the quality of resourcing data, processes and decision-making across teams.

The kind of problems you’ll solve

  • Two teams need the same specialist at the same time, but both consider their work business-critical.
  • A resource request does not align with the skills, timing, duration or level of allocation genuinely required.
  • New sales demand is growing faster than available delivery capacity.
  • A project is carrying incorrect, duplicated or outdated bookings that distort the forward resource view.
  • Managed Services or hypercare demand creates unexpected pressure on project delivery capacity.
  • Valuable capability is under-utilised while other teams are requesting external support.
  • A delivery risk needs resolving quickly, but the decision involves customer, commercial and operational trade-offs.
  • Future demand suggests the business may need to recruit, use contractors or change delivery priorities.

What sets you apart

  • You do not simply process requests. You question whether they make sense and propose a better option when they do not.
  • You can work through an unclear resourcing problem, weigh the trade-offs and make a considered recommendation.
  • You understand that resource decisions affect customers, revenue, utilisation and team performance, not just schedules.
  • You remain calm and organised when priorities change and several teams need answers at once.
  • You are comfortable making day-to-day decisions independently while recognising when a wider commercial or strategic call is required.
  • You build trust through accurate information, sound judgement and clear communication.
  • You pay attention to detail without losing sight of the wider delivery and commercial outcome.

Your impact:

    On the business

  • You create a reliable view of capacity and demand, helping the business protect utilisation, make better hiring decisions and take on new work with greater confidence.

    • On customers

  • You reduce the risk of delays, inconsistent handovers and missed commitments by ensuring customer work has the right capability behind it at the right time.

    • On team performance

  • You give delivery teams clearer priorities, more accurate bookings and faster resolution of resource conflicts. Project Managers, Service Delivery Managers and senior leaders spend less time chasing information and more time making informed decisions.

What it’s like here

  • Ambitious, but not political
  • Collaborative, but with high standards
  • People who care about doing things properly — not just getting them out the door
    • We’ve built a culture where:
  • Architects have real ownership and influence
  • Good ideas win (regardless of role or tenure)
  • You’re trusted to solve problems, not micromanaged

What you get:

  • Unlimited annual leave
  • Private healthcare, life assurance, company shares
  • Electric car scheme
  • Flexible/remote working (with access to Tunbridge Wells & Paddington offices)
  • Company & team socials, including our annual Illuminate Awards
