jobs.title: Ceph Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.excerpt: Über uns:Als Vorreiter für nachhaltige Green-IT-Cloud-Computing-Lösungen setzen wir unseren Fokus auf digitale Souveränität, Sicherheit nach europäischen Standards sowie Unabhängigkeit und Flexibilität durch den Einsatz von Open-Source-Technologien.
jobs.description:
Über uns:

Als Vorreiter für nachhaltige Green-IT-Cloud-Computing-Lösungen setzen wir unseren Fokus auf digitale Souveränität, Sicherheit nach europäischen Standards sowie Unabhängigkeit und Flexibilität durch den Einsatz von Open-Source-Technologien.

Open Source ist unsere DNA:Wir engagieren uns aktiv in Open-Source-Verbänden, Netzwerken und Kooperationen, um offene Standards mitzugestalten und die digitale Souveränität Europas mit innovativen IT-Lösungen zu fördern. Unsere Mission ist es, Unternehmen jeder Größe gemeinsam mit unserem Partnerökosystem dabei zu unterstützen, ihre digitale Transformation zu beschleunigen und ihre Geschäftsziele durch den Einsatz nachhaltiger Cloud-Technologien zu erreichen.

Start-up-Spirit trifft Konzern-Power: Yorizon ist eine Tochtergesellschaft von HOCHTIEF. HOCHTIEF ist ein technisch ausgerichteter, globaler Infrastrukturkonzern mit führenden Positionen in seinen Kernaktivitäten Bau, Dienstleistungen und Konzessionen/Public-Private-Partnerships (PPP) und mit Tätigkeitsschwerpunkten in Australien, Nordamerika und Europa. So verbinden wir agilen Pioniergeist und flache Hierarchien mit der Stabilität eines internationalen Konzerns.

Dein Wirkungsbereich:

Als Teil unseres Datacenter Operations-Teams berichtest Du an den Lead Plattform Architekten und verantwortest das Herzstück unserer internen Cloud-Umgebung: die Ceph-Cluster, die als Storage-Basis unserer OpenStack-Plattform dienen. Ob Block Storage für virtuelle Maschinen, Images oder S3-kompatibler Object Storage – wenn es um Daten geht, läuft alles über Deine Systeme. Gemeinsam sorgen wir dafür, dass unsere Plattformen stabil, skalierbar und hochverfügbar bleiben.

Deine Rolle:

  • Ceph-Expertise einbringen.Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für alles rund um Ceph – von RADOS, RBD und RGW über CephFS bis hin zu CRUSH-Maps, Pool-Layouts und Placement Groups. Dein Wissen macht uns unabhängiger und schneller.
  • Betrieb & Verfügbarkeit sicherstellen. Du betreibst unsere Ceph-Cluster im Tagesgeschäft. Kapazitätsplanung, Rebalancing, Scrubbing-Strategien, Hardware-Lifecycle, Upgrades im Rolling-Verfahren und ein Monitoring, das Probleme sichtbar macht, bevor sie welche werden.
  • Debugging auf tiefer Ebene.Flappende OSDs, degraded oder inconsistent PGs, Netzwerkprobleme zwischen Public und Cluster Network – Du gehst den Dingen bis auf Log- und Kernel-Ebene auf den Grund und findest die Ursache statt nur das Symptom.
  • Performance-Analyse & Tuning. Du misst, bevor Du optimierst. Latenzen, IOPS und Durchsatz analysierst Du systematisch und leitest daraus konkrete Verbesserungen ab.
  • Architektur & Weiterentwicklung mitgestalten. Du begleitest Architektur-, Design- und Integrationsentscheidungen rund um Storage und entwickelst nachhaltige, skalierbare Lösungen – inklusive Themen wie Failure Domains, Multi-Site-Konzepte, RBD Mirroring und Disaster Recovery.
  • OpenStack-Integration.Du sorgst dafür, dass das Zusammenspiel von Ceph und OpenStack sauber funktioniert, und bist Sparringspartner für unsere Plattform-Teams bei Storage-nahen Fragestellungen.
  • You built it – You run it.Mit ausgeprägter Hands-on-Mentalität unterstützt Du bei Einführung, Inbetriebnahme und zuverlässigem Betrieb neuer Cluster in unseren Datacenter-Umgebungen.
  • Best Practices & Wissen teilen.Du etablierst moderne Standards, dokumentierst clevere Lösungen und baust Ceph-Know-how aktiv im Team auf – Runbooks, Troubleshooting-Guides und Pairing gehören für Dich dazu.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Dein Fundament (Linux & OpenSource).Du besitzt tiefgehendes Know-how im Linux-Umfeld sowie ein starkes Verständnis für Datacenter-Infrastrukturen – insbesondere Storage, Netzwerk und Virtualisierung.
  • Dein Schwerpunkt (Ceph). Du hast Ceph-Cluster in Produktion betrieben, skaliert und aus schwierigen Situationen zurückgeholt. Begriffe wie MON, MGR, OSD, MDS, BlueStore, WAL/DB-Devices oder PG-Autoscaler sind für Dich Alltag, nicht Theorie. Erfahrung mit cephadm, Rook oder ceph-ansible ist ein Plus.
  • Storage-Hardware-Verständnis.Du weißt, wie sich NVMe, SSD und HDD im Cluster unterschiedlich verhalten, und kannst Hardware-Auswahl und -Layout fundiert bewerten.
  • Moderne Plattformen & GitOps. Du hast Erfahrung mit Kubernetes und modernen Deployment-Paradigmen wie GitOps (idealerweise mit Flux).
  • Infrastruktur als Code. Automatisierung ist für Dich Standard – Du bist vertraut mit Tools wie Ansible, Terraform oder klassischen CI/CD-Pipelines. Bash oder Python zum Bauen eigener Tools und Auswertungen liegen Dir.
  • Analytischer Kopf. Du durchdringst komplexe, hochverfügbare, verteilte Systemlandschaften und findest auch bei kniffligen Problemen strukturierte Lösungen – auch unter Druck, wenn Daten im Spiel sind.
  • Kommunikation.Du arbeitest gerne auf Augenhöhe, teilst Dein Wissen und kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch.

Unser Angebot:

  • Teamspirit. Du wirst Teil eines dynamischen, wachsenden Teams mit echter Du-Kultur. Wir bieten dir den Freiraum, deine Talente aktiv einzubringen und die Zukunft des Unternehmens mitzugestalten.
  • Karrierechancen.Stillstand gibt es bei uns nicht. Nutze die vielfältigen Aufstiegschancen in einem expandierenden Umfeld und profitiere von unseren spannenden internationalen Perspektiven.
  • Remote first.Work-Life-Balance wird bei uns großgeschrieben. Ob 100 % remote aus Deutschland oder Österreich oder hybrid an unseren Standorten in Berlin, Augsburg oder Wien.
  • Deine Entwicklung. Wir investieren in dich. Mit einem eigenen Weiterbildungsbudget entscheidest du selbst, welche fachlichen oder persönlichen Skills du als Nächstes vertiefen möchtest.
  • Equipment.Damit du Bestleistungen bringen kannst, kriegst du das passende Werkzeug. Wähle bei deinem Equipment frei zwischen modernsten Apple- oder Windows-Geräten.
  • Mobilität. Wir unterstützen dich finanziell bei der Nutzung öffentlicher Verkehrsmittel, damit du entspannt und klimafreundlich ins Büro kommst.
  • Purpose. Wenn du dich ehrenamtlich engagieren möchtest, unterstützen wir dich dabei, deinen Beitrag für die Gesellschaft zu leisten.

Bereit für die Herausforderung?

Werde Teil unserer Erfolgsgeschichte und bring deine Leidenschaft für moderne Infrastrukturen in unser Team ein. Wir sind gespannt auf deine Bewerbung!

jobs.title: Senior Strategic Account Marketing Lead
jobs.excerpt: About MISUMI AmericasMISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions.
jobs.description:
About MISUMI Americas

MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.

Impact In This Role

As the Senior Strategic Account Marketing Lead at MISUMI Americas, you will work side by side with the sales reps who own your assigned accounts. You will take their account plans, what customers are telling us, and our revenue goals, and turn them into practical, creative marketing campaigns. These campaigns should spark engagement, create and move deals forward, and strengthen customer relationships.

This is not a role for a single-channel specialist. You will build and lead growth plans for each account, using both hands-on and large-scale tactics. These include customer visits, lunch-and-learns, direct mail and swag, executive outreach, events, targeted email and nurture programs, paid ads, sales support materials, and account-specific content. You do not have to create every asset or run every channel yourself. You do need to pick the right mix, bring in the right partners, and see the work through to results you can measure.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Become a trusted, proactive marketing partner to the Account Executives and sales leaders for a named portfolio of Strategic and Key Accounts. Maintain a regular operating cadence with each seller to understand account priorities, opportunities, whitespace, risks, and next steps.
  • Translate account plans, account research, buyer and buying-group insights, intent signals, opportunity data, and customer engagement into focused account-growth strategies and quarterly activation plans.
  • Own the end-to-end planning, orchestration, and execution of 1:1, 1:few, and 1:many account marketing programs. Select the right mix of high-touch and scalable tactics based on the account objective, buying stage, audience, and expected impact.
  • Develop creative, practical account plays that help Sales earn attention and create momentum. Examples include customer-office visits, lunch-and-learns, executive meetings, local customer experiences, direct mail and swag, targeted events, customer workshops, outbound support, account-specific content, and digital nurture programs.
  • Partner with Lifecycle, Performance Marketing, Field and Events, Content, Product Marketing, Design, Sales Development, and external vendors to activate cohesive campaigns. Write clear briefs, establish ownership and timelines, resolve blockers, and ensure every program is delivered to a high bar.
  • Work with Web, Lifecycle and Performance Marketing to create and optimize targeted email, nurture, retargeting, paid media, landing-page, and audience programs for assigned accounts when those tactics will advance the account objective.
  • Drive customers and prospects to MISUMI Americas events and create thoughtful pre-event, onsite, and post-event account plans that convert event participation into meaningful sales follow-up and pipeline progress.
  • Work with Content and PMMs to build the sales enablement required for each activation, including messaging, outreach guidance, follow-up plans, templates, snippets, talking points, and clear seller actions. Ensure Sales understands the plan and follows through.
  • Manage assigned program budgets and vendors with an ROI mindset. Test, learn, reallocate investment, and know when to stop, revise, or scale an account play.
  • Use Salesforce, Marketo, Reachdesk, Sigma, intent data, account engagement data, and other available signals to identify opportunity, prioritize investment, and measure impact. Maintain a clear view of account engagement, buying-group reach, opportunity creation and progression, pipeline, conversion, velocity, win rate, and revenue influence.
  • Share account-level learnings, results, and recommendations with Sales and Marketing. Turn successful plays into repeatable programs and quickly address underperforming tactics.
  • Execute directly when speed and quality require it. This role is expected to be a hands-on operator, not solely a strategist, coordinator, or requester of work from other teams.
  • Travel to customer offices, MISUMI Americas events, industry events, and internal meetings when in-person engagement can accelerate an account objective.

How We’ll Measure Success

Success in this role is measured by business impact and sales-partner effectiveness, not campaign activity alone. In the first year, this person will:

  • Establish productive working relationships and a clear account-growth cadence with the sellers for their assigned Strategic and Key Accounts.
  • Deliver account plans and integrated activations that are directly tied to seller priorities, customer needs, and pipeline goals.
  • Increase meaningful engagement with priority contacts and buying groups, create or advance qualified opportunities, and contribute to pipeline progression, opportunity velocity, win rate, and revenue across the supported portfolio.
  • Build repeatable, data-informed account plays that combine high-touch experiences with scalable lifecycle and performance tactics.
  • Earn a reputation with Sales and Marketing for creativity, responsiveness, sound judgment, operational follow-through, and measurable impact.

What Makes This Role Different

This role sits at the intersection of account strategy, field execution, digital activation, and sales partnership. It is not limited to digital marketing, paid media, event production, project management, or account research. Candidates must bring broad marketing judgment and be comfortable moving between customer-facing experiences, account-specific campaigns, and scaled programs.

The role owns the account marketing strategy, activation plan, cross-functional orchestration, seller adoption, and performance readout for the assigned portfolio. Channel and functional teams provide their specialized expertise; this role brings those capabilities together into the right account solution and owns the outcome.

Desired Traits

  • 8+ years of B2B marketing experience in account-based marketing, strategic account marketing, field marketing, demand generation, or a closely related revenue-marketing role.
  • Demonstrated experience partnering directly with enterprise, strategic, or key-account sellers to build and execute account plans that contributed to pipeline, opportunity progression, and revenue.
  • Proven ability to develop and execute integrated campaigns across both high-touch and digital channels, including customer events or experiences, direct mail or gifting, sales outreach support, email or nurture, paid or performance programs, and content.
  • Track record of taking programs from insight and strategy through detailed execution, optimization, and performance reporting.
  • Strong commercial judgment and comfort prioritizing a portfolio of accounts against revenue opportunity, sales priorities, and expected return on investment.
  • Customer-facing confidence and experience representing Marketing in seller and customer conversations, including onsite engagements when appropriate.
  • Excellent cross-functional project leadership. Able to write clear briefs, align stakeholders, build realistic workback plans, resolve ambiguity, and keep multiple time-sensitive programs moving.
  • Analytical fluency and experience using CRM, marketing automation, account engagement, and intent data to make decisions and measure results. Salesforce and Marketo experience strongly preferred.
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
  • Comfort in a fast-moving environment where the right play is not always obvious and initiative matters.
  • Ability to travel up to 25% within the U.S. for customer-office visits, MISUMI | Fictiv events, industry events, and internal meetings.

Preferred Traits

  • Experience marketing to complex B2B buying groups in a technical, industrial, manufacturing, or supply-chain environment.
  • Experience with ABM platforms, intent-data tools, audience development, and account-level reporting.
  • Experience producing or supporting executive programs, customer workshops, lunch-and-learns, field events, and direct-mail or gifting programs.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Physical Traits

The physical demands described here are representative of those an employee must meet to successfully perform the essential functions of this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.

While performing the duties of this role, the employee routinely is required to sit, walk, talk, hear, use hands to keyboard and handle objects, and occasionally stoop, kneel, crouch, twist, crawl, reach, and stretch.

Ability to travel up to 25% within the U.S. for customer-office visits, MISUMI Americas events, industry events, and internal meetings in Oakland, CA and Schaumburg, IL.

Perks and Benefits

  • Competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401K plan
  • Parental leave programs
  • Paid volunteer days
  • And much, much more!

Salary Range: $130,000 to $160,000 per year, based upon experience

Interested in learning more? We look forward to hearing from you soon.

We’re actively seeking teammates who:

  • Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.
  • Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.
  • Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.
  • Have an ‘always learning’ mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.
  • Help us continue to build a world-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates

We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

jobs.description:
We are looking for AIVoice Recording Contributors to join an English (Australia)voice evaluation project and help support the development of the next generation of AI technologies.
Job Type: Freelance
Location: Work from home
Work Schedule:Flexible, task-based work (approximately 4–6 hours per day)
Project Duration: Approximately 1 month
Start Date: Immediately
Rate: 20 USD/hour

Help Shape the Future of AI

This short project offers an opportunity to contribute to the development and improvement of speech and language AI technologies by providing high-quality voice recordings in your native language and dialect.

You will complete recording tasks using our internal platform by reading provided text prompts aloud. The goal is to capture natural speech from native speakers of specific language variants to help improve AI systems' ability to understand diverse languages, dialects, and accents.

How Your Recordings Will Be Used

Your recordings will be used to evaluate how agents respond to spoken instructions and to compare that evaluation with an evaluation of text-based instructions. The collected audio may be reviewed for quality and incorporated into datasets used for research, development, testing, and improvement of AI systems.

What You’ll Do

  • Read provided text cards aloud and record them exactly as written (there approximately 640 cards per person).
  • Produce clear, natural, and high-quality speech recordings following the guidelines and instructions provided.
  • Speak using your natural dialect and accent.
  • Ensure no words are added, omitted, or altered.
  • Re-record submissions if requested to meet quality standards.
  • Complete tasks using our internal recording platform.

What We’re Looking For

  • Native-level fluency in English (Australia).
  • Authentic pronunciation and strong familiarity with the target dialect or accent through everyday use.
  • Ability to complete a trial voice recording to verify language variant and accent.
  • Contributors must not imitate dialects or accents that are not their own.
  • Experience with speech recording projects is an advantage, but not required.
  • Strong communication skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to follow detailed instructions and maintain recording accuracy.

Technical Requirements

  • Quiet room or recording space with minimal background noise.
  • Computer microphone or headset with microphone.
  • Reliable internet connection.
  • Ability to access and use an online recording platform.

What We Offer

  • Flexible, remote work.
  • Timely and reliable payments.
  • Opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge AI technology.
  • Access to future language and AI-related projects.
  • A flexible engagement ideal for gaining experience with AI data collection projects.

Vendor Type

When applying, please select the option that best describes your working status.

A Freelancer is someone who has a business license and may have a VAT number or EIN for tax purposes. A VAT (Value Added Tax) number is a unique identifier assigned to a registered business in many countries; an EIN (Employer Identification Number) is a similar identifier used in the US. A Private Individual does not have a business license. If you aren’t sure, you are probably a private individual.

Entreprenista is a leading media company and home to the Entreprenista League, our vibrant membership community designed to support and empower women founders and leaders. This is a hands-on role for someone with substantial experience implementing and enhancing Intapp products in a law-firm environment. You will take ownership of complex workstreams, guide technical decisions and support other members of the delivery team.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead end-to-end Intapp implementation work, from discovery and requirements through solution design, configuration, testing, deployment and post-go-live support.
  • Design and enhance workflows, forms, rules and application configurations for client and matter intake, conflicts, risk and compliance, time recording or related processes.
  • Advise clients on solution options, product capabilities, design trade-offs and implementation approach.
  • Configure and support relevant Intapp products, such as Intapp Intake, Conflicts, Open, Time, Walls, Flow and Integrate.
  • Plan and oversee integrations with legal finance, document management and other business systems, including integration testing and defect resolution.
  • Lead workshops with business and technical stakeholders; document requirements, process flows, functional designs and technical specifications.
  • Plan and coordinate system testing, user acceptance testing, data validation, training, deployment and business readiness.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues and work with client teams and Intapp support to resolve product or implementation problems.
  • Identify opportunities to improve workflows, controls, data quality and user experience.
  • Provide technical guidance to junior engineers and contribute to delivery standards, documentation and estimates.
  • Support upgrades, migration planning and cloud readiness where required.

What we’re looking for:

  • At least five years of hands-on experience implementing, configuring or significantly enhancing Intapp products.
  • Experience delivering Intapp solutions in a law firm or comparable professional-services environment.
  • Proven participation in multiple implementation or major enhancement projects, with responsibility for solution design and delivery.
  • Strong working knowledge of one or more Intapp products, such as Intake, Conflicts, Open, Time, Walls, Flow or Integrate. Depth in a core product is essential; experience across several products is an advantage.
  • Experience designing workflows and translating Risk, Compliance, Finance or legal business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Experience with integrations between Intapp and other enterprise or legal-sector systems.
  • Confidence leading workshops, managing stakeholders and explaining technical choices clearly.
  • Experience planning or carrying out testing, deployments, upgrades and post-go-live support.
  • Strong troubleshooting, documentation and analytical skills.

Desirable experience:

  • Intapp cloud migration or cloud readiness work.
  • Legal finance or document management platforms such as Aderant or iManage.
  • SQL, APIs, reporting tools or integration platforms.
  • Conflicts management, ethical walls, information barriers, client due diligence or AML workflows.
  • Agile delivery, project governance or mentoring other engineers.

How success will be measured:

You will deliver reliable Intapp solutions that meet agreed business and control requirements, communicate risks and decisions clearly, and leave clients with supportable configurations and useful documentation.

About Us:

Harbor is the preeminent provider of expert services across strategy, legal technology, operations, and intelligence. Our globally integrated team of 900+ strategists, technologists, and specialists navigate alongside our clients – leading law firms, corporations, and their law departments – to provide essential resources and invaluable insights. Anchored in a rich heritage of deep knowledge, steadfast relationships, and mutual respect, our unwavering dedication lies in shaping the future of the legal industry and fostering enduring partnerships within our community and ecosystem.

jobs.description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍UK Remote (with essential travel to our global offshore sites) | 💰£51,200 - £64,700 + Incentive Awards + Benefits ✨

Our Global Ops Team ⭐️

At Monzo, our customers should receive great service regardless of where it is delivered. Turning our partner estate direction into successful outcomes requires clear programme design, coordinated delivery and strong ownership across teams and partners.

The Partner Strategy and Delivery Manager exists to determine how agreed priorities will be tackled. You will turn a strategic focus area or business outcome into a clear programme approach, define what needs to happen and lead the work through delivery, stabilisation and handover.

Delivery is expected at every level within the pillar. In this role, most of your time will be spent designing how an agreed priority will be tackled and leading the resulting project or programme.

You will contribute evidence and recommendations that can influence future priorities, and you will remain sufficiently close to the detailed delivery to ensure the approach works in practice.

🔑 You’ll play a key role by...

Programme design and definition

  • Programme strategy & scoping: Translate strategic objectives into clear, actionable delivery roadmaps—defining scope, workstreams, sequencing, success metrics, and required analytical inputs for complex initiatives.
  • Integrated planning & governance: Establish end-to-end plans, milestones, and proportionate governance models to manage dependencies, guide cross-functional inputs, and maintain clear stakeholder visibility.
  • Agile adaptability & BAU transition: Design implementation, stabilisation, and handover strategies from kickoff, dynamically adapting programme parameters as business conditions evolve to ensure seamless transition to BAU.

Analysis, recommendations and business cases

  • Problem structuring & root cause analysis: Deconstruct ambiguous strategic issues into clear workstreams, synthesising operational data, partner insights, and team findings to isolate systemic estate themes from domain-specific matters.
  • Holistic solution design: Evaluate estate-wide processes, services, and locations to build practical, evidence-based options that clearly articulate trade-offs, operational impacts, and strategic pathways forward.
  • Business case ownership: Own the development of robust business cases, thoroughly detailing customer value, financial costs, operational benefits, dependencies, risks, and counterfactual impacts.
  • Product & Tech integration: Partner with Product and Technology leads to design system and process optimisations that maximise operational efficiency, customer experience, and commercial return.
  • Executive decision support: Author high-impact program proposals, decision papers, and leadership presentations to drive clarity and enable informed executive decision-making.

Programme delivery

  • End-to-end delivery & cross-functional coordination: Lead complex programmes from kickoff through to realised outcomes, serving as the primary point of contact coordinating workstreams, dependencies, and key decisions across Global Ops, GCOO, and partner organisations.
  • Partner alignment & hands-on leadership: Direct partner working sessions to set delivery expectations, maintaining active hands-on involvement in critical path tasks while constructively challenging delays and ownership gaps.
  • Governance, risk & benefit tracking: Embed customer, risk, regulatory, and resilience standards throughout programme design, continuously tracking performance against target metrics and adjusting execution to guarantee benefit realisation.
  • Stabilisation, BAU transfer & post-implementation review: Oversee implementation and stabilisation through to formal BAU handover—ensuring documented ownership and metrics—and conduct post-delivery reviews to capture strategic learnings for future initiatives.

Team and portfolio contribution

  • Matrix leadership & coaching: Guide more junior colleagues across program workstreams, providing clear strategic context, quality assurance, and constructive coaching while empowering autonomous delivery.
  • Pillar standards & strategic insight: Share emerging risks, dependencies, and themes with the Strategy Lead while contributing to consistent, pillar-wide governance, business case, and benefit-tracking frameworks.
  • Cross-operational execution & mobility: Lead ad-hoc cross-functional initiatives across teams and partners, traveling periodically across UK and international locations to support discovery, sourcing, mobilisation, and stabilisation.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

  • Significant experience designing and delivering complex projects or programmes across multiple teams, stakeholders and external partners.
  • Essential experience working with outsourced operations, suppliers or third party partners.
  • Ability to travel within the UK and internationally when required. We currently have sites in India, Romania and South Africa, with plans underway for the EU.
  • Proven ability to take an agreed strategic priority or ambiguous problem and turn it into a clear programme approach and route to delivery.
  • Strong programme design and delivery skills, including scope definition, workstream design, planning, governance, risk management, dependency management, success measures and handover.
  • Experience setting meaningful programme outcomes, measures and expected benefits and monitoring delivery against them.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills, with the ability to bring together quantitative and qualitative evidence and turn it into a clear recommendation.
  • Experience developing or owning high quality business cases, proposals and decision materials.
  • Sound commercial and operational judgement, with the ability to balance customer outcomes, quality, risk, resilience, flexibility, cost and long term value.
  • Proven ability to influence leaders, operational teams and external partners across organisational boundaries.
  • Strong stakeholder leadership skills, with the ability to create clarity, resolve ambiguity and maintain momentum across a complex programme.
  • Confidence leading partner conversations and constructively challenging missed commitments or weak outcomes.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to structure complex information into clear proposals, papers and presentations.
  • The ability to coordinate and challenge the work of others while coaching and supporting less experienced colleagues.
  • Strong organisation and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage changing priorities and several dependencies without losing focus on the intended outcome.
  • Experience working in a regulated or customer sensitive environment, with sound judgement on customer impact, governance and control.
  • A collaborative and challenging approach, with the confidence to question assumptions, address difficult issues and bring stakeholders together around a clear outcome.
  • Experience within financial services, global operations, partner estate planning, mobilisation, transition or Product and Technology enabled operational change would be particularly valuable.

jobs.description:
Description

The eCOA and RTSM Application Specialist is responsible for supporting the design, deployment, configuration, and oversight of electronic Clinical Outcome Assessment (eCOA) solutions—including ePRO, eConsent, and other patient-centric electronic data capture tools— and of Randomization and Trial Supply Management (RTSM) across global clinical studies.

This role collaborates with cross-functional teams, Sponsors, and external vendors to ensure that eCOA and RTSM systems are implemented in alignment with study protocols, regulatory expectations, and industry standards. The eCOA and RTSM Specialist acts as a subject matter expert throughout the study lifecycle to ensure reliable data collection, optimal user experience, and data integrity.

RESPONSIBILITIES

More specifically, the eCOA and RTSM Application Specialist must:

  • Act as cCOA and RTSM subject matter expert during study start-up, maintenance, and close-out.
  • Define functional requirements and participate in the design and configuration of eCOA and RTSM solutions.
  • Draft and maintain system specifications, user requirements, edit checks, notifications, and reporting requirements.
  • Assist with the design of eCOA-related Case Report Forms (CRFs).
  • Create User Acceptance Testing (UAT) test scripts and coordinate or perform system validation testing.
  • Validate eCOA logic, rules, and study calculations against protocol requirements.
  • Support CDISC-compliant data mapping and collaborate with Clinical Data Standards teams.
  • Contribute to the development of data cleaning strategies and review relevant plans (e.g., DMP, edit check specifications).
  • Prepare study-specific training materials (site guides, participant instructions, etc.) and support training delivery as needed.
  • Lead or participate in internal and sponsor meetings related to system setup, changes, and issue management.
  • Document system configuration and file eCOA and RTSM deliverables into the Trial Master File (TMF).
  • Manage updates, amendments, and change requests throughout the study lifecycle.
  • Troubleshoot issues, escalate risks, and ensure timely resolution with vendors and project teams
  • Ensure eCOA and RTSM activities comply with ICH-GCP, FDA, EMA, and other relevant regulatory standards.
  • Contribute to SOPs, work instructions, process improvement initiatives, templates, and eCOA and RTSM standards.
  • Support continuous improvement, training, and knowledge sharing within Clinical Data Management.
  • Stay current on emerging eCOA and RTSM technologies, regulatory trends, and best practices.
  • Support vendor evaluation, standardization, and relationship management when applicable.
  • Act as a resource for cross-functional teams regarding cCOA and RTSM processes, timelines, and risks.

Employee may be assigned to other responsibilities that do not pertain to their former description, if they have the required experience, are qualified and/or have received adequate training

Requirements

PROFILE

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Computer Science, Health Sciences, or related field.
  • 3–5 years of experience in eCOA, EDC, IRT, or eClinical solutions within a CRO, pharma, or health-technology environment.
  • Strong knowledge of eCOA systems and patient-reported outcomes (ePRO).
  • Solid understanding of clinical trial processes and data management principles (CDISC knowledge is an asset).
  • Experience with system configuration, UAT, edit checks, and validation activities.
  • Ability to collaborate in cross-functional settings and manage multiple priorities.
  • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Global trial experience and knowledge of regulatory expectations (FDA, EMA, GDPR, HIPAA).
  • Attention to quality and data integrity
  • Technical curiosity and digital mindset
  • Problem solving and escalation awareness
  • Stakeholder communication and collaboration
  • Organization, accountability, and autonomy

Good knowledge of good clinical practices, and applicable Health Canada and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations/guidelines.

Our company

﻿The work environment

At Indero, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.

In this position, you will be eligible for the following perks:

  • Flexible work schedule
  • Permanent full-time position
  • Ongoing learning and development

About Indero

Formerly known as Innovaderm, Indero is a world-renowned expert and clinical research leader in dermatology. We have more than two decades of experience serving a broad range of indications, patient populations, administration routes, and drug classes, and a global footprint.

Indero is a dual-focus CRO for dermatology and rheumatology, with 25+ years’ experience in clinical research and trial delivery. Our full-service approach – which includes everything from protocol design and patient recruitment to trial monitoring and biometrics – provides biotech and pharmaceutical sponsors with the rigorous scientific foundation and tailored expertise their studies need to reach the finish line efficiently and effectively. With capabilities in North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Latin America; vast, continuously growing relationships with investigators and patients; and a dedicated research clinic through which we design and execute our own studies, Indero is the ideal CRO partner for clinical needs at global scale..

Indero is committed to providing equitable treatment and equal opportunity to all individuals. As such, Indero will provide accommodations throughout the recruitment and selection process to applicants with disabilities, upon request.

Indero only accepts applicants who can legally work in Romania.

Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.

We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.

Job Description

The Clinical Program Manager is responsible for the worldwide execution of all Phase I - IV clinical trials across all Gilead therapeutic areas. Clinical Operations plays a key role in ensuring all Gilead clinical trials are performed in accordance with applicable SOPs, company policies and regulatory guidelines to provide timely and high-quality clinical data that supports global registration and commercialization of Gilead’s products.


You will oversee and be responsible for the successful execution of studies and/or multiple studies within a program or multiple programs, including financial responsibility. You will be responsible for the resource management of studies, including ongoing assessment of resource needs and optimal deployment of resources to support a fluid ‘One Ops’ workforce.


You will participate and engage in Clinical Operations and/or cross-functional organizational change initiatives. You may act as the business process owner (BPO) and/or serve as a subject matter expert for Clinical Operations processes. You will encourage an innovative mindset by championing new ideas and initiatives and incorporating best practices, external benchmarking, and standardization across Clinical Operations.


Job Responsibilities:

  • Provides ongoing financial oversight of clinical trials/programs assigned.
  • May provide input into strategic and operational short- and long-range therapeutic area / functional area plans as appropriate, including supporting alignment and communications to other team members upon implementation.
  • Provides guidance and oversight for the successful management of all aspects of clinical trials within designated program budgets and timelines.
  • Leads cross-functional Study Management Teams (SMTs) and influences all relevant stakeholders.
  • Partners with cross-functional teams to manage, adjust and revise project timelines and budgets as needed.
  • Communicates project status and issues and ensures project team goals are met in alignment with project decisions. Escalates issues as needed.
  • Participates in the development of all study-related documentation, including study protocols.
  • Participates in the selection, management and oversight of contract research organizations (CROs) / vendors, including development of requests for proposals (RFPs).
  • Anticipates obstacles and difficulties and implements solutions to achieve project goals, including risk assessment and mitigation strategies.
  • Resolves issues as needed within national and international regulations and guidelines.
  • Uses all available tools to track, oversee and communicate on program status to all key stakeholders.
  • Participates in and/or leads departmental or interdepartmental strategic initiatives.
  • As assigned, initiates, authors, or otherwise contributes to standard operating procedure (SOP) development, implementation, and training.
  • Responsible for Clinical Operations activities conducted by the affiliate that are required by local regulations and/or usual practice to support clinical trials.
  • Ensures team’s work complies with established practices, policies and processes, and any regulatory or other requirements.
  • People Leader Path: Hires, develops, and retains diverse top talent on the team. Sets clear expectations for direct reports, and coaches direct reports on their performance, development and career interests.

Basic Requirements:

  • BA / BS / RN with 8 or more years’ relevant clinical or related experience in life sciences or MA / MS / PharmD / PhD with 6 or more years’ relevant clinical or related experience in life sciences.
  • Minimum of 4 years’ cross-functional study management or related leadership experience in life sciences, including multiple years’ experience managing study or project teams.

Preferred Requirements:

  • Advanced knowledge of one or more disease or therapeutic areas, as evidenced by independence in designing, implementing, and managing study team plans, deliverables and resource management.
  • Experience developing RFPs and selection and oversight/management of CROs or other vendors.
  • Proven ability to successfully start-up, manage and close-out clinical studies, including authoring clinical study and regulatory documentation and SOPs.
  • Complete knowledge of full cycle study management, from start-up to close-out.
  • Advanced knowledge of study management best practices and tools and has shown ability to apply these to improve study efficiencies and effectiveness.
  • Thorough knowledge of Food & Drug Administration (FDA) and European Medicines Agency (EMA), and other applicable national regulations, International Council for Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Pharmaceuticals for Human Use (ICH) guidelines and Good Clinical Practice (GCP) governing the conduct of clinical studies.
  • Proven ability to effectively author clinical study and regulatory documentation.
  • Ability to lead and influence programs, projects and/or initiatives.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and understanding of team dynamics.
  • Proven ability to work successfully in a team-oriented, highly matrixed environment.
  • Demonstrated effectiveness coaching, guiding and directing the work of others, effectively managing performance of others, and developing team capabilities.
  • Demonstrated effectiveness in proactively managing change.
  • Strong communication and organizational skills.
  • As required, the ability to travel

People Leader Accountabilities:

  • Create Inclusion - knowing the business value of diverse teams, modeling inclusion, and embedding the value of diversity in the way they manage their teams.
  • Develop Talent - understand the skills, experience, aspirations and potential of their employees and coach them on current performance and future potential. They ensure employees are receiving the feedback and insight needed to grow, develop and realize their purpose.
  • Empower Teams - connect the team to the organization by aligning goals, purpose, and organizational objectives, and holding them to account. They provide the support needed to remove barriers and connect their team to the broader ecosystem.

jobs.title: Endocrinologist/ Physician
jobs.excerpt: Blue Circle Health is a nonprofit organization working to improve how type 1 diabetes (T1D) care is delivered and accessed.
jobs.description:
Blue Circle Health is a nonprofit organization working to improve how type 1 diabetes (T1D) care is delivered and accessed. Funding from The Leona M. and Harry B. Helmsley Charitable Trust makes it possible to provide our 6-month virtual care, education, and support program to adults with T1D for free. Designed based on need rather than traditional reimbursement rules, our whole-person model is individualized and can include endocrinology care, diabetes education, insurance navigation, peer support, diabetes supportive counseling, help paying for T1D medications and supplies, and connections to community resources. We work alongside existing healthcare providers to fill gaps in care and empower people to manage this 24/7 condition.

We’re building a high-quality, scalable model for better T1D care—and we’re looking for mission-driven professionals who want to help create the healthcare system people with T1D deserve. Our ambition is to reach and support as many people living with T1D across the country as possible, and that urgency shapes how we work: we move quickly, set a high bar, and work hard to turn our mission into meaningful impact at scale.

Blue Circle Health is searching for an experienced MD or DO who will provide virtual patient care, specific to people with type 1 diabetes. Blue Circle Health has a team based, whole person approach to care where we bring together multiple specialties to create a personalized care plan for our patients. The Endocrinologist will conduct telehealth visits and will work with the clinical care team to provide the best care possible to the people we serve. The Endocrinologist will partner closely with the care team - including educators, diabetes supportive counselors, case managers, T1D support guides, and insurance navigators - to guide, educate and empower people living with type 1 diabetes to achieve better health outcomes. Currently we offer 30 minute (follow-up) and 60 minute (new patient) appointments , as we believe spending time with each of our patients is critical. This team includes support from medical assistants and from our technology team.

This role is primarily remote, with potential to attend in-person meetings. All team members also attend our annual in person company retreat. Our patients are currently located in 21 states + Washington D.C., with the intention to expand to additional states throughout the country. We will support the Endocrinologist in obtaining and maintaining licensure upon hire. This role is full-time and requires consistent availability Monday–Friday, with scheduled hours of 11:00 a.m.–8:00 p.m. ET on Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, and Friday. Thursdays are scheduled either 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. ET (preferred) or 11:00 a.m.–8:00 p.m. ET . Blue Circle has a call schedule during the work-day but does not currently have off-hours call, however as we expand, this may be a future need. Candidates can live anywhere in the U.S.

Core Responsibilities

  • Evaluate and treat our patients with T1D. Conduct medical evaluations, consultations, and provide diabetes-related care using telehealth platforms.
  • Provide guidance and care to our patients living with T1D, using evidence-based therapies and following ADA Standards of Care, with a focus on achieving individual goals and optimizing health outcomes.
  • In partnership with the Care Team, design individualized treatment plans for each patient, monitor their progress and adjust their therapies as needed.
  • Analyze data from all existing diabetes devices and stay up to date on future tech advances in the field
  • Teach patients, and new support staff, how to interpret device downloads and adjust insulin dosing and provide additional patient education to support this.
  • Address urgent patient inquiries, critical updates, and emergency interventions from patients and team members during work hours on a defined call schedule.
  • Provide medical guidance to a team of diabetes care providers including APRNs, RNs, diabetes educators, clinical social workers, behavioral health providers and potentially others as the team grows.
  • Direct supervision via state-specific collaborative care agreements with our current APRN with longstanding experience in the field, with potential to add additional mid-level providers in the future.
  • Partner with the VP of Clinical Care, VP of Clinical Operations, and team Endocrinologist(s) to provide support and guidance to the team responsible for the end-to-end patient care journey, ensuring that all services are delivered in a coordinated, efficient, and effective manner.
  • Help ensure that the clinical team provides compassionate and culturally responsive care and ensure rigor in evidence-based quality and safety.
  • Work with leadership and the administration team to ensure regulatory compliance of the clinical care team with local, state and federal regulations.
  • Use quantifiable evidence of impact to advocate for the improvement or scaling of services.
  • Develop partnerships with referring providers (PCPs, Endocrinologists, etc) and keep an open source of communication and camaraderie to support mutual patient care.
  • Potential to attend in-person meetings with partnering clinics to meet providers and present on our approach to care.
  • Lead by example in supporting a non-traditional healthcare model designed to serve both patients and providers to decrease barriers to care.

Expected Credentials, Experiences and Capabilities

  • An MD or DO who is a board certified/board eligible endocrinologist in the United States.
  • Must be eligible to obtain and maintain medical licensure in U.S. states where BCH provides care and have no known circumstances that would prevent or materially interfere with obtaining additional state licenses as BCH expands.
  • An approach to care delivery that embraces innovation and patient-centered care.
  • A strong communicator that can earn the respect of people with different backgrounds and expertise.
Preferred skills and experience:
  • Experience providing care in a remote care delivery model.
  • Experience in working with under-resourced communities and diverse populations.
  • Experience using data analytics, population health metrics, and quality improvement processes.
  • Experience in oral speaking and presenting to a range of audiences.
  • Experience contributing to the design or oversight of Quality Improvement initiatives

Total Rewards

Compensation:
Range: $220,000-$280,000/year. This range reflects the good-faith estimate of the compensation we reasonably expect to pay for this position. Individual compensation decisions are based on job-related factors, including skills, experience, and internal equity.

Benefits:
  • Health + dental + vision + short & long term disability coverage.
  • 401(k)
  • PTO & Holidays
  • 100% remote work within the United States with much of the current organization located in the Eastern time zone. Attendance at occasional in-person meetings will be required.
  • Opportunity to shape a healthcare delivery system and contribute to strategy every step of the way.
  • Make an impact in the lives of patients at a non-profit dedicated to improving healthcare.

At Blue Circle Health, we strive for a thoughtful and timely hiring process. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled or closed at any time once sufficient qualified candidates are identified. We're committed to keeping candidates informed as decisions move forward.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Job Description Summary

Senior Leader of a P&L. Not functional specific. (eg.: CEO, COO). Interprets simple internal and external business challenges and recommends best practices to improve products, processes or services. Stays informed of industry trends that may influence work.

Job Description

Job Description Summary


This Lean Growth Leader will be part of the Radiopharmaceutical team responsible for the design, adoption, and execution of the enterprise-wide lean transformation of the Pharmaceutical Diagnostics (PDx) business in the United States and Canada (USCAN). They will be focused on and partnered with one (or more) of the leaders in the business for their scope of responsibility. The Lean Growth Leader will possess hands-on experience applying Lean principles and driving results through continuous improvement. They will also be a contributing leader to the overall financial performance of the business unit and drive relevant improvements to the customer experience, as well as to the experience of our field sales and commercial support colleagues.


Job Description


With business partner(s), co-own and support development of the annual “Lean Road Map” and execution plan to drive business results. Roadmap will identify:

  • Identify major processes, key performance indicators (KPIs) and process/KPI owners.

jobs.excerpt: About Us:Zepto is building the beating heart of Australia's real-time, account-to-account payments revolution.
jobs.description:
About Us:

Zepto is building the beating heart of Australia's real-time, account-to-account payments revolution.

It’s a good moment to be doing this work. Card surcharging rules have changed, Payday Super is live, and many businesses are taking a serious look at account-to-account payments for the first time. A lot of that shift lands on our platform. We're looking for action-oriented people to help build category defining infrastructure.

Payments is a domain where the details matter. When someone’s wages or a business’s cash flow moves through our platform, it has to arrive correctly, every time, in seconds. Meeting that bar in a regulated industry makes for interesting engineering problems, and as a senior engineer you’ll have real ownership over how we solve them.

We’re a remote-first team that works closely together. Engineers here are trusted to make decisions, encouraged to share their thinking, and supported to grow. That culture is part of why we’ve been named FinTech Organisation of the Year at the Finnies twice.

What you’ll do:

  • Build, scale, and maintain high-volume, real-time payment APIs operating in a mission-critical, regulated environment.
  • Work across cross-functional teams to design architecture, write RFCs, and ship clean, observable, secure software.
  • Collaborate with Platform, Security, and Incident Management teams, participating in a shared on-call rotation.
  • Mentor and pair with peers, raising the team's bar for code quality, system design, and engineering practices.

What you’ll bring:

  • Strong backend foundations: Deep experience in a backend language and API development. We work in Ruby and Go, and we care more about your engineering than your current language.
  • Cloud native architectures: Practical experience on public cloud (preferably AWS), event-driven patterns, Infrastructure as Code, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Scale & reliability mindset: Track record maintaining performance and high availability under heavy transaction loads.
  • AI adoption: AI is changing how engineering works, and you're evolving with it. You use tools like Claude Code or Cursor as a core part of delivery, experiment as capabilities improve, while reviewing solutions with rigour and respecting data security boundaries.
  • Clear, open communication: You collaborate early with drafts/RFCs and flag risks proactively.
  • Front-end experience (React, TypeScript) is a bonus: Plenty of our work spans the stack, from the APIs that move money to the merchant-facing UIs built on them, so engineers who can follow their work through to the UI add real value.

Your First 6 Months:

Week 1: You’ll be paired with an onboarding buddy to get familiar with our domains, understand the business context across teams, and ship your first changes to production.

Month 1: You’ll begin to deliver features within your team's domains and review code with real context. You're building relationships across product, engineering and the wider business. You've probably spotted something that we could do better and either fixed it or made the case for prioritising an improvement.

Month 6: You’ve led a significant feature from idea to production: shaping the requirements with product, writing the RFC, breaking down the work and seeing it land with stakeholders. Alongside delivery, you've taken on an engineering project that makes the platform or the team better, whether that's observability, developer tooling, test infrastructure or paying down a piece of architecture we've outgrown. You own your team’s area of the product and know it better than anyone, including how it’s used and where it falls short. You challenge requirements when you can see a simpler way to solve the customer’s problem, and you’ve helped teammates level up through code review, pairing and design discussions. You’re helping set the standard for how your team uses AI tooling, shipping faster without cutting corners.

Why Zepto?

Headquartered in beautiful Byron Bay, Zepto has an inspiring founder story and is a customer-focused, culture-first organisation. You’ll be joining a team that champions curiosity and a pioneering perspective, and thrives in a fast-moving sector.

Just some of Zepto’s commitments to our people include:

  • Join a Talented Team: Work with world-class talent and leaders who support career growth
  • Flexible Work: A remote-first work culture, with the opportunity to work anywhere in Australia. You’ll also get access to premium co-working spaces and a Byron, Sydney & Melbourne Hub
  • Paid Parental Leave: 12 weeks Paid Parental Leave for primary caregivers and 4 weeks for secondary caregivers
  • Wellbeing Focus: Access to Zepto’s Wellbeing Menu, which includes 3 x paid Wellbeing Days per year and access to an Employee Assistance Program
  • Annual Learning Budget: An individual learning budget, and 4 x paid Growth & Impact Days annually to focus on professional development
  • Remote-Work Support: A $500 Remote Work Budget to set up your home office upon commencement, and $300 annually from your 2nd Zeptoversary

Senior Frontend Engineer

Invaluable, an LSI Company, is one of the world’s largest online live auction marketplaces for antiques, fine art and collectibles. Our industry-leading live online bidding platform lets customers participate in premier auctions in real time—from their home, office, or mobile device.

Role Summary

As a Senior Frontend Engineer, you’ll build and maintain customer-facing experiences that power live online auctions. You’ll deliver new features, improve performance and reliability, reduce technical debt, and help shape frontend standards and long-term strategy. You’ll collaborate closely with product, design, and engineering partners while mentoring teammates and raising the bar through thoughtful engineering practices.
We’re an AI-forward engineering team. You’ll use AI tools (Claude and Claude Code are our toolset of choice) as an everyday force multiplier, multiplying what you can deliver while staying fully accountable for the quality, security, and maintainability of everything you ship. We use AI under a clear company AI policy: vetted, approved tools with strong data protections, careful handling of customer and confidential data, and the expectation that engineers review AI output as carefully as a junior colleague’s work before it carries their name.
Our Tech Stack: Node/Express, Handlebars, React, Redux, Backbone.js, jQuery, Bootstrap 3/4, Figma, Jest, Cypress, Claude / Claude Code.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and ship features end-to-end across any tier of the Invaluable platform, from implementation through testing and deployment.
  • Improve quality and maintainability by refactoring legacy areas (Backbone, Handlebars/jQuery) and reducing technical debt with pragmatic, incremental changes.
  • Own reliability and performance: diagnose production issues, squash bugs, and improve UX with measurable outcomes.
  • Drive frontend architecture and standards: propose patterns, tooling, and conventions that improve developer experience and long-term maintainability.
  • Build with AI as a teammate: Use AI tools (Claude Code preferred) to plan, build, test, debug, review, and document your work. Treat AI the way you’d treat a capable junior colleague: hand it real work, review what it produces, and ship only what you’d put your name on. Our AI policy gives you approved tools and clear data-handling rules, so you can use AI on day one without second-guessing what’s allowed.
  • Raise the team’s AI fluency: share effective workflows, build reusable context (project instruction files, prompts, skills, MCP integrations), and help teammates adopt AI-assisted practices safely and effectively.
  • Collaborate effectively through pairing, code reviews, and shared problem-solving, including communicating clearly across time zones.
  • Mentor and support engineers by sharing best practices, offering feedback, and helping others grow through guidance and technical leadership.
  • Partner with Product and Design to clarify requirements, scope of work, identify tradeoffs, and deliver high-quality user experiences.
  • Champion inclusive teamwork by actively engaging with colleagues while maintaining space for others to contribute.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 5–7+ years of professional frontend engineering experience (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Strong proficiency with JavaScript and modern frontend development practices.
  • Significant experience with React (and ideally Redux) in production.
  • Experience working in Node/Express environments (e.g., local tooling, server-rendered integrations, API coordination).
  • Comfort working in and improving legacy codebases (e.g., Backbone, Handlebars, jQuery) with an ability to modernize safely over time.
  • Strong testing discipline: experience writing and maintaining React Testing Library unit tests and Cypress end-to-end tests; values meaningful coverage.
  • Hands-on, daily use of AI coding tools (Claude / Claude Code preferred, or comparable tools) across the development lifecycle, with a practical understanding of how LLMs work—context, prompting, and limitations such as hallucination—and disciplined verification of AI-generated code.
  • Sound data-handling judgment when using AI: keeps credentials, customer data, and personal information out of prompts and works within approved tools and company policy.
  • Strong technical judgment: able to propose solutions, explain tradeoffs, and make pragmatic decisions for long-term project health, including knowing when and how to apply AI and when not to.
  • Collaborative and kind: enjoying pairing, code reviews, and knowledge sharing; open to learning and teaching.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with ecommerce or marketplace products (or adjacent high-traffic consumer experiences).
  • Familiarity with UI systems and design collaboration workflows (e.g., Figma, design systems, accessibility).
  • Experience improving front-end performance and observability in production.

  • A track record of measurable productivity or quality gains from AI adoption, for yourself or your team (e.g., faster delivery, expanded scope, improved test coverage).

Our power is at the intersection of Connections, Creative and Commerce – that’s what is in our DNA. By harvesting insights and utilizing audience data, we work with our clients to develop scroll-stopping content and creative that performs and elevates the brands we work with across all digital media platforms.

Our people are energized by challenges and sprint to find unorthodox solutions. We plan, activate and measure as one team, and we’re not afraid to push boundaries and test our way to success. Coders are Relentless, Gritty, Nimble humans who are always striving to be better.

With teams across the U.S., you’ll find more than a job at Code3. You’ll find a place to grow, make an impact, and do your best work alongside a team that’s invested in your success.

The Opportunity

The Paid Social Specialist supports the execution, optimization, and reporting of paid social campaigns for some of the world's most recognized luxury, fashion, and beauty brands. Working closely with strategists and senior team members, this person plays an important role in bringing media strategies to life across platforms including Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, Snapchat, and YouTube, ensuring campaigns are launched accurately, budgets are managed responsibly, and performance insights inform ongoing optimization.

We're looking for someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, and passionate about delivering exceptional work. Someone who takes ownership of their responsibilities, can effectively manage multiple priorities and deadlines, and approaches challenges with curiosity, resourcefulness, and a continuous improvement mindset.

Success in this role requires strong attention to detail, effective communication, and a collaborative approach. This person will be part of a supportive, high-performing team that values accountability, knowledge sharing, and professional growth.

What you’ll do:

  • Build, launch, and optimize paid social campaigns across major platforms including Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, Snapchat, and YouTube, ensuring accurate setup, targeting, creative implementation, and tracking.
  • Monitor campaign performance and budget pacing, implementing optimizations and proactively identifying opportunities or potential issues in collaboration with senior team members.
  • Perform thorough quality assurance across campaign builds, creative assets, tracking, and reporting to maintain a high standard of accuracy and execution.
  • Support weekly, monthly, and ad hoc reporting by pulling data, analyzing performance trends, and contributing insights and recommendations that help inform campaign strategy.
  • Collaborate with strategists and cross-functional partners on campaign planning, creative testing, and ongoing optimization initiatives, while participating in client meetings and communicating executional updates as appropriate.
  • Stay informed about paid social platform developments, emerging trends, and industry best practices, proactively seeking opportunities to expand knowledge and strengthen technical skills.

Who will love this role:

  • A highly organized, detail-oriented individual who takes pride in accuracy and can effectively manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines.
  • A curious, analytical problem-solver who enjoys working with data, asking thoughtful questions, and identifying opportunities for improvement.
  • A proactive, collaborative teammate who communicates clearly, takes initiative, and enjoys contributing to a supportive, high-performing team.
  • Someone with a genuine interest in social media, luxury, fashion, and beauty, and an understanding of how creative content and consumer trends influence brand engagement.
  • A motivated, growth-oriented professional who welcomes feedback, embraces new challenges, and is committed to continuously developing their paid social expertise.

You should have:

  • 1+ years of professional experience in marketing, advertising, social media, or a related field; previous hands-on paid social experience is a plus.
  • Familiarity with major social media platforms including Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, Snapchat, and YouTube, with an interest in developing paid advertising expertise.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and strong organizational skills, with demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, maintain accuracy, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and/or Google Sheets, including data organization, basic analysis, and reporting.
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and communicate observations clearly.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively, communicate professionally, and proactively seek clarification when needed.
  • A self-motivated approach to learning, openness to feedback, and the ability to take ownership of assigned responsibilities.
  • Previous experience with paid social advertising platforms and relevant certifications (Meta Blueprint, TikTok Media Buying, Google Analytics, etc.) are preferred but not required.

The base salary range will be determined based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location. Certain positions may also be eligible for a bonus, with eligibility and details discussed during the recruitment process. For candidates that are based in California, we encourage you to review this important information for California residents here. For best results, open the link in a new tab.

$65,000—$70,000 USD

Working at Code3

At Code3, we believe great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and empowered to do their best. We’re proud to offer a competitive rewards package, meaningful opportunities for growth, and a culture that’s collaborative, inclusive, and—most importantly—human.

Here’s what you can expect as a Coder:

GrowthLoop is hiring an Enterprise Account Executive to win new business with some of the world’s largest brands. You’ll own a focused set of named accounts with more than $1B in annual revenue, build your own pipeline, and lead complex deals from first conversation to close. You’ll help marketing and data leaders make a clear business case for using agentic AI with the data in their cloud warehouse.

What You Will Do

  • Own your named-account strategy and full sales cycle, using MEDDPICC to qualify opportunities and consistently meet or exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets.
  • Self-source at least half of your pipeline through outbound prospecting and strategic networking, complementing inbound leads and the work of our marketing and partnerships teams.
  • Build a clear point of view on compound marketing with agentic AI. Connect each prospect’s marketing goals and business challenges to GrowthLoop’s value, and lead contract negotiations that align solutions and services with their needs.
  • Build account plans with data warehouse partners. Work across executive, Data, Operations, Marketing, and AdTech stakeholders to move complex enterprise deals forward.
  • Sell as a team with marketing, product, sales engineering, and customer solutions. Partner with the Customer team to identify expansion opportunities and make GrowthLoop a core part of each customer’s marketing strategy.

What You Bring

  • You bring 5–7+ years of experience selling complex SaaS marketing technology to large organizations, with a track record of closing multiple $300k–$1M ARR opportunities, including seven-figure deals with Global 2000 brands.
  • You’ve won new logos, built your own pipeline, and sold effectively with global partners. You can navigate complex business, technical, and partnership conversations rather than relying primarily on existing customer relationships.
  • You can engage C-suite executives, build a compelling business case, and tailor presentations to technical and non-technical audiences. You listen closely and align your approach with customer planning and budgeting cycles.
  • You understand the marketing and data technology ecosystem, including Customer Data Platforms and data products, and want to become an expert in GrowthLoop’s role in marketing architecture. You stay current on industry shifts and competitors and bring an informed point of view to customer conversations.

About GrowthLoop

GrowthLoop built the first composable CDP, helping marketers leverage live, first-party data from their cloud warehouse to launch highly targeted campaigns.
