jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.excerpt: At Trella Health, our mission is simple: empowering meaningful change in healthcare.
jobs.description:
At Trella Health, our mission is simple: empowering meaningful change in healthcare.

We are building AI-enabled intelligence and workflows that help healthcare organizations make smarter decisions, strengthen operations, and support healthier outcomes for patients. Our platform connects health systems and post-acute providers through actionable intelligence and connected workflows that improve how care is coordinated across the healthcare continuum.

That work starts with our people. Trellavators are collaborative, curious, and committed to doing meaningful work that makes a measurable impact. We move quickly, support each other, keep our commitments, and continuously look for better ways to serve our customers and one another.

If you are excited by the opportunity to grow your career while helping shape the future of healthcare intelligence, workflows, and outcomes, we would love to meet you.

Position Overview:

We are looking for a highly motivated Enterprise Account Executive to help us grow revenue within the Home Medical Equipment (HME), Home Infusion, and Specialty Pharmacy markets. This is an exciting, net-new opportunity for someone with 3-5 years of mid-market or enterprise level experience to own the full sales cycle–from prospecting to driving deals to close and everything in between–in a sales territory with an approximate $1M annual quota. We are looking for someone who thrives in both independent and team environments, possesses outstanding communication skills, and is well versed in developing relationships with prospects of various backgrounds and personalities.

Location: This role is remote with a strong preference for candidates within commuting distance of Atlanta, GA or Philadelphia, PA. We will also consider applicants based in other U.S. locations.

Reports to: Director, Sales

As a Enterprise Account Executive at Trella, you will:

  • Manage a named account list to meet or exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual quota goals, win rates, and pipeline goals within the HME, Infusion, and Specialty Pharmacy markets
  • Create effective outbound prospecting strategies and conduct a high volume of lead generating activities to build your pipeline including cold calls, emails, and social touches
  • Strategize with BDR, Marketing, and Customer Success Teams to break into new accounts as well as expand within existing clients
  • Effectively qualify prospects by understanding their goals, plans, challenges, timeline, budget, and decision-making authority
  • Deliver quality and tailored demonstrations of our solutions to prospects based on the prospects needs and priorities
  • Be responsible for strategic selling by sourcing deals, negotiating pricing and contract terms, and driving deals to close
  • Collaborate with internal teams on customer handoff, training, and user adoption along with understanding potential product enhancements and assisting with sharing general market feedback
  • Use critical thinking skills to be able to work with clients on solutions, proof of concept, contracting, and strategic selling
  • Maintain up to date account information in Salesforce including opportunities, accounts, contacts, and accurate forecasts
  • Strive to continuously improve your sales process and demonstrate a willingness to learn and implement best practices
  • Build an in-depth understanding of Trella Health’s full portfolio, including our post-acute provider, health system, and Trella community and referral partner offerings, along with the evolving market and competitive landscape, to position Trella as a partner across the continuum of care
  • Stay focused on your HME, Infusion, and Specialty Pharmacy accounts while spotting cross-portfolio opportunities, such as shared referral relationships with health systems and post-acute providers, and partnering with peer teams to pursue them
  • Use AI tools to automate repeatable sales work such as account research, call prep, meeting summaries, follow-up emails, and CRM updates, so more of your time goes to customer conversations
  • Apply AI to analyze pipeline, call recordings, and market data to sharpen targeting, messaging, and forecast accuracy

This job might be a fit for you if you have:

  • Minimum of 3 years of mid-market or enterprise-level experience as a quota carrying sales representative
  • Demonstrated success with prospecting, pipeline creation, and qualifying leads
  • Familiarity with a software-as-a-service (SaaS) sales process within the healthcare industry is preferred, but not required
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools (for example ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, or conversation intelligence platforms like Gong) in your sales workflow, with specific examples of what you have automated or improved
  • Curiosity to test new tools, measure what works, and share what you learn with the team
  • A strong track record of prospecting leads, closing deals, and meeting quota objectives
  • Ability to navigate the strategic levels of customer organizations, identify key decision-makers, build relationships with senior executives and schedule meetings with key stakeholders at various levels within an organization
  • A competitive spirit and a drive to be the best in a fast-growing, start-up environment
  • A results-driven and highly motivated demeanor who is an independent and resourceful self-starter
  • Ability to establish strong team relationships and thrive in a highly collaborative environment
  • A strong sense of accountability to help drive productivity and revenue goals for the team and the company
  • Ability to travel for industry conferences and company events

About Trella Health

Trella Health is the AI-powered intelligence and workflow platform helping health systems and post-acute providers turn fragmented healthcare data into decisive action. We bring together market intelligence, referral workflows, patient discharge automation, and care coordination tools so healthcare organizations can make smarter decisions, strengthen business and clinical operations, and deliver high-quality, cost-efficient care.

Powered by billions of data points across claims, referrals, patient discharge, and clinical data, Trella Health gives customers the intelligence and workflows they need to understand their markets, build stronger referral relationships, coordinate patient care transitions, and grow with confidence.

Since launching our first product in 2016, Trella Health has continued to grow our team, our platform, and our impact across healthcare. Today, we support more than 17,000 customers, including leading post-acute providers and health systems, and more than 63,000 users across the care continuum.

Trella Health is headquartered in Atlanta, with a growing presence in Philadelphia and team members located across the country.

Join Us

At Trella Health, you will have the opportunity to do meaningful work with people who are focused on outcomes, committed to continuous improvement, and supportive of one another. We believe great work happens when team members feel trusted, connected, and empowered to grow.

Our culture is built on transparency, accountability, partnership, and the belief that better healthcare starts with better decisions. Trellavators work hard, move fast, celebrate wins, and have fun along the way.

We offer competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support team members inside and outside of work, including:

  • Health, dental, vision, and voluntary benefits
  • Competitive salary, incentive compensation, and equity shares
  • 401(k) retirement savings
  • Flexible PTO and 10 paid holidays
  • Flexible work hours
  • Paid leave programs
  • Marketplace for discounted retail and entertainment

At Trella Health, you can grow your career while helping build technology that strengthens healthcare operations, improves care coordination, and supports healthier outcomes for patients.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Trella Health is an equal opportunity employer. All persons will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin, marital status, age, disability, handicap, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected status as recognized by federal, state, or local laws.

Description

Remedio is transforming how organizations reduce cyber risk.

While most security tools focus on finding problems, Remedio focuses on fixing them.

Our Autonomous Remediation Platform helps enterprises continuously and safely reduce exposure by remediating vulnerabilities and misconfigurations, closing patching gaps, hardening systems, enforcing compliance, governing applications, and controlling AI risk.

By combining deep dependency awareness, pre-execution validation, automated remediation, and instant rollback, Remedio enables organizations to eliminate risk across endpoints, servers, applications, and AI systems-without disrupting business operations.

Founded in 2019, Remedio spent its first years as a bootstrapped, profitable company, building a strong enterprise customer base before raising a $65M Series A led by Bessemer Venture Partners.

Today, more than 300 enterprise organizations trust Remedio to protect over 3 million devices worldwide, including Amazon, Colgate-Palmolive, Kraft Heinz, Coca Cola Hellenic Bottling Company, and many more.

As we continue expanding our platform and growing our global business, we’re looking for exceptional people who want to take ownership, solve meaningful challenges, and help shape the next chapter of Remedio’s journey.

We are looking for a Channel Manager, with a growth mindset, to expand, engage and execute Remedio’s growing channel partner ecosystem.

Reporting directly to the VP of Channels, this role will focus on developing partner relationships, driving

partner-sourced pipeline, and supporting the execution of Remedio’s channel go-to-market strategy.

This is a highly collaborative and hands-on role for someone who understands how to build trusted relationships with cybersecurity partners, activate partner teams, and turn partner engagement into measurable business outcomes.

Joining Remedio means becoming part of a growing cybersecurity company at a pivotal stage, where you’ll have the opportunity to:

  • Help scale the company’s partner-led go-to-market motion
  • Work closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, Technical teams, and channel leadership
  • Build relationships with cybersecurity resellers, distributors, and ecosystem partners
  • Contribute directly to pipeline generation, revenue growth, and market expansion
  • Play a key role in shaping repeatable partner engagement and operational processes
  • We are looking for a relationship-driven channel professional who combines partner management experience, commercial discipline, and strong execution in a fast-moving startup environment.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and manage relationships with channel partners, including cybersecurity resellers, VARs, solution providers and systems integrators..
  • Support the execution of Remedio’s channel strategy, partner programs, and go-to-market initiatives.
  • Recruit, onboard, enable, and activate partners to ensure they understand Remedio’s value proposition, target customers, use cases, and proof-of-value process.
  • Work closely with partner sales and technical teams to generate pipeline, identify qualified opportunities, and accelerate active deals.
  • Coordinate joint account planning, partner campaigns, co-selling motions, and field engagement activities.
  • Support deal registration, partner pipeline tracking, and alignment between partners and Remedio’s sales organization.
  • Track partner engagement, pipeline activity, win rates, and performance metrics.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Product, Sales Engineering, and Technical teams to support partner success.
  • Participate in partner events, field activities, pipeline reviews, QBRs, and ecosystem development initiatives.
  • Share partner and field feedback internally to improve messaging, enablement, partner experience, and go-to-market execution.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of channel sales, partner management, alliances, or indirect sales experience in cybersecurity software.
  • Experience working with cybersecurity resellers, VARs, solution providers, or strategic partners.
  • Strong understanding of channel sales motions, partner ecosystems, co-selling, account mapping, deal registration, and pipeline development.
  • Experience supporting partner enablement, onboarding, training, and activation activities.
  • Proven ability to build trusted partner relationships and contribute to measurable partner-sourced or partner-influenced pipeline.
  • Cybersecurity industry experience, preferably in one or more of the following areas:
    • Vulnerability Management
    • Exposure Management
    • Patch Management / Remediation
    • Endpoint Security
    • Security Operations
  • Experience working in startup or high-growth technology environments.
  • Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple partner relationships and priorities simultaneously.
  • Metrics-driven mindset with the ability to track, report, and improve partner performance and pipeline contribution.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with internal sales, marketing, product, and technical stakeholders.
  • Willingness to travel for partner meetings, customer meetings, events, and field activities as needed.


    • What Success Looks Like:

    In your first 12 months, you will:

    • Successfully onboard and activate channel partners.
    • Build strong working relationships across resellers in your territory.
    • Contribute measurable partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline.
    • Support the successful rollout and execution of Remedio’s channel program.

jobs.title: OpenStack Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.excerpt: Über uns:Als Vorreiter für nachhaltige Green-IT-Cloud-Computing-Lösungen setzen wir unseren Fokus auf digitale Souveränität, Sicherheit nach europäischen Standards sowie Unabhängigkeit und Flexibilität durch den Einsatz von Open-Source-Technologien.
jobs.description:
Über uns:

Als Vorreiter für nachhaltige Green-IT-Cloud-Computing-Lösungen setzen wir unseren Fokus auf digitale Souveränität, Sicherheit nach europäischen Standards sowie Unabhängigkeit und Flexibilität durch den Einsatz von Open-Source-Technologien.

Open Source ist unsere DNA:Wir engagieren uns aktiv in Open-Source-Verbänden, Netzwerken und Kooperationen, um offene Standards mitzugestalten und die digitale Souveränität Europas mit innovativen IT-Lösungen zu fördern. Unsere Mission ist es, Unternehmen jeder Größe gemeinsam mit unserem Partnerökosystem dabei zu unterstützen, ihre digitale Transformation zu beschleunigen und ihre Geschäftsziele durch den Einsatz nachhaltiger Cloud-Technologien zu erreichen.

Start-up-Spirit trifft Konzern-Power: Yorizon ist eine Tochtergesellschaft von HOCHTIEF. HOCHTIEF ist ein technisch ausgerichteter, globaler Infrastrukturkonzern mit führenden Positionen in seinen Kernaktivitäten Bau, Dienstleistungen und Konzessionen/Public-Private-Partnerships (PPP) und mit Tätigkeitsschwerpunkten in Australien, Nordamerika und Europa. So verbinden wir agilen Pioniergeist und flache Hierarchien mit der Stabilität eines internationalen Konzerns.

Dein Wirkungsbereich:

Als Teil unseres DC.Ops-Teams berichtest Du an den Lead Plattform Architekten und verantwortest das, was unsere Cloud im Kern ausmacht: die OpenStack-Plattform. Sie läuft auf unserer eigenen Hardware, in unseren eigenen Rechenzentren, mit Ceph als Storage-Backend – und sie entsteht gerade erst. Das heißt: keine gewachsene Landschaft, keine Altlasten, keine Entscheidungen, die vor Deiner Zeit getroffen wurden. Du prägst die Standards, mit denen wir jede weitere Region ausrollen.

Deine Rolle:

  • OpenStack verantworten:Du betreibst und entwickelst unsere Control Plane und Compute Nodes weiter – Nova, Neutron, Cinder, Glance, Keystone, Placement und die Services, die wir als Nächstes dazunehmen. Du kennst nicht nur die Komponenten, sondern auch ihr Zusammenspiel.
  • Deployment & Lifecycle: Du rollst OpenStack reproduzierbar aus und hältst es aktuell – Deployment-Tooling wie Kolla-Ansible, OpenStack-Ansible oder OSISM, saubere Upgrade-Pfade über Releases hinweg, Rolling Upgrades ohne Ausfall für Kund:innen.
  • Neutron & Netzwerk:Neutron mit OVN bzw. Open vSwitch, Provider- und Tenant-Netze, Floating IPs, Security Groups, Load Balancing mit Octavia – Du verstehst, welchen Weg ein Paket durch die Virtualisierung tatsächlich nimmt.
  • Compute & Scheduling: KVM/libvirt als Fundament, Flavor- und Aggregate-Design, Scheduler- und Placement-Verhalten, Live Migration, Overcommit-Strategien, Quotas und Multi-Tenancy – inklusive GPU-Passthrough für unsere AI-Workloads.
  • Storage-Integration:Du sorgst dafür, dass Ceph und OpenStack sauber zusammenspielen – RBD für Nova und Cinder, Images über Glance, Object Storage über RGW – und arbeitest eng mit unserem Ceph Engineer zusammen.
  • Debugging auf tiefer Ebene: Hängende Nova-Instanzen, RabbitMQ unter Last, Galera-Cluster mit Eigenleben, Neutron-Agents, die nicht mehr melden – Du gehst bis auf Log- und Kernel-Ebene und findest die Ursache statt des Symptoms.
  • Automatisierung als Standard:Ansible, Terraform/OpenTofu, GitOps mit Flux, CI/CD – was zweimal passiert, passiert bei uns automatisiert. Eigene Tools in Python oder Bash gehören dazu.
  • You built it – you run it: Mit ausgeprägter Hands-on-Mentalität begleitest Du neue Regionen von der Inbetriebnahme bis in den stabilen Betrieb – gemeinsam mit unseren Datacenter Engineers vor Ort.
  • Architektur & Wissen: Du prägst Architektur-, Design- und Integrationsentscheidungen, etablierst Standards und teilst Dein Wissen aktiv im Team – Runbooks, Troubleshooting-Guides, Pairing.

Das bringst du mit:

  • OpenStack in Produktion: Du hast OpenStack-Umgebungen produktiv betrieben, erweitert und durch Upgrades gebracht. Begriffe wie Nova, Neutron, Cinder, Keystone, Placement, Octavia oder Ironic sind für Dich Alltag, nicht Theorie – und Du weißt aus eigener Erfahrung, wo die Plattform im Betrieb wehtut.
  • Dein Fundament (Linux & Open Source):Tiefgehendes Linux-Know-how und ein starkes Verständnis für Datacenter-Infrastrukturen – Virtualisierung mit KVM/libvirt, Netzwerk und Storage. Du bist zu Hause auf der Kommandozeile, nicht im Dashboard.
  • Deployment-Tooling: Erfahrung mit mindestens einem Weg, OpenStack reproduzierbar auszurollen (z. B. Kolla-Ansible, OpenStack-Ansible, OSISM, TripleO oder eine eigene Ansible-basierte Lösung).
  • Storage-Verständnis:Du weißt, wie Ceph unter OpenStack arbeitet und was passiert, wenn Storage-Latenz plötzlich zum Compute-Problem wird.
    Moderne Plattformen & GitOps: Erfahrung mit Kubernetes und modernen Deployment-Paradigmen wie GitOps (idealerweise mit Flux).
  • Infrastruktur als Code: Automatisierung ist für Dich Standard – Ansible, Terraform/OpenTofu, CI/CD-Pipelines. Bash oder Python zum Bauen eigener Tools liegen Dir.
  • Analytischer Kopf: Du durchdringst komplexe, hochverfügbare, verteilte Systemlandschaften und findest auch bei kniffligen Problemen strukturierte Lösungen – auch dann, wenn Kundenworkloads betroffen sind.
  • Kommunikation: Du arbeitest gerne auf Augenhöhe, teilst Dein Wissen und kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch.

Nice to have:

  • Erfahrung im Umfeld des Sovereign Cloud Stack (SCS) oder in anderen souveränen Cloud-Projekten
  • Beiträge zur OpenStack-Community oder zu anderen Open-Source-Projekten – Code, Doku, Bug Reports, Vorträge
  • Bare-Metal-Provisioning mit Ironic oder vergleichbaren Ansätzen
    Erfahrung mit GPU-Workloads, Passthrough oder AI-Infrastruktur
  • Kenntnisse in Monitoring und Observability verteilter Systeme (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki)
  • Erfahrung mit Multi-Region- oder Multi-AZ-Architekturen

Unser Angebot

  • Teamspirit. Du wirst Teil eines dynamischen, wachsenden Teams mit echter Du-Kultur. Wir bieten dir den Freiraum, deine Talente aktiv einzubringen und die Zukunft des Unternehmens mitzugestalten.
  • Karrierechancen.Stillstand gibt es bei uns nicht. Nutze die vielfältigen Aufstiegschancen in einem expandierenden Umfeld und profitiere von unseren spannenden internationalen Perspektiven.
  • Remote first.Work-Life-Balance wird bei uns großgeschrieben. Ob 100 % remote aus Deutschland oder Österreich oder hybrid an unseren Standorten in Berlin, Augsburg oder Wien.
  • Deine Entwicklung. Wir investieren in dich. Mit einem eigenen Weiterbildungsbudget entscheidest du selbst, welche fachlichen oder persönlichen Skills du als Nächstes vertiefen möchtest.
  • Equipment.Damit du Bestleistungen bringen kannst, kriegst du das passende Werkzeug. Wähle bei deinem Equipment frei zwischen modernsten Apple- oder Windows-Geräten.
  • Purpose. Wenn du dich ehrenamtlich engagieren möchtest, unterstützen wir dich dabei, deinen Beitrag für die Gesellschaft zu leisten.

Bereit für die Herausforderung?

Brennst du dafür, eine OpenStack-Cloud von Grund auf neu aufzubauen – auf eigener Hardware, in eigenen Rechenzentren und mit einem Team, das gerade zusammenwächst? Dann werde Teil unserer Erfolgsgeschichte und bring deine Leidenschaft für moderne Infrastrukturen in unser Team ein. Wir sind gespannt auf deine Bewerbung!

Opportunity Type:

Summary:

A home is the foundation on which we build our lives. When families have access to safe, affordable housing, they gain the stability to pursue opportunity, improve health and well-being, and build stronger futures. Yet every day, millions of people around the world face the challenges that come with inadequate housing. Celebrating our 50th year, we at Habitat for Humanity are working to change that by expanding access to housing solutions and opening doors to opportunity worldwide.

Reporting to the Chief Development Officer (based in the US), the newly-created Vice President, Global Fundraising & Partnerships will lead Habitat for Humanity International's philanthropic revenue generation across all regions outside the United States. This is a transformational leadership opportunity for a visionary fundraising executive who can inspire donors, partners, and teams to help advance a world where everyone has a decent place to live.

As a member of the Resource Development Management Group, you'll shape Habitat's international fundraising strategy and lead a global team responsible for generating more than $150 million annually. Through strategic philanthropy, you'll help mobilize the resources needed to expand housing access, strengthen communities, and accelerate lasting impact around the world.

Key Responsibilities:


Official Business Title: Vice President, International Resource Development

Scope: All regions outside the U.S.

Travel: International travel of approximately 40-50%.

Location: This position may be based in a country where we are registered to do business, such as the UK, Slovakia, Kenya, Philippines, Costa Rica or the US. Importantly, this role must be generally available to support a variety of time zones, including the Asia/Pacific region.

Why This Role Matters

Habitat's work is grounded in a simple belief: housing matters. Safe, affordable homes create the foundation for stronger families, more resilient communities, and greater economic opportunity. As the Vice President, Global Fundraising & Partnerships, you will help build the partnerships and philanthropic investments that make this work possible at scale.

You will engage some of the world's leading corporations, foundations, institutions, and philanthropists to help open doors to housing solutions, mobilize resources for systemic change, and strengthen a global movement that has helped more than 65 million people access improved housing over the past 50 years.

What You'll Do

  • Develop and lead an international fundraising strategy that integrates corporate, individual, and institutional giving to drive sustainable revenue growth across all regions outside the U.S.
  • Cultivate, solicit, and steward major donors and partners, securing six-, seven-, and eight-figure commitments that advance Habitat's global mission.
  • Lead, mentor, and support a global team of 5-6 direct and 30 indirect reports, fostering operational excellence, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Build and strengthen high-level relationships with board members, international partners, government agencies, and senior leaders across the Habitat network.
  • Partner across program, finance, communications, and advocacy teams to deliver a unified "One Habitat" donor experience and compelling cases for support.
  • Serve as a strategic advisor to the Chief Development Officer and executive leadership on fundraising trends, opportunities, risks, and long-term revenue planning.

What You'll Bring

Requirements

  • Commitment to Habitat's mission on a global scale and genuine passion for advancing a world where everyone has a decent place to live.
  • Comfortable leading in an inclusive, Christian ministry.
  • Bachelor's degree.
  • 12+ years of progressive fundraising or business development leadership experience, including significant experience in complex international or multi-regional environments.
  • Deep knowledge of international philanthropy, corporate social responsibility, bi- and multi-lateral institutional funding, and global development.
  • Proven track record securing $1M-$10M+ gifts from corporations, foundations, and high-net-worth individuals.
  • Demonstrated success leading high-performing fundraising teams with operational excellence and strong performance management.
  • Experience navigating diverse cultures, geographies, and regulatory environments.
  • Strong strategic planning, change management, negotiation, budgeting, and forecasting skills.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to articulate a compelling global vision.
  • Collaborative leadership style with the ability to influence across a federated or networked organization.

Preferred

  • Fluency in one or more languages beyond English.
  • Experience working in international development, humanitarian aid, or global nonprofit organizations.
  • Experience with Blackbaud CRM or demonstrated ability to leverage systems to drive performance.
  • Experience working within a multinational, federated organization.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to help lead one of the world's most recognized housing organizations during a pivotal period of global impact.
  • A chance to build partnerships that open doors to safe, affordable housing for families around the world.
  • A collaborative, mission-driven culture focused on innovation, accountability, and lasting change.
  • The ability to contribute to a global movement dedicated to expanding housing access, affordability, and opportunity.

Habitat for Humanity, founded in 1976, is a global, Christian-based nonprofit organization that grew out of an intentionally multi-racial community in rural Georgia. Seeking to put God’s love into action, Habitat brings together people of all faiths and people of no faith to build homes, communities and hope. Working alongside each other, we help families and individuals build and improve places to call home and achieve the strength, stability and self-reliance they need to build better lives for themselves. Remote | Full-time | $260,000 - $320,000YOUR ROLEAs a Medical Monitoring Director at Enveda, you'll be a sponsor physician on our clinical trials: medical monitor on the studies you take on, the physician who oversees the consultant medical monitors on the rest, and, as trials move in house, the person who builds the in-house medical monitoring team.
jobs.description:
Let’s build the future of medicine - together.

Remote | Full-time | $260,000 - $320,000

YOUR ROLE

As a Medical Monitoring Director at Enveda, you'll be a sponsor physician on our clinical trials: medical monitor on the studies you take on, the physician who oversees the consultant medical monitors on the rest, and, as trials move in house, the person who builds the in-house medical monitoring team. You'll report to the SVP, Clinical Development, work day to day with the clinical leads, Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, and our in-house Pharmacovigilance team, and be the clinical owner of the AI tools our engineers build for blinded safety monitoring. The medical decisions on your studies are yours, and the consultant monitors work to plans you sign. This is a high impact opportunity where you'll influence the medical oversight of a three-program clinical pipeline while collaborating with some of the brightest minds in the industry.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Serve as the sponsor's medical monitor on your studies, blinded where the study is blinded: eligibility and protocol questions from sites, the sponsor's causality assessment on every serious adverse event, and the medical judgment calls the protocol asks of the sponsor's physician
  • Sit on the dose-escalation safety review committees for our Phase 1 studies and chair the internal blinded safety review for each study, presenting the sponsor's update in the open session of the independent data monitoring committee where a study has one
  • Write the medical monitoring plans, own the protocol's stopping rules, dose-modification rules, and safety monitoring schedule with each clinical lead, and contribute the medical content of investigator's brochures, safety update reports, and study reports
  • Do the medical review the data needs: protocol deviations, MedDRA and WHODrug coding, SAE reconciliation, and the listings before database lock
  • Set the standard for the consultant medical monitors: onboard them, define the plans and escalation paths they work to, review their decisions, and share the 24-hour medical monitor line with them
  • Be the clinical owner of the AI tools Enveda's engineers build for blinded safety monitoring: define what a medical monitor needs to see, set the flag rules, write the acceptance criteria, and sign off on each release. The tools work on blinded data only and flag and draft for you. Seriousness and causality are assessed by you, expectedness and reportability by Pharmacovigilance, which also holds the unblinding, and none of them by a tool
  • Train investigators and sites on safety reporting and eligibility, and keep the function inspection-ready with SOPs and a searchable record of medical decisions
  • Build the in-house medical monitoring team as trials move in house: define the roles, then hire and lead as the team is approved

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • MD or DO (or equivalent) who has completed residency training and practiced clinically. Board certification and an active medical license are preferred
  • 5 or more years in industry medical monitoring or drug safety, including hands-on medical monitoring of Phase 1 and Phase 2 studies, ideally in inflammatory, immunologic, dermatologic, gastrointestinal, or metabolic disease
  • Working knowledge of ICH E6(R3), E2A and E2F, US IND safety reporting, MedDRA coding review, and SAE reconciliation, and of the early-phase safety assessments an oral small molecule needs (liver safety, QT, stopping rules)
  • Experience overseeing CRO or consultant medical monitors and pharmacovigilance vendors, and with blinded safety review committees and independent data monitoring committees
  • Data-driven judgment: you turn adverse event, laboratory, vital sign, and ECG data into clear decisions, protect the blind, and know when a participant's safety comes first
  • AI-native or AI-curious: you can say what a tool should do for a medical monitor, how you would check its output, and what it must never decide
  • Ego-lite, hands-on, and patient-first: collaborative, direct, no task too big or small, and never losing sight of who the trial is for

We hire for trajectory, not just credentials. If you meet most of the above and care deeply about this problem, we want to hear from you.

ABOUT ENVEDA

We're a clinical-stage, AI-enabled biotech discovering medicines from nature four times faster than the industry standard. We recently raised $311M in a Series E, bringing total funding to over $845M, and doubled our valuation to $2B. We now have three oral medicines in the clinic, including our lead drug, ENV-294, in Phase 2 trials for eczema and asthma. Forbes named us one of America's Best Startup Employers, and Newsweek recognized us as a Top 100 Most Loved Workplace. We're still early, and most of the best work is ahead of us.

Benefits (Starting Day 1): Medical, dental, and vision covered at 90%, 401(k) with company match, flexible PTO and a company-wide weeklong recharge break, adoption assistance

Our Process: We move fast and respect your time. Typically: a recruiter screen → hiring manager conversation → work sample, technical interview, & culture interview.

Our Values: Curiosity | Agency | Journey | Charity | Unity

Enveda is protecting Job Seekers

We care deeply about creating a safe, respectful experience for every applicant, so we wanted to share a few guidelines to help you spot anything that doesn’t feel right.

  • You’ll always meet real Enveda team members through video or in-person conversations before receiving an offer.
  • All communication from us will come from an @enveda.com or @envedabio.com email address.
  • We’ll never ask you to purchase equipment, send money, or share sensitive banking details as part of any step in our recruiting process.

If something feels off or you’re unsure whether a message is truly from Enveda, please reach out at anytime at .

At Enveda, we’re building a place where everyone can do the best work of their life. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity in all its forms. Apply now and join a team committed to shaping the future of drug discovery.

About the position of the Care Management Specialist II


The Care Management Specialist II works independently performing intake of inpatient and outpatient service requests and provides information to external customers and medical professionals as related to medical services inquiries. This Specialist is responsible for managing all lines of business. In this role you will work independently and apply your understanding of a variety of complex lines of business (e.g. national accounts, self-insured, fully-insured) when responding to both providers and facilities regarding their clinical review questions and requests. The Care Management Specialist II requires a permanent weekend schedule. jobs.description:
You:The champion who turns belief in liberty into the resources to defend it. Every case PLF wins starts with someone who chose to fund the fight. You'll be that person's trusted partner. You'll get to know what drives our donors, show them the real impact of their giving, and invite them to make bold investments in freedom.

Them: Bureaucrats, city councils, mayors, governors, and federal agencies stripping Americans of their rights every day. There’s a lot of government overreach out there, and it’s backed by seemingly endless resources. But fortunately, like all lumbering giants, abusive government is most vulnerable when countered by individuals who act strategically and nimbly, take calculated risks, have each other’s backs, and are confident in and passionate for the cause—the very sort of swashbucklers we employ in spades here at PLF.

Us: We fight back. Pacific Legal Foundation is the nation’s first and most successful public interest law firm dedicated to vindicating individual liberty. PLF has an unmatched record in the United States Supreme Court, with 18 victories out of 21 litigated at the Court—including three victories last term. We also have nearly two hundred active cases across the nation.

We are a next-generation public interest law firm. That means we aren’t interested in doing the same thing as everyone else. We aspire to be the best player in a constantly changing game.

Here’s what you get to do in this role:

The Senior Donor Relations Officer is responsible for developing and managing a portfolio of high-capacity current and prospective major gift donors, with responsibility for the identification, qualification, cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship of significant philanthropic relationships supporting Pacific Legal Foundation’s mission and strategic priorities.

The Senior Donor Relations Officer will develop and execute sophisticated donor strategies, build meaningful long-term relationships with donors and prospects, and secure significant new, renewed, and increased philanthropic commitments.

The successful candidate will be an accomplished frontline fundraiser with exceptional relationship-building and communication skills, strong fundraising judgment, and a demonstrated record of closing significant major gifts. The position requires a highly organized, persistent, disciplined, and self-directed professional who can operate with substantial independence while collaborating effectively with PLF leadership, attorneys, and Development colleagues.

Getting down to brass tacks, your specific job duties likely will include:

  • Managing a portfolio of approximately 100 high-capacity major gift donors and prospects and achieve established fundraising, engagement, and solicitation goals.
  • Developing and executing individualized strategies for donor qualification, cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship.
  • Personally soliciting and securing significant new, renewed, and increased gifts, including six-figure and seven-figure commitments.
  • Building trusted, long-term donor relationships by understanding donors’ interests, motivations, and philanthropic priorities and serving as their primary PLF relationship manager.
  • Creating meaningful donor engagement and stewardship opportunities that demonstrate the impact of philanthropy and connect donors to PLF’s litigation, policy, and strategic priorities.
  • Strategically engaging PLF executives, attorneys, trustees, and other organizational leaders in donor cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship.
  • Identifying and advancing new major gift prospects and recognize opportunities for multi-year, planned, blended, campaign, and other complex gifts in collaboration with Development colleagues.
  • Maintaininga disciplined portfolio and moves management, including donor strategies, next steps, solicitation plans, revenue projections, contact reports, and accurate CRM records.
  • Contributing to Development team strategy and serve as a resource to colleagues on complex donor relationships and major gift opportunities.

The ideal candidate will have:

  • 8+ years of professional fundraising experience, including substantial frontline major gift experience.
  • A demonstrated record of personally cultivating, soliciting, and closing significant major gifts, preferably including six and seven figure commitments.
  • Exceptional interpersonal, listening, verbal, and written communication skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships and communicate complex ideas clearly and compellingly.
  • Strong strategic judgment, initiative, organization, and personal accountability, with the ability to operate independently in a results-oriented environment.
  • Proficiency with fundraising CRM systems and disciplined portfolio and moves management practices.
  • A willingness to travel up to 50% throughout the United States, with a heavy focus throughout California, to meet with donors and prospects.
  • A sincere appreciation for PLF’s mission

Preferred experience. Previous experience with a pro-liberty organization, legal advocacy organization, public policy organization, or similar mission-driven institution is a plus. Experience with Salesforce or a comparable fundraising CRM is also preferred.

General information:

Pacific Legal Foundation identifies and litigates important legal issues to set landmark precedents that will benefit Americans nationwide. Using strategic and principled litigation, communications, and research, we battle for freedom in the nation’s courts and the court of public opinion.

As a national nonprofit organization, PLF has brick-and-mortar offices in Sacramento, California and Arlington, Virginia, although approximately half of the staff work from home offices across the country. You may work from any of our offices or request to work remotely, although strong preference will be given to California-based candidates.

Salary range and benefits:

This is a full-time, permanent position. PLF is committed to recruiting and retaining the highest-quality talent available nationwide, and we offer a total compensation package that includes a competitive salary, medical and dental insurance, and employer-paid retirement savings. We take work-life balance seriously through our generous paid leave and flextime policies. To learn more about the starting salary range and benefits options, please apply.

How to apply:

Qualified candidates should submit the following application materials:

  • Résumé
  • Cover letter detailing the candidate’s sincere interest in Pacific Legal Foundation, its mission, and the Senior Donor Relations Officer position

At Morgan & Morgan, the work we do matters. For millions of Americans, we’re their last line of defense against insurance companies, large corporations or defective goods. Our over 6,000 employees are all united by one mission: For the People.

Forward Deployed Engineer

Remote, United States

About the Role

We're hiring Forward Deployed Engineers who are passionate about building high-quality software and putting AI to work where it makes the biggest difference. In this role, you'll work directly with our business teams, such as call center reps, case managers and attorneys, to find problems worth solving and ship solutions that move a measurable business result. You'll build AI agents and full-stack applications on AWS and MX2, our in-house AI platform, which more than 5,000 people across the firm use every month.

This is a hands-on engineering role on smaller teams tasked with solving one problem at a time. You'll own each solution from the first conversation to the measured result, then hand it to a permanent owner and take on the next problem. There is one title for this role, with no junior or senior levels: we care most about the business impact you deliver and how well you use AI to get there, not about years of experience alone.

Responsibilities

  • Embed with the business: Spend time with the teams doing the work to understand how it gets done and where it gets stuck
  • Pick the right problem: Agree with business owners on one measurable problem, take a baseline before building, and define how success will be measured
  • Lead by example: Design and implement reliable systems across the backend, frontend, and cloud infrastructure on AWS
  • Build with AI: Build AI agents and workflows for areas such as our call center and client intake across chat, text and voice, the early steps of litigation, practice areas beyond personal injury, and new AI products the firm is building
  • Elevate code quality: Champion test-driven development, code hygiene, and clean architecture
  • Build for trust: Test and evaluate AI output, design human review where it matters, and protect client data under HIPAA and firm policy
  • Move fast, build right-sized: Ship working solutions quickly and improve them in production, with the reliability and observability the problem actually needs rather than over-engineering up front
  • Measure the result: Report the business outcome, not just the feature shipped
  • Champion documentation and handoff: Author technical design documents and transfer what you build cleanly to a permanent product or engineering owner
  • Cross-functional alignment: Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders to keep every solution aligned with the MX2 roadmap

Requirements

  • Typically 5+ years of professional software development experience, though we weigh shipped impact and AI fluency over tenure
  • Strong in at least one modern programming language, and comfortable working across the full stack

  • Hands-on experience building with large language models in production, such as Anthropic Claude or OpenAI models, including prompting, tool use, retrieval, AI agent workflows and evaluation
  • Production experience with AWS and modern cloud-native architectures
  • Demonstrated expertise in software testing, quality assurance, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Comfort turning a loosely defined business problem into a scoped build without a detailed spec
  • Exceptional communication skills, including explaining technical tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders in plain language

Nice to Have

  • Experience as a forward deployed, solutions or field engineer, or in another customer-facing engineering role
  • Voice AI or contact center technology, such as speech-to-text, telephony and real-time conversation
  • Amazon Bedrock, Bedrock AgentCore or similar AI agent platforms
  • Salesforce or Litify experience
  • Experience in legal, healthcare or another regulated industry

Why Join Us

  • Be part of a fast-growing engineering team within a stable, established company
  • Build AI that people across America's largest injury law firm use every day
  • Opportunities for career advancement, ownership, and professional development
  • Get recognized for the impact you deliver, and see the difference your work makes in the business
  • Work with passionate engineers who value thoughtful design, high-quality code, and continuous improvement

This role is remote within the United States, with occasional travel to our offices and business teams.

jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in Canada EST.

About Product Management:

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own your product’s roadmap, collateral, and market research, and you will collaborate with Grafana leadership on fine-tuning your product’s goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential.

Product Managers are the bridge that connect Engineering, Design, and UX to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers.

The opportunity:

As the Product Manager for Application Observability (App O11y), you’ll be responsible for helping application developers and SREs understand how their applications are performing, what’s affecting their users, and where to focus when something goes wrong. You’ll continue to build App O11y on top of the Knowledge Graph and fully integrate high-fidelity signals like traces and profiles, making all three first-class parts of the product experience. You’ll bring these capabilities together into our full-stack observability experience, alongside our Drilldown products, while building AI-first workflows that help customers investigate issues, understand root cause, and take action beyond static experiences.

Your primary responsibility will be to define the vision and roadmap that takes App O11y into its next wave of adoption and revenue growth. This will require heavy customer discovery, using product data to understand where users get stuck, and working with your engineering and design partners to turn those needs into clear priorities. You’ll balance new product opportunities with the depth, performance, and reliability customers need from tracing and profiling, while working across R&D to ensure App O11y is tightly woven into our broader Grafana Cloud suite.

You’ll also work closely with PMM and GTM to help customers understand the value of App O11y. This includes shaping pricing and packaging that make it easy to get started and grow with the product. You’ll regularly review customer feedback and usage data to understand what’s working and where people get stuck, and then be accountable for turning what you learn into stronger adoption and revenue growth.

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you will:

  • Transform ideas and feedback into a product vision and roadmap
  • Empathize with customer problems in order to collect user needs, requirements, and pain points
  • Curate and properly represent user feedback to Engineering, while providing evidence to support tradeoffs and priorities
  • Work closely with PMM to enable GTM on product differentiation, including creating and updating presentations, documentation, website content, datasheets, and whitepapers.
  • Use your deep product expertise to make decisions about our go-to-market strategies, pricing, packaging, licensing and tiering.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Transform ideas and feedback into a product vision and roadmap

  • Experience working with Engineering and Design teams to build delightful products and features with sound UX in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders

We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.

jobs.title: Product & Platform Lead
jobs.excerpt: Role OverviewThe Product & Platform Lead (PPL) exists to ensure Timber's marketplace mechanics—Option, Package, Launch/License/Resell—work for the people using them.
jobs.description:
Role Overview

The Product & Platform Lead (PPL) exists to ensure Timber's marketplace mechanics—Option, Package, Launch/License/Resell—work for the people using them. This role sits at the intersection of business model and product, translating how Timber creates value into clear, trusted features.

Role Classification

Founding Team Member — “Someone joining extremely early and owning a critical function, but not necessarily receiving co-founder-level ownership.”

Reporting Relationship

Reports to the Founder & CEO (Allan Meade), in close partnership with the Founding Full Stack Engineer, and Chief Operations Officer (COO).
Start Date: To be confirmed in writing between the parties via Offer Letter.

Responsibilities

The Product & Platform Lead owns the 0 to 1 development of the Timber platform, turning Timber's business model and marketplace vision into a focused, usable product that real users can adopt and rely on. The PPL leads the evolution of the platform, ensuring the experiences of creators, buyers, soft-circle investors, talent, and other participants work together to create a functioning platform.

Specific responsibilities include:

  • Own the end-to-end product vision and strategy for Timber's platform from concept through MVP and early validation

  • Translate Timber's Option → Package → Build model into intuitive platform experiences and workflows

  • Lead discovery with founders, operators, packagers, capital partners, buyers, and other participants to identify and validate real problems

  • Prioritize problems worth solving and distinguish meaningful user needs from surface requests

  • Develop and maintain the 0 to 1 product roadmap, balancing user needs, business objectives, technical feasibility, and resources

  • Rapidly prototype and test concepts through lightweight methods before significant engineering work

  • Define and lead the MVP, focusing the team on delivering meaningful early value

  • Partner with engineering to translate validated concepts into clear requirements and priorities

  • Prioritize the product backlog and make clear tradeoffs about what to build now, later, or not at all

  • Own the evolution of key Timber experiences (Marketplace, Packaging Workspace, Founder HQ, Talent Hub, Deal Log, Deal & Legal Glossary, and other platform functionality) as validated by discovery

  • Establish product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and success measures

  • Lead usability testing and early validation, using feedback to drive continuous improvement

  • Define and monitor product metrics related to activation, engagement, listings, marketplace activity, deal progression, conversion, and retention

  • Use early product data and qualitative feedback to assess MVP fit and guide iteration

  • Maintain a shared roadmap, backlog, and decision log for founder visibility

  • Conduct regular platform reviews to evaluate what works and what should change

  • Partner with the CEO to ensure product strategy aligns with Timber's broader business model

  • Balance product ambition with technical feasibility, architecture, and scalability with the Founding Full Stack Engineer

  • Collaborate with the Head of Design to deliver clear, cohesive platform experiences

  • Work with the CMGO to communicate major changes to users

  • Foster a culture of rapid experimentation, learning, iteration, and customer-driven decision making

Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience taking a product from 0 to 1, including turning an ambiguous idea into a working MVP used by real customers

  • Experience defining and prioritizing a product roadmap for a marketplace, platform, SaaS, or other multi-sided product

  • Strong understanding of the 0 to 1 product development process (discovery, validation, prototyping, MVP, launch, iteration)

  • Comfortable conducting hands-on user research and usability testing (interviews, workflow observation, prototype testing, qualitative feedback)

  • Ability to distinguish between user statements and underlying problems to be solved

  • Strong ability to translate complex business models into simple product experiences and workflows

  • Comfortable creating or working with wireframes, prototypes, user flows, and product requirements

  • Strong product judgment with pragmatic prioritization when resources are limited

  • Comfortable working in ambiguity and making decisions with imperfect information

  • Strong collaborator who can work closely with engineering, design, business, and leadership

  • Clear communication of product decisions and alignment across a small founding team

  • Data-informed with comfort defining metrics and using quantitative and qualitative feedback to guide decisions

  • Marketplace, startup, entrepreneurial, or early-stage product/platform experience is strongly preferred

  • Experience with products involving marketplaces, transactions, deal structures, licensing, investments, or multi-party workflows is a plus

  • Experience on a small founding team where the PPL is hands-on rather than solely managing a platform organization is a plus

What “Wins” Look Like for this role

Concrete markers that this role is succeeding at Timber's current stage:

  • A product roadmap the founding team agrees reflects Timber's real priorities

  • Clear, tested user flows for browsing listings, NDAs, options, packaging deals, and licenses/resells

  • Early user research validating (or correcting) assumptions about founders, operators, and buyers

  • Platform metrics (listings created, NDAs signed, options locked, deals packaged) tracked and reviewed regularly

  • A Deal & Legal Glossary and platform experience that makes Timber’s model understandable to first-time users

What Timber Needs From This Role

This is not primarily a product management role for an established platform. Timber needs a visionary-driven and ambitious Product & Platform Lead who can help take the company from 0 to 1.

The ideal person is willing to talk to users on Monday, sketch a new workflow on Tuesday, test a prototype on Wednesday, rethink the idea on Thursday, and sit with engineers on Friday to determine what can actually ship. They should be a builder, visionary, researcher, strategist, risk-taker, executor, and product operator who can turn ambiguity into clarity and clarity into a real, innovative product platform.

Expected Time Commitment

Hours as needed, reflecting Timber's current early development stage. There is no fixed weekly hour requirement; the PPL is expected to commit whatever time is reasonably needed to meet the responsibilities above. This commitment is expected to increase — potentially to full-time — as Timber reaches key funding or traction milestones.

Remote / Work Arrangement

Remote-first, with core collaboration hours coordinated with the CEO and founding team.

Communication Expectations

Weekly 1:1 with the CEO, participation in the founding-team leadership sync, and prompt (same-business-day) responsiveness on the Company's primary communication channel during agreed working hours.

Outside Activities

Hours-as-needed engagement; the PPL may hold other employment, consulting engagements, or business activities, provided they do not directly compete with Timber, do not create a conflict of interest, and do not interfere with the availability and responsiveness this role requires. Any potential conflict should be disclosed to, and approved in advance by, the CEO.

Startup Compensation Structure

  • Equity-only compensation during this fundraising round, with detailed equity terms to be set in the Offer Letter (including type of equity, vesting schedule, cliff, and any refresh considerations)

  • No cash salary as part of this round; compensation is aligned with equity ownership and future liquidity milestones

  • Any future compensation adjustments (e.g., salary, benefits) will be determined in subsequent fundraising rounds or upon milestone-based triggers, and will be documented in an updated Offer Letter or employment agreement

At-Will Relationship

This role is engaged on an at-will basis. Either the PPL or the Company may terminate the relationship at any time, with or without cause and with or without notice. Nothing in this document guarantees continued engagement for any specific period, notwithstanding the vesting schedule described above.

Confidentiality & IP Assignment

As a condition of this role, the PPL is required to execute Timber's Confidential Information and Invention Assignment Agreement (“CIIAA”) prior to or concurrent with starting work. Under the CIIAA, all inventions, work product, and intellectual property created in connection with Timber are assigned to the Company, and the Company's confidential information (including marketplace, listing, and deal data) is protected during and after the engagement.

jobs.description:
Smartbug Media est l'un des noms les plus respectés de l'écosystème HubSpot, et nous l'avons mérité.

Nous ne sommes pas arrivés ici par hasard. Smartbug s'est bâti une réputation à laquelle la plupart des agences ne peuvent qu'aspirer : Partenaire nord-américain de l'année HubSpot, une équipe de spécialistes entièrement à distance dont l'impact dépasse largement sa taille, et une clientèle qui ne se contente pas de faire appel à nous, mais qui reste avec nous. C'est de ce dernier point que nous sommes le plus fiers.

À distance par choix et stratégiques par nature, nous n'avons jamais cru que l'excellence exigeait un bureau d'angle ou une cafétéria de campus. Ce qu'elle exige, ce sont les bonnes personnes, profondément alignées sur les résultats, qui travaillent avec des clients qui leur font confiance pour livrer. C'est la culture que nous avons bâtie : une culture où l'expertise n'a pas de frontières, où les relations sont profondes et où le travail parle de lui-même.

Les résultats de nos clients sont notre obsession. Pas les indicateurs de vanité. Pas les rapports qui font simplement plaisir. Une croissance réelle et mesurable qui fait de nos clients des héros au sein de leur propre organisation. Quand Smartbug est à vos côtés, votre équipe gagne, et c'est exactement pour cette raison que nos clients reviennent.

Nous sommes en croissance, notre portefeuille de clients s'élargit et les relations que nous avons bâties n'ont jamais été aussi solides. Ce qu'il nous faut maintenant, c'est un leader qui comprend que le plus difficile dans ce métier, ce n'est pas de gagner des clients. C'est de s'intégrer si profondément à leur succès que partir n'est tout simplement pas une option. Si vous avez déjà bâti ce genre de fidélité, si vous savez ce qu'il faut pour transformer une bonne relation client en un partenariat qui dure dix ans, et si l'idée de concevoir cette fonction à grande échelle vous stimule, nous voulons vous rencontrer.

Smartbug Media is one of the most respected names in the HubSpot ecosystem — and we've earned it.

We didn't get here by accident. Smartbug has built a reputation that most agencies only aspire to: HubSpot North American Partner of the Year, a fully remote team of specialists who punch well above their weight, and a client base that doesn't just hire us — they stay with us. That last part is the one we're most proud of.

Remote by design and strategic by nature, we've never believed that great work requires a corner office or a campus cafeteria. What it requires is the right people, deeply aligned on outcomes, working with clients who trust them to deliver. That's the culture we've built — one where expertise travels, relationships run deep, and the work speaks for itself.

We're obsessed with client outcomes. Not vanity metrics. Not feel-good reports. Real, measurable growth that makes our clients look like heroes inside their own organizations. When Smartbug is in your corner, your team wins — and that's exactly why our clients keep coming back.

We're growing, our client portfolio is expanding, and the relationships we've built are stronger than ever. What we need next is a leader who understands that the hardest part of this business isn't winning clients — it's becoming so embedded in their success that leaving simply isn't an option. If you've built that kind of loyalty before, if you know what it takes to transform a good client relationship into a decade-long partnership, and if you're energized by the idea of architecting that function at scale — we want to meet you.

Le Stratège CRM relève du Directeur principal, Stratégie, et agit à titre d’architecte principal responsable de

la mise en œuvre d’implémentations HubSpot hautement complexes. Il s’agit d’un rôle très technique axé

sur l’intersection des opérations de revenus (RevOps), de l’architecture des systèmes HubSpot et des

intégrations natives. Vous représentez SmartBug et constituez la première impression de l’entreprise

auprès de nos clients, vous devez donc exceller dans l’établissement de relations et de liens de confiance

avec des clients de haut niveau.

Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous devez avoir d'excellentes habiletés de communications tant en français qu'en anglais afin de supporter nos clients au Canada et aux États-Unis, être un professionnel engagé, faisant preuve d’un engagement

indéfectible à offrir une expérience client exceptionnelle, notamment une communication client solide et

des résultats clients probants. Vous traduirez des exigences d’affaires complexes en flux de travail

techniques évolutifs et en intégrations natives qui favorisent une croissance mesurable des revenus.

En tant que Stratège CRM, votre rendement sera évalué en fonction des éléments suivants.

● La satisfaction de la clientèle (résultats, fidélisation, prix, avis, clients pouvant servir de référence)

● La croissance et la rentabilité de la clientèle

● Les taux de facturation effectifs des clients (TFE)

● L’atteinte des revenus hors périmètre

● L’établissement et l’atteinte d’objectifs clients SMART

● La livraison des stratégies dans les délais prévus

● Les taux d’utilisation individuels conformes aux objectifs de l’entreprise

RESPONSABILITÉS

● Diriger des projets d’implémentation HubSpot de grande envergure et hautement complexes, en assurant l’harmonisation avec les objectifs d’affaires stratégiques et tactiques.

● Repérer et recommander des services complémentaires pour élargir la portée des mandats; fournir l’évaluation de la portée, les soumissions et l’orientation pour la mise en œuvre.

● Se tenir informé des tendances de l’industrie et du positionnement concurrentiel de HubSpot afin de garder les stratégies clients à la fine pointe.

Implémentation et configuration HubSpot

● Traduire les stratégies des clients et internes en solutions HubSpot complètes appuyant le marketing, les ventes, le succès client et les flux de travail opérationnels.

● Assurer une configuration intermédiaire à avancée de HubSpot Marketing Hub, Sales Hub, Service Hub, Content Hub, Hub et HubSpot AI.

● Assumer la responsabilité de la stratégie et de la configuration des intégrations natives de HubSpot (p. ex. Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite), avec une expertise des règles de synchronisation, du mapping des champs et de la résolution des conflits.

● Optimisation du moteur de revenus : concevoir et mettre en œuvre le schéma de données, les objets personnalisés et le mappage des propriétés en fonction de la stratégie RevOps du client.

● Concevoir et optimiser les composantes du moteur de revenus, y compris la notation des prospects (lead scoring), l’attribution avancée et les séquences automatisées de transfert marketing-ventes-service.

● Concevoir des tableaux de bord RevOps complexes qui démontrent un rendement du capital investi (RCI) clair pour les parties prenantes.

● Gouvernance des données : mettre en œuvre les meilleures pratiques en matière de gouvernance des données, y compris la logique de déduplication et les normes d’hygiène, afin que HubSpot demeure une source unique et fiable de vérité.

● Implémentation de l'IA : Diriger des mandats de stratégie et d'implémentation de l'IA, notamment les audits de préparation AEO, les plans stratégiques IA ainsi que la conception, le déploiement et l'optimisation continue d'agents HubSpot AI

● Offrir de la formation aux clients et aux équipes internes sur l’utilisation efficace de leur instance HubSpot personnalisée; offrir un soutien continu et de l’aide au dépannage.

● Obtenir la certification HubSpot Trainer et contribuer à l’intégration des clients à la plateforme.

● Configurer des instances HubSpot à partir de zéro, y compris les objets personnalisés, le mappage des propriétés et le schéma de données, conformément aux exigences du client.

● Traduire les exigences d’affaires en configurations HubSpot évolutives qui soutiennent l’ensemble du cycle de vie du client.

● Cartographie des processus d’affaires : mener des analyses techniques afin de cartographier les processus « état actuel » par rapport à « état futur », en repérant les goulots d’étranglement techniques dans l’entonnoir de revenus.

Processus de livraison

● Surveiller et gérer les budgets et la portée des projets; suivre et les objectifs de taux de facturation effectif (TFE).

● Collaborer avec l’équipe interne de SmartBug afin d’assurer la livraison d’un travail de qualité aux clients.

● Créer et suivre des processus permettant d’obtenir des résultats et une qualité différenciés pour les clients.

COMPÉTENCES ET EXPÉRIENCE REQUISES

● Baccalauréat en marketing, en administration des affaires, en communications ou dans un domaine connexe.

● Expérience technique : un minimum de 5 années d’expérience dans la création de solutions complexes sur la plateforme HubSpot.

● Expérience avérée avec la suite logicielle HubSpot et une compréhension approfondie de l’écosystème HubSpot.

● Expertise RevOps : capacité avérée à concevoir des systèmes autour des processus générateurs de revenus (du prospect à l’encaissement, prévisions et attribution).

● Maîtrise des intégrations : compréhension approfondie de la façon dont HubSpot s’intègre nativement aux piles technologiques externes, et capacité à gérer des synchronisations de données complexes.

● Expertise en IA et en AEO : Expérience pratique du déploiement d'agents HubSpot AI en production et connaissance pratique de l'AEO, y compris la façon dont les moteurs d'IA sélectionnent et citent leurs sources

● Compréhension des technologies complémentaires que les clients peuvent utiliser au sein de l’écosystème HubSpot.

● Compétences analytiques : grande capacité à s’orienter dans des enjeux d’affaires complexes et à les traduire en solutions techniques automatisées.

● Compétences exceptionnelles en communication tant en français qu'en anglais, en présentation et en relations interpersonnelles.

● Grand sens de l’organisation, souci du détail et capacité à gérer plusieurs priorités à la fois.

● Capacité démontrée à assurer un haut niveau de satisfaction de la clientèle tout en respectant les valeurs de SmartBug.

● Grande intégrité, éthique de travail et professionnalisme; passion pour la réussite des clients.

● Expérience de travail à distance dans un rôle similaire fortement souhaitée.

● Certification HubSpot Trainer, ainsi que les certifications HubSpot Marketing Software, Sales Software, Service Hub et Revenue Operations.

QUALIFICATIONS SOUHAITÉES

● Certifications HubSpot (p. ex. HubSpot Solutions Architect, Revenue Operations ou Marketing Hub Implementation)

● Expérience de travail au sein d’une agence partenaire HubSpot

● Connaissance des projets de migration CRM, y compris le mappage des données et le transfert propre des données à partir de systèmes hérités​‌

The CRM Strategist reports to the Senior Director, Strategy, and serves as the lead architect responsible for delivering highly complex HubSpot implementations. This is a highly technical role focused on the intersection of Revenue Operations (RevOps), HubSpot systems architecture, and native integrations. You represent SmartBug and are the company's first impression with our clients, so you must excel at building relationships and trust with senior-level clients.

To succeed in this role, you must have excellent communication skills in both French and English to support our clients in Canada and the United States, and be a committed professional with an unwavering dedication to delivering an exceptional client experience, including strong client communication and proven client results. You will translate complex business requirements into scalable technical workflows and native integrations that drive measurable revenue growth.

As a CRM Strategist, your performance will be evaluated on the following:

  • Client satisfaction (results, retention, awards, reviews, clients references)
  • Client growth and profitability
  • Client effective billing rates (EBR)
  • Achievement of out-of-scope revenue
  • Setting and achieving SMART client goals
  • On-time delivery of strategies
  • Individual utilization rates in line with company targets

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead large-scale, highly complex HubSpot implementation projects, ensuring alignment with strategic and tactical business objectives.
  • Identify and recommend complementary services to expand engagement scope; provide scoping, proposals, and implementation guidance.
  • Stay informed on industry trends and HubSpot's competitive positioning to keep client strategies at the cutting edge.

HubSpot Implementation and Configuration

  • Translate client and internal strategies into comprehensive HubSpot solutions supporting marketing, sales, customer success, and operational workflows.
  • Perform intermediate to advanced configuration of HubSpot Marketing Hub, Sales Hub, Service Hub, Content Hub, and HubSpot AI, etc.
  • Own the strategy and configuration of HubSpot's native integrations (e.g., Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite), with expertise in sync rules, field mapping, and conflict resolution.
  • Revenue engine optimization: design and implement the data schema, custom objects, and property mapping based on the client's RevOps strategy.
  • Design and optimize revenue engine components, including lead scoring, advanced attribution, and automated marketing-to-sales-to-service handoff sequences.
  • Build complex RevOps dashboards that demonstrate clear return on investment (ROI) to stakeholders.
  • Data governance: implement data governance best practices, including deduplication logic and hygiene standards, so that HubSpot remains a single, reliable source of truth.
  • AI implementation: Lead AI strategy and implementation engagements, including AEO Readiness Audits, AI Strategy Playbooks, and the design, deployment, and ongoing optimization of HubSpot AI agents
  • Provide training to clients and internal teams on effectively using their customized HubSpot instance; offer ongoing support and troubleshooting assistance.
  • Obtain HubSpot Trainer certification and contribute to onboarding clients to the platform.
  • Configure HubSpot instances from scratch, including custom objects, property mapping, and data schema, according to client requirements.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable HubSpot configurations that support the entire customer lifecycle.
  • Business process mapping: conduct technical analyses to map "current state" versus "future state" processes, identifying technical bottlenecks in the revenue funnel.

Delivery Process

  • Monitor and manage project budgets and scope; track and meet effective billing rate (EBR) targets.
  • Collaborate with SmartBug's internal team to ensure delivery of quality work to clients.
  • Create and follow processes that achieve differentiated results and quality for clients.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, business administration, communications, or a related field.
  • Technical experience: a minimum of 5 years of experience building complex solutions on the HubSpot platform.
  • Proven experience with the HubSpot software suite and a deep understanding of the HubSpot ecosystem.
  • RevOps expertise: proven ability to design systems around revenue-generating processes (lead-to-cash, forecasting, and attribution).
  • Integration mastery: deep understanding of how HubSpot integrates natively with external tech stacks, and the ability to manage complex data syncs.
  • AI and AEO expertise: Hands-on experience deploying HubSpot AI agents in production, and a working knowledge of AEO, including how AI engines select and cite sources
  • Understanding of complementary technologies clients may use within the HubSpot ecosystem.
  • Analytical skills: strong ability to navigate complex business challenges and translate them into automated technical solutions.
  • Exceptional communication skills in both French and English, as well as strong presentation and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities at once.
  • Demonstrated ability to maintain a high level of client satisfaction while upholding SmartBug's values.
  • High integrity, work ethic, and professionalism; a passion for client success.
  • Experience working remotely in a similar role strongly preferred.
  • HubSpot Trainer certification, as well as HubSpot Marketing Software, Sales Software, Service Hub, and Revenue Operations certifications.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • HubSpot certifications (e.g., HubSpot Solutions Architect, Revenue Operations, or Marketing Hub Implementation)
  • Experience working at a HubSpot partner agency
  • Knowledge of CRM migration projects, including data mapping and clean data transfer from legacy systems

jobs.excerpt: Location: 100% Remote Employment: Full-time, long-term position Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement Salary: Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with the potential for substantial growth during the first few years About UsWe are a startup developing software products, web applications, AI-powered tools, integrations, and business automations across different projects.
