Location: 100% Remote

Employment: Full-time, long-term position

Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement

Salary: Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with the potential for substantial growth during the first few years

About UsWe are a startup developing software products, web applications, AI-powered tools, integrations, and business automations across different projects.

Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We work with external developers and specialists, and we need strong technical leadership to turn their contributions into reliable, maintainable software.

AI-assisted and agentic development are central to how we work. We want to move quickly, make sensible technical decisions, and build solutions that our team can understand, operate, and improve.

We are looking for an experienced engineer who wants to join at an early stage, take meaningful responsibility, and grow with the company.

Job DescriptionWe are seeking a Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer who can develop applications across frontend and backend, integrate AI capabilities, and manage the Linux infrastructure, databases, and deployment processes supporting them.

You should be comfortable taking a project from an initial business requirement through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation. You will work across different products and internal initiatives, helping us choose practical solutions and deliver them efficiently.

Alongside hands-on engineering, your responsibilities may include leading developers, mentoring less experienced colleagues, coordinating outsourced contributors, and reviewing externally delivered work. Previous team leadership and mentoring experience are therefore important.

This is an opportunity to help establish the engineering foundations of a growing startup and develop into a broader technical leadership position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain web applications across frontend and backend.
  • Build AI-powered features, integrations, internal tools, and business automations.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents effectively, with appropriate testing and human review.
  • Translate business requirements into clear implementation tasks and verifiable acceptance criteria.
  • Design APIs, business logic, authentication, authorization, and third-party integrations.
  • Manage database schemas, migrations, query performance, backups, and recovery procedures.
  • Administer Linux servers, including application services, permissions, updates, networking, and troubleshooting.
  • Build and maintain Docker environments, including container networking, persistent storage, configuration, and health checks.
  • Manage DNS records, domain routing, TLS certificates, and reverse proxies.
  • Maintain CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines, and appropriate build agents or runners.
  • Carry out deployments with migration checks, rollback procedures, and post-deployment verification.
  • Investigate production incidents and address their underlying causes.
  • Coordinate outsourced developers and specialists, clarify requirements, review deliverables, and manage technical dependencies.
  • Mentor developers through code reviews, practical demonstrations, and constructive feedback.
  • Keep implementation proportionate to the problem, controlling unnecessary complexity, infrastructure costs, and maintenance overhead.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production web applications.
  • Strong frontend development skills using a modern framework, JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Strong backend development experience, including secure APIs, integrations, validation, and error handling.
  • Practical experience integrating AI or LLM capabilities into software, including checking output quality, handling failures, and managing latency and usage costs.
  • Substantial hands-on experience with AI coding assistants or agentic development workflows, with examples of working results you independently verified.
  • Strong SQL and relational database experience, including migrations, indexing, performance analysis, and backup and recovery.
  • Hands-on Linux administration and Docker deployment experience.
  • A working understanding of DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, firewalls, ports, and reverse proxies.
  • Practical CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions and familiarity with Azure DevOps repositories, pipelines, and build agents.
  • Strong Git, pull-request, code-review, and release-management skills.
  • Previous experience leading a development team or coordinating technical delivery.
  • Proven mentoring experience and the ability to explain technical decisions clearly.
  • Experience working with outsourced developers, contractors, or distributed teams.
  • The ability to work independently, prioritize competing needs, and make sound decisions with a limited startup budget.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time role with increasing responsibility.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Building products or engineering processes in an early-stage startup.
  • Taking responsibility for several applications or services at the same time.
  • Evaluating outsourced work for correctness, security, maintainability, and operational readiness.
  • Developing AI agents, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, or reliable automation.
  • Operating PostgreSQL and multi-service Docker environments.
  • Establishing deployment standards, monitoring, incident procedures, and practical documentation.
  • Helping junior developers become more effective through structured mentoring.

Growth, Responsibility and CompensationJoining at this stage offers the opportunity to influence how we build software, organize delivery, and develop our engineering team.

Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed scope of responsibility. As your contribution and responsibilities grow alongside the business, we aim to provide substantial salary progression during the first few years.

For a strong contributor, the role can develop into positions such as Technical Lead, Engineering Lead, or Head of Engineering. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. Compensation expectations and progression milestones will be discussed openly during recruitment.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Direct involvement in technical decisions across multiple products and initiatives.
  • The opportunity to build, lead, and mentor a distributed engineering team.
  • Broad ownership across software, AI integration, infrastructure, and delivery.
  • Close collaboration with startup leadership.
  • The potential for significant career and compensation growth as the company develops.

Remote Working ArrangementOur remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to ApplyWe are looking to fill this core engineering role promptly. Applying early gives us the opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our technical direction from the beginning.

Please submit your CV and a short overview covering:

  • A production application you helped deliver and your own frontend and backend contributions.
  • An AI feature or agentic workflow you implemented and how you verified its results.
  • Your Linux, Docker, database, and deployment responsibilities.
  • A team you led or developers you mentored, including the outcomes.
  • Your experience coordinating outsourced development and reviewing external deliverables.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations, taking our startup stage into account.

Public portfolio links and GitHub repositories are welcome. Please do not share confidential customer information or credentials.

As their named technical point of contact, you will lead onboarding, configure data sources, and work directly with customers' IT and security teams to build a complete, accurate picture of their environment. When a customer needs something that the platform doesn't do yet, such as a new data source or a ServiceNow integration, you'll design the solution with them and work with our engineering team to deliver it.   • Run regular technical reviews on coverage, data health and open issues, and catch problems before the customer does.
  • Triage customer issues, resolve configuration problems directly, and give engineering complete diagnoses for product defects.
  • Support Fenix24's services and incident response teams with Argos99 data and environment context during any assigned customer incidents.
  • Bring customer feedback, recurring needs and onboarding friction back to product and engineering.

  • Demonstrated strong written and oral communication skills, including strong relationship building skills and leadership capabilities.
  • Ability to form relationships across all levels of the company while modeling Fenix24’s Culture and Values.

jobs.title: Infrastructure and Operations Principal Architect, ITD
jobs.excerpt: The Role – Overview Brookhaven National Laboratory is seeking a multidisciplinary technical leader to serve as the Infrastructure and Operations (I&O) Principal Architect within the Information Technology Division (ITD).
jobs.description:
The Role – Overview

Brookhaven National Laboratory is seeking a multidisciplinary technical leader to serve as the Infrastructure and Operations (I&O) Principal Architect within the Information Technology Division (ITD). Reporting to the ITD I&O department manager, this individual contributor provides technical leadership for the infrastructure and services that enable the Laboratory’s operations and scientific mission. The Principal Architect establishes standards and roadmaps, guides complex cross-functional initiatives, and advises IT and Laboratory leaders on architecture, risk, and technology investments.

The role spans networks, compute, storage, cloud, identity, endpoint platforms, monitoring, and service resilience in a hybrid on-premises and cloud environment. Drawing on hands-on experience operating production services, the Principal Architect helps shape strategic roadmaps, advances infrastructure-as-code practices, and raises engineering maturity across teams. As a member of the ITD Architect Council, the architect also helps set technical direction for major IT investments and standards.

The Principal Architect supports the Laboratory’s evolving AI initiatives by partnering with application, data, and AI teams to deliver secure, scalable, and reusable platform capabilities for traditional and AI-driven workloads. Success requires a collaborative problem-solver who can mentor architects and senior engineers, challenge existing approaches, and lead the transformation of the Laboratory’s infrastructure platforms over the next several years.

Success in this role requires someone who enjoys solving complex technical problems, mentoring architects and senior engineers, challenging existing approaches, and building platforms that enable others to be successful. We are looking for someone who wants to help transform where our current platforms go over the next several years, not simply maintain where they are today.


Organizational Overview

Brookhaven Lab's Information Technology Division's mission is to deliver safe, efficient operations that ensure the delivery of the Lab's research mission by:

  • Developing and deploying state-of-the-art information and computing systems in support of scientific research and business operations
  • Providing a reliable and secure, high-speed network infrastructure for scientific and business computing
  • Developing a scientific computing infrastructure that can support the computing needs common among the scientific departments
  • Providing support to scientific and administrative programs to help them address their unique computing challenges
  • Providing a cost-effective, highly reliable, secure, and standardized computing infrastructure
  • Promoting best practices in the areas of platform support, application development, and customer service
  • Providing cost-effective information services to the Brookhaven Lab community, including Research Library, publications, records management, and technical editing services, in support of the research mission and in compliance with contractual requirements

ITD includes experts in IT infrastructure and operations, cyber security, business systems, data information, and information services, including records management and the Research Library. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator who is resourceful and innovative, and who understands that collaboration with stakeholders from across the Laboratory is critical to ensure the right expertise and technology are in place to advance our mission of bringing science solutions to the world.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain infrastructure architectures, technical standards, reference designs, and multiyear roadmaps and serve on the ITD Architect Council.
  • Lead architectural planning for initiatives spanning multiple platforms, vendors, teams, or customer groups, addressing dependencies, integration, operational risks, and long-term support.
  • Evaluate current and emerging technologies for technical fit, cost, security, reliability, and operational impact; recommend investments and modernization priorities to senior leadership.
  • Advise on complex projects and unresolved infrastructure issues, working with engineers, cybersecurity, application teams, project leaders, and stakeholders to turn requirements into workable designs.
  • Review and approve solution architectures for major initiatives, guiding teams through tradeoffs, implementation plans, and exceptions to enterprise standards.
  • Guide improvements in capacity planning, performance, configuration management, observability, recoverability, and service resilience.
  • Lead technical vendor evaluations and assess proposals against laboratory requirements.
  • Produce architecture diagrams, decision records, standards, and strategic reports; communicate recommendations to technical staff, customers, and senior management.
  • Mentor I&O architects and promote sound engineering and architectural practices.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent combination of education, certifications, and relevant experience.
  • Experience: 10+ years of progressively increasing responsibility in infrastructure and operations, with demonstrated breadth across enterprise architecture, cloud, DevOps and automation, and Windows and Linux platform engineering.
  • Technical Expertise: Deep expertise in one or more infrastructure disciplines and broad working knowledge across multiple I&O technologies. Demonstrated experience designing or guiding complex infrastructure solutions with cross-platform dependencies and significant operational or implementation risk. Ability to independently define and analyze unfamiliar technical problems, evaluate alternatives, and make sound recommendations that account for technical and economic feasibility.
  • Problem Solving and Versatility: Technology-neutral and mission-oriented mindset with broad and deep experience in enterprise infrastructure, including networking, identity and access management (IAM), virtualization, cybersecurity, and systems integration. Experienced in hybrid-cloud and complex environments, with strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities. Proven ability to rapidly retool on emerging technologies. Curious, adaptable, and excited by emerging cloud and AI technologies. Strong business acumen with the ability to balance technical excellence, security, operational reliability, and cost optimization.
  • Communication: Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills with the ability to communicate technical concepts to engineers, architects, leadership, and business stakeholders. Trusted technical leader with the ability to influence executives, business leaders, architects, engineering teams, and strategic partners.
  • Mentorship and Team Development: Experience and comfort mentoring architects and senior engineers and serving as a technical leader to “raise the bar” within infrastructure engineering teams.
  • Applicants must submit both a resume and cover letter for consideration.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills

  • 15+ years of relevant experience.
  • Master’s degree is highly desired.
  • Experience supporting research, scientific computing, higher education, or Department of Energy environments.
  • Experience with FinOps practices, cloud cost governance, and subscription management.
  • Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2, or FedRAMP.

Other Information

  • This is a fully remote position with on-site presence available at Brookhaven National Laboratory in Upton, NY
  • Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position
  • Applicants must submit both a resume and cover letter for consideration.

Brookhaven National Laboratory is committed to providing fair, equitable and competitive compensation. This is a multi-level role and the full salary range for this position is $126000 - $222500 / year. You will be placed at the level and salary commensurate with your experience. Salary offers will be commensurate with the final candidate’s qualification, education and experience and considered with the internal peer group.


Brookhaven National Laboratory is committed to employee success and we believe that a comprehensive employee benefits program is an important and meaningful part of the compensation employees receive. Review more information at BNL | Benefits Program


Brookhaven National Laboratory requires all non-badged personnel including visitors to produce a REAL-ID or REAL-ID compliant documentation to access Brookhaven National Laboratory – view more information at . This is due to nationwide identification requirements for federal site access as required by the federal REAL ID Act. Those not in possession of a REAL ID-compliant document will not be permitted to access the site which includes access to the Laboratory for interviews.


As a U.S. Department of Energy laboratory, Brookhaven National Laboratory requires employees to obtain and maintain a DOE Uncleared Personal Identity Verification (UPIV) credential in accordance with Homeland Security Presidential Directive 12 (HSPD-12) requirements. The credentialing process is completed as part of onboarding and enables access to DOE facilities and information systems. As a condition of employment, the selected candidate must be able to obtain and maintain a UPIV credential. These requirements are established under DOE Order 206.2 Chg. 2, Identity, Credential, and Access Management (ICAM- Identity, Credential, and Access Management (ICAM)), and DOE Order 473.1A- Physical Protection Program- Physical Protection Program.


About Us

Brookhaven National Laboratory (www.bnl.gov) delivers discovery science and transformative technology to power and secure the nation’s future. Brookhaven Lab is a multidisciplinary laboratory with seven Nobel Prize-winning discoveries, 37 R&D 100 Awards, and more than 70 years of pioneering research. The Lab is primarily supported by the U.S. Department of Energy’s (DOE) Office of Science. Brookhaven Science Associates (BSA) operates and manages the Laboratory for DOE. BSA is a partnership between Battelle and The Research Foundation for the State University of New York on behalf of Stony Brook University. BSA salutes our veterans and active military members with careers that leverage the skills and unique experience they gained while serving our country, learn more at BNL | Opportunities for Veterans at Brookhaven National Laboratory.


Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer

Guided by our core values of integrity, responsibility, innovation, respect, and teamwork, Brookhaven Science Associates is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer-Vets/Disabled. We are committed to fostering a respectful and collaborative environment that fuels scientific discovery. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to any characteristic protected by law. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. *VEVRAA Federal Contractor


BSA employees are subject to restrictions related to participation in Foreign Government Talent Recruitment Programs, as defined and detailed in United States Department of Energy Order 486.1A. jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Senior Systems Engineer to join our tech team and help build the future of neuro-contextual advertising at global scale.

Who We Are

At Seedtag, our mission is to transform advertising by proving that effectiveness and user privacy can truly coexist.

As the leading Neuro-Contextual Advertising Company, we combine Artificial Intelligence, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, and neuroscience to understand not only what content is about, but how it makes people feel and what they intend to do next.

Our proprietary AI, Liz, enables brands to connect with audiences across the open web and Connected TV without cookies or user tracking. Founded in 2014 by two ex-Googlers, Seedtag has grown to 500+ Seedtaggers in 17 countries, backed by €250M in funding, and operates today as a global ad-tech leader.

If you enjoy solving complex engineering challenges and building AI-driven systems at scale, you’ll feel right at home here.

Your Challenge

As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will:

  • Collaborate with engineering teams at Seedtag to set direction and build platforms that enhance customer experience, while providing necessary operational support.

  • Contribute to the professional growth and performance optimization of the Platform Engineering (SRE) team by offering helpful feedback and guidance.

  • Foster and cultivate trust within the SRE team, empowering them to implement solid engineering practices and principles.

  • Ensure reliability, security and compliance of Seedtag's cloud foundations, aligned with the Google Cloud Architecture Framework and NIST/ISO controls (logging, vulnerability and secrets management, hardening, backup and restore).

  • Design, build and operate the internal developer platform (GKE, networking, IAM, CI/CD, GitOps) so product teams can ship autonomously under a "you build it, you run it" model.

  • Share knowledge, review peers' work and raise the bar on engineering practices in the team.

  • Take part in the Platform on-call rotation, lead incident response and write blameless postmortems, turning recurring issues into automation and lasting fixes.

  • Partner with engineering teams to understand their needs and communicate roadmap, trade-offs and progress transparently.

  • Operate and evolve our streaming and data infrastructure (Redpanda and self-hosted databases), including migrations, upgrades and the discontinuation of legacy components.

  • Own the observability stack (VictoriaMetrics, Grafana, alerting, PagerDuty), tackling scalability problems such as high-cardinality metrics, and define SLIs/SLOs and a service maturity model with engineering teams.

  • Drive cost efficiency (FinOps): capacity planning, node and instance right-sizing, quota management and cost anomaly detection.

  • Reduce toil and enable self-service: replace tickets with tools, golden paths and reusable CI/CD workflows, and keep documentation and runbooks fresh.

  • Apply AI to platform operations: build and operate agents and automations (e.g. cost anomaly detection, PR review, incident triage), define MCP integrations, and contribute to AI governance with Security.

Our Core Values

Outcome over Output
We measure success by impact and value, not by volume of features or lines of code.

Failure Is Allowed, Learning Is a Must
Experimentation is key to innovation. We test early, iterate often, and learn fast.

We Are All Scouts
We take ownership and leave things better than we found them.

We Are Data-Driven
Data informs our decisions and helps us continuously improve our systems and results.

Tech Stack

Our stack includes:

  • Languages & Automation: Python, Go

  • Cloud & Infrastructure: GCP, Kubernetes (GKE), Terraform, Terraform Cloud

  • CI/CD & GitOps: GitHub Actions, ArgoCD

  • Observability: VictoriaMetrics, Grafana, PagerDuty

  • Streaming & Data: Redpanda, Kafka, MongoDB, Redis

  • Security & Networking: IAM, VPC, Cloudflare, secrets management

  • AI & Automation: LLM-based agents, MCP integrations

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • Technical Experience: Minimum of 4 years of experience in SRE/DevOps/Platform/Cloud Engineering roles, preferably in large-scale, high-traffic product companies, with proven technical proficiency and the ability to engage in deep technical conversations with the team.

  • Collaboration and Prioritization: Service-oriented mindset: understands stakeholders' problems, communicates clearly and prioritizes across several concurrent projects in a fast-paced environment. Experience with Kanban or Scrum.

  • Automation and Programming: Strong scripting/programming skills (Python, Go or similar) to automate operations and build internal tooling (operators, agents, CI/CD workflows).

  • Cloud Services: Deep hands-on knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or an equivalent hyperscaler (VPC and peering/PSC, IAM, GKE, CloudSQL, GCS), including networking and migrations between projects or organizations.

  • Incident Management and On-call Responsibilities: Proven on-call and incident management experience, with strong problem-solving skills under pressure and a track record of root-cause analysis and blameless postmortems.

  • Kubernetes: Solid production experience with Kubernetes, ideally GKE: cluster lifecycle and upgrades, autoscaling and node pool tuning, and workload identity.

  • Infrastructure as Code and GitOps: Strong Terraform experience (Terraform Cloud a plus), GitOps (ArgoCD) and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, self-hosted runners).

  • Observability: Experience with Prometheus-compatible stacks (VictoriaMetrics, Grafana), alerting design and SLI/SLO practices. Understanding of cardinality and scaling issues is a plus.

  • Security: Working knowledge of cloud security practices: secrets management, vulnerability and CVE remediation, hardening and least privilege.

  • Other tools and engines: Streaming platforms (Kafka/Redpanda), or other stateful systems (MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch, Aerospike); Cloudflare (CDN, load balancing); compliance frameworks (NIST CSF, SOC 2, ISO 27001); FinOps and capacity planning; hands-on experience building or operating LLM-based agents or automations (e.g. ADK, MCP) and using AI tools in daily engineering work; service maturity / internal developer platform approach.

  • People-Centric Approach: Focus on understanding stakeholders problems and providing the best way to solve team.

  • Agile Methodologies: Experience working with agile development methodologies like Kanban or Scrum, promoting transparency and collaboration within the team.

  • Planning and Execution: Strong skills in roadmap planning, execution, and measuring engineering excellence through key metrics and KPIs.

  • Priority Management: Proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple priorities and concurrent projects effectively.

  • Cloud Services: Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or other cloud services, including technologies like Terraform and Ansible, for designing and managing scalable infrastructures.

  • Incident Management and On-call Responsibilities: Previous experience in incident management and on-call responsibilities is needed. The candidate must demonstrate strong problem-solving skills under pressure and quick responsiveness to critical situations.

Why Join Seedtag?

  • A key moment of growth with real ownership and global impact.

  • Flexible work model with 100% remote or hybrid options.
    (Remote contracts available in Spain, Italy, UK, Belgium, Netherlands, France, and Germany.)

  • Continuous learning through a learning platform and optional language classes.

  • A supportive, trust-based culture that values well-being.

  • Team activities, offsites, and opportunities to connect beyond work.

Additional Perks

  • Home office setup budget up to €1,000

  • Paid trips to our HQ in Madrid

  • MacBook Pro M3

Ready to Join the Seedtag Adventure?

At Seedtag, we create an environment where everyone can thrive. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, let us know and we’ll ensure a positive experience.

Send us your CV and let’s build the future of neuro-contextual advertising together.

jobs.description:
Connect communities. Create opportunities. Grow your career.

At Rightfiber, we're bringing the power of fiber technology to the communities we serve while creating meaningful opportunities for our employees to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join a team that's committed to innovation, exceptional service, and building stronger connections for customers, communities, and each other.

DATA ARCHITECT - REMOTE

About the Role

This remote position will define and maintain enterprise data architecture that supports business operations, integration, reporting and analytics. Will establish data models, architecture standards and roadmaps aligned with business priorities. Will provide technical direction and design oversight in partnership with implementation teams, Data Governance and Security. Will prepare data architecture to support artificial intelligence and machine learning use cases.

What You'll Do

Job duties include but are not limited to:

·Defines and maintains enterprise data architecture and roadmaps aligned with business priorities, enterprise architecture principles and technical requirements.

·Collaborates with business stakeholders, Business Analysts, Software Engineering and other technical teams to translate business requirements into data architecture and design specifications.

·Develops and maintains conceptual, logical and physical data models, including entity-relationship diagrams (ERDs), to document business entities, attributes and relationships.

·Defines authoritative data sources and cross-system identifier strategies in partnership with application owners and business data owners.

·Designs data integration patterns for movement, transformation and synchronization across systems, including batch processing and event-driven integration where appropriate.

·Defines the architecture of the Snowflake data platform, including data organization, workload design, performance and cost optimization.

·Establishes PostgreSQL data design standards and provides architectural guidance on database structures, query performance and operational requirements.

·Defines standards for schemas, naming conventions and data organization across supported platforms.

·Guides the translation of logical data models into platform-specific physical designs, working with developers and database administrators to support data integrity, performance and efficient storage.

·Defines requirements for source-to-target mappings and transformation specifications and reviews implementation designs for alignment with approved data models and business rules.

·Partners with Data Governance and business data owners to incorporate approved data definitions, ownership and governance policies into data solutions.

·Defines data quality rules, validation and reconciliation requirements and collaborates with implementation teams and business stakeholders to measure quality and resolve recurring data issues.

·Defines metadata and data lineage requirements to support data discovery, traceability and change impact analysis.

·Maintains technical data definitions and partners with business data owners and Data Governance to establish consistent business terminology.

·Partners with Security, Data Governance and platform administrators to apply approved data classifications and design appropriate access controls, encryption and data handling requirements.

·Translates approved data retention, archival and disposal policies into architecture requirements and implementation standards.

·Collaborates with DevOps and Infrastructure teams to define architectural requirements for version control, deployment, monitoring and recovery of data services.

·Reviews solution designs and vendor proposals for alignment with enterprise data architecture standards and documents material risks, dependencies and exceptions.

·Assesses the impact of proposed data changes and guides model and schema evolution while managing downstream dependencies.

·Creates and maintains data architecture documentation, standards and design decisions, including diagrams and implementation guidance.

·Provides technical leadership and knowledge transfer to developers, data teams and other stakeholders and communicates architecture concepts to technical and nontechnical audiences.

·Supports audits and compliance reviews by providing architecture documentation and evidence of alignment with approved data controls.

·Designs data architecture that supports approved artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML) and advanced analytics use cases, including requirements for data quality, lineage and controlled access.

·Evaluates emerging data technologies and practices and recommends adoption based on business value, compatibility, cost and supportability.

·Performs other related duties as assigned by management.

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

·Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology or a related field, or an equivalent combination of relevant education, training and experience.

·5+ years of experience in data architecture, data modeling, and database management

·Certifications in data architecture, database management, or related fields are a plus

Preferred Qualifications

·Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate complex issues and recommend practical solutions.

·Ability to assess architecture tradeoffs and explain their business impact, cost and long-term support implications.

·Strong facilitation and negotiation skills, with the ability to build agreement across teams and influence decisions without direct supervisory authority.

·Ability to work through ambiguity, identify gaps in requirements and make recommendations with clearly documented assumptions.

·Strong organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize competing demands and manage dependencies across initiatives.

·Experience in the telecommunications sector desirable

jobs.excerpt: We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production.
jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!

About Jaan Health / Phamily

Jaan Health is an innovative, AI-powered healthcare technology company focused on transforming proactive care management and improving patient outcomes.

Through its proprietary Phamily platform, Jaan Health enables healthcare providers, medical groups, health systems, and Accountable Care Organizations (ACOs) to deliver scalable, high-quality care management services.

Phamily leverages advanced technology and AI-enabled workflows to help providers manage chronic conditions, improve patient engagement, reduce avoidable healthcare utilization, and deliver measurable clinical and financial outcomes.

Learn more at phamily.com.

Position Overview

Jaan Health is seeking a highly experienced Lead Data Scientist specializing in Causal Inference and Clinical Outcomes Research for a flexible, remote consulting engagement.

This opportunity is ideal for a senior-level data scientist, biostatistician, health economist, or Healthcare Economics and Outcomes Research (HEOR) professional who has extensive experience evaluating the impact of healthcare interventions using real-world clinical data.

The consultant will lead the design and execution of a rigorous clinical outcomes study evaluating the effectiveness of Jaan Health's Advanced Primary Care Management (APCM) and Chronic Care Management (CCM) programs.

The primary objective is to establish statistically defensible evidence of program effectiveness, with particular emphasis on:

  • Hospitalization and Readmission Rates: Determining whether patients enrolled in care management programs experience fewer hospitalizations or readmissions.

  • Post-Discharge Follow-Up: Evaluating whether enrolled patients demonstrate improved follow-up rates after hospital discharge.

  • Clinical and Financial Outcomes: Quantifying measurable improvements in patient care, healthcare utilization, and program performance.

The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in causal inference methodologies, observational healthcare data, and advanced statistical modeling, with the ability to independently lead a high-impact analytical initiative.

This position offers significant flexibility, beginning at approximately 10–15 hours per week, with the opportunity to ramp up hours as the project progresses.

Key Responsibilities

Clinical Outcomes Research & Study Design

  • Lead the development and execution of longitudinal, quasi-experimental clinical outcomes studies.

  • Evaluate the effectiveness of APCM and CCM programs using healthcare claims and Electronic Health Record (EHR) data.

  • Establish appropriate patient cohorts, comparison groups, outcome definitions, and analytical frameworks.

  • Quantify differences in hospitalization rates, readmissions, and post-discharge follow-up outcomes.

  • Develop statistically rigorous, reproducible methodologies capable of withstanding actuarial and clinical review.

Causal Inference & Advanced Statistical Modeling

  • Apply advanced causal inference techniques to estimate the impact of healthcare interventions.

  • Utilize methodologies such as propensity score matching, inverse probability weighting, difference-in-differences, and other appropriate quasi-experimental approaches.

  • Identify and address confounding variables, selection bias, and other limitations associated with observational healthcare data.

  • Develop high-dimensional statistical matching approaches for large, complex datasets.

  • Conduct sensitivity analyses and validate the robustness of research findings.

Healthcare Data Analysis & Technical Execution

  • Analyze complex healthcare claims, EHR, and patient utilization datasets.

  • Develop and maintain analytical workflows using Python, R, and SQL.

  • Work within existing data environments that may include dbt, Amazon Redshift, and Looker.

  • Ensure data integrity, analytical reproducibility, and compliance with applicable PHI security requirements.

  • Produce well-documented analytical code and reporting assets for internal stakeholders.

Stakeholder Collaboration & Reporting

  • Collaborate directly with the Director of Business Intelligence and other internal stakeholders.

  • Engage with healthcare clients, clinical leadership, and actuarial teams to align research methodologies and outcome measures.

  • Present statistical findings and clinical outcomes in a clear, actionable format.

  • Develop executive-ready presentations, reports, and supporting documentation.

  • Translate complex analytical findings into meaningful business and clinical insights.

Vendor Deliverable Review & Knowledge Transfer

  • Review and assess analytical deliverables produced by previous external vendors.

  • Identify usable methodologies, data assets, and findings that can be incorporated into ongoing research.

  • Recommend improvements to existing analytical processes and study designs.

  • Document methodologies and transfer knowledge to the internal Business Intelligence team.

Required Qualifications

  • Extensive professional experience in data science, biostatistics, epidemiology, health economics, or clinical outcomes research.

  • Demonstrated expertise in causal inference and observational study design.

  • Proven experience evaluating healthcare interventions and measuring clinical outcomes.

  • Strong proficiency in Python, R, and SQL.

  • Experience analyzing large-scale healthcare claims and EHR datasets.

  • Deep understanding of propensity score matching, quasi-experimental research methodologies, statistical validation, and confounding adjustment.

  • Ability to independently design and execute technically sophisticated analytical studies.

  • Experience developing statistical methodologies suitable for rigorous clinical, actuarial, or external stakeholder review.

  • Strong understanding of healthcare data privacy, HIPAA, and protected health information requirements.

  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to present complex findings to nontechnical stakeholders.

  • Advanced degree in Statistics, Data Science, Biostatistics, Epidemiology, Health Economics, or a closely related quantitative discipline.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience evaluating chronic care management, population health, value-based care, or Medicare-related programs.

  • Familiarity with APCM, CCM, and healthcare reimbursement models.

  • Experience working with healthcare actuaries or validating analytical methodologies for actuarial review.

  • Knowledge of dbt, Amazon Redshift, and Looker.

  • Experience supporting health-tech startups or rapidly growing healthcare technology companies.

  • Strong consulting background with the ability to deliver results independently.

  • Experience developing executive-level clinical outcomes presentations and client-facing research reports.

Contract Details & Compensation

  • Engagement Type: 1099 independent contractor or W-2 contract.

  • Growth Opportunity: Potential to increase weekly hours as project requirements evolve.

We are looking for an experienced IT Systems Administrator / Workplace Operations Engineer to take full ownership of our internal technology infrastructure, global device fleet, and identity management across our growing, distributed team (US and India).

In this role, you will design, deploy, and maintain zero-touch device provisioning, enforce enterprise security standards, manage our SaaS application ecosystem, and deliver seamless onboarding and offboarding experiences for all team members.

4. IT Helpdesk & Internal Documentation
